The ambience stands out the moment you walk in dim lights, retro Bollywood posters, and a fun filmy vibe all around.The staff is also very helpful and polite, which makes the place feel even more welcoming.

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Shine Kitchen is a hidden gem for delicious and freshly prepared food. The moment you enter, you’re greeted with a clean and welcoming atmosphere. The interiors are simple yet cozy, and the seating is arranged in a way that feels comfortable whether you’re dining alone, with family, or friends.

The menu has a good variety — from Indian curries and breads to Chinese dishes and snacks. I tried their Chicken Handi with butter naan, and it was outstanding — rich, flavorful gravy with perfectly cooked chicken pieces. The spices were well-balanced, and the taste was truly satisfying.

For starters, their chicken crispy and paneer chilli are highly recommended — fresh, crunchy, and full of flavor. The fried rice and Hakka noodles also tasted authentic and paired perfectly with the gravies.

The staff here is polite, attentive, and quick in serving orders. Even when the place is busy, the service remains smooth and the food arrives hot and fresh. I also appreciate their focus on hygiene and cleanliness, which is very noticeable.

The portion sizes are generous, making it great value for money. The prices are reasonable, and the quality of ingredients is clearly top-notch. Packaging for takeaways is neat and spill-proof, so the food stays fresh even when you carry it home.

Overall, Shine Kitchen is the perfect place for anyone looking for tasty, well-cooked meals with friendly service and a pleasant dining experience. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1}, time_line=a month ago, review=I had buy chocolate cherry cake and the quality, taste was so pathetic. The cake is so rough from inside ., name_person=supriya kokare}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Chocolate_Truffle, Belgium_Chocolate_Large], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Delivery, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Not_sure, E:NOT_SURE], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN]}, time_line=Edited 6 months ago, review=I have been buying cakes from Baker's Treat since 15 years and have always felt that the quality of their cakes is comparable to some high end bakery brands. It still remains a relatively small shop which along with cakes and pastries sells chips, bread sticks, bread, buns and other bakery products. I have found their Dutch and Chocolate truffle cakes to be extremely tasty and rich. Many bakeries stuff chocolate cakes with cream. But here truffle cakes are made of dense fudgy chocolate and that makes them taste heavenly. I did not find their black forest cake to be upto the mark though. It was extremely creamy with no biscuity base. All their cakes are vegetarian. Their home delivery has also been reliable over the years.

The one thing that can be improved is the customer service. The guys at the counter are always unsmiling and uncommunicative. A more polite and friendlier approach would help., name_person=Vijayshri}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1}, time_line=11 months ago, review=I had the most disappointing and frustrating experience with Baker’s Treat. I placed an order for a custom cake for my grandfather’s 80th birthday, a once-in-a-lifetime event, and trusted them to deliver what they promised. I shared the design in advance and repeatedly emphasized how important this occasion was. They assured me they would create the exact design and deliver it on time, yet they completely failed on every front.
1. Despite multiple follow-ups and my clear instructions to contact me if there were any issues, they failed to communicate. They did not even share a photo of the completed cake, as I had requested.
2. The cake that arrived was an absolute disaster. It looked nothing like the design I provided. The quality was atrocious—oily liquid was leaking from it, the design was pathetic, and it tasted terrible.
3. After this horrible experience, I visited their shop and checked their kitchen. It was filthy beyond words. The utensils were unclean, the staff didn’t wear gloves, and the entire kitchen, including the floors and refrigerator, was disgusting. I recorded a video of this unhygienic setup, and I strongly urge everyone to stay away from this place.

I don’t know which government body granted them an FSSAI license because their kitchen fails to meet even basic hygiene standards. Their license should be canceled immediately, and the local police and health authorities must take strict action against them. This level of negligence is unacceptable, and they are putting public health at risk.

If Baker’s Treat cannot handle custom orders, they should be upfront about it instead of ruining someone’s special occasion. Their negligence completely ruined what was supposed to be a joyous celebration for my grandfather’s milestone birthday.

To anyone considering ordering from them: Don’t make the mistake I did. This place does not deserve your trust or money. They lack professionalism, hygiene, and basic respect for their customers. I will never order from them again, and I hope others don’t have to go through what I did., name_person=Vansh Khandelwal}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Delivery}, time_line=7 months ago, review=For a small bakery they are doing really good… however they have a long way to go when it comes to taste…, name_person=Nivea Navjot Kaur}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Takeaway, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Chocolate_Celebration_Large], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1}, time_line=3 months ago, review=I had a very disappointing experience and I feel it’s important to share it so others are aware.
The cakes here might look tempting, but the reality is far from satisfying. What I noticed is that the cakes are deliberately soaked in an excessive amount of sugar syrup, which not only ruins the texture and taste but also artificially increases the weight. This is a very unfair practice because customers end up paying more for sugar water than for actual cake.
The sponge turns soggy, overly sweet, and loses any natural flavor it might have had. Instead of enjoying a fresh, fluffy cake, you’re left with something heavy, sticky, and unpleasant. On top of that, it feels like a clear attempt to mislead customers by inflating the cake’s weight just to charge more, name_person=Ubaid d}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Belgium_Chocolate_Large], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Takeaway, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=a year ago, review=I ordered a cake from here, and it was delivered on time. However, since delivery isn’t available, you’ll need to pick it up yourself. As for the Belgium chocolate cake, it was absolutely amazing and fresh. Both my family and I loved it!, name_person=Sejal S Mahadik}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=Edited 5 months ago, review=A big thank you to Baker's Treat for the absolutely wonderful birthday cake they made for our daughter’s birthday party!

She’s a huge space enthusiast and had her heart set on a space-themed cake - complete with a space shuttle, planets, and stars. I had shared a reference design and honestly wasn’t sure how it would turn out. But when the cake arrived, we were blown away. It was beautifully crafted, full of thoughtful details, and perfectly matched the theme. Our daughter’s eyes lit up the moment she saw it!

And of course, the cake wasn’t just a treat for the eyes - it was delicious too. Moist, flavourful, and thoroughly enjoyed by both kids and adults alike.

Thank you again to the talented team at Baker's Treat for adding that special sparkle to our celebration. Highly recommended for anyone looking for creativity, taste, and heart all in one cake! 🚀🌟🎂, name_person=Anand Raj}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Takeaway}, time_line=4 months ago, review=I had a terrible experience with Baker’s Treat. I placed an order for my sister’s farewell cake (salted caramel) and when I called to check on the delivery, they casually informed me that the cake was never prepared. This completely ruined an important day for us. As it is, they have only one cake that tastes decent, so I wasn’t willing to take any alternative they offered. Extremely unprofessional and unreliable … will not be ordering from them again., name_person=hannan kashmiri}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Good place to have cakes , pastries veg patties.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Their pizza base is quite good for homemade pizzas and are reasonable priced.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Baker's Treat offers freshly baked and tasty cakes and other bakery stuff.}"]

We visited the restaurant around 3 PM and were initially greeted by the service staff, who recommended the Paneer Hilltop starter. We placed our order for both the starter and main course. About 10 minutes later, the staff returned to inform us that the tandoor was about to close and that our order would take at least an hour. We were okay with waiting, but then he immediately told us we wouldn’t get the starter at all.

Already quite hungry, we decided to proceed with just the main course and ordered a mocktail as well. The staff then said he’d need to check if the mocktail was even available — which added to our frustration. He returned after a few minutes and confirmed it was available.

What made the experience worse was that even after closing the tandoor, they continued allowing new customers to enter. The lounge is located inside Palm Beach Galleria Mall, Sector 19D, Vashi, Navi Mumbai – on the rooftop, just like other popular spots in the building.

The total bill came to ₹6688 (including taxes). Here’s what we ordered:

2 Butter Rotis – ₹109 each
1 Butter Chicken – ₹669
5 Butter Naans – ₹99 each
1 Cheesy Fries – ₹384
3 Fresh Lime Sodas – ₹210 each
1 Hakka Noodles – ₹428
1 Murg Tikka Masala – ₹637
1 Non-Veg Platter – ₹1499
3 Virgin Mojitos – ₹440 each
1 Water Bottle – ₹90

The ambience was nice, and although they had live music, it hadn’t started by the time we were there, so we missed out on that part of the experience. Still, the setting was good for a small group celebration.

The food quality was very nice, and everyone at the table enjoyed what was served. Service was decent, and the overall vibe of the place felt modern and chill.

However, the one major disappointment was the pricing of the water bottle — ₹90 for a Bisleri bottle with MRP of ₹20 felt extremely unnecessary and overpriced. For larger groups, these small add-ons can become an unpleasant surprise on the final bill. That part definitely felt like a setback.

The place is otherwise well-suited for small group dinners, celebrations, and casual evenings. The seating is spacious, and the rooftop layout adds to the experience.

Overall, I’d say it was a good time with friends — food and setting were on point, but small things like inflated water prices take away from the experience.

reviews:
["{guided_block={}, time_line=Edited 7 years ago, review=Sofitel Wine Days are back! This is held on a monthly basis at The Sofitel Mumbai BKC and I was lucky to be a part of one at Le Bar Diamantaire, located at lobbey level next to Pondicherry Cafe!

A sit down multi course Italian meal with Italian wine is what you witness! An experience unparalleled. Sofitel has always been my one of the most favourite places in Mumbai because of the numerous festivals they do. But the food tried at this event was one of the best that I have ever had!

Every course had its own wine, started with couple of white and finishing with couple of red! All the wines had been specially curated and imported and the food also complemented really well. You have Veg as well as Non Veg options, so one can choose accordingly. Talking about what all I tried at Sofitel Wine Days -

We began with Almond and Goat Cheese as Starters, had Zucchini, Avocado and Mustard Sauce. The non veg equivalent to this was Amaranth Prawns. This was served with the first wine of the evening - Villa Antinori Bianco - white wine. A perfect way to begin your meal! The wine aims at maximizing the Tuscan character of the wine and is straw yellow in colour with greenish highlights. It is still wine with approx 12% alcohol by volume.

Next in line we tried the Forest Mushroom Veloute which was Truffle Mousse, Pine nuts and brioche. Absolutely awesome and I loved the taste! Texture was thick and rich in flavour and aroma. This was served with the second white wine of the evening - Antinori Santa Cristina Pinot Grigio. The wine is straw yellow in colour, the wine offers fruity and delicate aromas of pineapple, green apples and lemon. The wine is refreshing and has approx 12% alcohol by volume.

Moving to the mains - we first had the Baked Courgette which was Duxelle, Edamame and Parmesan Risotto! Again an awesome dish for Mushroom lovers. This was served along with the first red wine of the evening - Antinori Santa Cristina Toscana. For non vegetarians there was Grilled Seabass (Risotto). Wine is a red wine from Toscana, Italy and has approx 12.5% alcohol by volume.

Next main dish was Grilled Polenta which had red lentil ragout, charred leek, fondant potato and caramlised onion straw! A filling dish and really good! I preferred Polenta more than Baked Courgette! This one was served along with Antinori Peppoli Chianti Classico, the last wine / 2nd red wine of the evening. Non veg equivalent was Braised Lamb Shank with same ingredients. The wine represents the Chianti Classico territory and it's historic grape variety with typical floral and fruity aromas. Wine has approx 13% alcohol by volume.

We ended our meal with one of the most amazing desserts - Berry Trail. It had Raspberry Parfait, Blueberry Jelly, Blackberry Chantilly, Oats Crumble and Berry Chocolate Crisps. One of the best dessert that I have had till date! Simply awesome.

In complete awe of the experience at Sofitel Mumbai BKC! As mentioned earlier, they keep doing #sofitelwinedays often, almost every month and I would highly recommend everyone including all wine connoisseurs!, name_person=Jatin Shah}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=7 years ago, review=Sofitel BKC  has been our favourite hub to enjoy some family times , thanks to their Festivals which they organise with great enthusiasm .

This time it was our time to be a part of their Italian Fiesta Festival at Le Bar Diamantaire which was in collaboration with Ferrari Mumbai .

Le Bar has a Classy Ambience and flaunts to be one of the rare restaurant in Mumbai having a Wine Tower of its own . What will amaze you more is the food they serve which is just too good to be missed .

Lastly Not to Forget the Red Beauty ie Ferrari standing at the door step of the Sofitel.

Let's straight move on to what all we savoured out here during our visit .

Appetizers :

Bruschetta :
An amazing start to a classy evening . Crisp bread with luscious Topping ....

Arracini Balls :
Hot balls having a Scrummy peas based stuffing .

Polenta :
Boiled Cornmeal served with a tasty mushrooms preparation served along side .

Mains :

Cannelloni :
An immaculately presented dish with spinach Cannelloni served with Salsa Rosa . This a definite must to enjoy delicacy of the outlet .

Lasagna :
Again a super delicious dish straight from the treasure box of chef special delicacy of the outlet .

Mocktails :

We went for our all time favourite classic Mocktails during our visit . Mojito ,  Shikanji and Blue Curacao were amongst the Favourites .

Dessert:

Tiramisu :
After a very long time we really enjoyed our most beloved dessert at this super cool place .

Zucotto :
Now that's a dessert for which we will visit the place soon again . Just don't miss on this the moment you are going for dessert out here . Outer coating of chocolate Creamy pastry stuffed with freezing cold icecream and fruits .

Do visit the Italian  Food Fiesta  at Le Bar Diamantaire  Sofitel  before 21st  June  2018 to have a great experience as we did.

Thanks for reading my detailed review ., name_person=Mithil Thakker}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Me and my friend asked if they could make us a strawberry Daquiri, They Said yes. reviews: ["{\"name_person\":\"vishal sawant\",\"time_line\":\"a month ago\",\"review\":\"I recently visited Farzi Caf\u00e9 at Oberoi Mall, and it was a delightful dining experience overall. Right in the middle of Social and Pizza Express.\\nI had been to their Gurgaon (Cyber Hub) outlet and I had liked the food there. So quietly went in for lunch on a weekday.\\nThe Restaurant was relatively empty with handful of customers.\\nTheir starters (Prawn and Chicken) both tasted really good, highlighted more by the presentation.\\nThe Biriyani was good too, but was a bit too spicy for my taste.\\nService was a bit slow.\\nHowever because of the food, I might still visit them once more!\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE\":\"\u20b91,800\u20132,000\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":4,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":4,\"GUIDED_DINING_RESERVATION\":\"Walk-ins only\",\"GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL\":\"Quiet, easy to talk\",\"GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME\":\"No wait\",\"GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS\":\"Somewhat recommend\",\"GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO\":[\"Vegetarian_menu_or_section\",\"E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION\"],\"GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS\":[\"Vegetarian_options\",\"E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS\"]}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Suyash Karangutkar\",\"time_line\":\"5 months ago\",\"review\":\"Farzi Caf\u00e9 lived up to its reputation of blending Indian flavors with modern culinary imagination. Our recent visit was a delightful experience that hit the right notes, not just in taste but in atmosphere and service too.\\n\\nWe began our meal with the Sweet Corn Soup with Cornflakes Churan and Herbs. This was no ordinary corn soup\u2014it was comforting, delicately spiced, and full of character. The corn kernels added texture, while the cornflakes and herb seasoning gave the broth a refreshing twist, balanced perfectly with coriander. A warm, flavorful start that set the tone for the rest of the meal.\\n\\nNext came the Chicken Thukpa with Ramen Noodles, Chicken Dumpling, in Truffle Oil. This fusion take on the classic Himalayan dish was mellow yet richly flavored. The dumplings were tender, the noodles soaked in the mildly spiced broth, and the touch of truffle oil added a subtle umami depth. The half-boiled egg was a nice touch.\\n\\nThe Salli Boti Bao was a creative surprise\u2014soft, open bao buns filled with spicy, well-marinated mutton boti, drenched in a desi-style gravy and topped with crispy potato salli. A clever and satisfying bite with layers of flavor and texture.\\n\\nFor drinks, we tried the F.B., a self-proclaimed \u2018Farzified\u2019 bong-style cocktail. It was quite the mix\u2014vodka, gin, rum, peach pur\u00e9e, and cranberry juice, rounded off with a jelly syrup that gave it a playful sweetness.\\n\\nWe also sampled the Litchi Panna Desire, a refreshing blend of lychee, lime, and mango panna, which was equal parts tart and tropical.\\n\\nFor the main course, we went traditional with the Saag Paneer Tarkari, paired with Meethi Laccha Paratha. The saag, a hearty combination of spinach, mustard greens, chopped vegetables, and crisp-edged paneer cubes, was rich and earthy. ["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_PARKING_LOT, Free_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_STREET_PARKING, Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET, Free_parking_garage, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_PARKING_GARAGE], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO, Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Clearly_labeled_vegetarian_dishes, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS]}, time_line=Edited a month ago, review=Visited Onrique for dinner and was truly blown away by the entire experience. They’ve recently launched their European Exclusive Menu, and every dish I tried was packed with flavour, beautifully presented, and crafted with real passion. From the Chicken, Potato & Leeks Soup to the Gambas al Aglio, Crisp Fried Chicken, Rigatoni, and the outstanding Coq au Vin with Herbed Pilaf Rice, everything tasted premium and thoughtfully curated.

The vibe of the place is stunning with indoor, outdoor, and rooftop seating, each corner has its own charm. What really stood out was their hospitality. The staff is polite, professional, and extremely attentive. I even experienced their unique chocolate hand wash ritual, which made the evening feel so special and luxurious.

Their drinks were another highlight especially Mango Fizz, Essence of Guava, Smoke & Oak, and The Royal Wedding all beautifully prepared right at the table.

Ended the meal with their in-house signature Tiramisu, and it was a treat not just to eat but to watch, as the chef prepares it live at your table. They have six varieties, and both the Sesame and Biscoff versions were outstanding.

A big thanks to Faizan Shaikh , the chefs, mixologists, and the entire team for taking such amazing care of everything.
Onrique isn’t just a restaurant it’s a complete dining experience that you will truly remember. Highly recommended!, name_person=ABHITHEFOODIE}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a week ago, review=Had a lovely experience at Onrique. The ambience is classy yet cozy, perfect for a relaxed evening. The cocktails were well-crafted, and the food was on point — especially the Avocado Tartare, Alpine Spätzle and Skillet Vegetables.
A special mention to Allan for the warm service and Ashay at the bar for the excellent cocktails. Overall, a great spot in Bandra that’s definitely worth visiting., name_person=Mona Juneja}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,600–1,800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=a month ago, review=A breezy rooftop, beautiful ambience and food that actually lives up to the vibe. Onrique was the perfect place for a date night! The ambience feels really warm and aesthetic. Perfect for a relaxed dinner, good conversations and some great food.

Here’s everything we tried:

Chicken & Charred Zucchini (Recommended)

A thin crust authentic Italian Pizza with smoky charred zucchini, juicy chicken and perfect balance of cheese. Light, crisp and flavour-packed.

Gambas Al Ajilio

An absolute treat consisting of plump and buttery prawns swimming in a garlicky olive oil base alongside toasted garlic bread. The taste really stood out.

Crispy Fried Chicken

Golden, crunchy and really soft inside, it was some well seasoned chunks of fried chicken. Loved it totally.

Rigatoni Alfredo Chicken Pasta

Pasta in creamy sauce with add-on chicken. Much like a comfort food that we really enjoyed having.

Onrique’s Tiramisu

Our favourite tiramisu with a pinch of espresso that gives it the bold and rich kick. A very light dessert to end a hearty meal.

For drinks we had Peach Iced Tea that was quite refreshing and Tropicana Breeze that was a fruity, tropical cooler.

Overall, Onrique gives you a beautiful rooftop setting, warm service and genuinely good food.
Definitely a place we’d come back to!, name_person=The Hogger Bloggers}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Onrique completely exceeded my expectations! The ambience is elegant yet cozy, and the live music during brunch made the whole experience even more special. Every dish was beautifully presented and full of flavor from the grilled peach panzanella and avocado tartare to the pinsa romana, roasted cauliflower, and those heavenly desserts (coffee tiramisu, tiramisu, and panna cotta!).
A special mention to Shrikant, who was incredibly helpful and attentive throughout our visit ..his recommendations were spot on!
Onrique is the perfect blend of great food, classy vibes, and warm service., name_person=Tanvi Yamsanwar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=2 months ago, review=I had heard about this place in Bandra so thought of giving it a try for my birthday. There were 2 floors with an amazing view. We went for an early dinner. We ordered Korean chicken, Mama meat pizza, and vegetable khow suey. We liked the food except the pizza.
The ambience was sea facing with a sunset view. We were feeling a little cold and they gave us shawls. Overall it was a good experience., name_person=Harleen Suri}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=Onrique in Santacruz turned out to be such a delightful surprise. The ambience strikes the perfect balance between chic and comfortable, making it ideal for both a relaxed meal and a night out with friends. The service deserves a special mention — the staff is attentive, warm and invested in ensuring you have a great experience. Overall, Onrique feels like one of those neighbourhood gems you’re glad to discover and even happier to return to., name_person=Foodofmumbaii}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Nights at Onrique Mumbai hit different ✨ From mouth-watering food and chic interiors to a rooftop that sets the mood just right 🌆🍸 The ambiance is classy, the vibes are elite, and every moment here feels like a celebration❤️🍻, name_person=Pratik Asnani}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=8 months ago, review=Onrique – Bar Boulangerie Bistro, located on Linking Road, Santacruz West, Mumbai, offers a chic and immersive dining experience that seamlessly blends European elegance with contemporary flair.​ The restaurant is divided into two distinct sections - Ac section on 12th floor greets patrons by an enchanting Provençal-inspired luncheonette. The interiors feature hand-painted murals and a mirrored ceiling that amplifies the vibrant atmosphere, creating an inviting space for relaxed conversations. ​Ascending to the rooftop on 14th floor, the ambiance transforms into a serene French countryside garden. The open-air setting is adorned with stained glass details, a pergola ceiling and al fresco seating offering panoramic views of the Mumbai skyline. This elevated space is perfect for evening sundowners and romantic dates. ​
Onrique's menu blends European and Asian influences, with standout dishes such as
• Falafel Wraps
• Pan Seared Vegetable Dumpling
• Chips & Dips Platter
• Vegetarian Donburri
• Skillet Cookie
Each dish is a journey of textures and colors, artfully plated with creativity. Each experience is crafted to linger long after the taste fades, leaving behind memories woven with flavours and beauty. Onrique is renowned for its innovative cocktails, including
• Glow in Dark gin cocktail - A visually striking drink that glows under UV light.
• Royal Wedding - Served in a porcelain teacup, this cocktail offers a regal touch.
• Melon & Mint Spritz - A refreshing blend.
Cocktail's offers a truly exceptional and
unparalleled experience that captures the essence of French Riviera. Through a combination of traditional and modern
mixology Onrique has created a truly one -of-Kind experience that caters to every mood and drives. Staff members are very polite and friendly like Faizan for their helpfulness and food recommendatons. Whether you're seeking a romantic dinner, a lively night out, or a serene brunch with city views, Onrique offers a versatile and memorable dining experence., name_person=Bhavin Parekh}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Onrique is the perfect blend of great food, classy vibes, and warm service.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=We ordered Korean chicken, Mama meat pizza, and vegetable khow suey.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=We got Spaghetti pasta and pizza for kids and sliders and dumplings for me.}"]

Since it is located on a Height, there are a few steps to climb up to reach its entrance, but no ramp has been provided, so you need to carry your bags up the steps, which can be a bit difficult if you are travelling with heavy bags. There are 2 Stylish Wash Basins as well, but the Washroom is situated on the Road Level below, so you need to go outside and use the Steps to go there. Location: 2nd Floor, Customer Square, C K Narar Marg, Shivaji Park, Dadar West, Mumbai

We were a group of 10 looking for an indulgent seafood and coastal meal in Mumbai and Coast & Bloom delivered beyond expectations. With a modern, minimalistic ambience and a menu that is curated Malvani inspirations and there were some mains like Chettinad, konkani and goan, this spot is perfect for both celebrations and leisurely meals.

What We Ordered

Our feast included a fantastic mix of seafood, meats, and sides:

- Crab Kakori

- Shallow Fried Malvani Bombil

- Chicken Chilli

- Chicken Malvani Masala

- Prawns Bhujane

- APC Pomfret & APC Crab

- Pasta Arrabiata for kids

- Rice Bhakri, Ghavane, Wade

- Solkadi

Everything was rich, flavorful, and well-prepared, especially the seafood, which was fresh and cooked to perfection.

Service Excellence

Special shout-out to Chandani, Chandan, and Roshan, they took exceptional care of us from start to finish. For a table of 10, the service was quick, warm, and always attentive. They made excellent suggestions and ensured every dietary need was handled with care.

Price & Value

Medium to high priced considering the generous portions and seafood quality. Value for money for group dining with great ambiance.

-Verdict

A must-visit for seafood lovers and anyone wanting a coastal food experience with a modern twist. Great food, warm staff, and a classy yet cozy vibe., name_person=Tanmay Ayare}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=In a re-developed part of Dadar I'd never been to, a restaurant based on the interesting concept of coastal cuisines.

reviews:

The place has a neat and pleasant vibe – not overly fancy, but very comfortable and welcoming. What stood out immediately was the behavior of the staff. They were extremely polite, attentive, and always ready to serve with a smile, which instantly gives a positive feeling.

We started off with Crispy Veg and Cheese Cigar as starters, along with a bowl of Veg Soup. The Crispy Veg was crunchy, fresh, and spiced just right – perfect for a starter. The Cheese Cigar, on the other hand, was absolutely delightful. It had a crisp outer layer and a soft, cheesy filling inside that was creamy and satisfying. The Veg Soup balanced things well – light, flavorful, and very comforting. Together, these starters set the tone for a great meal ahead.

For the main course, we ordered Paneer Rajwari and Chana Masala, paired with Garlic Naan and Cheese Naan. The Paneer Rajwari was rich and creamy, with perfectly cooked paneer pieces that were soft and fresh. The Chana Masala was equally impressive – well-cooked chickpeas with a flavorful, homestyle taste that paired wonderfully with the naans. Both Garlic and Cheese naans were fresh, soft, and enhanced the taste of the gravies beautifully.

One of the highlights of Veggies Annex is the balance between quality and price. The portion sizes were generous, the flavors were authentic, and the pricing was very reasonable compared to the quality they serve. It’s not easy to find a place that offers good food, great service, and fair prices all together, but Veggies Annex manages to do it perfectly.

Overall, it turned out to be a memorable dinner experience. This restaurant is definitely worth recommending – whether you’re going out with family, friends, or even for a casual dinner, Veggies Annex will leave you satisfied. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SEATING_TYPE=[Indoor_dining_area, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_INDOOR_DINING_AREA, Bar_area, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_BAR_AREA], GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Not sure, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION, Clearly_labeled_vegetarian_dishes, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS]}, time_line=2 weeks ago, review=SAZ in BKC is one of those places that instantly wraps you in its warm, modern brasserie vibe the moment you walk in. With its chic interiors, dim-gold lighting and a playlist that feels curated for good moods, it’s the perfect blend of classy and comfortable — the kind of place you can go for a cosy brunch, a fun dinner date, or post-work cocktails that turn into long conversations.

The menu leans into American comfort with a gourmet twist, and almost everything that lands on the table has the “I want to take a picture first” aesthetic. Think bold flavours, generous portions, and dishes that balance indulgence with finesse.

From small plates to mains, every dish has its own personality — nothing bland, nothing boring. Their ingredients taste fresh, execution is neat, and the flavours hit that satisfying spot without being overly heavy.

The cocktails deserve their own chapter. SAZ is known for its bar game, and it shows — well-balanced drinks, interesting mixes, and something for every palate. Whether you like punchy, fruity, smoky or spirit-forward, you won’t feel short of options.

Service is smooth, attentive and friendly without being in-your-face. The staff actually knows the menu and recommends things based on what you like, not just what’s trending.

Overall, SAZ BKC is the perfect spot when you want a guaranteed good time — amazing food, great drinks, a stylish ambience and a vibe that feels both lively and relaxed. It’s the kind of place you walk out of thinking, “Yep, we’re coming back.”, name_person=khanapina. in}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Brunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Very loud, hard to hear, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Clearly_labeled_vegetarian_dishes, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS]}, time_line=Edited a week ago, review=First the good.

The service is excellent. Especially Sneha who was attentive & nice:

The cheesy cauliflower was surprisingly good

The fried burrata was nice though the balsamic reduction made the dish a little seeet which one didn’t like but that’s a personal choice I guess.

The chicken scallopini was okay. The saffron rice was incredible but the meat itself was covered in too much gravy for it to shine.

The star of the show was the desert. Chocolate berries and nuts. It looked a little gross in the presentation but the taste was sublime with the dark chocolate being a perfect counterpoint for the tart raspberry sorbet. Perfection on a plate.

The not so good

The verdure pizza was boring and tasteless. Had to dunk it in a lot of olive oil to get some kind of flavour.

The pesto pinwheel was horrible. Too much bread. Too little veggies and pesto. It was dry and frankly the presentation was better than the dish.

The really bad

The music is so loud on a Saturday afternoon that you have to scream to call out for your server making all conversations virtually impossible.

All in all. I would come here again. Maybe for the dessert and the service. For all else head to other restaurants in the complex., name_person=Lavanya Anand}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Chic ambience with stylish interiors and cozy seating at Jio World Drive.

I had tried to get a table here a few months ago and as it was a weekend, it was packed with waiting time upwards of 60 mins.

I was lucky to get a table on diwali. Our original booking was for 9.30pm. We got there a little early and were easily accommodated by the hostess at around 8.45pm.

The menu is short with a few veg options. The server was quick and good with recommendations. We decided to go for their house speciality, guacamole which was well presented in pestle and mortar, freshly made. It came with nacho chips, salsa, sour cream and cheese sauce. The quantity of nacho chips should be more, we had to order an extra portion of it. It was definitely delicious.

For mains, we had the burrata pizza was fantastic. Special thanks to the server for recommending the risotto with spicy tomato sauce, it was tangy and perfect.

We were trying to avoid sugar hence had to skip the dessert. Would definitely want to try  a couple of dishes on my next visit.

According to me, the avg. price of a dish was a bit on higher side. Portion quantity could have been more to justify the price.

The ambience was uplifting and energetic. The lights were slightly dimmed after 9pm and music became more audible.

For future visits, i would check for dine in discounts on swiggy/zomato dineout., name_person=Darsh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Paid_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_PAID_PARKING_LOT], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Not sure, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=5 months ago, review=SAZ is one of the best American Dinners I have come across during my visits in Mumbai. name: Tiger Tiger Lounge - Mulund
reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=4 months ago, review=⭐ 4.5/5 – Mulund’s Only Pure Veg Lounge with Jain Options & Live DJ!

If you’re in Mulund and looking for a pure vegetarian lounge experience, Tiger Tiger Lounge is an absolute must-visit! The vibe here is electric, with a Live DJ every evening setting the perfect mood to chill or party.

What we tried:
•	Surgical Strike 2 – A unique, fiery starter packed with flavors.
•	Paneer Hot Chilli Basil – The paneer was soft and perfectly spiced; a complete winner!
•	Oriental Bowl – Comfort food at its best, loaded with flavors.
•	Cheesy Garlic Naan – Buttery, cheesy, and an absolute delight.
•	Chocolate Walnut Brownie with Ice Cream – A sizzling, chocolatey end to our meal.
•	Mocktails: Cinderella & Candy Kiss – Refreshing and picture-perfect.

What makes this place stand out:
•	100% Pure Veg Menu with Jain food options – a big plus for vegetarians.
•	2+1 on mocktails and cocktails (Mon–Thu) – a crazy good deal!
•	Trendy ambiance with spacious seating and great lighting.
•	Attentive and courteous staff who make the dining experience smooth., name_person=Rohit}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=4 months ago, review=⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
📍 Location: Mulund
🎶 Ambience: Absolutely luxurious! The vibe was on point with dim lights, plush seating, and live music that totally elevated the whole experience. It felt like a mini getaway — perfect spot for hanging out with friends, a cozy family dinner, or even a first date. Major vibe check ✅

🍽️ Now coming to the food... we ordered so much just in starters that we were full already!
Each dish was packed with flavor, beautifully presented, and honestly, tasted heavenly.
Here’s what we tried:

🔥 Honey Chilly Lotus Stem – crispy, spicy, and a little sweet – perfect balance

🌿 Hara Bhara Tikki – soft, flavorful, and made just right

🧆 Veg Seekh Kebabs – juicy with a nice smoky touch

🧀 Cheese Cigar – crunchy on the outside, cheesy explosion inside

🌮 Mexican Paneer Tacos – great fusion
dish, tangy and tasty

🍘 PNR Kurkure – super crunchy and spicy, totally unique!

💥 Surgical Strike 2 – spicy, fiery, and a must-try for the brave hearts 😄

💯 Taste: Truly felt like a “once-in-a-lifetime” kind of experience – rich, bold, and unforgettable flavors.
✨ Final Verdict:
If you’re looking for a place with great ambience, mind-blowing food, and a memorable vibe – this is the place. Highly recommended for anyone who loves good food and great times. We tried their Signature Surgical Strike 2, Cheese Cigars, Nachos, and Paneer Kurkure — food was fresh & delicious !!

The mocktails were refreshing and beautifully presented !!

They have a DJ every night & Live Performing Artists on Wednesday & Friday !!

Honestly, it was a refreshing experience and definitely worth the money. The drink had a smooth coffee base, with a subtle hazelnut flavor that blended really well without being overpowering. The sweetness was balanced just right—not too sugary, not too bitter—making it a great choice for anyone who enjoys a flavored coffee that still tastes like coffee.

The portion size for the regular cup felt adequate and satisfying. The ice-to-coffee ratio was perfect, so the drink stayed chilled and refreshing till the last sip without feeling watered down. Presentation-wise, it looked simple but inviting.

Apart from the drink, the café itself had a calm and comfortable vibe, which made the experience even better. Service was quick, and the staff was polite and efficient. The prices are slightly premium compared to other coffee chains, but given the taste and overall quality, I feel it justifies the cost.

Overall a good place., name_person=Florence Vegas}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Would not recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS]}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Absolutely horrible experience! We visited this restaurant last night and specifically ordered only vegetarian food. We reminded the waiter four times to ensure everything was strictly vegetarian — yet, to our shock, we found chicken pieces in our dish!

As vegetarians, this was extremely upsetting and completely unacceptable. To make matters worse, they also overcharged us by ₹400–₹500. When we called to report this, the manager on duty (Shubham) gave an absurd excuse, claiming we ourselves brought the chicken piece and added it to the dish! After that, he stopped responding to our calls.

Getting any sort of compensation was never the concern the issue is hygiene, honesty and respect for customers dietary beliefs.

This kind of negligence and behavior is beyond unprofessional — it’s deeply offensive to vegetarians and raises serious concerns about their kitchen hygiene and honesty.

We are deeply disappointed and will be taking further legal action against the restaurant for serving non-vegetarian food despite clear instructions and for their false accusations.

Vegetarians, please avoid this place at all costs!, name_person=darshan shah}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Despite telling them multiple times that we only wanted pure vegetarian food, and even requesting them to please be careful and not serve us non-veg even by mistake, we still found a piece of chicken in our biryani. It was literally 3 a.m., and we had to argue with them for almost 45 minutes. Their attitude was so casuaal they just said, “kya kar sakte hai, ho gaya humse, dusri lelo, not a big issue.” Extremely disappointing and irresponsible!, name_person=Neha Yadav}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[9+_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_NINE_OR_MORE], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=Up to 10 min}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Never visit - served non-veg in a veg order, manager lied & overcharged in bill.

We are lifelong vegetarians and clearly told the waiter multiple times (4–8 reminders) that our biryani must be vegetarian - including guests who do not eat onion/garlic.  We were 17 of us. Mid-meal we discovered a piece of chicken in the veg biryani. This is a severe hygiene and religious violation. We complained to the manager who reacted with laughter, shrugged it off as “a mistake” and made light of the situation. That response was offensive and unprofessional.

To make matters worse, when we paid the bill we later discovered an extra ₹700–₹800 added without explanation. When we called the manager about the unauthorized charge today, he accused us of planting the chicken, refused to investigate, and told us to “do whatever you want.” This is blatant dishonesty and extremely disrespectful to customers.

Do not risk your health, religion or money here. I’m reporting this to consumer and food safety authorities and will be taking further action. Serving European dishes, it’s fine dining that’s homely, cozy and heartwarmingly delicious.

Appetizers
⭐️ The Togarashi Fries were the perfect start to the meal. Crisp and golden, these fries came dusted with a Japanese spice blend, paired beautifully with a creamy kimchi mayo that added a tangy kick.

⭐️ The Gnocchi was a revelation—soft, pillowy potato dumplings seared to perfection and bathed in a zesty lemongrass infused corn sauce.

Mains
⭐️ The Tortellini was, without doubt, the star of the evening. These delicate, house-made pasta pillows, filled with creamy ricotta and roasted water chestnuts, melted in my mouth. The Dijon and Cognac sauce added a luxurious richness, making this dish truly unforgettable.
⭐️ The Fagotini was another standout, with pasta filled with amaranth and goat cheese, enveloped in a rich, velvety red wine sauce. The dish had a perfect harmony of earthy flavours.

Desserts :
⭐️ For dessert, the popular Starry Night was a piece of edible art. The creamy custard, layered with white chocolate mousse, musk melon chunks, and passionfruit jelly, was a delightful medley of textures and flavors. Its presentation was just as impressive as its taste.
⭐️ The Cacao Leaf, a layered chocolate cake with raspberry compote, was decadent and rich, offering the perfect balance of sweet and tart. A treat for every chocolate lover!

Luv Restaurant impressed me with its thoughtful flavors and elegant presentation. The Tortellini, in particular, will remain a favorite.

The biggest issue was the service — we had to repeat the same order to multiple staff members before it was finally taken. The team seems understaffed and not well-trained, which really affects the dining experience.

name: Kaffee Nostalgic
reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Kaffee Nostalgic in Vashi truly lives up to its name! The moment you walk in, the rustic wooden interiors, old-school games, and warm aroma of freshly baked treats instantly bring back nostalgic memories. It’s a cozy, comforting space that feels straight out of the good old days.

We visited to try their new 100% pure veg, homemade Strawberry Menu, and it genuinely impressed us. Everything is made from scratch using quality ingredients—no preservatives, no palm oil—just pure flavour.

Our top picks:
•	Strawberry Tres Leches – stole our hearts in the very first bite. Soft, creamy, and absolutely delightful.
•	Bombolinis – big, fluffy, and super soft.
•	Strawberry Biscoff Cheesecake – a unique and delicious combination that works beautifully.
•	Strawberry Croissant – buttery, flaky, and filled with fresh flavour.
•	And if you love Strawberry Cream, this place will be your paradise!

It’s a bakery, patisserie, and café all in one, offering great quality at affordable prices. A must-visit spot in Navi Mumbai for dessert lovers and anyone craving a sweet nostalgic escape!, name_person=Arena Job}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Other, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=6 days ago, review=This place is small but cute. Besides cakes, they serve delicious cookies, bamboloni, coffee, etc. Prices are fair. The owner Poorva is one of the best bakers in town., name_person=Asmant Nimbalkar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Breakfast, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Best Sunday breakfast with family in a long time! We came here especially for the "Chai thali" which was great. We also tried their Nutella bombolini which was loaded with warm Nutella and tasted heavenly. The biscoff cheesecake here is one of the best we've had so far. The dark hot chocolate and the creamy cheesy korean bun, on the monsoon menu are a must try! So good! Even the humble veg puff here was crispy and yummy. The ambience has a cozy, quaint, rustic vibe. We were impressed by the friendly and attentive service. All the best to the owner for her endeavour. We will definitely be back for a warm, wholesome breakfast again., name_person=a b}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Other, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Delivery, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Not_sure, E:NOT_SURE]}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=Ordered: PISTACHIO ALPHONSO CAKE
On: 26/04/2025

I don't usually post reviews. This cake was worth the time spent in reviewing. Being half German, I know what good quality ingredients and good bakes are... After all, they known worldwide for their bakes.
The cake was ordered for a family who disliked cakes. It was finished in minutes. It was really perfect... Yes, perfect!

-No colours
-No artificial flavours.
-Choped pistachio and its paste for filling
-Handpicked alphonso to ensure sweet ones are used only.
-Less sweet
-Well balanced

I must've given 15-16 specifications and this team managed my order patiently.

Offering a mix of Indian, Pan Asian, and Continental cuisine, the restaurant caters to every taste preference, making it a great option for family outings or group gatherings. Their buffet selection is extensive, featuring a wide variety of starters, mains, and an especially tempting range of desserts that can satisfy anyone with a sweet tooth.
I visited Rainbow with my family, and we found it to be an excellent choice for enjoying multiple cuisines under one roof. One of the highlights of our visit was the exceptional hospitality—they are well-known for it, and they definitely lived up to their reputation. The staff welcomed us warmly and ensured that we were comfortable throughout our meal. Their professionalism and attentiveness added a special touch to the experience.
The restaurant’s ambiance is another major plus. The entire space was beautifully decorated, featuring regional live counters that were set up with great attention to detail. Overall, a wonderful experience and definitely worth visiting again., name_person=sunil tejinkar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Brunch, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=Visited Rainbow Restaurant for their unlimited Sunday brunch buffet, and this place truly delivers a colourful and flavour-packed experience! 🌈✨ From starters to dessert, every section of the buffet feels thoughtfully curated.

⸻

Ambiance ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Bright, spacious, and lively—perfect for a relaxed Sunday outing. The buffet layout is easy to navigate, and the live counters add a fun, interactive vibe. Ideal for families, groups, and anyone looking for a weekend treat.

⸻

Food Experience ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Starters 🍢

A wide range of veg appetizers—fresh, well-prepared, and flavourful:
• Beetroot Slider – soft, unique, and delicious.
• Babycorn Chilly – crispy with the right spice kick.
• Kumbh ke Tikke – smoky mushrooms with perfect marination.
• Sweet Potato Tikki – crunchy outside, soft inside.
• Station chaats & fries – great for snacking between courses.

⸻

Live Counters 🔥

One of the best parts of the buffet!
• Live Pasta – choose your sauce, veggies, and seasoning; made fresh and creamy.
• Live Pizza – thin crust, baked fresh, with generous toppings.
• Live Dimsums – soft, steaming hot, and served with dipping sauces.

These counters added a lot of excitement and ensured every dish came to the table piping hot.

⸻

Main Course 🍛

A diverse mix of Indian, Asian, and Continental dishes:
• Indian gravies – Paneer, Mushroom Curry & another sabzi, all flavourful.
• Dal Dhaba – rustic, homely, and perfectly spiced.
• Indo-Chinese – Garlic noodles & Manchurian (a total hit).
• Thai Curry – fragrant, creamy, and comforting.
• Biryani – flavourful and well-balanced.
• Ravioli – soft pasta with a smooth, creamy filling—impressive for a buffet.

Everything tasted fresh and hot, and the variety was more than satisfying.

⸻

Dessert Heaven 🍰🍨

The dessert section is HUGE and heavenly!
They had an endless selection of:
• Kaju Katli
• Rasgulla
• Gulab Jamun
• Cheesecake
• Pastries
• Brownie
• Ice Cream

Both Indian and continental desserts were fresh and delicious—an absolute paradise for anyone with a sweet tooth.

⸻

Service ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Super attentive staff. Plates cleared promptly, buffet refilled constantly, and live counters handled smoothly.

⸻

Overall Verdict 🌟

Rainbow Restaurant’s Sunday brunch buffet is a must-visit for anyone who loves unlimited variety, great flavours, and a fun dining experience. Ambience & Service

Soups:
There are three types of soups, catering to diverse preferences. Whether you’re in the mood for something hearty or a light, flavorful broth, you’ll find something to your liking !!

Live Chaat Counter:
The live counter for chaats is a huge draw! You can indulge in fresh, made-to-order chaats like Pani Puri, Sev Puri, Dahi Puri and Dahi. wada, topped with chutneys and yogurt—perfect for anyone craving a tangy snack !!

Kulfi & Ice Cream:
To round off your meal, the variety of Kulfi and ice cream is a perfect treat !!

Mumbai's dining scene just received a stunning upgrade with the opening of Otoki at Apollo Bunder, a new sanctuary dedicated to specialty Japanese cuisine. From the moment we were settled at the intimate sushi tables, we knew we were in for a memorable experience. Otoki’s dedication to pristine ingredients and technical skill quickly turned our lunch into a true celebration of flavour, leaving us with broad smiles.

The Sublime Sushi Experience
Our focus was entirely on the raw bar, and Otoki delivered a masterclass in precision and quality. Every piece was a miniature work of art.
The Nigiri selection was flawless: the classic Bluefin Tuna Akami was pristine, and the Unagi (eel) was perfectly glazed. The Hotate (scallop) melted delicately on the tongue, but the true surprise was the Pickled Tomato nigiri—a burst of innovative, acidic freshness that elevated the traditional lineup.

The Sashimi course was a moment of sheer indulgence. The Bluefin Tuna Otoro offered that characteristic, luxurious marbling that defines perfection, dissolving on the palate with a rich, buttery texture.

The Maki rolls were meticulously crafted and perfectly balanced. We thoroughly enjoyed the traditional Norimaki, the bright, citrusy notes of the Yuzu Salmon, and the clean simplicity of the Bluefin Tuna Akami roll.

To cap off the meal, the desserts provided a sophisticated finish: the earthy sweetness of the Warabi Mochi paired perfectly with the sharp, aromatic brightness of the Yuzu Ice Cream.

Hospitality and Passion
While the food was phenomenal, the exceptional hospitality truly elevated our visit. The chefs at Otoki are a delight, well-informed, and visibly passionate about their craft.

We were fortunate enough to be looked after by Chef Yunus, who ensured we loved every bite and guided us with spot-on recommendations. He was wonderfully accompanied by Chef Rahul. Chef Yusuf, was wonderful at ensuring we were comfortable and made time for great conversations. A great host.

The entire staff is great, friendly, and contributes to the welcoming atmosphere.

Looking Ahead
Otoki currently operates a limited menu for lunch, but based on the exemplary quality we experienced, we are already counting down the days until our next visit for dinner. We look forward to being surprised with what more they have to offer.

Overview
AER at the Four Seasons is a rooftop experience that lives up to the hype. Perched high above Worli, it delivers sweeping Mumbai skyline and sea views, a modern yet warm ambience, and consistently polished service — ideal for both special evenings and relaxed drinks with friends.

Ambience & design
- Incredible vantage point: panoramic views of Mumbai and the Arabian Sea are the star — especially dramatic when clouds roll in or the city lights up at night.
- Roof engineering: the covered rooftop feels state-of-the-art — thoughtfully designed to shelter guests during rain while preserving the sense of openness. Even in a downpour the space felt airy and comfortable, with rain adding to the drama rather than disrupting the experience.
- Vibe: stylish, contemporary décor with an upscale lounge energy. Music, lighting and layout encourage both intimate conversations and lively groups without feeling crowded.

Drinks
- Negroni: expertly executed — perfectly blanched (clean, balanced bitterness and bright aromatics), with excellent temperature and presentation. The cocktail showcased strong technique and attention to classic proportions.
- Cocktail program: creative but respectful of classics; bartenders clearly know their craft and tailor drinks to taste.

Food
- Guacamole prepared tableside: a highlight. Watching it made fresh added theatre, and the result was vibrant, aromatic and packed with flavour — creamy texture, bright citrus and just the right seasoning. Superb balance of richness and acidity.
- Overall tasting: dishes leaned modern, high-quality and well-seasoned. Portions are geared for sharing and designed to complement the cocktail-led experience.

Service
- Attentive and professional without being intrusive. Staff handled the evening smoothly, from timing of drinks and food to accommodating the rain cover without fuss.
- Knowledgeable servers and bartenders willing to recommend pairings and adjust drinks to preference.

- Polished, thoughtful service.

Cons / notes
- Popularity means it can get busy; reservations are recommended for prime seating.
- Price point is upscale — expect to pay a premium for the location and experience.

Who it’s for
- Couples seeking a romantic, skyline-backed evening.
- Groups celebrating special occasions.
- Cocktail enthusiasts who appreciate skilled bartending and well-executed classics.

Bottom line
AER at the Four Seasons is a standout rooftop destination in Mumbai. ["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=Up to 10 min, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN]}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Kakke Di Hatti – Andheri

If you’re craving authentic Punjabi flavors, Kakke Di Hatti in Andheri is a must-visit! Their stuffed naan is an absolute favourite – soft, buttery, and bursting with flavour.

We started with Tandoori Paneer and Cheese Cigars, both cooked to perfection. For the main course, we had Paneer Sabji with Naan, and each bite felt like pure comfort food. We also tried Triple Schezwan Rice with Manchurian Gravy, and the Indo-Chinese twist was spot on.

To cool down, we enjoyed Chaas and Punjabi Lassi – refreshing and perfectly balanced. Ended the meal on a sweet note with Gulab Jamun & Ice Cream, which was heavenly.

The ambience is warm and welcoming, seating is comfortable, and the staff is attentive and courteous. It’s a perfect spot to come with family and friends for a satisfying, hearty meal.

Highly recommended for all Punjabi food lovers! 🍛🥘, name_person=Yash Shah}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=4 months ago, review=We Visited Kake Di Hatti in Andheri and it was a true North Indian feast. The Chole was rich and flavorful, perfectly paired with their soft and fresh naan. The refreshing Mojito and creamy Lassi balanced the spices beautifully, and the warm, melt-in-the-mouth Gulab Jamun was the perfect way to end the meal., name_person=Rahul Solanki}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=Up to 10 min, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN]}, time_line=3 months ago, review=Kake Di Hatti in Andheri West is a must-visit for food lovers.They serve lip-smacking North Indian and Chinese dishes, making it a true multi-cuisine delight.The Honey Chilli Potato is perfectly crispy with just the right amount of spice.

Worth the price and food experience., name_person=Anup Surendra Jaiswal (Dada)}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=5 months ago, review=If you're a true lover of North Indian cuisine and happen to be in Andheri, *Kake De Hatti* is one spot that absolutely deserves a visit. I recently had the pleasure of dining here, and I must say – the experience exceeded my expectations on multiple fronts. Whether it was the ambience, the food, or the service, everything was well in sync to create a satisfying and memorable meal.

Ambience:
The moment you step into Kake De Hatti, you're greeted with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The interiors have a rustic yet vibrant Punjabi dhaba vibe but with a touch of modern comfort. The decor features earthy tones, subtle lighting, and interesting wall art that adds character to the space without being too loud. It’s the kind of place that works equally well for a casual dinner with friends or a wholesome family outing. Despite being a relatively busy spot, the seating was spacious, and the overall vibe felt lively but not chaotic – a fine balance that not many restaurants get right.

Food:
Now coming to the highlight – the food. The menu is a celebration of rich North Indian flavors, especially Punjabi cuisine. We started with the Soya Malai Tikka Roll, which was perfectly marinated and grilled soft on the inside with a delightful char on the outside. For mains, we ordered the iconic Kake Thali their famous, with includes 1 kake garlic butter naan, 1 dal makhani, 1 paneer of the day, 1 mix veg of the day, 1 portion veg pulao, raita, sweet, mix salad, achar, papad with generously portioned definitely prepared with authentic spices and a lot of love.

Service:
The service was another strong point. The staff was polite, attentive, and made sure we were comfortable throughout. Our server was well-informed and helped us with recommendations based on our preferences. The food came in a timely manner, and despite being a busy evening, we never felt neglected., name_person=dhawal gala}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Tucked right near Andheri metro station, Kake di Hatti is a cozy spot that serves delicious North Indian, Tandoor, and Chinese delicacies. While they’re famous for their giant naans and kulchas, we started with Dahi ke Kebab and Chilli Stick – both packed with flavor and perfectly cooked. To beat the heat, their chaas and lassi are an absolute must-try! For mains, we went with the Paneer Makhni Thali, and it was super satisfying – two buttery rotis, dal makhani, paneer sabzi, rice, salad, and pickle, making it wholesome and filling. My Experience:
I stayed at Locomo Hostel, Vile Parle recently. The people and staff here were friendly and welcoming, which made the environment positive. However, the overall stay was disappointing for the price charged.

---

⭐ Aspect Ratings

Staff & People: ★★★★☆ (4/5)
Good crowd, friendly atmosphere, and staff were polite.

Dormitory Setup: ★★☆☆☆ (2/5)
The dorm beds were completely open with no privacy at all. At the very least, curtains should be provided around each bed for a comfortable hostel experience.

Pricing / Value: ★★☆☆☆ (2/5)
For the facilities offered, the rates are very high compared to other hostels in Mumbai. Not value-for-money.

Security: ★★☆☆☆ (2/5)
No real sense of security provided for personal belongings, which is a major concern for hostel guests.

---

🔧 Suggestions for Improvement

1. Add privacy curtains for dormitory beds to improve comfort.

2. Provide lockers and better security arrangements for guests’ belongings.

3. Reconsider pricing to match the actual facilities and services offered.

---

Final Note:
While the people and vibe were good, the lack of privacy, high rates, and weak security make this hostel hard to recommend. With a few improvements, Locomo could be a much better choice for travelers.

*   Grilled Chicken Pandhra Rassa: This Maharashtrian classic was executed beautifully. The Pandhra Rassa (white curry) was rich, creamy, and flavourful, perfectly complementing the tender grilled chicken. A comforting yet sophisticated dish.
*   Churros Palate: A delightful end to the meal. The churros were crispy on the outside, fluffy inside, and served with delectable accompaniments. A satisfying and fun dessert.
Special Thanks to Anup for serving the delicious food.

🍗 Fried Chicken Pieces – crispy and full of flavor
🍢 Kebabs – juicy and well-marinated
🍤 Stir-Fried Prawns – tasty and cooked just right
🍕 Chicken Pizza (Rum-based) – unique twist with a subtle rum flavour, tasted great!

Every dish was delicious and nicely presented. The ambience was pleasant and perfect for a relaxed outing.

⸻

Overall:
A great place for chicken lovers and those who enjoy trying something different like a rum-infused pizza. Definitely worth a visit if you’re around Vashi., name_person=Siddhesh Bavkar}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=10 months ago, review=The vibe at Broaster Chicken was welcoming, making it a great spot for friends, families, or couples to gather. The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, which made the overall experience pleasant. The interior design had a nice western flair, giving the place a cozy and modern feel.
However, the food didn’t live up to the expectations set by the ambiance. While the restaurant maintained a clean environment, the flavor of the dishes didn’t justify the price. The classical crunchy chicken burger was greasy and disappointing, lacking the bold flavor it promised. The chicken chilly dry was decent but nothing out of the ordinary. The murg malai kebab didn’t resemble a typical kebab, and it lacked the richness and tenderness you would hope for.
The Oreo milkshake was a big letdown, as it was watery and far from the indulgent treat you’d expect. The virgin mojito, on the other hand, was acceptable and somewhat refreshing.
In summary, while the atmosphere and service were great, the food needs significant improvement. Located in a central area, the restaurant is easy to reach and has a warm, inviting atmosphere that creates a comfortable and refined dining experience.

The interior of Panchtara Fine Dine is stylishly decorated with a mix of contemporary and traditional decor. Dim lighting, well-arranged tables, and comfortable seating add to the overall ambiance, making it a cozy yet classy place for dining. The restaurant has both family and separate dining areas, offering some privacy for larger groups, which many guests appreciate.

Panchtara Fine Dine offers a vast menu that spans Indian, Chinese, and Continental cuisines, catering to a variety of tastes and preferences. Their North Indian dishes, especially the butter chicken, tandoori items, and biryanis, are highly recommended by patrons for their rich flavors and authentic taste. You will also rave about the Chinese selections, mentioning that the crispy starters and flavorful gravies are well-prepared and satisfying. Vegetarians and non-vegetarians alike find plenty of delicious options on the menu, and the restaurant is known for generous portion sizes, making it a good value for money.

Service at Panchtara Fine Dine is consistently praised, the attentiveness and professionalism of the staff is worth noting. The waitstaff are courteous and knowledgeable about the menu, always ready to provide recommendations or customize dishes based on dietary needs. Orders are served promptly, and the restaurant’s staff ensures that guests have a pleasant dining experience from start to finish.

Overall, Panchtara Fine Dine is a go-to place in Dombivli for anyone looking to enjoy a delicious meal in a relaxed, upscale setting. Its extensive menu, pleasant ambiance, and excellent service make it a top choice for celebrations, family gatherings, or a memorable dining experience. Whether you’re craving North Indian flavors, Chinese delicacies, or Continental favorites, Panchtara Fine Dine offers a culinary experience that lives up to its name.

From the moment you step in, the earthy interiors, ambient lighting, and soft background music set the tone for a relaxed experience, whether you’re catching up with friends or enjoying a solo coffee date.

☕ Barista’s Special: Filter Kaapi
The highlight of my visit was undoubtedly their Filter Kaapi, a beautifully brewed South Indian classic that stays true to its roots. Rich, aromatic, and served piping hot, this kaapi had the perfect balance of strength and smoothness — a must-try if you’re a true coffee lover.

🍹 Beverages That Impress
Apart from the kaapi, I tried their Sea Salt Caramel Frappe, which was a delightful mix of sweet and salty. It had just the right amount of caramel without being overpowering, and the sea salt added a sophisticated twist.
Their Hot Chocolate deserves a special mention — thick, indulgent, and made from real dark chocolate. It’s not your regular watery cocoa mix; this one’s crafted for true chocolate enthusiasts.

🍴 Savoury Bites That Hit the Spot
Coming to the food — the Chicken Cheese Bruschetta was a flavor bomb. Crisp toasted bread topped with juicy chicken chunks and melty cheese, it made for the perfect starter.
The Butter Garlic Prawns were cooked to perfection — plump, juicy prawns in a buttery, garlicky sauce that was both rich and comforting.
The main course I opted for was the Grilled Chicken with Mushroom Sauce, served with sautéed veggies and rice. The chicken was tender and perfectly grilled, and the creamy mushroom sauce tied everything together beautifully.

🍫 Dessert to End on a High
To round off the meal, I indulged in their Walnut Sizzling Brownie, which arrived at the table bubbling hot and aromatic. The brownie was dense, rich, and generously studded with walnuts — paired with vanilla ice cream and sizzling chocolate sauce, it was the perfect finish to an already satisfying meal.

Coffee Bistro in Kharghar is a hidden gem for those who appreciate a good cup of coffee paired with thoughtfully curated food. If you’re looking for a cozy yet vibrant spot to explore authentic Asian flavors, Mantoou in Belapur is a hidden gem you shouldn’t miss. The place strikes a perfect balance between a chic, contemporary bistro and a warm, welcoming vibe.

The menu is thoughtfully curated, focusing mainly on Pan-Asian cuisines like Tibetan, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. Their signature “Mantoou” dumplings are a must-try — fresh, delicately steamed, and packed with flavor. Each dish feels authentic yet innovative, presented beautifully without being overly fancy.

Some highlights from my visit:
•	Chicken Mantoou Dumplings: Soft, juicy, and full of flavor. You can tell they use fresh ingredients.
•	Korean Bibimbap: Served sizzling, with a good mix of veggies and perfectly cooked rice.
•	Thai Curry with Jasmine Rice: Rich, aromatic, and comforting — felt like a warm hug in a bowl.
•	Sushi Rolls: Fresh and well-rolled, especially impressive for a non-specialist sushi place.

The service was polite and attentive. Staff members were happy to recommend dishes based on preferences, which really added to the experience. The interiors are minimalistic but stylish, featuring Asian-inspired art and a calming color palette — great for both casual dining and small celebrations.

Pricing is moderate — not super cheap, but fair for the quality and the portion sizes.

Verdict:
Mantoou is a delightful spot if you’re craving genuine Asian flavors without heading to a super commercial chain. reviews: ["{\"name_person\":\"JASON SEQUEIRA\",\"time_line\":\"3 weeks ago\",\"review\":\"\\uD83C\\uDF53 Dessert Therapy \u2013 Bandra Review \\uD83C\\uDF6B\\n\\nVisited Dessert Therapy in Bandra, and it\u2019s honestly the perfect spot for anyone with a serious sweet tooth! Creamy, rich, and perfectly balanced with that caramelized Biscoff flavor. The texture was smooth, the crust had the right crunch, and the portion was generous. Easily one of the best Biscoff cheesecakes I\u2019ve had in a long time.\\n\\n\\uD83E\\uDD5E Nutella & Strawberry Pancakes \u2013 pure indulgence!
