To begin with, the portions are extremely small for the price of bao buns, just 2 pieces, for ₹545! After receiving my bill, I asked the waiter what the “staff contribution charge” meant. Although I already knew it referred to service charges, I wanted to hear it from them. He confirmed the same, and I politely requested for it to be waived because tips cannot be enforced on customers jabardasti.

I was dining alone, and apart from bringing the food to my table, there was no additional service involved. Yet YouMee charged me a staff contribution fee of ₹96.50. Every restaurant has waiters and stewards and serving customers is their basic responsibility because we come there to dine. You cannot impose service charges on customers by default, that too without consent.

This isn’t about the money; it’s about ethics. Restaurants cannot be allowed to take customers for granted and levy such charges forcefully. When I asked for it to be removed, the staff simply said they "cannot" do that.

I have taken a screenshot of my bill and will be reporting this incident to the National Consumer Helpline immediately. Restaurants should not be allowed to impose fraudulent charges on customers. Imagine the amount collected when every table is billed this way—under what justification? Has anyone even questioned this practice, or are people just blindly paying their bills without noticing?, name_person=Larissa DSouza}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=Edited 2 months ago, review=This place is perfect for Pan-asian cuisine. Previously it was Shizusan and now rebranded to Youmee.
The food is delicious and the ambiance is good. It's perfect for a group as you can try a lot of dishes.
We loved their Hibachi rice, Spicy chicken Ramen and Nasi Goreng. Even their Thai curry was also nice. Quantity of rice is also sufficient. Sushi is OK here.
You can try any of their dumplings n you won't be disappointed. We loved the Prawn bury dumplings, Crunchy chicken dumplings and New York Cheese & Chilli oil dumplings

Caspers Bar and Kitchen is one of those places you keep coming back to once you’ve been there. The ambience is really well done—it strikes the perfect balance between modern and cozy. Whether you're out with friends for drinks, on a casual date, or just in the mood for a relaxed dinner, Caspers delivers on all fronts.

The food menu is quite extensive with plenty of options across Indian, Chinese, and Continental cuisines. I’ve tried their starters, sizzlers, and pizzas, and everything was well-prepared and served hot. Their paneer dishes and chicken platters especially stand out—flavorful, juicy, and perfectly spiced. The bar menu also has a good selection of cocktails, mocktails, beers, and spirits at reasonable rates.

Service is another big plus. The staff is friendly, attentive, and quick to respond. The seating is comfortable, music is at the right volume, and the overall vibe makes you want to stay longer.

That said, the menu could use a little TLC—ours was sticky and had seen better days, which was a bit of a fly in the ointment.

The buffet was impressive, offering a wide variety of delicacies in both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, all served at a very reasonable budget. Specially The Saboot Lobster., name_person=Manasi Satam}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+}, time_line=10 months ago, review=Beware: 2365 rupee / £24.49 for a bowl of cumin rice/jeera rice!!! Our stay at ITC Grand Central was ruined by this restaurant experience.

We ordered one murgh tikka, lamb tawa, and 1 kashmiri roti, 1 paratha and one jeera rice (rice is NOT on the menu but we were able to order via the waiter). However our experience was totally dampened when we received the bill. The jeera rice was listed for 2635 rupees (we are from London and this equates to £24.50 for a bowl of rice). Ridiculous. We flagged to the waiter who confirmed this is the correct price. We requested the manager, who also confirmed its the correct price and asked how we would like to pay. We said no way are we paying for rice that expensive, charge us appropriately we said. He then went away for 10 minutes and came back with 15% off the rice. We were shocked to see the rice was still on the bill. We said no, the rice was not on the menu and they should charge us properly and appropriately for rice!! He said it is on the menu and we didn’t look properly. We then showed him the online menu from which we ordered from where not one single rice dish is mentioned and he said the menu must vary by device. He then went away for 10 minutes and came back with the rice removed. He mentioned that even he was shocked at the rice but the fact he didnt remove the rice from the bill in a 5 star hotel restaurant was very poor. He then asked if we were staying at the hotel and was shocked to hear that we were and then finally apologised for the bill. Very strange encounter. As we left he thanked is for highlighting the bill discrepancy and apologised. We believe we were overcharged on purpose. We normally charge dinners and extras to the room but were so glad we didnt in this case so we were able to notice the ridiculous price and the clear scamming of customers. Absolutely shocking. PLEASE BE WARY., name_person=Ishani}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000}, time_line=2 years ago, review=One of the most exciting dinner of my trip in India!

Shalimar Point is a cozy cafe offering a limited menu that is both pocket-friendly and satisfying. The food is well-prepared, with fresh bread that stands out as one of the highlights. The portions are generous, especially when it comes to the chicken, which is cooked well and seasoned nicely. The addition of fresh vegetables adds a healthy touch to the meal, enhancing both flavor and texture. Overall, the food provides good value for money, delivering a balance of quality and quantity.

However, there are some areas that could use improvement. While the food is commendable, cleanliness seems to be an issue. The cafe could benefit from more attention to tidiness, especially in high-traffic areas. This might detract from the overall dining experience, particularly for those who are particular about hygiene.

The juice served is fresh and a great complement to the meal, but the use of plastic straws is disappointing. In today’s environmentally conscious world, it would be a positive step for the cafe to consider more eco-friendly alternatives.

On a positive note, the staff is quick and efficient, offering prompt service even during busy times. Despite the bustling nature of the area, the staff manages to keep things moving smoothly, ensuring that customers are served without long waits.

In conclusion, Shalimar Point is a solid option for a casual, budget-friendly meal. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Parking, E:PARKING, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Somewhat difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=Edited a month ago, review=Disappointing Experience on Diwali
We were a group of 5 who had booked a table a day in advance through Google for 20th Oct, 9pm. On calling the restaurant in the afternoon about parking, the manager suddenly claimed they have “stopped online reservations” — even though the slot was available and confirmed on Google. When I asked his name (atleast thriceA) he disconnected the call without telling.
Not taking a chance, we reached at 7:30pm. The restaurant was barely 40% occupied. Our waiter Kabir was polite and helpful — full marks to him for service.
The major issue happened at billing — they flatly refused to accept Zomato payment despite Zomato showing a good discount option. There was no notice displayed, and we were not told at entry or while ordering. The manager “Shrikant Pedhnekar” was unapologetic and defensive instead of clarifying or expressing regret. While we were leaving, another manager (name unknown) also argued with us. In this era of 'Customer First', not once these managers showed any signs of being apologetic nor regret. The high-handed attitude spoiled our mood. Especially when the prices are comparable with premium restaurants. While prices match that of premium restaurant, the customer-centric attitude does not.

Other aspects:
• Ambience feels dated — furniture and décor easily 15–20 years old
• Prices are comparable to premium restaurants but food is only average in taste and portion
• We ordered for two cocktails but they were not well made.
• Service charge of 10% was added automatically while most restaurants of this level charge 5% (we got it removed)
• Restaurant is on 1st floor - No lift so elderlies and people with mobility issues will find it difficult to reach the restaurant

Overall, good food and smiling service of Kabir the waiter saved complete disaster. One star is for him. 4 stars goes out for an unprofessional and disappointing handling of guests. Would not recommend until management fixes confirmed reservations, billing transparency and how they treat their customers., name_person=Dr. Nayan Bheda}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Absolutely loved Revival! 🌿

It is advised to do pre-booking and go

The Kung Pao Potato had the perfect kick — crisp outside, juicy inside, and laced with spicy goodness.
Crispy Thai Lotus Stem was a crunchy delight, glazed in sweet-chili magic that lingered just right.
The Smoked Chilli Cottage Cheese stole the show — rich, smoky, and melt-in-mouth with a balanced zing.
Shillong Soup was a warm hug in a bowl — subtle, spiced, and soothingly aromatic.
Among the mains, the Revival Bhindi Rajasthani surprised me with its tangy masala punch and perfect texture.
Barabanki Korta was royal — a rich, earthy sabzi bursting with North Indian flair and depth.
Balti Sabzi offered a mix of veggies in a semi-dry, fragrant gravy — rustic and satisfying.

All in all, a soulful vegetarian spread with flavors as expansive as the sea it faces., name_person=AJay Sadh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR, 5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN]}, time_line=5 months ago, review=1 of the best family restaurant in Chowpatty area. ["{guided_block={}, time_line=a year ago, review=A nice sweet corner with also variety of snack stalls outside it. The sandwiches are amazing. South Indian snacks are tasty too. The veg chinese snacks are also worth the try and so are the chaat items., name_person=Arman Fanaskar}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Neelkanth Sweets is a sweets joint chain since 1992 and serves the best sweets in town.
They have variety of snacks like Pav Bhaji, Dosas, Munchurian, Frankies, Sandwiches, etc.
I had Butter Pav Bhaji which was awesome.
The taste of the Bhaji is just perfect plus the amount of butter they use is just amazing, must try for butter lovers out there.

I also had Cheese Masala Dosa which was one of the best dosa I've ever had.

This place is near to my home so I've tried almost every dish & I can tell it's worth it.
They also have differ types of Bengali sweets which are worth trying., name_person=Flavours of Bombay}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=3 years ago, review=A normal place for breakfast and juices. They have stalls for southindian, sandwiches, juices and tea.
I tried south indian which was just okay in quality and taste. The place is pocket friendly. The service is quick, name_person=Harsha}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=Edited 2 years ago, review=A place to have good snack and quick bite of South Indian tiffins like Idli, Dosa, Vada. You can get sada dosa at a price as low as Rs 35/-  and masala at Rs 50/-. Also you can get Pav Bhaji at Rs 45/-, Pani Puri at 30/- per plate. You can enjoy the taste of Burger, Pizza etc. Ready to eat snacks also will be available at best prices. Quantity and quality are good at the best price., name_person=Mahesh Vanama}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review=Best place for quick bite and variety of chat at one place especially for dosa...Great at taste...need to improve hygiene standards... enough in quantity as per price...they also serve panipuri,pizza, sandwiches,soda or Momo!
.
Recommend
Maisoor masala dosa
American chopsi dosa, name_person=Dr.nicky joshi}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review=There is one tea stall inside this store which serves amazing and varieties of tea and coffee. I would recommend to visit this tea stall to fuel yourself., name_person=kartik pillai}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review=I tried Jini Dosa and Chikku-Banana Milkshake here.

St

They play any song that will ruin your mood. They don't care about the customers at all.. Please don't go this TIGHT bar. They will ignore your request.

Because of the boring music and the refusal to adjust it, the place fails to deliver the enjoyable bar experience one would expect in Vashi.
There are many better options around where the staff are more responsive and actually care about what guests want from the ambience and music.
The attitude of the staff feels rigid and uninterested, as if customer comfort and feedback do not matter at all.
In a bar, music is a key part of the experience, and when the team ignores customer requests, it shows a lack of basic hospitality and respect for guests’ time and money., name_person=Ashish Kamble}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1}, time_line=4 weeks ago, review=Had a disappointing experience at this place. Despite booking through Swiggy Pay, the staff refused to accept it, claiming that happy hours weren’t covered, even when we offered to pay for food via Swiggy and drinks in cash. The excuses felt unreasonable. The staff also seemed confused throughout; they even spilled a friend’s drink while serving. On top of that, they added a hefty service charge. The food was decent, but overall the experience was poor. I don’t think I’d visit again., name_person=Dhruv Sachdev}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Chicken_Fried_Rice, Kala_Khatta]}, time_line=a year ago, review=Dropped by this wonderful place in vashi for the weekend party with my gang!
This place is located in inorbit mall which is really a plus as the inorbit mall is at a jump distance from the station.
Talking about the decor this place has trippy lights all over and the seating arena is phenomenal too! Comfy couches and high chairs to chill!
Coming to the food and beverages,
The bar here is full stocked serving some great cocktails and mocktails. We tried few of them and we really were impressed with the taste and the beautiful creation done by the mixologist.
In food department this one was superb too.
We had chicken schezwan fried rice which was really well made and had generous chicken and egg portions. Loved this one.
Chilli garlic noodles // thin noodles which were well tossed in sauces and lovely presentation too. It was on a spicier side too.
In appetizers,
We had chicken lollipop. Served in 6 pieces and lovely taste however the presentation could have been better. But the taste took everything ahead.
Murgh Hyderabadi tikka was the call for second appetizer, 6 pieces were served and well presented too. The texture was soft and tender. Served with mint chutney!
In drinks we had following,
Tropical LIIT
It is the better option and a nice change of pace if you find your self in LIIT, It was made pleasantly with Pineapple Juice and Mix of Alcohol.
Mandarin Mojito
A normal Mojito with a hint of fresh Orange.
Garnish with mint leaves and orange wedges would recommend!
Beer LIIT
A normal LIIT which replaced Coke with beer, the taste was phenomenal. A refreshing drink for beer lovers.
Blueberry mojito
A virgin mojito with a great mix of blueberry squash in it. Loved this alotttt! A great drink for non alcoholics.
Overall loved this place a lot and would genuinely recommend to others of you are looking for something in vashi with exquisite decor and proper club vibes., name_person=HARSHVARDHAN SOLANKI}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_SEATING_TYPE=[Bar_area, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_BAR_AREA], GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=10-30 min}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Had an amazing time here! The live band and DJ night are the absolute highlights — the music creates such a vibrant and energetic vibe. Perfect spot for a fun. Great ambience, good crowd, and solid drink options too. Highly recommended if you're looking for a fun evening with great tunes., name_person=Harshal Nikhare}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Chicken_Lollipop], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SPECIAL_EVENTS=[No_special_event, E:DINING_SPECIAL_EVENTS_NO_SPECIAL_EVENT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SPECIAL_OFFERS=[Happy_hour, E:DINING_SPECIAL_OFFERS_HAPPY_HOUR]}, time_line=11 months ago, review=The portion sizes were small, and the taste was merely average. The chicken gyoza was awesome too with a generous amount of crispy chilli on it. I had to wait a long time for the gyoza compared to the rest of the items but I guess it was just a busy day for them.

A casual setup serving authentic korean and Japanese street food.

The ambience i loved. Soft dim lights, basic street style tables, wall grafitti - all in all the place was vibing. The open kicthen made the place look more spacious.

The music - upbeat

I liked the concept of pay first and the food gets delivered to the tables. Keeps u in check of hw much you eat.

The service is top notch. Everything is so smooth. Unreal.

What we ate

Chicken gyoza - a succulent juicy cresent shaped dumpling made of thin dough and stuffed with flavourful chicken - pan seared.

Prawn takoyaki - prawn stuffed flour balls, pan seared topped with crumbs - unique. Served with a spicey mayo dip.

Fiery tiger(bowl) - lip smacking noodles, topped with korean fried chicken, spicey mayo and buttered cabbage - generous portion size.

Blueberry kombucha - unique, kombucha with a blueberry punch.

Pineapple Kombucha - pinapple all the way.

Highly recommended for authentic korean/japanese food lovers., name_person=imran badami}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=This is the best place to eat Korean food with a budget.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Portion size for the rice/noodles is good enough for 2 people.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Veg Corn Dog 😋 they use fresh mozzarella cheese 🤤}"]

reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=9 months ago, review=I recently had dinner at Bageecha Restaurant, Novotel, and it was a delightful experience.

Ambiance & Setting:
The open-air setting with a stunning view of Juhu Beach created a perfect dining atmosphere. The live music further enhanced the experience, with singers performing a mix of soulful and popular melodies, adding a lively yet soothing vibe to the evening.

Food Quality & Taste:
The menu was quite limited, but the available dishes were well-curated. We tried the Chicken Biryani, which was absolutely fabulous—rich in flavor, perfectly spiced, and with a generous portion of chicken. It was a well-balanced dish that didn’t feel overly spicy yet packed a punch in taste. Cocktails were well crafted.

The starters, mainly chicken kebabs, were average. While they had a good texture and were cooked well, the flavors could be enhanced slightly to match the high standard of the biryani.

Desserts:
The desserts were the highlight of the meal. We had Gulab Jamun and Kulfi Falooda, both of which were fantastic. The Gulab Jamun portion was quite generous, served with dry fruits filled in center, making it a decadent treat. It's had 3 gulab jamuns and was almost too much for one person to finish but was absolutely worth it!

Overall Experience:
The ambiance, live music, and biryani were the standout aspects, while the starters had room for slight improvement. The desserts were flawless and left a lasting impression., name_person=vishal sawant}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 years ago, review=I recently had the pleasure of experiencing the Awadhi Food Festival at Bageecha, located in Novotel Juhu, and I must say, it was an extraordinary culinary adventure that left an indelible mark on my taste buds. Bageecha not only lives up to its reputation as a fine dining destination but also managed to transport me to the regal land of Awadh with its impeccable ambiance, warm hospitality, and mouthwatering delicacies.

Upon entering Bageecha, I was immediately struck by the elegant decor, which exuded an aura of sophistication and charm. The restaurant's beautiful garden setting added to the overall experience, creating a serene and relaxed atmosphere that was perfect for indulging in the rich flavors of Awadhi cuisine.

The festival menu was a treasure trove of traditional Awadhi dishes, curated to perfection by the talented culinary team at Bageecha. The sheer variety and authenticity of the dishes impressed me beyond words. From aromatic biryanis and kebabs to delectable curries and decadent desserts, every aspect of the Awadhi culinary heritage was meticulously represented.

The standout dish of the evening was undoubtedly Tunde Kebab. The melt-in-your-mouth texture, combined with the burst of spices was a true testament to the culinary mastery at Bageecha. Each bite was a symphony of flavors, leaving me yearning for more.

The Murgh Dum Biryani was another revelation. The fragrant basmati rice cooked with tender chicken and a medley of aromatic spices transported me to the Nawabi courts of Lucknow. The flavors were perfectly balanced, and the dish was presented with utmost finesse, making it a feast for both the eyes and the palate.

Bandh Gosht, lamb chunk braised in a bone stock with fresh onion and luscious blend of spices, was a true indulgence. The meat was succulent and flavorful, and the accompanying gravy added an extra layer of richness to the dish. The attention to detail and the quality of ingredients were evident in every bite.

The service at Bageecha was exceptional, with the staff displaying deep knowledge of the menu and offering helpful suggestions. The waitstaff was attentive, ensuring that every need was promptly attended to, and their warm hospitality further enhanced the overall dining experience.

In conclusion, my visit to Bageecha for the Awadhi Food Festival was an absolute delight. The culinary journey through the flavors of Awadh was truly remarkable, and the team at Bageecha deserves commendation for their commitment to authenticity and excellence. If you're a lover of Awadhi cuisine or simply seeking a unique dining experience, Bageecha is an absolute must-visit., name_person=shripad marathe}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in}, time_line=3 years ago, review=We had one of our dinners while staying at Novotel Mumbai Juhu Beach at Bageecha restaurant. The specialty Indian restaurant of Novotel Mumbai was what we were excited for. Crossing the garden area and the pool, we reached the beautiful restaurant and were excited to dine in besides the pool under the starlit sky and around the palm trees.

The 45 seater restaurant features heritage and ancient recipes of India that might be forgotten by us. A proper Indian ancient dining set up was waiting for us. Chef Kuldeep greeted us with a beautiful smile and acquainted us with the menu for the night. Small buckets with various dips- garlic, apple and mint chutneys accompanied with papad made its way to our table. An Indian meal is incomplete without mint chutney and papad….isn’t it?

For starters, we had Kabuli Chicken Tikka- soft, juicy succulent chicken tikka pieces served with sliced onions, lemon and green chilli. They tasted great with the chutneys. Rawa Fish Fry was crispy, very tasty and authentic. I have never had such tasty fish. A must try! Soft and mushy inside and juicy too served with onions, tomatoes, carrots and lemon. Just perfect! Punjabi Murgh Tikka was a little spicy but juicy with big pieces of chicken marinated and done well in Punjabi style. Appetizing and great to eat! Time for Tangri Chicken. Aah! The best part of the chicken. Well marinated, mildly spiced and well presented with cucumber slices, tomatoes and chillies. Juicy and succulent! Paneer Tikka had soft, big chunks of paneer which were great and perfectly spiced. Galauti Kebab were melt in mouth! The bite-sized kabab made it so convenient to eat. Achari Fish Tikka and Kalaunji Fish Tikka had great margination with unique flavours which we loved.

Since we were almost full, we didn’t order a lot in Main course. Dal Makhani was tasty, creamy with a rich consistency and was flavourful. Butter Chicken was made with small boneless pieces which were soft, juicy, perfect with a yummy gravy and spices. Homestyle Palak had homely style patta, laccha palak- very desi and Indian. We relished all this with raita and assorted breads- Tandoori and Roomali Rotis which were fresh, soft and yummy.

For Desserts, our picks were Basoondi, with dry fruits and strawberries, a milk-based dessert which was amazing. Gulab Jamun was good, deliciously laden with pistas.  Not to forget Rajbhog Ice-cream and the Paan ice-cream- with a lovely after taste. Welcome to Bageecha, where lost Indian recipes are found, where the Waves of the beach are encountered, where the wind flutters & the pool Besides shines.
As you walk here on a winter evening you will see an open kitchen set up and aroma of spices in the air is enchanting you.
It's just too wonderful and welcoming.
Here authentic Indian food is served to you and lost recipes which Indians had are found.
To start with,
Sabz makhmali seekh which was really soft and flavoursome
Then had the Mushroom galouti and I absolutely loved it
Who doesn't like Paneer? The Parakdar Paneer was soft and luscious.
I know it's nothing what people mention but I feel assorted papads with variety of chutnis are a major thing in Indian cuisine. . The different chutneys served in a bucket with Papad refills and raita just made me too happy.
Bhakharkhani flavour of fennel and nuts  . I had this sabji and loved it as I had never tried it earlier.
Paneer Damani - I really liked this Vegetable as it again the dish depends on how soft the cottage cheese is with its gravy too.
Sabz Bageecha - This was their speciality. I loved it completely
Palak aur gobe or kofte - Kofte were perfectly held up and I didn't think that palak would taste so good.
Dal bageecha dal Makhani : A lot of people and well renowned chefs say you judge a place by its dal . It's all about the dal . The thickness, the consistency all has to match. And thankfully this one did justice to it .
Dal tadka : Dal Tadka had that touch. The masala yet nor so strong .
I tried different breads this time apart from the normal Roti sabji : I really liked the  Shirmal saffron flavour and Taftan awadhi bread
And now my favourite part 😍😍😍😍
The desserts . I don't know but Indian desserts just have my heart . They make me feel at home .
From falooda to the three flavours of icecream (not to forget the Motichoor icecream) and the rasmalai !
Do head there for a memorable meal,

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 months ago, review=We recently visited Bhaijaanz Resto Bar, and it was truly a memorable experience! From the moment we entered, the aesthetic ambience set the tone. The cozy interiors are adorned with wallpapers and tributes to Salman Khan, which makes it a perfect spot for fans and Bollywood lovers.
The vibe is chill and welcoming – a great place to hang out with your loved ones and soak in the Bollywood feels. The renovated ambience adds a fresh touch, and there's a dedicated bar section where you can enjoy a range of refreshing mocktails and cocktails.
🍸 Drinks we tried:
Cosmopolitan – Refreshing and perfectly balanced
Whiskey Sour – Unique twist, great taste
🍢 Starters:
Mutton Seekh Kebab – Juicy and well-spiced
Chicken Tangdi Kebab – Tender and flavorful
🍛 Main Course:
Chicken Lahori with Butter Garlic Naan – Rich and creamy
Chicken Dum Murgh Biryani – A must-try (and apparently a favorite of Salman sir himself!)
Chicken Darbar Latpata with Tandoori Roti – Spicy and satisfying
🍨 Dessert:
Sizzling Brownie with Vanilla Ice Cream – The perfect sweet ending
If you're a Salman Khan fan or just looking for a good Indian-Mughlai dining experience in Bandra/Khar, Bhaijaanz is a must-visit. Great food, great vibe, and a tribute to a Bollywood icon – what more could you want?, name_person=amin shaikh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_SPECIAL_EVENTS=[Others, E:DINING_SPECIAL_EVENTS_OTHERS], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_SEATING_TYPE=[Indoor_dining_area, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_INDOOR_DINING_AREA, Bar_area, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_BAR_AREA], GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_PARKING_LOT, Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SPECIAL_OFFERS=[Happy_hour, E:DINING_SPECIAL_OFFERS_HAPPY_HOUR, Weekday_specials, E:DINING_SPECIAL_OFFERS_WEEKDAY_SPECIALS, Weekend_specials, E:DINING_SPECIAL_OFFERS_WEEKEND_SPECIALS], GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=2 months ago, review=I Organised My Bday Celebration At Bhaijaanz . reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Delivery}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Hardly anything had spice in it. Never tasted bland KFC chicken until now. Chicken wings were not fresh. They were smelly and was little black on the inside., name_person=Aaron Pinto}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Would not recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹200–400, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Somewhat difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=5 months ago, review=I recently visited this KFC outlet and while the ambience, cleanliness, and staff behavior were all quite good, I felt disappointed with the taste and quality of the food. The items didn't meet expectations, especially considering the pricing.

Also, the offers seem to come with too many terms and conditions, which reduces their value. I believe there's definitely scope for improvement in terms of flavor, portion size, and better pricing transparency. Hoping KFC takes feedback seriously to enhance the overall experience., name_person=Sudip Pawar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=2}, time_line=4 months ago, review=I ordered for 4 zinger burgers with cheese but they didn’t add cheese to the burgers. After reminding them they added cheese slice to our half eaten burgers and returned. Pathetic, name_person=Sidd 6983}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹200–400, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Delivery, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=Edited a year ago, review=Disclaimer: It was a delivery so please ignore the ratings for ambiance.

I was always impressed by their customer service. I visited a KFC outlet for the first time in Kolkata, when it just started its operations. I still remember I asked the rep whether I can get a cold drink instead of whatever they were providing complementary at that time. Though the drink was priced significantly higher than the product that was in the offer, the rep without hesitation handed the drink to me.
I was amazed, and asked him to pay the balance amount. And, he said with a smile - "nothing". He didn't even bother to get a nod from his manager. Really impressive!
Anyway, at present, the food was delivered before the stipulated 45 minutes. Though, I was not there to receive, they didn't make a fuss or bother me with a call. They simply left it with the person who opened the door after checking my credentials.
The wings were of course delectable. I would say if they charge any premium, they certainly deserve it. 👍🏼, name_person=Soumik Biswas}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1}, time_line=2 months ago, review=The service is very slow each time we visit. The store is not maintained. Air-conditioning does not work. The staff needs to be changed. For a single meal they take 20 mins to serve and get on the table., name_person=Pooja Singh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in}, time_line=4 months ago, review=I was quite disappointed with my experience. The ambience was not good and the AC was not working, which made it very uncomfortable as it was quite hot. The quantity of food served was much less compared to the price, and what was shown on the menu/ads was different from what was actually given. The taste was also below expectations. Overall, the pricing felt too high and not at all worth the quality or quantity provided., name_person=sayed nazia}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Not sure, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Not_sure, E:ANSWER_NOT_SURE]}, time_line=2 months ago, review=I have visited many KFC outlets before, and honestly, whenever I went with my family and friends, my experience was good. But today, I had a very bad and disappointing experience. The staff was extremely casual, busy talking among themselves instead of paying attention to customers.

On top of that, regarding the food, even after the timer board showed the time was up, we were still made to wait another 10–15 minutes. We had ordered the Sunday offer which included 2 Pepsi, 1 Mojito, 1 bucket of chicken, and 1 chicken strips. After waiting 15 minutes to receive everything, the chicken strips came another 10 minutes late. The food was also too oily and not at all up to KFC’s standards.

We’d simply asked for an extra bottle of our drink, which they didn’t have. Fair enough. But instead of handling it politely, the person in charge was extremely rude and unprofessional — refusing not just to arrange it, but also to let us get it from outside. While I completely understand restaurant policies, what matters is how you say things and clearly, basic courtesy wasn’t on the menu.

To top it off, the prices were exorbitantly high for the quality And quantity of food offered. We paid a very high price  for 3 pastas, 1 pizza, 2 sizzlers, 2 Thai green curries, — and for that price, I’d at least expect decent quality and portion size. The food was average at best, And let’s not even talk about the Thai Green Curry, last I checked, it’s supposed to be savory, not sweet and confused. It honestly tasted like Thai curry paste and sugar had an illegitimate child.

Honestly, I went in expecting warmth, good food, and hospitality. What I got instead was attitude, disappointment, and a bill that definitely wasn’t worth it.

If this is what passes for “highly acclaimed,” maybe it’s time the management revisited both their hospitality lessons and their recipes.

Despite my disappointment with the food and the management I feel it's necessary to make clear that the person attending was extremely professional and polite, my grievance is with the manager and my anger is directed towards the owner who despite being asked to be spoken to a lot of time refused to speak with us or address the issue...

For example, I have a kid, so my choice of restaurant is the one with a kid-friendly ambiance and greater food choices. So, I would be looking for such reviews. My experience in a nut shell:

1. Food - Nothing really great taste wise and an expensive affair for the quality of food and mocktails served here. We tried the following:
A) Chicken 🐔 cheese 🧀 Tikka - Nothing really great but not bad either
B) Non veg cream of mushroom 🍄 soup 🍲 - A good taste and blended well with all the ingredients in it
C) Non veg Alfredo Pasta 🍝 - Creamy and a good quantity
D) Blue Lagoon Mocktail - Okayish taste and definitely not worth the amount charged
E) Lychee Lemongrass - Again okayish taste with with a lot of lemongrass in it

2. Ambience - Excellent and well lit with nice soft music 🎶 playing in the background

3. Service - All the servers have a smile on their face however, needs to be more attentive. I had told them that I want the mocktails to be served at room temperature however they served me cold ones. They got it rectified even though I had taken a sip from it.

Do not worry about parking 🅿️ as they have valet parking available

I don't like when restaurants levy a service charge without your consent. When I enquired about it they asked me if I wanted it to be taken off to which I told them not to. The point is "Do not charge it in the first place without the customer's consent"

The place is embellished with an amazing set up in the dining area with spacious seating. On top of that, the dessert bar with an amazing line up of sweet treats and confectionery adds to the charm.

The bistro makes you feel in your element with their camaraderie. The atmosphere of this place and the crew connive to make the customer feel like a huésped as they embrace them to their ménage.

The service was pretty good. Our table was hosted by Mr. Rahul, Mr. Nikhil and Mr. Vishal. They helped us out in selecting the dishes and were very friendly. The restaurant being an part of The Empresa, has to manage the hotel guests along with the adventurous diners who visit the place. So it may take a while to get what you order but the food is totally worth the wait.

They serve a variety of dishes from the Mediterranean and North Indian Cuisine. The menu is pretty elaborate and covers a lot of palatable dishes with top class presentation. The chefs collude to serve appetizing and innovative dishes to appease the diners and bring a smile of satisfaction on their faces.

Our table was festooned with salads, burgers, appetizers, risotto and desserts.
We started off with 'Feta & Co. '. It's a salad constructed with the Greek Feta and a combination of fresh fruits and mixed greens. The salty and tangy taste of Feta combined with the flavours of fresh fruits and avocado makes it one of the finest salads in the menu.

The 'Supreme Crisp Burger' had the perfect cohesiveness between the amount of bun, meat and toppings. It was a merger of the chicken supreme patty, onion rings with the side of potato wedges. The bun was nicely toasted to hold up the patty. The quality of the meat used was top class which made the burger very juicy.
We also had 'Easy green Burger' which was served with a side of potato wedges and salads. It had a delectable taste.

Mediterranean food is more than just pizza and spaghetti, for a change, we ordered 'Grilled Portobello & Asparagus Risotto'. It was ambrosial! Amazing taste. The 'Potato Mille-Feuille' was very appetizing. The combination of fried potatoes and wild mushrooms with parmesan ragoût made it delicious!

We had a few beverages here: 'Passion Fruit Chilli Lemonade' and 'Blueberry & Basil lemonade'. They were very refreshing. The passion fruit chilli tasted really good. It had a spicy twist to it.

They serve some of the most bewitching and delicious desserts. We had 'Hazelnut Mousse' and 'Chocolate Chip Cupcake'. The Hazelnut mousse is one the best desserts I've had in a while. It tasted heavenly with a the base made of chocolate crumbs. The cup cake tasted alright. I liked the Mousse more.

Mediterranean food is one of those cultural elements that have felicitously helped to preserve the special nature of the Mediterranean.
When it comes to Mediterranean Cuine, Loco loca is definitely one of the best places in town., name_person=GLEN MONTEIRO}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=LOCO LOCA

Loco loca is located in the Sab Tv lane New link road Andheri west. This restaturant is part of Empressa Hotel.
This is a best place to visit with your partner, it had such a beautiful ambience.
Staff were very friendly and we tried most of the dish which were recommended. They serve North Indian Cuisine, Mediterranean and Spanish. This place have
• Spanish Rice Bowl
Highly recommended dish. The spanish rice is given Indian tadka touch with mixture of bell peppers , tomato and bell pepper with melted cheese topped over the rice. It was yummy and delicious.
Its the best rice i have ever tried.
• Bombay Bravas
The presentation of this was so amazing.
This dish had dal makhni base with fried potato cubes and topped with lots of cheese. The taste of the dish was very delicious.

• Khopoli Croquetas
This is more a type of Vada Pav. Vada pav masala was stuffed in croquetas and it was crispy from outside. This was a very delicious dish and loved the comcept of presentation. It is served with spicy green chutney.

• Lemonades Blueberry & Basil
A mocktail with an amazing blend of blueberry and basil with herb topped onto the drink.

• Whisky and Smoke
Loved the concept of this dish. The dish exactly looked like a smoke cigar. It is a chocolate cigar stuffed with whisky mouse. It had very strong taste of whisky.
Loved it!!!

Overall
Service 5/5
Food 4/5
Ambience 4/5, name_person=Vinay Doshi}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=2 years ago, review=An open air restaurant located inside the premises of Empress hotel just in front of the entrance gate. Valet is available in the hotel premises.

The price of food and beverages are normal. The entire restaurant has been decorated with a green architecture with a wall dedicated to plants and creepers. A perfect place to take picture.

A giant screen is available in the middle of the restaurant and thus can be a great place during top sporting events.

The waiters are very polite and helpful. However they need to be bit more attentive as finding them at times was difficult as they were not making eye contacts

Tried their peri peri chicken that was above average. In the main course I tried grilled chicken and mushroom sizzlers served with rice made in Oriental style. It was indeed very tasty. In Sizzlers they have options to make it in Oriental or Mediterranean style. In Oriental it’s severed with rice while in Oriental Spaghetti is used.  The patron can also choose between French fries or potato wedges or mashed potatoes as the side.

I went in here reading it’s a Spanish place although it turned out to be different. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=9 months ago, review=Wine Review:
Christian Moreau Chablis 2016

It is very rare to find a Christian Moreau Chablis in India, and it was nice to see this wine on the menu at Le Cirque, Mumbai, and I ordered the same for my dinner.

Christian Moreau is one of the oldest and most respected domains in Chablis.
Wine has fruit notes like apple, green apple, pear etc.
A very beautiful and amazing Chablis wine.

Food Review:
A great wine needs great food.
That’s where the restaurant failed badly, and food was below average.

Initially their regular Chef prepared a dish based on lobster, and probably lobster was stale and the food was very bad which is not expected from such a restaurant.
Next a prawn based dish which was completely bad as well.
Finally I had a discussion with the restaurant manager and has concluded to change the regular Chef to another Chef Kamlesh to take over the dishes for dinner.
Kamlesh was comparatively better I felt when he prepared further dishes.

To be frank the restaurant had only me as a customer for the whole evening and it was very empty. Only one more customer came for a very short snacks that evening on another table.
I could understand it’s probably because of the bad Chef and lack of fine dining food menu.
I used to be a regular customer of the same restaurant Le Cirque in Bangalore which was much better as per my experience.

After discussing with Chef Kamlesh, I ordered smoked Scottish Salmon as starters which was very nice.
Followed by Pomfret dish which was quite average.
Next, another baked fish and vegetables.

Dessert:
The Chef Kamlesh suggested a portion of Crème Brûlée + Tiramisu.
Crème Brûlée was nice and tiramisu was average.

Conclusion:
To conclude, the overall experience was far below expectations.
The restaurant also didn’t had any special dishes like fish roe/caviar or scallops on the menu.
Food menu needs a lot of improvements to include fine dining dishes.
I could see that “Leela” failing very badly on expectations in Mumbai.

Probably needs a better Chef or Chef needs to improve a lot., name_person=Vivek Rajagopalan}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Creme_Brulee], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_PARKING_LOT, Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Dietary_restrictions, E:OTHER_DIETARY_RESTRICTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 years ago, review=The restaurant Le cirque serves the classic, authentic Franco-Italian cuisine. Le Cirque’s original outpost in NYC was owned by the famed Maccioni family where the rich and famous used to dine. The only problem was they didn’t move forward in time and naturally the decline of an era was inevitable. Credits to the Nair’s of the Leela group who joined hands with Maccioni’s and revamped the Le Cirque opening it’s first Indian outpost in Delhi. From then, everything has gone upwards. Torii in Bandra came highly recommended\u2014and spoiler alert\u2014it almost lives up to the hype, and then some.\\n\\nLet\u2019s start from the outside: that black-and-white arched entrance with the gold-lettered TORII feels like you\u2019re about to enter a movie set. Inside, the vibe is unmistakably plush\u2014with mirrored ceilings, retro lampshades, opulent seating, and music that doesn\u2019t scream at you but keeps the energy flowing. It\u2019s where Japanese zen meets Mumbai glam.\\n\\nThe Meal\\nWe were 7. The table bill read \u20b945,999, so yes, about \u20b96.5K per head after taxes and service, but here\u2019s what made it feel worth it:\\n\u2022\\tCold Young Coconut Carpaccio \u2013 Sounds fancy and tasted the part. It\u2019s what black cod dreams are made of.\\n\u2022\\tChicken Chilli Oil & Lemongrass Chicken Tsukune \u2013 Packed flavour bombs. The chilli oil was a standout.\\n\u2022\\tCold Prawns Tempura Maki \u2013 Crisp, clean, and a hit with everyone at the table.\\n\u2022\\tTwilight Tingles (mocktail) \u2013 Refreshing and not sugary, a tough balance to nail.\\n\u2022\\tTorii X-mess Sundae \u2013 The name may be cheeky, but this dessert brought childlike joy with its waffle castle presentation. The kind of ending you photograph before devouring.\\n\\nService\\nSmooth, attentive, and non-intrusive. Our server knew the menu well and paced the meal right. That\u2019s half the job done in high-end dining.\\n\\nWhat Could Be Better?\\nNot much honestly. A couple of small hits and misses on portion sizes (looking at you, gyoza), but hey, we weren\u2019t here for the quantity.\\nThe bill might jolt you for a second, but by the end of the night, you\u2019ll justify it to yourself with, \u201cWell, the black cod made up for it.\u201d\\n\\nMy final two bit\\n\\nPaise gaye, par taste ban gaya.\\n\\nAide  dessert  pe toh calories bhi selfie mangti hai.\\n\\n\\uD83D\\uDCCD Final Verdict:\\n\u2b50\ufe0f\u2b50\ufe0f\u2b50\ufe0f\u2b50\ufe0f\u2b50\ufe0f \u2014 A strong 5 stars for a place that brings together design, service, and standout dishes under one gilded roof. The Firangi juice had more peru(guava) taste than strawberry, but was fresh and not too sugary. Will definitely try other curious combos the next time.

Pasta pe Pasta was a combination of macaroni in cheesy sauce and speghetti in red sauce, taste was pretty good, the breads served with it were a little dry.

Staff was very nice and let us use the group seating area which could easily accommodate 9-10 people although we were just 2. The ambience is pretty good.

name: The Sassy Spoon Powai
reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_SPECIAL_EVENTS=[No_special_event, E:DINING_SPECIAL_EVENTS_NO_SPECIAL_EVENT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Sassy Spoon is a delightful restaurant that offers a fantastic dining experience. I recently visited and was thoroughly impressed by the quality of food and the overall ambiance. The tacos I ordered were absolutely delicious — well-seasoned, perfectly cooked, and presented beautifully. It’s clear that a lot of thought goes into their food preparation and presentation.

The restaurant has a cozy yet vibrant atmosphere, making it a great place to unwind with friends or enjoy a casual meal. The interiors are tastefully done, creating a pleasant and inviting environment. The background music was subtle and didn’t overpower conversations, which added to the charm.

Located in a prime area, Sassy Spoon is easy to find and accessible. The staff was courteous, attentive, and prompt in their service, ensuring we had a comfortable experience throughout. The menu has a wide variety of options, and the pricing felt reasonable for the quality offered.

Whether you’re a foodie or someone just looking for a relaxed outing, Sassy Spoon won’t disappoint. I would highly recommend trying their tacos and exploring other items on the menu — it’s definitely a place worth revisiting. Overall, a great spot for good food, good vibes, and a memorable time., name_person=rahul gupta}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 months ago, review=Beautiful ambience. in desserts, we had the seven textures of chocolate and hazelnut and the salted caramel cheesecake. good presentation but taste didn't feel like the same., name_person=Anamika P}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=3 months ago, review=Nice place. Nice food. A little expensive for the menu and offerings. But nice., name_person=Charu Thukral}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Paid_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_PAID_PARKING_LOT], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION]}, time_line=a month ago, review=Usually all Powai restaurants are pretty bad-mouthed for it's food's taste and being over-expensive. I felt a little pinch of truth in this statement here.
The Vegetarian food was Okay okay for me. My friends however liked their Non Veg.
But when it comes to the service and the behaviour of staff and their conduct, also the ambience, a straigh 5 star.
Also Must try the kokum drink in mocktails section. And Corn based started is amazing and very unique, loved it., name_person=DEVAL CHAUHAN}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=Must try dishes: Sassy 65, Mutton Biriyani and Toffee pudding.
This is one of the places where you can speak to each other without the obnoxious loud music. Waiters are attentive and service is good. They do provide 10% corporate discount., name_person=Forever Wanderer}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=Edited 4 years ago, review=Please allow me to explain the reason for my rating.

We visited the place after one of my friend at college got placed with a good company.
We reach the restaurant around 10, and we were rushed into ordering soon as the kitchen was closing soon which is understandable.
We ordered pork ribs, Punjabi mutton curry, Spaghetti and a couple of starters.
The first thing that shocked us was the portion size, the atrociously priced started just had 4 pieces, and the main course was half the size of a usual main course.
The taste was also sub-par, and when we asked for the manager, they stalled us for half an hour and then they tell us that the manager is on leave, and then we asked for a feedback book, after which they again stalled for another half an hour and then they come back empty handed and they tell us they don't have a feedback book.
That's just sad for a restaurant it's size.

The ambience was good but I was expecting better hospitality and better tasting food., name_person=Girish Kumar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 years ago, review=My visit to The Sassy Spoon was for a very short time but I will definitely visit again and again.
The ambience is beautiful.
In salad we ordered Warm lemony couscous with toasted almonds & grilled chicken which was the best salad I ever had.
In small plates we had Apple wood smoked beetroot & goat cheese croquettes with tomato chilli jam which tasted sweet and savoury and really good in taste.
Also we had Grilled chicken in house smoked BBQ glaze, mozzarella & fresh basil.

Overall it was a wonderful experience at The Sassy Spoon.
Kudos to all the staff for amazing service., name_person=Vighnesh Joshi}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Wanted a cosy, comfortable place with good food and ambience for a small group.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Great menu, good location, valet parking, live music, great experience.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=We ordered pork ribs, Punjabi mutton curry, Spaghetti and a couple of starters.}"]

I stopped by Love N Latte early in the morning, and I was pleased to find it open at 8:30 am. The staff were courteous and welcoming, setting a positive tone for my visit.

The cafe was clean and well-maintained, which is always a plus.

For food, I opted for the English Breakfast, which consisted of sautéed mushrooms, chicken sausage, 2 eggs, 2 bread toasts, and baked beans. While the dish was moderately filling, I felt the quantity could have been better, especially considering the price of INR 300. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=2 months ago, review=🌴 Baliboo Cocktail and Cuisine – A Tropical Escape in Goregaon! 🌺
Located on the first floor of Commerz II, Oberoi Garden City, Baliboo is truly a hidden gem in Goregaon. The moment you step in, you're transported to a serene, Bali-inspired setting with soft ambient lighting, lush indoor greenery, elegant statues (like a majestic elephant), and earthy, resort-style décor. The vibe is relaxed yet sophisticated — perfect for a peaceful evening or a special celebration.
The interiors are warm and contemporary, blending natural elements like glass, plants, and wood to create a space that feels both cozy and open. The bar is seamlessly integrated into the dining area, making it great for both casual drinks and full meals.
We tried their Japanese menu, and it was a delight:
🍣 California Sushi Roll
🥟 Spinach & Cream Cheese Gyoza
🍗 Miso Caramel Chicken
🍛 Japanese Katsu Curry Chicken
For dessert, the Matilda Chocolate Cake and Tiramisu were indulgent and beautifully plated.
Drinks were equally impressive:
🍸 Jamun Juice Cocktail
🍉 Thirsty Watermelon Mocktail
❄️🍓 Snowberry Mocktail
🌹 Rosetta Cocktail
Each item was flavorful and well-prepared, with great presentation. The staff was friendly, attentive, and happy to guide us through the menu.
✨ Whether you're a local or just passing through, Baliboo is a must-visit in Goregaon for its ambiance, fusion food, and refreshing drinks. Highly recommended!, name_person=amin shaikh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Other, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_RESERVATION=Reservations recommended, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=Visited Baliboo yesterday for a meet-up, and the place instantly felt warm and inviting. The décor was tastefully done with thoughtful detailing, and the plants added such a soothing, fresh appeal to the whole space. It was clean, and the setting sun gently waving goodbye from one side made the atmosphere even lovelier.
The service was prompt. I ordered a cold coffee... hmm it was alright, nothing much to highlight on the food front yet.
But the seating was comfortable, and the space felt bright, open, and easy to settle into. It's a nice place to explore. Reservation recommended.
Try it Out.
All the best., name_person=Hina Beg Therapist}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=6 months ago, review=Had a lovely birthday lunch at Baliboo and really enjoyed the overall experience! The vibe is chill and welcoming, perfect for a relaxed outing. The food was delicious, served fresh and without delays. The staff was friendly, attentive, and made us feel truly taken care of. While the cocktails were average, everything else—from service to ambience—was on point.

They gave us a feedback form asking for birth and anniversary dates. When I asked if there were any discounts or complimentaries linked to that, they initially said no. But just as we were about to leave, a staff member surprised us with a pastry that said “Happy Birthday”—a sweet, thoughtful gesture that showed they really listened and acted on feedback. Truly appreciated it!

A beautiful place and definitely worth a visit!, name_person=Anjali Chauhan}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=3 months ago, review=Visited Baliboo, Goregaon recently and tried a few dishes – Anardhana Bhatti Murgh, Lasagna Alla Pollo, Korean Gochujang Bowl, and Tiramisu. The food was absolutely delicious – perfectly cooked, rich in flavors, and beautifully presented. Each dish stood out, especially the lasagna and tiramisu which were spot on!

The only downside was the service – it felt a bit slow, which made the waiting time longer than expected. But once the food arrived, it was definitely worth it.

Juhu outlet is in the famous Kishore Kumar bungalow.

Ambience & Interior - The design is beautiful, with earthy tones, glass ceiling, good lighting, greenery, decorative lamps and mirrors. Multiple types of seating, cozy corners, outdoors, glasshouse style spaces.

Menu - The restaurant offers a mix of global comfort food + twists. Cocktail / mocktail menu is creative. Food is “good” but not excellent for what is charged. Some dishes mentioned not matching expectations for the price. Portions are sometimes seen as small.

Good for Occasions & special dinners. The place has a lively vibe, especially later in the evening.

The staff is polite, but often ignorant, delays, or not being shown to the table properly even if reserved. Reservation issues.

that said, if you’re in the mood to splurge or just got your bonus, this is a great spot for a cozy dinner and chill evening. the vibe is classy yet relaxed, making it worth the visit.

Ambience: The ambience was amazing, especially at night. It felt pleasant, calm, and premium. They have both indoor and outdoor seating, so you can choose as per your preference. The space is well designed and can accommodate both couples and larger groups comfortably.

Food: They offer a variety of special dishes, right from starters to mains and desserts. Everything I tried was delicious and well presented.

name: Yeti - The Himalayan Kitchen, Mumbai
reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a year ago, review=If you're craving an authentic taste of the Himalayas, look no further than Yeti! This hidden gem offers a culinary journey like no other, with flavorful dishes that transport you to the majestic peaks of Nepal, Bhutan, and Tibet. From momos bursting with savory fillings to hearty curries that warm the soul, every bite at Yeti is a delightful adventure. The ambiance is cozy and inviting, making it the perfect spot for a memorable dining experience. Trust me, Yeti is a must-visit for anyone seeking delicious Himalayan cuisine and friendly service., name_person=Ankita Mali}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=We were there at 12 pm today for lunch. Though the food was good, it wasn’t served hot. The momos were cold and the soup was lukewarm. The restaurant was empty when we arrived. We requested to be seated at a slightly bigger table away from the AC vent. We were told that since it was Friday afternoon, they were expecting a large crowd. Though we said that we would have a quick lunch and leave, we were refused. When we left at 1.45 pm, only one other table was occupied., name_person=Melinda D'Silva}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Brunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Steamed_Momos, Chicken_Dry_Fry, Veg_Momos, Aloo_Ko_Achar, Sekuwa], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=10 months ago, review=If you’re craving authentic and flavorful Nepali cuisine, this restaurant is an absolute must-visit! They serve the best momos - whether it’s chicken steamed, fried, kothey, or the delicious veg options, each bite is packed with juicy goodness. Their laphing is spot-on, full of rich flavors and just the right amount of spice. The wai wai sadeko is a must-try too. It is tangy, crunchy, and addictive!

Beyond the food, their cocktails are good, perfectly complementing the meal. And if you’re in the mood for something warm and comforting, their thukpa (both veg and non-veg) is the best in town. The variety of options, fresh ingredients, and bold flavors make this place a top recommendation. If you love Nepali food or just want to try something new, this is the spot to go!, name_person=Arpita Chatterjee}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Steamed_Momos, Tingmo, Yeti_Veg_Platter], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=2 years ago, review=I recently visited Yeti - The Himalayan Kitchen, a restaurant located in Khar, Mumbai, and I must say that it was an incredible experience. The extensive Tibetan and Nepali menu offers a range of authentic dishes that are absolutely delicious. I tried the momos, thukpa, wai wai, tingmo bread, and Yeti platter, and they were all fantastic. The momos were especially noteworthy, as they were perfectly steamed and had a delicious filling. The thukpa was also a standout, with a rich broth and tender noodles. The drinks were also refreshing and complemented the food well. Overall, I would highly recommend Yeti - The Himalayan Kitchen to anyone looking for a unique dining experience in Mumbai., name_person=VARSHA JOSHI}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=Great ambiance, lovely food and hospitable staff. It felt like am in Kathmandu eating Thalaki 🚀🙌

Great work team., name_person=atul jha}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review=Yeti - Serves Himalayan and Tibetan food, is located in khar, is on 4th floor. This place has an amazing ambience, comfortable seating and serves some amazing food.

One of my most favourite dishes from here is the dry chicken fry and is highly recommended from here.

We ordered :-
1) Veg Momos - Nicely shaped huge 6 pieces and they were served with 3 different types of dipping chutney- red colour schezwan sauce, white colour coconut chutney and orange colour was for spicy chilli's and peanut...

2) Chicken Dry Fry - My favourite and most amazing dish here, deep fried boneless chicken pieces with lot of red, green and yellow bell peppers, caramelized onions and lot of  peanuts toased in an awesome spicy masala and garnished with lot spring onion greens. Highly recommended here...

3) Ema Datchi - A creamy cheesy gravy with lot of jalapenos in it, with pepper dressing and it is served with very unique but bread like bun, this dish is very similar to a white sauce that we use in pasta...

4) Egg Fried Rice - Small pieces of caramelized onion and fried egg properly mixed with the rice, garnished with lot of spring onions...

In Mocktails we ordered,

5) Raasta Special - this is a three layered colourful and refreshing drink and the lower layer which is a green colour is of khus sharbat and the middle one is the Cranberry juice and the top one is the canned watermelon juice. It looked beautiful and tasted great..., name_person=Styletravelzest !!!}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=So quite honestly this was our 1st experience with Himalayan food, I was bit spectical about the flavours and I have to admit my experience was amazing.

"Yeti" serves authentic Himalayan cuisine which consists of bhutanese, Nepali and Tibetian variant's.
Situated on the top floor it's an open roof top restaurant with decent sitting, clean and neat ambience with no unnecessary clutter.
Too add on to the Himalayan vibe, it started raining heavily and we thoroughly enjoyed our lunch with rooftop view.

As per our serves suggestion we ordered the following dishes from the menu:
♦️Ema datchi with tingmo : Amazing creamy, cheesy bhutanese preparation of mushroom ,chilly peppers served along with steamed bread from the said region. Highly recommended 👍
♦️Chicken Dry Fry : Kind of chicken 65 but with nice smoky flavour. Chicken was perfectly cooked and was bit spicy and we loved it.
♦️Shabalay : kind of fried dimsums but definitely very different. Very flavourful and I have to mention about the dips provided with it they were lip smacking. Surely recommended👍
♦️Mushroom with black bean paste: Not the usual mushroom tossed in black bean sauce this was authentic, you could taste the flavour of fermented black bean which was rustic and very interesting. Loved it., name_person=RCD thefoodie}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=5 years ago, review=Yeti- The Himalayan Kitchen, Khar Road.
Place-

Drinks-

Nestled in Bandra, this spot effortlessly blends exceptional service with outstanding food, making it one of the finest bars in the area. What truly sets SIXTEEN33 apart is its innovative cocktail menu, inspired by the rich heritage of Bandra’s older times and local produce from its different villages.

Each drink here isn’t just a mix of flavors but a story that pays homage to Bandra’s history. The bartenders take immense pride in sharing the tales behind the cocktails, adding an enriching touch to the experience. The craftsmanship and creativity that go into the drinks are unmatched, making every sip a trip down memory lane.

The food, too, stands out with a menu designed to complement the cocktails, and it’s nothing short of fantastic. From small plates to full meals, the flavors are as vibrant as the cocktails. The service is warm and attentive, ensuring that you feel well taken care of throughout your visit.

If you’re looking for a bar in Bandra that offers more than just a drink, SIXTEEN33 is the place to be. It’s a celebration of Bandra’s legacy, served in a glass., name_person=Sammeer Pakvasa}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=3 months ago, review=🚫 Extremely Disappointing Experience at Sixteen 33

I had high expectations for this place based on the reviews, but my experience was far from pleasant. From the moment we walked in, the staff seemed disinterested and dismissive. No one bothered to greet us properly —we were made to feel like we were a burden rather than valued guests.

To make matters worse, one of the staff members was outright rude when we politely asked for a menu. His tone was aggressive, and when we pointed it out, he brushed it off without an apology. Hospitality seems to be completely missing here.

The food took forever to arrive, and when it finally did, it was lukewarm and average at best. Certainly not worth the premium pricing. For a restaurant that prides itself on vibe and service, both were severely lacking.

I rarely leave negative reviews, but this experience was unacceptable. There are plenty of places in Bandra with far better service, food, and overall respect for customers.

Would not recommend., name_person=Pramila Pramila Ojha}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=The food is great, the service is smooth, the music was a vibe when we visited.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Creamy, flavorful, and served with jasmine rice—absolute comfort food!}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=My sister and I ordered the Nachos—they were loaded with cheese and guacamole.}"]

reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 months ago, review=If you’re looking for a warm and cozy café in Bandra West, Rituals Café is such a lovely find! From the moment you walk in, the vibe feels inviting – it has that cute, aesthetic charm that makes you want to sit down, relax, and just spend hours there. The upper deck seating is one of my favorite parts – perfect for catching up with friends, getting some work done, or even just enjoying a quiet coffee by yourself.

Cafe Trofima, located near the bustling Shivaji Park in Dadar, has garnered attention as a popular hangout spot, but it falls short of the hype for several reasons.

Food

The menu boasts a variety of food options, including breakfast platters, which might initially seem impressive. However, the taste of the food is compromised and does not justify the high prices. For a cafe that markets itself as a premium experience, the quality of the dishes leaves much to be desired.

Ambience and Seating

The sitting space is one of the better aspects of Cafe Trofima. Considering it is a cafe, the seating is comfortable and suitable for casual conversations or work. However, the overall ambience is just average, with no music to elevate the vibe. It lacks the warmth or charm that many would expect from a cafe in this area.

Service

The service is satisfactory but nothing extraordinary. While the staff is polite and attends to customers in a timely manner, the overall experience doesn’t stand out as memorable.

Location and Accessibility

A significant downside is the lack of parking space, which can be a hassle, especially given the busy location of Shivaji Park. Visitors arriving in their own vehicles may find it inconvenient.

Pricing

The prices are on the higher side, making it hard to justify for the quality of food and overall experience provided. While there are plenty of food options to choose from, the value for money is not reflected in the offerings.

Verdict

Cafe Trofima is overrated and doesn’t quite live up to its reputation. While it has some redeeming qualities like decent seating and satisfactory service, the compromised food taste, lack of parking, and high prices make it hard to recommend wholeheartedly. It could work as a one-time visit for those curious about its breakfast platters, but better options are available in and around the area for a more satisfying experience.

This particular Smokin' Joe's outlet is located on a very isolated road, which already makes it less convenient to access. While the food quality is acceptable and meets the standards of the brand (earning it 3 stars in the food category), the rest of the experience was significantly disappointing.
Atmosphere (1/5 Stars)
The dining area is a major drawback. It is confined to a small, tightly closed room with extremely limited seating, accommodating only about 10-15 people. This configuration feels claustrophobic and does not offer a comfortable dining experience.
Service (1/5 Stars)
The service was the most frustrating aspect. Due to the isolated location and very low foot traffic, the waiters appeared completely uninterested and disengaged. I had to repeatedly call them over for every request and to place each subsequent order. This lack of attentiveness severely detracted from the experience.
Final Verdict
If you are passing by and absolutely need a quick, reliable pizza from this brand, the food will suffice. However, the combination of the isolated location, cramped atmosphere, and genuinely poor, inattentive service means I cannot recommend dining in at this location. Management needs to address the service standards immediately.
