A Disappointing Experience – Overrated & Overhyped

If you’re planning a special evening at Liv Eatery & Bar, a rooftop restaurant located in Wagle Estate, Thane, you might want to reconsider. Our recent visit turned out to be the worst dining experience we’ve had in a long time, leaving us frustrated, disappointed, and still hungry.

Location & Ambience: 2/5

Let’s start with the location – while the building itself is new and modern, the area around it is dusty, unhygienic, and gives off a creepy vibe, especially after sunset. Upon arrival, guests are required to check in at the reception to get an entry pass before heading up to the 14th floor via a lift.

As we stepped out onto the rooftop, the Valentine’s Day decoration with red heart-shaped props and crimson focus lights was meant to create a romantic atmosphere. Unfortunately, it felt cheap and borderline eerie, more like a setup from a low-budget horror flick than a cozy date spot.

Seating arrangements were a major letdown.
The tables for couples were tiny, cramped, and paired with uncomfortable chairs. Even the waitstaff admitted that the seating was impractical. They added an extra small table to accommodate our order, but it hardly helped. We spent the evening struggling for space rather than enjoying our time.

Service: 1/5

Right from the moment we sat down, we noticed a pattern – the waitstaff was indifferent, inattentive, and seemed disinterested in serving guests. We had to wave multiple times just to get a menu card, setting the tone for what would be a frustrating dining experience.

Food Quality & Taste: 1/5

We ordered Chicken Cheese Kebabs with Jalapeños. The dish arrived with an “okayish” presentation with 6 pieces, but the taste was only spicy. The chicken inside was flavorless, and we had to request salt separately to make chicken somewhat palatable.

Our second dish was supposed to be a safe bet – Chicken Crispy, a personal favorite of my wife. What arrived was an utter disaster. The chicken was so rubbery and chewy that it felt like chewing gum. After just 2-3 bites, my wife gave up. I pushed myself to eat half the plate, but it left me with jaw pain and frustration. We left the rest of the dish untouched.

Interestingly, the couple seated next to us had also left their food untouched, and at the time, we wondered why. After our ordeal with the Chicken Crispy, we completely understood their decision. Wasting food is never ideal, but when it’s this inedible, it’s the only choice.

Smoky Atmosphere: 2/5

Adding to our misery, the restaurant is a smoker’s paradise. Smoke from nearby tables and bar counters constantly filled the air, making it unpleasant and suffocating for non-smokers like us.
Forget about enjoying your meal – you’ll spend half the time waving away smoke.

Final Straw: We Left Hungry

Frustrated and dissatisfied, we left the place with half-empty stomachs and headed to another restaurant to salvage what was left of our evening. Thankfully, we finally had good food elsewhere, but the damage to our mood was already done.

Overrated & Not Recommended

Liv Eatery & Bar is heavily overrated, and the reality falls far short of the hype. If you value good food, attentive service, and a pleasant atmosphere, this is not the place for you.
Spend your hard-earned money somewhere else where both your taste buds and your mood are respected.

•	Food Taste: 2/5
•	Location: 2/5
•	Atmosphere: 2/5
•	Music: 4/5

Tucked away quietly in Kalyan West, this restaurant is truly a hidden treasure. From the outside, it looks ordinary, but the moment you walk in, the beautifully crafted interiors simply leave you amazed. The ambience is elegant, warm, and far more luxurious than anything you’d imagine from the exterior.

A close friend recently celebrated his son’s birthday here, and the entire event was handled flawlessly. The staff is extremely polite, cooperative, and genuinely attentive. Their hospitality adds a special touch that makes every moment feel well taken care of.

The food is exceptional — flavourful, fresh, and served with great presentation. If there's one thing you must try, it’s their dimsums. Both veg and non-veg are perfectly prepared and easily among the best in the area.

They offer a dedicated dine-in section, a spacious party hall, and even a separate conference space — making it ideal for families, celebrations, and corporate events. The overall vibe is so refined and classy that it genuinely feels like a piece of South Mumbai brought to Kalyan.

reviews: ["{\"name_person\":\"Vinayak Londhe\",\"time_line\":\"6 days ago\",\"review\":\"I visited Ba\u011flami on 12/12/2025 in Mumbai, and it turned out to be a really enjoyable dining experience. The place is known for its Asian cuisine along with Italian pizzas and pasta, and I genuinely felt that the quality of the food matched its reputation.\\n\\nThe ambience is one of the biggest highlights of Ba\u011flami. If you visit in the evening, the beautiful lighting and overall atmosphere make the place feel warm, vibrant, and perfect for both casual outings and special occasions. The seating arrangement, staff behaviour, and even the washroom facilities were well-maintained and impressive. I would definitely recommend making a reservation beforehand, as the place tends to get full during peak hours.\\n\\nWe tried a few dishes and drinks:\\n\u2022 Spicy Chicken Pepperoni Pizza\\n\u2022 B Town Sunset (mocktail)\\n\u2022 10 Layer Chocolate & Nutella Cake\\nAmong these, the Nutella cake was the absolute winner \u2014 rich, delicious, and a must-try for dessert lovers. Overall, the food and drinks were flavorful, fresh, and satisfying.\\n\\nOne thing to note is that there is no dedicated parking for Ba\u011flami in the building, which can be slightly inconvenient especially in the BKC area. Another small drawback was that when we asked for still water, we were served a 750 ml bottle priced at \u20b9345, which felt a bit unnecessary and pricey.\\n\\nIn my personal opinion, the food is excellent but slightly overpriced. However, the ambience, service, and overall experience make it worth visiting at least once. With better parking arrangements, it would be even more convenient for customers.\\n\\nOverall, Ba\u011flami is a great place for a memorable dining experience, and I would gladly visit again.\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE\":\"Lunch\",\"GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE\":\"\u20b91,400\u20131,600\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL\":\"Loud, but you can still talk\",\"GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE\":[\"Suitable_for_all_group_sizes\",\"E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL\"]}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Tanvi Topkhanewale\",\"time_line\":\"2 weeks ago\",\"review\":\"Had an amazing anniversary dinner spent here. reviews: ["{\"name_person\":\"Shubham Muneshwar\",\"time_line\":\"4 months ago\",\"review\":\"We visited this restaurant yesterday night to celebrate a special occasion. After enjoying our meal, we cut our cake and requested the staff to pack the leftover cake as a parcel. Unfortunately, during the bill payment, we forgot to collect the cake in the rush as it was late and travelling options were limited.\\n\\nBy the time we reached home, it was already 1 AM. We immediately tried to call the restaurant, but no one answered. The next morning, we personally visited the restaurant to collect our cake. I’ve been a regular at High Point Veg Restaurant, having enjoyed their South Indian specialties like masala dosa, idli vada sambhar, tomato onion uttapam, and rava masala dosa on several past visits. These dishes have consistently delivered the rich flavors and textures one expects from a well-established South Indian eatery. However, my recent foray into their Chinese cuisine left much to be desired, warranting a cautious 2-star rating overall.

A Disappointing Dive into Chinese Cuisine

Lured by multiple glowing reviews on Zomato and Swiggy, I decided to explore the restaurant’s Chinese menu. I ordered three dishes—a rice option, a noodles dish, and a main gravy—to get a comprehensive taste:
•	Burnt Garlic Noodles: Despite the intriguing name, these noodles turned out to be bland, with a stale texture that did not live up to the promise of aromatic garlic notes.
•	Veg Fried Rice: Expected to be a flavorful accompaniment, the fried rice was devoid of any significant seasoning or spice, leaving it tasting flat and uninspired.
•	Mushroom Chilly in Schezwan Sauce: Perhaps the most disappointing of all, the mushroom in this dish was undercooked, and the overall preparation lacked the bold flavors characteristic of a well-executed Schezwan sauce.

Each dish suffered from one glaring issue: a profound lack of taste. It felt as if the Chinese menu was added merely for the sake of variety, rather than as a thoughtfully curated culinary experience.

Overpriced for the Outcome

To add to the disappointment, the final bill was steep relative to both the quality and quantity of the food served. When paying a premium, diners expect a memorable, flavor-rich meal—a standard the Chinese offerings at High Point simply did not meet.

Final Thoughts

While I would have preferred to give zero stars for the Chinese experience, my past positive encounters with their South Indian dishes have compelled me to settle on a 2-star rating overall. High Point Veg Restaurant remains a go-to for South Indian cuisine enthusiasts, but I would advise potential customers to think twice before trying their Chinese menu., name_person=Sagar Abichandani}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_PARKING_LOT], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Somewhat difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN, Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=a year ago, review=Disappointing Dining Experience at High Point

reviews:

Each dish had beautiful taste, flavour and textures and enjoyed the culinary exemplance.The chef’s special Greek fondue was a creamy, flavour-packed start, followed by the ratatouille cannelloni which was perfectly baked and beautifully balanced.

The presentations and flavours truly made a good first impression. The signature veggie pizza had a crisp base with fresh toppings, and the bistro veggie burger was hearty and delicious with a generous portion size of wedges

For drinks, we enjoyed the refreshing Rosemary Gin Fizz and the tangy Kokum O, both crafted really well. We ended on a sweet note with their decadent sizzling brownie

The Ficus-inspired interiors warm bistro vibe, well-stocked bar and great finger-food nibbles add to the charm. The European-style musiccosy tables, and chic décor make it a perfect spot for a relaxed meal Special shout out to Shakti for his great service, recommendations and Chef Prashant for his culinary magic. Our lunch was superb! From fizzy cocktails to creamy curries, this place is definitely here to stay!

Drinks
Rosemary Gin Fizz was sweet and light. Great use of gin and raspberry.

Italian Job was like an orange sweet. Very good when having a spicy curry.

Starters
Minestrone soup was filled with veggies that will satisfy your gut. Excellent to fill yourself if you’d like to lighten the rest of the meal.

House salad was superb in presentation and taste. The beet root added a sweet flavour to the salty leaves and hummus.

Mains
Panang curry was exquisite. Spicy 🌶️ too though. Very well cooked in coconut curry with that lovely orange colour and mixed veggies.
Steamed rice was a good accompaniment.

Asparagus and Saffron Risotto was very creamy and rich in taste. Definitely recommend it.

Desert
Chocolate Fondant was like this volcanic burst of chocolate sauce from a short volcano shaped cake. The orange ice cream was amazing.

Definitely recommend this place.

reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1–200, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=Edited a week ago, review=Anand on Hanuman Road, Vile Parle East has quickly become one of our regular go-to places simply because of both convenience and quality. Being very close to our home, we find ourselves visiting quite often, and the experience has consistently been satisfying. The restaurant offers a great mix of traditional South Indian dishes along with popular Mumbai-style snacks, which makes it a perfect spot whether you are in the mood for a classic dosa or a typical Mumbai indulgence like pav bhaji or grilled sandwiches. Their dosas are crisp and flavorful, the chutneys are fresh, and the pav bhaji has that authentic Mumbai taste without being overly spicy or greasy. The grilled sandwich is another favorite — well-stuffed and nicely toasted.

Service is fast, the staff is polite, and food arrives quicker than you expect, which is a big plus especially during busy hours. The seating area is slightly limited, so at peak times you might have to wait a bit or adjust accordingly. reviews:
["{guided_block={}, time_line=2 weeks ago, review=Such incredible food and a very cool vibe. Would definitely recommend going if you’re in Mumbai. This is the kind of place where one should skip the menu and just listen to their server., name_person=Shashank Ravi}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_RESERVATION=Reservations recommended, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=went on a sunday without reservations so it was quite crowded but we were seated quickly. the seekh kebabs and pork birria tacos were great but the eggs kejriwal was lowkey a miss. the melon drink was amazing. overall a great experience!, name_person=Navin Chawathe}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Loud, but you can still talk, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION, Clearly_labelled_vegetarian_dishes, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS]}, time_line=5 months ago, review=I was expecting to experience something that was uniquely and delightfully new as I reserved a table at The Bombay Canteen (as I had heard so much about it for so long) and I can safely say that this expectation was more than just met. It was a delightful afternoon spent with great cocktails and surprising fusion of flavors and concepts. We were a party of six, so we could experience a lot on the menu and barring perhaps a couple of the dishes, every other dish was simply delectable and yum! There isn’t a “one” dish that I can single out as the highlight, there were multiple of them. Among the cocktails we tried:
·         Tamarind Whisky Shake – just a hint of the sweet sourness from the tamarind to add the kick but did not lose the character of the whisky
·         Waiting List – Gin based, curry leaf salt flavored, quite innovative in terms of the flavors
·         Stranger cocktail – Refreshing and again flavor packed
For drinks we also had the IPA, Belgian Wit and a green apple mocktail (green flag). The beers were nice but the mocktail was ok, especially compared to the bursts of flavors we were experiencing from the other drinks. A lot of what we ate was all simply superb and sent us down a flavor packed, surprise filled road! I mean – who would have thunk “kadi patta khakra” can taste that good!!! (that comes with the carrot thoran btw). The Chive brioche that came with the squid kheema pao was so amazing that we asked for two extra portions of just the brioche! Buttery, fluffy and heavenly! The dishes we ate and loved: Garlic Sourdough Naan, Morning Glory, Squid Kheema Pao, Mutton claypot rice, malai kofta, chur chur paratha, avocado papdi chaat, carrot thoran, seyal Pao (chef’s kiss!!!), and sea bass sev puri.
On the flip side, some of the dishes in our opinion missed the mark or were simply not to our palate like the Prawn Malai Curry (felt very watery and one could only taste the galangal and not much else), Prawn Pani Puri (just felt like a bit of strange juxtaposition in terms of flavors) and the fish pulimunchi (which was good in terms of flavor but simply wasn’t pulimunchi). The Ghee roast kabab and the corn locho were not bad but felt quite flat and underwhelming.
Finally, do not miss the dessert! The Coffee Rasgulla Sundae is something else! I could eat an entire bowl of just the almond brittle in that dessert. Other desserts we ate and loved – Gadbad falooda, my uncle’s birthday cake and coconut phirni.
Our server Tilak was prompt, friendly and amazing with his recommendations. The service is quick and on point. Make sure to call ahead and reserve your table, especially if you plan to visit the place over the weekend. Valet parking is available., name_person=Kanchan Shetty}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=I first dined here on my birthday and that meal has been one of the top 5 of my life so far.

Luckily, we managed to get a table during lunch hours. The ambience was lively, and the staff was polite and helpful. Since I’m a pure vegetarian, we chose to stick to vegetarian options. On recommendation, we started with aloo chaat and corn. For the main course, we ordered malai kofta with paratha, followed by a delicious serving of kheer. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=Average eatery and nothing much to talk about.
My partners espresso martini was little better than drinkable. The pizzas were nothing to merit more than a three star rating. Although, and this is blasphemous, the vegetarian one was better than the ham pizza !!
No tobasco, no mustard. Maybe you bring your own.
Dessert was no go.
Second visit for me but, i don't find anything drawing me back., name_person=ranjeet mahtani}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=9 months ago, review=For our Valentine’s Day dinner, we visited this charming Italian restaurant, and it turned out to be an unforgettable experience. Given the occasion, reservations were essential, and we were lucky to secure a table.

The ambiance was warm and cozy, with soft lighting and elegant décor that set the perfect romantic mood. The staff was incredibly attentive, ensuring we were comfortable throughout the evening. Their service was prompt, friendly, and efficient, adding to the overall delightful experience.

Now, let’s talk about the food—undoubtedly one of the best Italian restaurants in Mumbai! We began with some cocktails, which were decent, though not extraordinary. Moving on to the appetizers, we opted for the mushroom ravioli, and it was simply divine. The rich and creamy mushroom sauce paired perfectly with the stuffed chicken ravioli, creating a dish that literally melted in the mouth.

For the main course, we tried the Pollo Picante pizza. It had a bold, spicy kick that added a unique twist to the classic flavors. While it wasn’t the best pizza we’ve ever had, it was still delicious, with a perfectly crispy crust and generous toppings.

The real showstoppers of the evening were the desserts. The Tiramisu was, without a doubt, the best I’ve ever had—light, creamy, and full of rich coffee flavors. The chocolate goey cake was equally indulgent, with a soft center that was pure perfection.

Yes, the restaurant is on the pricier side, but for an evening of exceptional food, top-notch service, and an intimate atmosphere, it’s absolutely worth it., name_person=Anjali Kubal}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 months ago, review=I live right next door and have had pizzas from all over the world, and I can honestly say Gustoso is right up there with the best. Their Arrabbiata Pizza is my absolute favorite, perfectly baked with just the right kick of spice and that unmistakable wood fired flavor.

The pastas and gnocchi are also amazing, full of flavor and always cooked perfectly. You can taste how fresh everything is.

It’s one of those rare places that gets everything right – great food, warm atmosphere and consistency every time. I feel lucky to have it in the neighborhood., name_person=Neil K}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_STREET_PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Dietary_restrictions, E:OTHER_DIETARY_RESTRICTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Somewhat difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Went there for impromptu dinner with the family. It was a great experience for the kids to see the Pizza is being made in front of them through the glass partition next to our dinner table. Italian food prepared here is beyond delicious. The preparation is fantastic, and the service is great. Street parking is bit of an issue but everyone seems to find a way., name_person=Rahul Sancheti}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Margarita_Pizza], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=9 months ago, review=We had two Margherita pizzas, 1 thin crust and one thick crust, loved them both💯💯
ALSO, we had 1 serving of Penne pasta in Red sauce, which was quite good too🍽️🍽️
I liked the thick crust Margherita more than the thin crust, I had asked them to give me some chilli sauce and also some parmesan cheese (both free of cost).
Had beverages (yes they are quite expensive but quite delicious too👌🏻👌🏻
Ambience was good, valet parking is available too. We went at dinner hours so rush was quite expected, BUT, the service was still amazing 🙏🏻, name_person=Adit Wilankar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Burratina_Pizza_with_Jalapeños_and_Garlic, Affogato, Margherita_Pizza], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=9 months ago, review=Tried the pizza and arrabbiata pasta at Gustoso, and both were absolutely amazing! The pizza had the perfect crust, great balance of toppings, and a deliciously authentic flavor. The arrabbiata pasta was just the right mix of spice and richness—exactly what I was craving. Great food, good ambiance, and totally worth it!, name_person=Ruchita Mishra}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Non_Veg_and_Veg_Pizza], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=2 years ago, review=Happened to walk-in to this seemingly little looking restaurant which at first gave me train type feels, as it is long restaurant (the seating and space of Gustoso is length wise). This is possibly a Bombay thing. But once we sat at our little corner table it felt like a warm, cozy space with a fancy yet comfortable vibe. The place is beautifully and minimalistic-ally done and has a bigger dinning space towards the end (I think it is the smoking space).
We ordered all vegetarian dishes - a pizza, arancini balls and another starter whose name I cannot recall. All the dishes were delicious and served in decent time. All were fresh and it sort of justify the price of the same. Most dishes here cost upwards of 700-800. While we didn't order any beverages our bill was around 2500/-. This place is a must go for Italian food lovers (who want to enjoy a meal without an overdose of cheese).

This place is located in a corner on the main road (at least that's why it was when I last visited). Despite being a pricey place it was packed and I suggest you do a reservation and visit the place. The place was packed with family, couples, young and old alike., name_person=Geetanjali Harnal}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Tiramisu], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=a year ago, review=Overall, I believe the taste of food and quality of cheeses used can improve at Gustoso. Here's my review of the 3 dishes I ordered.

1. The Veggie Pizza: Crust was excellent and authentic. However, the taste of the cheese was missing. Also, the base was moist. I'd want to try more pizzas here, though. Upon request, they give chili oil and parmesan as well.

2. Mushroom Risotto: This was the biggest disappointment. The consistency and texture of the sauce of the risotto was missing, and it overall lacked seasoning and flavor. It was just doused in oil, which didn't help much.

3. Tiramisu (had on a prior visit): This was  good, and I will order again.

Service: This needs improvement. They only refilled my glass with water when asked. They need to be more proactive in filling glasses with water. Also no one came to ask on my experience with the food. Staff is polite though.

Ambience: Dimly lit. The bathroom door needs better signage.

I may skip this place in the future as it's not value for money. 2k for just pizza and risotto that were not up to the mark., name_person=Zoshua Colah}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Also it is the place, the ambience and the service and the prices!!}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Pizza was loaded with the sauce but little to no cheese and meat (pepperoni).}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=It’s a cozy and relaxing space and delicious wood fired pizzas}"]

Valet is available., name_person=saloni shah}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Kebab Korner is a restaurant with beautiful blue and white interiors along with artistic chairs which gives it a very royal look. To top it all this place has an amazing view of Mumbai’s Queen’s Necklace. It looks stunning, especially during the Monsoon Season.

The Cuisine here is Indian and they specialize in Kebabs and North Indian Curries. I have tried a lot of Vegetarian dishes here, which is mentioned in detail below.

Truffled Mushroom Baby Kulcha

Small Soft Kulchas Stuffed with a Mushroom Paste. It comes straight out of the tandoor to your plate! It was very soft when I tried it and it had a very mild flavor from the Mushrooms. However, I couldn't taste truffle anywhere, I was expecting the use of some truffle oil at least.

Chili Cheese Baby Kulcha

Another version of Soft Kulchas Stuffed with Cheese and lots of Red Chili Powder, I could taste a lot of cheese and the spice from the Red Chili was also not overpowering. I would prefer this over the Mushroom kulcha even though I LOVE Mushrooms.

Jaituni Paneer Tikka

Giant Cubes of Paneer Marinated in Tandoori Marinate and it was sliced from between to stuff in some Olives. That gave it a tangy flavor and it was an amazing way of serving the Paneer Tikka. The only thing I didn't like is the quantity of Olives was very less and I could hardly taste any Olives.

Kumbh Dak Banglow

Button Mushrooms marinated in a Mustard Paste and cooked inside the tandoor until they become soft.

Daal Makhani

A bowl full of richness, it was exactly what you expect from a Daal Makhani. Melt in mouth Daal in tonne loads of Butter & Cream with superb flavors coming from spices like Clove, Cumin and Cardamom.

Lehsooni Palak

A very creamy concoction of Spinach and Fried Garlic, this was hands down the best dish which I had here. It is a must try if you love Spinach.

The service here was very quick and the staff had total knowledge about the Menu. Overall this place was amazing and I would definitely recommend it to someone who loves to have North Indian Food., name_person=Paras}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=7 years ago, review=InterContinental - the iconic Hotel located at Marine Drive is home to Kebab Korner. Kebab Korner is an ultra luxurious fine dine place with breathtaking bayview and serves authentic Indian cuisine along with some fusion dishes / desserts as well. Kebab Korner is located on Level 1 alongside Long & Short, which is a lounge which serves European cuisine.

Kebab Korner has recently introduced Thalis - which is a lavish 3 course Indian meal including appetizers, main course and desserts. They offer Express Lunch Thali which caters to corporate as well and is priced at INR 1800 excluding wine. For dinner they offer "Experience Thali" which is an easy going complete meal, where you can take your time and enjoy scrumptious meal. This is priced at INR 2400.

Heading straight to what was on offer for Experience Thali - Veg

To begin with we were presented with a palate cleanser - Amuse Bouche. Crispy and Spiced Masala Chana Dal packed in edible plastic. I was intrigued about the ingredients used and technique to make this, but it stays as a secret with the restaurant and chef. Very unique and impressed I must say!

We started with Appetizers and were served three of them - Jaipuri Paneer Tikka, Bhune Subz Ki Shami and Sarson Brocolli Tandoori. Paneer Tikka was smoked cottage cheese marinated with olives. The olives gave it a bitter taste for me and I personally love the smokey effect given to cottage cheese. However in this process the cottage cheese might have become a little hard. Something, which can be looked into.

Next we had the Bhune Subz Ki Shami - Round shaped Patties / Tikkis with peas and spiced beans as filling, fried to perfection. Highly recommended to try! After this, we tried the Sarson Broccoli Tandoori - marinated with mustard and grilled to perfection! Loved it! Must try!

Before heading into the mains, we were served another palate cleanser - this time around it was Mango & Lemon Sorbet served in a cutting chai glass. Loved the combination and was very refreshing. Again very unique!

And now coming to the Star Veg Thali at Kebeb Korner - 5 Vegetables and 1 Dal with Assorted Indian Breads along with choice of steamed rice / Khichdi. The thali was presented in a beautiful way. They have a shiny steel arc where all the individual bowls are placed. So all of these 6 bowls along with a bowl of salad is placed in front of you at one go, unlike other thali places where different people serve you continuously which can be irritating at times.

The best part here at Kebab Korner is that you get a thali experience without any hassles. Coming to the 5 vegetables - Bhuna Gobi Masala, Paneer Butter Masala, Subz Miloni, Lehsooni Palak and Beawar Bhindi. After hearing mixed reviews regarding the food, we were quite unsure on what to expect, however, with high hopes, we still decided to visit.

Started off with their chicken tikka and the masala roomali roti. Didn’t disappoint. The chicken tikka was soft and very well seasoned. It was one of the very few I have had that doesn’t require the squeeze of lime to accentuate the taste. Paired with the roomali it was a started to get us started.

reviews: ["{\"name_person\":\"Kinjal Jethwa\",\"time_line\":\"5 days ago\",\"review\":\"Joshi House had been on my bucket list for the longest time, and finally experiencing their soulful modern Indian cuisine felt truly special. Every preparation reflects precision, thoughtfulness and beautiful detailing. The d\u00e9cor is minimal yet elegant, creating a calm, relaxing space \u2014 a quiet indulgence where city chaos fades away. The ambience, lighting and vibes are effortlessly soothing.\\n\\nThe menu is thoughtfully curated, where taste feels like a language of its own. We began with Pom Rajwadi and Charcoal Breeze \u2014 mocktails that turned flavours into memories. The Balinese Bhel and Sweet Potato Shammi Chaat were outstanding, followed by the heavenly Avocado Chutney Toast. The Lazeez Paneer Biryani was rich, aromatic and perfectly balanced. We ended on a high with Ode to Kerala, a smooth dessert with 75% rich chocolate that was absolutely scrumptious. A truly magical dining experience.\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_MODE\":\"Dine in\",\"GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE\":\"Lunch\",\"GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE\":\"\u20b91,400\u20131,600\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL\":\"Quiet, easy to talk\"}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Pooja Mandal\",\"time_line\":\"4 weeks ago\",\"review\":\"I recently enjoyed a delightful spread at this spot, and the experience truly stood out. The starters were a highlight: the Berry Almond Mingle offered a perfect balance of sweet and nutty flavors, while the Pom Rajwadi impressed with its rich, aromatic profile. The Mushroom Galouti Puff was flaky and savory, and the Sweet Potato Shammi Chaat delivered a satisfying blend of textures. The Tandoori Corn Salad added a refreshing crunch to the table.\\n\\nThe main course, Paneer Khurchan, was prepared exactly as requested\u2014spicy and full of depth, accompanied by three soft rotis that complemented the dish beautifully.\\n\\nService was attentive, and the digital ordering system made the experience seamless. Overall, the food, flavors, and presentation were exceptional, making it a must\u2011visit for anyone seeking a memorable meal.\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE\":\"Lunch\",\"GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE\":\"\u20b91,800\u20132,000\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL\":\"Quiet, easy to talk\",\"GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE\":[\"2_people\",\"E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO\"],\"GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS\":\"Highly recommend\",\"GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS\":[\"Vegetarian_options\",\"E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS\"]}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Saloni Jain\",\"time_line\":\"a month ago\",\"review\":\"Had a lovely North Indian meal at Joshi House!\\nThe Shammi Sweet Potato Chaat was just yum \u2014 perfectly balanced and so flavourful.\\nThe Beetroot Malai Kofta was my personal favourite\u2026 rich, creamy and absolutely delicious.\\nAnd the Ghevar \u2014 woww, the perfect sweet ending!\\nOverall, amazing food, great vibe. Definitely visiting again!\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE\":\"Lunch\",\"GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE\":\"\u20b9800\u20131,000\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL\":\"Quiet, easy to talk\",\"GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE\":[\"Suitable_for_all_group_sizes\",\"E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL\"]}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Bhavin Parekh\",\"time_line\":\"2 months ago\",\"review\":\"It\u2019s the relaunched version (2.0) of Joshi House (formerly in Bandra) now in Worli Koliwada. The emphasis is now strongly on Indian regional flavours (especially coastal & Rajasthani). The place is visually striking with good lighting, atmosphere within gives both grandeur and warmth. The space is spread over three floors, each with a distinct mood.\\n\u2022 Ground floor has al fresco seating (patio style), greenery, the entrance has terracotta pots, Jaisalmer stone jaali screens.\\n\u2022 First floor is more formal dining: yellow cement flooring, textured walls, sculptural wood furniture. Softer, more calming.\\n\u2022 Second floor / Bar area: moodier, more intimate. Deep hues (violet walls, etc.), vaulted ceilings, artistic murals (e.g. hand\u2011painted tiger motifs).\\nDetails of Rajasthani heritage show up subtly in decor: brass, stone, carved wood, warm earthy textures - feels lived\u2011in, comfortable.\\nThe cuisine is rooted in Indian regional flavours, especially coastal and Rajasthani. Sea food gets centre stage. Vegetarian fare isn\u2019t an afterthought. Top dishes like Balinese bhel, Dabeli sliders, Sweet potato shammi chaat (must try), Thecha brie toast, Mushroom benne dosa,Truffle Palak Saag with burrata along with makai roti, Beetroot malai kofta along with Malbari parotta etc get good attention. Desserts get creative - the Ghevar (Rajasthani dessert), Paan Magnum Kulfi etc. Nostalgic yet with some innovations. Cocktail and Mocktail is robust: creative mocktails like Sunset sipper, Berry almond mingle, Pom rajwadi, etc. are flavourful and refreshing.\\nService is generally attentive, with staff that understand the menu, guide and explains regional flavours. Joshi House Worli is a strong evolution from its Bandra version - more rooted, more coherent in theme, more local (both in ingredients and aesthetics). If you appreciate ambience, design, and wanting to explore awesome regional Indian cuisine with flair, it's a great pick. For special occasions or a nice evening out, it\u2019s well worth it.\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Nidhi jain\",\"time_line\":\"3 weeks ago\",\"review\":\"Loved the place very much. It was perfect for lunch as well as dinner. They have set menu which is totally worth a try. I had tried their starters in vegetarian and I loved their thecha brie toast very much. It was super cheesy and delicious. It was different and worth trying . It was crispy and crunchy. The other starter I tried was their sweet potato shammi chaat and that too was delicious to taste. In main course, I tried their truffle palak saag with makai roti. The subzi was good in quantity and i also loved their innovation in this dish as they added burata cheese on the top of the gravy and the makai roti was soft and tasty. Their cocktails were worth a try. They were innovative. I tried their hazel drink and it had good taste of coffee and the other was also nice. I liked their dessert and mainly their presentation in that. I tried their kerala chocolate ganache and it was served with a sorbet which made the dessert fantastic in taste.\\nThe food was good and the service was also quick and nice.\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE\":\"Dinner\",\"GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE\":\"\u20b91,800\u20132,000\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL\":\"Quiet, easy to talk\",\"GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE\":[\"2_people\",\"E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO\",\"Suitable_for_all_group_sizes\",\"E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL\"],\"GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS\":\"Highly recommend\",\"GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO\":[\"Large_vegetarian_selection\",\"E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION\"],\"GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS\":[\"Vegetarian_options\",\"E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS\"]}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Nikita K\",\"time_line\":\"a month ago\",\"review\":\"\u201cHuman Jaha Pe Tameez Suey Khaya Hai, Bhuke Hi Wapas Aaye Hai\u201d\\n-A go-getter Foodie.\\n\\nIf luxury had a desi heart, it would look exactly like Joshi House. In the heart of Worli, this fine dining gem is a North Indian food lover\u2019s dream \u2014 blending authentic flavours with a refined modern touch. The ambience is simply stunning \u2014 warm lights, earthy d\u00e9cor, soft music, and an old-world charm that makes you want to stay longer. The perfect spot for an indulgent evening with friends, family, or even a quiet soulful date night.\\n\\nFor mocktails, we started with the Spice Sutra and the House Special J House. Both drinks were beautifully presented \u2014 vibrant, aromatic, and bursting with layered flavours.\\n\\nFor Appetisers,  we called for Sweet Potato Shammi Chaat which was an absolute delight! The soft shammi with the sweetness of potato, dash of ice-cold ice cream (Yes! Ice Cream) layer and tang from chutneys created a perfect harmony of flavours and Chutney Avocado Toast which was a creative twist on the classic! Creamy avocado topped with tangy Indian chutneys, giving every bite a fresh and fusion-style punch.\\n\\nThe bar was already set high by the appetisers, we were looking forward for the mains now. Next we ordered Beetroot Malai Kofta Curry which was smooth, and rich. The beetroot koftas were melt-in-the-mouth soft, perfectly paired with a luscious malai gravy. Enjoyed it with Cheese Garlic Naan, which was fluffy and indulgent and Paneer Tikka Biryani which was Fragrant, flavorful, and perfectly spiced. The tender paneer tikka chunks added that royal touch, making it a must-try for every biryani lover.\\n\\nAaaaand, for desserts we chose  Joshi House Ghevar \u2013 Our absolute favourite! A stunning dessert that truly stole the show. The presentation, the textures, and the sweetness \u2014 everything was on point. A perfect modern take on a traditional Rajasthani classic. Where was this all these years?\\n\\nJoshi House truly stands out not just for its food but for the complete experience it offers \u2014 from the elegant ambience to the impeccable service. A special thanks to Francis for the warm hospitality and for making our evening truly memorable.\\n\\nSuperb food, heart-touching flavours, and that Ghevar\u2026 ahhh still thinking about it!\",\"guided_block\":{}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Arhan Sarkar\",\"time_line\":\"2 years ago\",\"review\":\"4.0/5\\nJoshi House reminds me of a place where classical architecture meets modern art. The facade is very minimal and can be missed if you\u2019re not looking carefully. Situated on the ever so busy Pali Hill road, it is a cozy atmospheric place filled with elegance and charm. The decor is white and embroidered with carefully placed art pieces like quirky flower vases.\\n\\nFood is as expected quite exquisite. The place is quite famous for its chefs. The carefully done dishes are set apart quite easily and the touch of decadence is very satisfying. It is on the expensive side so be prepared for spending a little extra. It is an experience however. I have been there on two occasions and have been quite pleased with the presentation of food on ever so beautiful cutlery. One area i would like to see improvement is the dessert. I had ordered the raspberry and dark chocolate, pretty safe choice but i had expected a little more creativity from this department. The coconut touille was tasty but could not marry the two wonderful elements together and failed to accentuate the dish. Overall a good gastronomical experience. I would love to try more dishes from here. As should anyone who is looking for places to try in Bandra, this one is a must try.\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":4,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":4,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Soumya Chauhan\",\"time_line\":\"2 years ago\",\"review\":\"The experience keeps scaling up as you enter, get served and finally eat.\\n- The ambiance and decor is elegant, beautiful with an old vintage charm.\\n- The service is really good, waiters are helpful, polite and attentive\\n- The food is perfect - We ordered the pesto avocado toast - was yummy and fresh with the pesto giving it a flavour kick; cheese garlic naan with paneer khurchan and dal makhani. Sadly we were full so could not get their desserts but they had an amazing collection.\\n- they have a really good collection of wines, particlulary led.\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_MODE\":\"Dine in\",\"GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE\":\"Dinner\",\"GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE\":\"\u20b91,800\u20132,000\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION\":[\"Cheese_Garlic_Truffle_Naan\"]}}", "{\"person_name\":null,\"time_line\":null,\"review\":\"Food is tasty but portions are a little small Service needs to be improved\",\"guided_block\":{}}", "{\"person_name\":null,\"time_line\":null,\"review\":\"Highly untrained staff chatting & seating in sofas while guests are eating .\",\"guided_block\":{}}", "{\"person_name\":null,\"time_line\":null,\"review\":\"Best place to chill with great ambience and amazing decor and vibes..\",\"guided_block\":{}}"]

While the place isn’t very big, the seating setup is smart and comfortable enough for a chill meal.

Pricing is reasonable, especially considering how pricey ramen can be at other places.

What makes the place even nicer is the vibe — calm and welcoming. They’ve got a shelf full of books in English and Marathi, which adds a thoughtful touch. Great if you like to unwind over a good meal and a quiet read.

Definitely a hidden gem in Airoli — will be coming back!, name_person=Nikit Sambargikar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Chicken_Ramen_Bowl_of_Soup], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=7 months ago, review=Lord Folklore is a lively place with good vibes, filled with groups of friends and couples. The novel-inspired interior, with a few Harry Potter references, adds a nice touch. It’s a good spot to chill, although the service was a bit slow.

Coming to the food:

Shanghai Chicken
The portion felt smaller than expected, but the taste was good and satisfying.

Kung Pao Chicken
Tasty and enjoyable, though the flavors weren’t particularly memorable.

Spicy Chicken Ramen Bowl
Quite spicy, but lacked depth in flavor. It wasn’t very impressive overall.

Curry Chicken Ramen Bowl
Much better than the spicy one. Flavorful broth, well-cooked chicken, and in both ramen bowls, the boiled eggs were a real highlight soft, rich, and very tasty.

Berry-based Drink
The drink was berry-flavored (something like blueberry), very refreshing and pleasant, though I couldn't find the exact name on the menu.

Baked Gulab Jamun
Warm, rich, and delicious. It was the best dish of the day and absolutely worth trying.

Final Thoughts:
Lord Folklore is definitely worth visiting for its vibe and setting. Food-wise, I would highly recommend trying the Baked Gulab Jamun and the Curry Chicken Ramen Bowl., name_person=TAHER JAWAD}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=10 months ago, review=The restaurant is very good. Our experience was delightful, offering a blend of flavors and a warm ambiance.

Mocktails: We began our meal with a selection of mocktails, including Blueberry Virgin Mojito, Virgin Mojito, and Iced Tea. Each beverage was refreshing, with prices ranging from ₹100 to ₹150, offering good value for the quality.

Non-Vegetarian Pizzas: For the main course, we opted for the "Bird in the Jungle" pizza priced at ₹550. This non-vegetarian delight stood out with its rich toppings and well-balanced flavors, making it a highlight of our meal.

Vegetarian Pizzas: We also tried the Veg Supreme and Greek Goddess pizzas, each costing ₹850. While they were well-prepared, they didn't quite match the exceptional quality of the non-vegetarian options. However, they might appeal to those who prefer vegetarian choices.

Garlic Bread: Our group sampled both the Chilly Cheese Garlic Bread (₹250) and the regular Cheese Garlic Bread (₹200). The regular version was enjoyable, but the Chilly Cheese variant was overly spicy, which might not suit everyone's palate.

Service and Ambiance: The service was attentive and friendly, contributing to a pleasant dining experience. The restaurant's ambiance is cozy, providing a comfortable setting for gatherings. Additionally, ample parking space is available for both two-wheelers and four-wheelers, which is a significant advantage in the area.

In conclusion, The Mad Pepperoni offers a satisfying dining experience, especially for those keen on exploring non-vegetarian pizza options. With reasonable pricing and a welcoming environment, it's a spot worth visiting. Mad Pepperoni manages to blend classic comfort with exceptional quality. Whether you’re ordering for a family dinner or just grabbing a quick slice, the freshness and flavor shine through every time. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise}, time_line=a month ago, review=Ordered Overloaded Nachos, Crispy Congee Chicken, Sticky Chicken Katsu, Spicy Korean Paneer Ramen, and a Peach Blossom mocktail..
Mocktails were decent, so we confidently ordered ramen.
Even told the waiter very clearly..Make it spicy, please ..we love spicy food and usually other places get it right

But the ramen turned out very sweet, nowhere close to spicy.
Same issue with the Crispy Congee Chicken
it tasted more like honey chilli potato than anything else. Flavours were totally off and didn’t match the description.

Service was also quite slow, which made the experience even more disappointing

Overall..great place for vibes, not great for food.
3/5 being generous because I’m a nice human being, name_person=PRASAD}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=4 months ago, review=It was Friendship day and me and my family decided to go out for dinner and we landed at 1411. We were a bit early so there wasn’t much crowd and since we had pre booked , our table was reserved. The ambience was great and so was the service. Mr. Mahi who was attending us made mindful suggestions and helped us have a wonderful dining experience. The food was flavourful and delicious. The entire family had a good time and we exited happy and stomach full with a short game of foosball at the end of our meal 😊, name_person=Masban Pereira}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT, Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=Edited 2 months ago, review=Had a chance to visit this place, good place for office outings/dinner/ bday celebration etc.
Food was really nice although long TAT. The ambience is great especially the glass lighting.
Veg starters have decent options and variety. I tried their pesto mushroom, cheese nachos, achari - tandoori aloo, etc.

For non veg - I tried Kala mutton and cheese naan which was mind-blowing, lehsooni kebab and chicken ghee roast was okayish.

A designated smoking area is also there.

Could include one more steward as most of the times we felt unheard., name_person=Darshan Ghag}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Somewhat difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SEATING_TYPE=[Indoor_dining_area, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_INDOOR_DINING_AREA, Bar_area, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_BAR_AREA, Outdoor_patio_/_terrace, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_OUTDOOR_PATIO, Counter_seating, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_COUNTER_SEATING], GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_STREET_PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Clearly_labeled_vegetarian_dishes, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS]}, time_line=7 months ago, review=I had a fantastic experience at 1411 Bar & Kitchen! From the moment I stepped in, the ambience struck the perfect balance between chic and cozy, making it an ideal spot for both casual outings and special occasions. The live singing added a wonderful touch, creating a lively yet relaxed atmosphere that kept us engaged throughout the evening.

The food was truly standout — the quality was exceptional, with every dish prepared to perfection. I was especially pleased with their vegetarian options, which were diverse, flavorful, and beautifully presented. It’s rare to find a place that caters so thoughtfully to vegetarians without compromising on taste or creativity.

Our server, Rajesh Kaushal, provided top-notch service that truly enhanced our visit. He was attentive, friendly, and genuinely passionate about ensuring we had an enjoyable experience. His professionalism and warm attitude earned him a well-deserved 5-star rating!

Overall, 1411 Bar & Kitchen offers a memorable dining experience with excellent food, great service, and a lively atmosphere. I highly recommend it and look forward to returning soon!, name_person=Umang A Dave}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=5 months ago, review=vibe- nice ambience, decent music volume. the sofa tables on top are tooo close to each other that's a bummer.
service- very nice. shobho das was very attentive n helpful. ready to suggest and adjust any requirement. his attitude to serve is good. there was another guy attending us didn't get name.but both were good. Food takes lot of time to arrive though
drinks- got good cocktails reasonably priced after long time.  angels hair( why would u name it so) is very nice and mocking bird both we got with gin. good balance.  peach mojito is decent other 2 better . bartender n waiter both understood our requests.
food.- good portions. very long menu. good choices. We got tempura sushi- very nice. wasabi not so good.
pesto paneer needs lots of improvement..skip . pesto itself lacks cheese n nuts .

Having reviewed countless brunches across the country—with over 7 million views across platforms—I rarely come across a property that surprises me the way Food Exchange at Novotel Mumbai International Airport (Andheri) did.

Let’s begin with what truly matters: the experience.

From the moment we walked in, there was a sense of genuine hospitality. The chef personally interacted with guests, and the team was attentive without being intrusive—hallmarks of a well-trained hospitality crew that truly understands service. There was care in every detail, from the way the dishes were plated to how staff ensured dietary preferences were catered to proactively.

The Food:
The vegetarian selection is hands-down one of the most thoughtful I’ve seen in a hotel brunch. It’s not just a few token dishes—there’s depth, flavour, and creativity at play.
The dessert counter is worth a special mention—everything from international pastries to Indian mithai was executed with finesse. Balanced sweetness, rich textures, and a surprisingly artisanal feel.
For those who enjoy a spirited brunch, the unlimited alcohol-inclusive offering starts under ₹2,000 per person, which is practically unheard of for a 5-star property.
Value Proposition:
As an Accor member, I’ve dined at several flagship properties—Sofitel BKC being a frequent go-to. While Sofitel’s grandeur is notable, Food Exchange delivers a more intimate, curated experience at nearly one-third the cost after Accor Plus discounts. And when you consider the quality of food, presentation, and warmth of service, it’s arguably better value than many standalone fine-dines.

This is the kind of place that deserves more spotlight. I’d go as far as to say that this is a benchmark brunch in the city—not just for Accor properties, but across Mumbai’s hospitality scene.

Pro tip: If you’re serious about food, desserts, and a great Sunday vibe without breaking the bank, make sure this is on your radar. And if the team at Novotel is planning any new brunch concepts or culinary events—I’d love to be among the first to know. ["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Hunky Dory is located inside Lemon Tree Premier Malad West and it is easy to find.

The restaurant is spacious with a mini and a full sized bar. The ambiance is super bright with tribal decor touch. Loved the colours used everywhere and every corner looks really beautiful. The seatings are arranged nicely and options for all size of groups are available. They also have DJ section and a dedicated space for live events.

The menu contains global dishes with sone traditional Indian food being available too. Loved the menu as you get everything from sushi to chicken tikka is available in their menu. Prices are at par with similar type of brands and the quantity served is nice. Also they do run dining offers so check online before visiting.

We went here for late lunch and kitchen service was decent but table service was haywire as the staff was super confused as they were booked for a private party at 6PM so I think they were under immense pressure as they kept on switching dishes on different tables. However staff Sandeep tried his best to make the table service smooth.

What We Had -
APPETISERS~
Butter Paneer Potli -
Butter paneer stuffed in a potli, fried to perfection but not oily, and served with a makhani dip. What I liked most was that it wasn’t sweet, the flavors of spices and onions really stood out, making the dish taste perfect.

Herb Crusted Truffle Parmesan Chicken Tikka -
One of the classy version of chicken tikka which tasted amazing. Perfectly grilled juicy chicken done in green spices topped with cheese with light truffle oil and with walnuts on the top tasted perfect. Everything in this tasted superb and you should definitely try this.

Golden Prawn Tempura Roll -
Again one of the best sushi experiences. Their portion is 5 pieces so you will definitely crave more. Crunchy tempura, fresh prawns, spicy sauce and everything in this sushi was perfect.

MAINS~
Wild Mushroom & Truffle Cacio E Pepe -
Man. This was one of the best pasta I have ever had. Earthy flavours due to mushrooms and truffle oil. Perfectly done spaghetti with crunchy veggies and the watery cheese sauce was outstanding. Try it to believe it.

Prawn Ghee Pepper Roast with Tadka Lemon Coriander Rice -
Fresh prawns in ghee roast gravy tasted good. The rice went nicely however I am not a fan of whole coriander hence full marks for gravy.

DESSERT~
Slow Baked Chocolate Bar -
This wasn’t that great as the chocolate used was not that tasty.

MOCKTAILS~
Black & Yellow.
Tropical Delight.
Both the drinks had perfect taste.

So our meal at Hunky Dory Malad was really good. Leaving the service, the food, ambience and music played was perfect. The staff was good and everything seemed just right for the evening! Loved it and will revisit. High 5:)), name_person=Aparna Salunke}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=9 months ago, review=Tucked away in a charming old bungalow in the Reclamation area of Bandra, this tea house is a haven for those seeking a tranquil and authentic tea experience.

The ambience is nothing short of perfect – cozy, intimate, and steeped in warmth. The moment you step inside, you'll feel enveloped in a sense of serenity.

The tea menu is staggering, boasting an impressive array of options that cater to every taste and preference. Milk tea enthusiasts will be in heaven, with an unparalleled selection to choose from.

Last winter they had a carrot cheese milk tea flavour , was my favourite .

While the food looks appealing, unfortunately, it falls short in terms of moisture and flavor. Most dishes I tried were dry , but not in edible .

On the plus side, the tea house offers convenient valet parking on site. However, be aware that the road leading to the bungalow may be inaccessible due to ongoing construction work, as was the case during my visit.

A delightful surprise is the small loose tea shop nestled inside, which is a treasure trove of artisanal teas. The staff here are knowledgeable and experienced, happy to guide you through the various options., name_person=Chirag Patel}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=10 months ago, review=A Charming Tea Experience at Brooke Bond Taj Mahal Tea Lounge ☕

We stumbled upon this quaint little spot for a casual catch-up with friends, and it turned out to be a delightful experience. The place exudes warmth, making it perfect for long conversations over tea.

The menu is surprisingly extensive, offering a contemporary twist on classics—think paneer-stuffed samosas! Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options are well represented, along with beautifully curated tea platters that pair perfectly with the food.

With such a wide variety of teas to explore, one visit just isn’t enough. Looking forward to coming back to sample more!

A must-visit for tea lovers and food enthusiasts alike., name_person=Gaurav Suri}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Excellent space, ambience, innovative drinks & food and service.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Fabulous atmosphere, polite staff, great selection of teas and tasty food.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Adorable place with great decor, fabulous tea selection and yummy food.}"]

reviews: ["{\"name_person\":\"Prudencia Gavankar\",\"time_line\":\"a month ago\",\"review\":\"Terrible experience at Zeal Skybar!\\nOrdered veg fried rice and specifically asked to add mushrooms, but they denied despite being willing to pay extra.\\nNot just that, the dining service was painfully slow on a weekday with barely any crowd. Weekends are understandable, but weekdays? Unacceptable. Avoid this place if you value your time and taste buds. 1/5 stars\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":1,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":1,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":1}}", "{\"name_person\":\"K. \u201cContentName\u201d F.\",\"time_line\":\"10 months ago\",\"review\":\"Our family visited Skybar for a Sunday dinner. Its spacious which made it comfortable for our family to settle in without feeling cramped. The restroom was clean and surprisingly spacious, a small but important detail when dining out with family.\\n\\nThe elevator ride up was marred by unsightly paan stains\u2014a real eyesore. Additionally, the stairs leading to the restaurant are poorly lit.\\n\\nThe view from the Skybar is unfortunately hindered by this huge sticker-like design on the glass windows, so don\u2019t expect breathtaking cityscapes at night. That said, the overall vibe inside is pleasant enough.\\n\\nThe band was excellent that evening. The acoustics of the venue left something to be desired. Pro tip: Avoid sitting to the sides of the stage, as the audio quality there is subpar. Opt for seats directly in front or further away for a better experience.\\n\\nWe decided to go for a range of various dishes. The food at Zeal Skybar ranged from delightful to disappointing. Some dishes truly shone, earning top marks: Mushroom and Cheese Cigar Rolls (5/5), Cheddar Stuffed Chicken (5/5) and the Mushroom Chilli (5/5)\\n\\nUnfortunately, the same cannot be said for the French fries (2/5), which were limp, lacked crispiness, and tasted like low-quality potatoes\u2014a major letdown for such a basic dish. Also the alcohol content in the cocktails (Long Island Iced Tea, Special Mojito) was questionable. The shots we tried (Brain Hemorrhage, Brain Tumor) were good, but lacked that punch.\\n\\nOur total bill came to around \u20b95,500 for six people, which felt reasonable given the portions and variety of dishes we ordered. Prior reservations are recommended, especially for weekends, as the place can get busy.\\n\\nWould I visit Skybar again? Absolutely\u2014but with some adjustments. Next time, I\u2019ll skip the French fries, steer clear of overly complicated cocktails, and make sure to grab a seat with better acoustics.\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE\":\"\u20b9800\u20131,000\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":4,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":3,\"GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION\":[\"Cheddar_Stuffed_Chicken\",\"Harissa_Chicken_Skewers\",\"Garlic_Bread_with_Cheese\",\"Chicken_Harissa\"]}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Sumit Mandal\",\"time_line\":\"Edited 3 months ago\",\"review\":\"My favourite in vasai as near to home, first choice , good crowd, they play all types of live music, quality food and service. vibrant ambience. overall amazing experience always.\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE\":\"\u20b91,000\u20131,200\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL\":\"Loud, but you can still talk\",\"GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE\":[\"Suitable_for_all_group_sizes\",\"E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL\"],\"GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME\":\"No wait\",\"GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY\":\"Plenty of parking\",\"GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS\":[\"Free_street_parking\",\"E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_STREET_PARKING\"],\"GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS\":[\"Parking\",\"E:PARKING\"]}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Navina Kadam\",\"time_line\":\"2 months ago\",\"review\":\"Our recent dinner was quite disappointing. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Baked in Bombay is a Tiny Café with Enormous Charm. Hidden in the bustling lanes of Bandra West lies Baked in Bombay..a petite café that packs a soulful punch. As soon as you step in, you’re greeted not just by ambient minimalism and charming wall art, but by the warmth of Ritu and Nilesh, the sibling duo behind it all. It immediately feels like you’re being served at a friend’s home.

Start with their house-made sourdough sandwiches, soft yet crisp, and sets the tone for everything else. The Pesto Melt is a dish done to perfection. The Za’atar Manakeesh is among the best in the city, and the Hummus? Don’t miss it!

End on a sweet note with the sourdough Vanilla cake or a fudgy brownie.

The vibe? Intimately small, subtly artistic, and full of conversations and smiles. Bottom Line: Baked in Bombay is not just another café, it is a heartfelt experience. Perfect for simply a comforting meal. A true Bandra gem😍, name_person=Neha Desai}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Dietary_restrictions, E:OTHER_DIETARY_RESTRICTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO, 3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=10-30 min, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION]}, time_line=4 months ago, review=My love for sourdough made me try this place and i must say the sourdoughs are great, freshly made and just awesome.

I tried the mushroom melt sandwich, vegetarian pizza and hot chocolate.

The hot chocolate is best and a must try. It is better than some of the places in Europe and i simple love it. The mushroom melt is also good. However, i did not like the pizza and would only give it 3/5. It was just an average pizza.

The service is little slow but if you are there to spend time with your loved ones,  this is your place which i why i have given 5 star. However, if you want a quick grab this place is not for you., name_person=Ankan Singhal}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1}, time_line=2 weeks ago, review=Ok. Here's what happened. And I am sure it must have happened to others but may have gone unnoticed as not all look into minute details.
I ordered the mushroom sandwich. 2 of the 3 cheeses were missing from the sandwich. I pointed out and I was told recipe has changed. So does that mean your menu is misleading ? If so, then upon asking 1 of the missing 2 cheeses was added like a Lil bit thrown in between. Tasteless. No flavour. Why ???  Recipe was changed, isn't it ?
Such tactics ( so called mistake ) by cooks in the hidden kitchen are termed cheap ways to save on ingredients while customers are charged in full ! Not cool. N i am not exaggerating. Put yourself in my place n think.
I ordered a caramel latte. I received a luke warm well designed on top latte. But all the caramel was settled like a goop at the bottom. I mixed with spoon after my first sip. But it dint work n i did not even realize what I had ordered....until in last sip i realized a thick goop of caramel sitting at the bottom. Conclusion - luke warm coffe. Think about it !
I was to take home a sourdough bread loaf which i returned on the spot after these bad experiences.
I came all the way from a few stations away, only watching your enthusiastic reels and realized yet another poor quality food ...just what we get in all regular shops around.
It's a harsh feedback. But it's upto you to take it as it is and improve with strict standards in place or let it be. As I said earlier, not everyone looks at minute details.
I did not realize there could be service charges added to it. Holy jesus !! You know it's optional right ! Especially when there's just one hostess who does all chores and is not waiting on you....I mean. Common !!!, name_person=Sahil Singh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=4 months ago, review=A Delicious Experience from Start to Finish!

From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with a warm welcoming smile and a thoughtful recommendation that set the tone for a wonderful experience. The place has a cool vibe with a positive and relaxed ambiance that instantly makes you feel at home.

We started with their refreshing drink, The highlight of our meal, however, was the incredibly creamy hummus on the sourdough bread and soft, fresh hot cheese garlic flatbread – an absolute must-try! Just when we thought it couldn’t get better, we ended with the heavenly brookies – the perfect mix of brownie and cookie that left us wanting more.

What truly stood out was the warm interaction with Nilesh and his Sister – their hospitality added a personal touch that made the experience memorable.

Highly recommended – for both the food and the people behind it!, name_person=Lester Trindade}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Parking_is_unavailable, E:PARKING_OPTION_NO_PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN]}, time_line=3 months ago, review=Tucked away in the quiet, narrow lanes of Bandra—just a short walk from Bandstand—this little café is an absolute hidden gem. It’s my go-to spot whenever I crave a truly good cup of coffee away from my home machine. True to its name, they really are champions of baking, especially their signature sourdough bread. I tried it on an avocado toast and it was nothing short of spectacular—perfectly creamy avocado, a hint of pesto, and that incredible sourdough slice that ties it all together.

Unfortunately, I couldn’t take a loaf home as their sourdough needs to be pre-ordered for retail, but that only gives me another reason to return. The coffee was excellent, the ambiance cozy and welcoming, and the hosts were wonderfully warm without ever being pushy. I loved how the owner focused on quality and gave personal attention to almost every table, making the experience feel special despite it being a commercial establishment.

I was too full to try the desserts this time, but if the avocado toast is any indication, I’m certain they’ll be just as delightful. This is a café in the making with all the right ingredients—great coffee, fantastic bread, and genuine hospitality. I’m definitely coming back for more. Thank you for such a refreshing experience!, name_person=Poonam Tharar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=4 months ago, review=I recently visited this cafe with a friend Happy to pure veg bakery plus cafe in bustling streets of Bandra!
