The Manglorean Chicken Ghee Roast is a must.
The Allapee fish curry is heavenly, name_person=Nikhil Gokul}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Bharleli_Bombil_Fry, Prawns_Thali], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=10 months ago, review=Meen Curry at DN Nagar is a vibing seafood restaurant with coastal fusion of flavours.

The open air outside seating has cool vibes and gets Lit up in the evenings. We choose the air conditioned inside seating which had a romantic feel - a little dark for taking pictures but overall cozy.

The service top Notch. The staff were tip toed and attentive. Telepathic - they wud reach you before u wud call them.

The tables were set artistically and the cutlery used looked chic and top grade.

The bar looked fully stocked and we chose to have blackberry crush breezer which went well with the seafood.

What we ate
Classic bombil fry - full marks to the presentation. The portions were huge, were perfectly marinated and fried. The chutney was sooo flavourful and the onion kachumber made the dish more or less perfect.

The thalis are available only on mon- thurs for lunch and we decided to grab onto that oppurtunity. The way the thalis were set on the tables gives u a maharaja wali feeling.

The surmai thali -
Surmai fry - huge portion, fried to perfection. Tasted yummy.

Surmai curry - flavourful.

Prawns sukha - this was so yummy, i polished it off in seconds.

Soul kadhi - perfect blend of tanginess kokum and sweetened cocont milk - i want more.

Sabudana kheer - light and refreshing. A substitute for normal kheer was delicious and best way to end the meal.

Chapati, rice, papad, pickle - perfect.

The prawn thali
The prawns fry - deep fried filled with flavours
The prawn curry - yumminess
Jowar bhakri - wow

(Other stuff was similar to the surmai thali)

The mouth fresher tingled the tasted buds.

The washroom hygenie was excellent. Spic and span clean.

Missed a little music in the air which wud elevate the entire experience to the next level.

At Meen Curry be prepapred to capture all the fishy moments., name_person=imran badami}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,400–1,600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Seafood at Meen Curry is truly delightful. Awesome  flavorful dishes truly a treat for the taste buds. superb support from the staff so you're looking for delicious seafood in a cozy atmosphere, Meen Curry is the place to be!, name_person=Karthik Sathuragiri}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a year ago, review=Very accessible location.. it's walkable from Andheri West metro station. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 months ago, review=Visited Prego at The Westin, Goregaon with my sister, and it was such a delightful experience! This place truly lives up to its reputation as an authentic Italian restaurant.

I tried a few vegetarian dishes from their menu:

1. Passionssation Mocktail – A refreshing, tropical blend with passion fruit that sets the perfect start to the meal.
2. Arancini – Crispy golden-fried risotto balls with a cheesy, flavorful center. A must-try appetizer!
3. Pizza Quattro Formaggi – A rich four-cheese pizza with a heavenly balance of gooey, sharp, and creamy flavors.
4. Rigatoni Pasta – Perfectly cooked pasta in a well-seasoned sauce, hearty and satisfying.

Every dish tasted fresh, flavorful, and authentic. The overall dining experience was excellent and definitely worth the ₹7k we spent 😆!, name_person=Swapnil}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SEATING_TYPE=[Indoor_dining_area, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_INDOOR_DINING_AREA, Outdoor_patio_/_terrace, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_OUTDOOR_PATIO], GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Dietary_restrictions, E:OTHER_DIETARY_RESTRICTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION]}, time_line=6 months ago, review=My love for lasagna and tiramisu always draws me to Italian restaurants, and that’s what brought me to Prego at The Westin.
The flavours didn’t disappoint – the lasagna was rich and hearty with a beautifully layered texture. I wish there was another layer of cheese but the tomato sauce just outpowerer everything. It was the highlight and binded the dish well together. However, the portion size felt a bit on the smaller side, which is why I’m giving 4 stars instead of 5.

I also ordered a Peruvian pizza which was not from the regular menu and it turned out amazing. It had some green sauces made with peruvian spices and olives which added a great taste to the pizza.

For dessert we ordered tiramisu. The tiramisu had great potential, but the ladyfingers were slightly over-soaked, which affected the balance. Still, the ambience, service, and overall experience made it a worthwhile visit., name_person=Ankan Singhal}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=2}, time_line=a year ago, review=Italian restaurant at the Westin Hotel in Goregaon. Walked in on a Saturday afternoon for lunch, and the place was near empty. The vibe seemed very dead and sleepy. But the food more than made up for it. We ordered a margherita pizza, a caramello pasta, agnelloti pasta, and a hazelnut cake, all to share. The pizza was excellent. Fresh dough, cheese, and baked to perfection. Enjoyed the pizza and rate it as one of the best I have eaten in Mumbai in ages. The caramello pasta was a bit too bland for me, but my sister enjoyed it. I loved the agnelloti pasta with the spinach and cheese stuffing done really well and tossed in a flavourful tomato sauce. To finish, we enjoyed the hazelnut cake, which had a lovely garnish of chocolate sticks and hazelnut chunks. Cost me nearly INR 7000, which seemed fair. Service was good though wait for the food may seem a wee bit long., name_person=Pankaj}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Brunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 years ago, review=I recently visited Prego to try their new menu.

I must say, I was impressed with their salad and cheese counter. So much to choose from.

They have enough vegetarian options be it pizza pasta or risotto.

Loved the pizzas here and the pastas were good too.

Loved the red wine poached strawberry with icecream for dessert.

Overall I had a lovely experience., name_person=1TeaspoonLove}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_RESERVATION=Reservations recommended, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in}, time_line=a month ago, review=We have been Club Marriott and Marriott Bonvoy members for the past six years and are frequent visitors to Prego. During our visit on 17th Nov 2025, we ordered multiple dishes, and unfortunately, the spinach arancini balls were not satisfactory.

Our server, Mr. Thakur, was extremely polite and helpful. He attempted to convey our feedback to the chefs, but the chef declined to come to our table. No one from the culinary team approached us, and we observed that they were engaging only with foreign guests while ignoring regular Indian patrons.

Such unprofessional and dismissive behaviour from the chef is disappointing and does not reflect the standards we expect from Westin or the Marriott brand. As guests who visit 2–3 times every month, this experience has left a negative impression. Once our Club Marriott membership expires, we are unlikely to continue with Westin Garden City, nor will we be recommending it to others., name_person=karan kamble}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=Edited 6 years ago, review=One of the best pizzas in the city. If you're looking at authentic Italian food, this is the place for you.
It's one of my favourite places to eat.
Excellent service. They always help me customise my pizza and I love watching the chef's at work, especially when the with the huge wood fired oven.
Love the casual and easy feel of the restaurant inside a five star hotel . It's one of the few places with an indoor and outdoor seating option as well., name_person=shruti modi}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+}, time_line=3 years ago, review=Prego is an Italian restaurant at The Westin Mumbai Garden City. If you are looking for authentic Italian food, look no further. Pizzas, salads, desserts and more. The huge glass wall enhances the ambience. It’s a perfect place for a peaceful brunch with your friends and family. I highly recommend the Tiramisu here, name_person=Jasmine}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 years ago, review=Its Plush, Captivating, Blissful.
A perfect amalgamation of culinary delights, elevated fine dine and unmatched hospitality. I can define this as a Richness not only in fine dine but also in taste of all dishes. This time I was lucky to experience exquisite taste of Truffle. And immediately decides to review this place. Review follows -
Sprawling Prego @thewestinmumbai located at ground floor specialised in serving authentic Italian cuisines, taste and textural journey. Chef Sameer and team has done an incredible job to retain customers expectations and understood what their requirements are. Outdoor seating is also available.
Set Course by course meal option is available highly recommend here.
Every dish was unique and justified it existence. Freshest ingredients, served hot and fresh, you won't go wrong with any of the choice.
Starting off fresh, soft bun, cream (lightly sweet) and Truffle butter which can be finish quiet early.
Soup which was extremely creamy and thick almost like a melted paste. Couple of pieces of Fried potatoes and shaved truffles.

This place is a classic example of how not to run a hotel or restaurant.

For INR 2000 per person (Pure Veg without alcohol), what we got was nothing short of daylight robbery. The food was stale, tasteless, unhygienic, and the service was downright insulting.

Soup: Served cold. When we asked for a replacement, the staff shockingly just reheated the same soup and brought it back in the same bowl – a complete disregard for hygiene and a serious risk of cross-contamination.

Paneer: Stale and chewy.

Curd: Sour and clearly gone bad.

Pastries: The first round was average; the second round (on request) was stale.

Gravies: Every dish tasted identical – as if they used the same base gravy for all.

Raita: One tiny cup for the entire table on a fixed menu – beyond ridiculous.

The service was equally pathetic. Staff seemed irritated if you asked for a repeat portion from the set menu. Absolutely no sense of customer service. For the price charged, this is a scam.

The only remotely decent thing was the ice cream – everything else was a health hazard.

Our culinary journey began with the prawns  soup—a harmonious blend of flavors that awakened the palate.  The chicken gyoza and Edamame were perfectly steamed, offering a savory bite that paired wonderfully with the accompanying sauces.

For the main course, the vegetarian sushi boat was a visual and gastronomic delight.  The assortment was generous, and each piece showcased the freshness and quality one expects from top-tier sushi.  The fish in butter garlic sauce melted in the mouth, rich and flavorful, while the lamb chops were tender and seasoned to perfection.  The Hakka noodles stood out with their impeccable texture and taste, complemented by a hearty stew-like gravy brimming with fresh vegetables—a wholesome touch that added both flavor and nutrition.

A highlight of our visit was the ongoing Mango Mania Festival.  The pull me up mango cake was a tropical dream, moist and bursting with mango goodness.  The mango panna cotta was silky smooth, offering a refreshing end to our meal.

If you’re looking for an authentic Italian experience, this café is an absolute gem! From the rich aroma of freshly brewed espresso to the perfectly crafted pasta dishes, every bite transports you straight to Italy.

The Turquoise Bean café is a dream for food lovers, bookworms, and music enthusiasts alike! A hidden treasure! Not only does it serve delicious Italian food, but it also offers an incredible ambiance with over 500 books, board games for a fun get-together, and beautifully displayed guitars. The music playing on the big screen enhances the atmosphere, making it a perfect place to unwind. Whether you’re here for coffee, a meal, or just some inspiration, this café delivers on every front.

The cozy ambiance and warm hospitality make it a place you’ll want to visit again and again. Highly recommend!, name_person=Sariel Silver}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION, Clearly_labelled_vegetarian_dishes, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS]}, time_line=a year ago, review=Found this place when looking for a quick lunch option for my mother and myself. Its a small little tiny cafe in one of Andheri's many bylanes with the road outside under construction, so parking and access may be a big issue.
They have outdoor seating too but its hot and lots of flies and dust around. The indoors are neat with a section filled with books and boardgames as well.
The cafe seems to be run by a young lady and gentleman with the chap even getting behind the kitchen to prepare food.
When I walked in around 1pm on May day, the place was empty. You have to order via QR codes and thankfully they have Wi-Fi else the spotty mobile network inside can be bothersome. The place offers a variety of sandwiches, pizza, pasta, coffees, beverages and dessert.
I ordered the classic cold coffee and requested it without ice which was duly followed. It was thick, creamy and had a lovely chocolate after taste. For food, we shared a portion of garlic bread, a pesto spaghetti and a paneer vegetable custom panini.
The spaghetti was a large portion but floating with oil at the bottom while the panini had a generous filling insde but was served almost room temperature with everything oozing out making it a messy affair to consume. The garlic bread was just ok though the two portions of bread served with the pasta were cold. Service is really slow despite being the first customer in the cafe. My food took really long to come and i can only imagine how slow service could get during busier times. Cost me 1200 INR for two people. Doubt I would really want to go back., name_person=Pankaj}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1–200, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 years ago, review=Visited this place just for the Van Gogh painting it featured. The overall ambience is really nice, service was a bit slow but food was good. We had Alfredo pasta, aglio olio spaghetti and waffles., name_person=Joylin Fernandes}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹200–400}, time_line=2 years ago, review=If you're looking for a cozy and inviting cafe with a warm atmosphere, look no further than The Turquoise Bean Cafe. From the moment you walk in, you're greeted with a welcoming and relaxed vibe, making you feel right at home.

The decor is tasteful and stylish, with comfortable seating and a turquoise colour scheme that sets the perfect tone for a relaxing and enjoyable experience. Whether you're looking for a spot to work, catch up with friends, or simply unwind with a good book, this cafe is the ideal spot.

The staff is friendly and attentive, providing top-notch service and making sure your every need is met. They take pride in their work and are always happy to chat with customers, making you feel like you're part of the community.

The menu is also worth mentioning, offering a range of delicious and carefully crafted drinks and snacks. From rich, velvety lattes to homemade pastries and sandwiches, there's something for everyone to enjoy.

Overall, if you're looking for a cafe with a great ambiance, The Turquoise Bean Cafe is definitely worth a visit. Be ready for a few minutes and wait to get  a table, it's worth the wait. Excellent authentic South Indian cuisine. Even though the restaurant was fully occupied, I was surprised and amazed at the quick efficient service. Medu Wada was piping hot, Idli Sambar, Rawa Dosa, butter Sada Dosa all delicious. Jain Dal khichdi is a must try for Khichdi lovers. Lastly gulped Vanilla milk shake. If in Sion this is a must visit place., name_person=Madan Dedhia}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹200–400, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN]}, time_line=a year ago, review=Easily Visible and Accessible Restaurant at the Prime Sion Circle Area. It's a pure Veg Restaurant with AC Seating on the Ground and Mezzanine/first floor.

Being Spacious, it houses a lot of crowd, such that the atmosphere becomes very noisy..😅

Coming to the food, it tastes very good and is prepared according to your needs when instructed.
Dishes We've had here:

Veg Kulchan, Paneer Lababdar, Jeera Rice, Dal Fry Tadka, Dahi Vada, Pinacolada, Rotis, Paratha Naan & Kulcha.

Although the pricing is set in accordance with the ambience being the centrepoint. Portion Size for the main course should have been a little more than what they are offering.

The Naan were a Lil disappointing as they were very hard to chew once they were at room temperature. Rest all things were Delicious 😋, name_person=Rajeev Kapadia}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=a month ago, review=Mushroom Soup was too sweet for my liking.
Paneer Chilli was average.
Triple Sichuan Noodles had very smelly burnt oil taste because of the fried noodles added which had gone bad. Huge place, probably 150 people can dine-in at a time. super quick service and reasonable food prices.

North Indian and Chinese Food is recommended.

You will have a nice time here!, name_person=Tejas Joshi}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600}, time_line=Edited 3 years ago, review=Visit 2 : Had a good time again! This time we had Mushroom soup 5/5 ⭐

Paneer crispy 4/5 ⭐
Veg Makmali 3.8/5 ⭐ (main course)
Schezwan Fried Rice 4/5 ⭐
Sizzling Brownie 5/5⭐
Gadbad ice cream 4.5/5 ⭐

Visit 1 : Loved it!

The crispy paneer starter was very good, In main course we had pav bhaji which I'd say was okay(not baad but not great either), Schezwan Noodles fried rice was nice. Sizzling brownie was the best thing I had here, Family had Gudbad ice cream which was also a 4 out of 5.

Overall an amazing experience with great staff and thanks to Saurab for being an excellent server!, name_person=Amar Makhija}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=7 years ago, review=Nice vegetarian restaurant at Sion circle with a nice ambience. From the moment you step in, the ambiance sets a serene yet elegant tone. The decor is tastefully understated, with soft lighting and comfortable seating that creates an intimate and relaxing environment, making it perfect for both a special occasion and a casual, upscale meal. The service is attentive without being intrusive, contributing significantly to the overall pleasant experience.
My visit was truly defined by the Dum Biryani, a dish often attempted but rarely perfected. At Nksha, it was a revelation. The aroma alone, a fragrant symphony of spices and basmati, promised excellence. Each grain of rice was separate, perfectly cooked, and infused with the rich, aromatic flavors. The meat, whether succulent chicken or tender mutton, melted in the mouth, slow-cooked to perfection under a sealed lid. It wasn't greasy or overly spicy; instead, it was a harmonious balance, showcasing the chef's mastery of the slow-cooking technique. Thanks, name_person=Nikhil Rane}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=7 years ago, review=ideal place for a small group to hang out over a beer or plan your travel. youthful atmosphere of the bar adds to your enthusiasm. the place is walkable from dadar station making it an ideal choice for a group comprising people from diverse places.  liquor is reasonably priced. food variety is good and tastes very well. seating capacity is a bit limited but there are many high chairs for solo travelers. service is quick and with a smile., name_person=Anand Patil}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=7 years ago, review=Located near Dadar station, Prithvi's Cavern is a small hangout place with chilled vibes, and not like the unnecessarily loud and boisterous clubs that are popping up everywhere. Last evening we went there early, (we were the first one's to enter in fact) and were greeted by a polite staff, dim lighting and mellow music. We opened our account with Smirnoff and peanuts, which come in two varieties, salted and masala. The Salted Peanuts were, well, salted peanuts, while the Masala Peanuts were really nice, with a seasoning of tomato and onion, not dissimilar to masala papad you might have had. Up next we ordered Chicken Meat Balls, (which weren't ball shaped) nice chunks of chicken, could've been better with some cheese in it. For the next round of drinks we had McDowell and Tropical Cooler, the latter being a mocktail which is converted into a cocktail by adding your choice of spirit to it. It was reminiscent of Blue Lagoon, a commonly served cocktail, since I chose to add vodka to the mocktail. A pointer regarding happy hours, they apply to beer only. Our next starter was Sausage Pepper Chilli Garlic and this was the standout dish for me. Sliced chicken sausages, spiced up with lot of chilli and pepper, with just a hint of garlic, this is a must have here. To end our innings we opted for Cheesy Chicken Nachos and a round of Old Monk. The nachos were a letdown, not as much cheese on it as expected, it was quite bland, even the accompanying salsa couldn't save it, you can give this a miss. To sum up then, Prithvi's Cavern is more a place for drinks and finger food than a wholesome dinner, (no desserts in the menu at all), and does it job quite well without burning up a big whole in your pocket. A bit cramped one might say, but I like the ambience, the music, and had no complaints with the service. Very cozy and romantic ambiance, the service is top-notch.
From the security to waiters everyone is so polite. Also, the staff is helpful with the menu.

You need to scan the menu, the have varieties of food options and alcohol too.

We had -

1. Teriyaki Chicken 5/5 - The chicken was super tender, juicy and flavourful. The veggies in it were also perfectly blended in.

2. Spaghetti Aglio Olio Pasta - 4/5 - Taste wise it was good, the spaghetti looked a bit like noodle and oily. Overall it was good.

3. Bartender’s choice mocktail- It was a cranberry flavour and fruity. I loved it.
4. ⁠Mimosa - It was in sparkling cocktail column, was good too.

The food is tasty, portion sizes are decent. Food service is the only caveat. We had to call for service numerous times. But with the hustle and bustle, that’s all right.

Overall a new place with a fresh feel for a nice get together on a weekend., name_person=Yash Chawla}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=2 years ago, review=Title: Great Food Variety, Some Room for Improvement

I recently dined at Brasserie 1935 Kitchen & Bar and overall, it was a satisfying experience. The menu boasts a variety of delicious options, and I particularly enjoyed their kebabs and beer-infused chicken dishes. The drinks selection was impressive, adding to the overall enjoyment of the meal.

However, there were a few areas where the experience could be enhanced. The biryani, while promising, felt a bit rushed in its preparation, resulting in flavors that didn't quite meet my expectations. With a bit more attention to detail, I believe this dish could become a highlight on their menu.

Despite this minor setback, I appreciate the efforts of Brasserie 1935 Kitchen & Bar to provide a diverse and enjoyable dining experience. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=Visited here after a tiring journey from Pune by train. The best part is its proximity to dadar station. I had prebooked a table here. There is sufficient dining available even if you don't book. We ordered their hot chocolate. It is one of their signature dishes. It did not disappoint. It was rich and tasty. Only it was little bit too sweet to my liking. Then we ordered loaded sizzling fries. Quantity was superb and so was the taste. Finally we ordered their Mac and Cheese. It was okaish. Not too good not too bad. One thing I loved about this dish is the bread crumbs on the top with the cheese. It gave a good crunch to the dish. Overall a good place to hangout with friends., name_person=Dr Parth Mehta}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Very quiet, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=a week ago, review=Food was above average, we had mac n cheese it was more flour heavy, marshmallow hot chocolate was amazing and crispy chicken bao was great too, overall a good cafe just a bit overpriced., name_person=Meet Solanki}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Brunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION, Clearly_labeled_vegetarian_dishes, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS]}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Visited this quaint cafe a few weeks back and absolutely enjoyed the food. We started off by ordering Affogato and Mint cooler. The quantity of coffee was pretty less in my opinion but it tasted okay nonetheless. The mint cooler was icy and delicious.

Their star of the show was definitely their Mushroom ragout pasta. It was creamy, rich and mushroom forward. The pasta was so well balanced and had notes of truffle oil. We paired it with garlic bread which was good.

The service is amazing and the ambiance is cool., name_person=Zoya Khan}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Other, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Tried the Classic Masala Fries, Cheesy Garlic Bread, and Hot Chocolate — and loved them all! The fries were crispy with just the right amount of spice, the garlic bread was super cheesy and satisfying, and the hot chocolate was rich, creamy, and comforting. Cozy vibe, great taste, and a perfect spot for a chill snack break near Dadar station.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️☆ (4.5/5), name_person=Sneha Naik}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Would not recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=2 months ago, review=I had come here when it was relatively new. And now had come after like 2-3 years. My experience here was very bad. The staff were rude and totally busy on their phones. They were just arguing for everything. I had ordered a margarita pizza with a chicken topping for my daughter and had said clearly it’s for a kid and has to be non spicy , but it turned out to be spicy and could see chilli flakes but the attendant kept arguing how can it be spicy it’s just margarita pizza.
Also whn asked your veg non veg sections are separate he denied and said we make it at one place only and also the oven for pizza and garlic breads are the same due to which my mom who is a strict vegetarian didn’t eat anything. Also another instance was when asked for ketchup the staff wiped the small bowl with his own hand and poured the ketchup in the bowl and gave it to us. Looked unhygienic completely.
It’s high time that the staff has to be replaced with good cordial and well spoken and people with etiquette’s.
My review 1 out of 5, name_person=Munish Tahiliani}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=3 months ago, review=Grandmama’s Café in Dadar is a cozy spot, perfect for short meet-ups or casual conversations. ✨️ The atmosphere is calm, noise-free, and makes for a refreshing break from the city buzz. reviews: ["{\"name_person\":\"Ninad Joshi\",\"time_line\":\"3 months ago\",\"review\":\"This restaurant is located on the first floor of the Hiranandani The Walk premises, and it immediately stands out for its thoughtfully designed interiors. The ambience feels curated rather than random, with attention given to creating a comfortable yet modern vibe. One detail I particularly appreciated was their choice of screening football matches instead of the more common cricket broadcasts, a refreshing change for sports enthusiasts who want something different from the usual.\\n\\nService was surprisingly quick. Every order we placed was served within 5\u20136 minutes. While this did make me wonder whether the food was freshly prepared or simply reheated, the flavors did not disappoint, each dish was well-presented and tasted good.\\n\\nWe sampled a few items from their fusion-driven menu:\\n\\nMisal Aranchi, Coffee Tilgul Cocktail, Rava Cake Fusion, Cheese and Chilly Pasta (I don't recollect the exact names now).\\n\\nWhile the food and concept were enjoyable, the biggest drawback for me was the pricing. Small plates and fusion-style dishes are priced steeply, often \u20b9400+ for even basic portions. The cocktail, though innovative, was \u20b9780 plus service charge, VAT, and GST \u2013 which felt excessive for what was essentially a single drink.\\n\\nOverall, the restaurant offers good food, a lively ambience, and fast service, but it comes at a premium. Worth a visit if you\u2019re in the mood to try something experimental, but be prepared for a high bill.\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_MODE\":\"Dine in\",\"GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE\":\"\u20b92,000+\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":4,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":4,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE\":[\"2_people\",\"E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO\"],\"GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME\":\"No wait\"}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Kalpesh More\",\"time_line\":\"3 months ago\",\"review\":\"Love the food & bar menu here, very unique and interesting. ["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Breakfast, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=a month ago, review=I like early start restaurants, this one opens at 8 am, so points to it for that. It’s a size ‘S’ place - that too coz of the mezzanine floor - so best to book and go. The whole place has a quaint look and warm ambience.

So, it was 6 of us and we ordered 7 dishes and orange juice.

The chicken and egg roll were tasty, accompanied by a fresh and slightly sweet tomato and onion chutney. They gave sweet potato fries with it; I would have preferred if they gave a choice between regular and sweet potatoes.

The English breakfast was as it should be. The hash browns were crunchy.

The spicy mutton keema with pao was ok. Have had better.

The s’mores waffles looked so pretty and tasted good. Same with the old fashioned pancake. The only thing is these days restaurants don’t serve chocolate sauce with it. It’s an add on which you have to pay for. It’s a peev that my kids have with all places serving waffles and pancakes without chocolate sauce or Nutella. But that not withstanding, the taste was great.

Now coming to the 2 things we didn’t like. The chicken croffles, looked like batter fried chicken breast on a waffle and it looked too dark as if deep fried for too long and didn’t taste well. The other thing was that the juices turned out to be too expensive. That glass cost ₹450 without taxes. Nearly equivalent to a dish. That was too much. And for that size of glass ₹200 or ₹250 would have been good.

So apart from that, the rest of the food was good and it is a quaint and cost place to go to with friends and family., name_person=Shweta Singh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Breakfast, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_RESERVATION=Reservations recommended, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION]}, time_line=2 months ago, review=If you’re around Juhu Beach and looking for great coffee and food, I’d highly recommend Silver Beach Café. ["{guided_block={}, time_line=10 months ago, review=A perfect place for cake and seafood lovers. The choice of sweet dishes is amazing also the variety of sushis and salads with sea food.

Unfortunately, this turned out to be one of the most underwhelming buffet dinners we’ve had in a long time.

To begin with, the vegetarian selection was extremely limited, which itself was disappointing for a premium luxury hotel. What made it worse was that several items had already run out by around 9:30–10 PM, which is surprisingly early for a dinner buffet. The veg sushi, in particular, was tucked away inside the refrigerator with no proper labelling or indication—it genuinely felt like a game of hide-and-seek unless you already knew where to look.

We were excited to try the chaat and gol gappas (puchkas), but this was hands down the worst part of the experience. The chaat was served cold, soggy, and overly sweet, even after we specifically requested mild spice. The gol gappas were shockingly plain—filled only with boondi and nothing else, completely missing the usual exciting mix of chutneys, potatoes, or flavours.

The Indian vegetarian main course was mediocre at best, lacking both variety and flavour. The only true highlight from the Indian section was the freshly made garlic naan, which was genuinely good. The hot dim sum station was another pleasant surprise, as those were freshly cooked and nicely done.

A special mention must be made of the pancake counter—the lady handling it was warm and sweet, and the fact that the pancakes were eggless won us over completely. Though pancakes aren’t a typical dinner or dessert item, this ended up being the most enjoyable part of our meal.

Service suffered due to severe understaffing. The staff, though polite, seemed unsure of menu details themselves, and the small dining arena with closly sat tables, which further affected the overall experience.

Overall, this dinner experience was a 5/10 at best. As Accor Gold members who genuinely love Accor properties, this was by far one of the most disappointing dining experiences we’ve had in recent times. Sadly, we wouldn’t recommend Pondicherry Café for vegetarian diners and do not see ourselves returning anytime soon.

P.S: Not adding any photos as the experience was not as exciting to capture into images!, name_person=Kunal Shah}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Would not recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Paid_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_PAID_PARKING_LOT], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Dietary_restrictions, E:OTHER_DIETARY_RESTRICTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION, Clearly_labelled_vegetarian_dishes, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS]}, time_line=Edited a year ago, review=Restaurant Review: Pondicherry Café - Sofitel, Mumbai

I recently visited Pondicherry Café at Sofitel in Mumbai, and unfortunately, the experience fell far below expectations. Here’s a detailed breakdown of my visit:

Parking Hassle

As someone who arrived on a motorbike, the experience began with a significant disappointment. The hotel does not provide motorbike parking within its premises. Instead, I was directed to a pay-and-park lot 300 meters away, located on an open ground opposite Jio International School. This parking area was poorly maintained and inconvenient, especially for those with huge bikes like mine. I had to leave my bike without a handle locked, which was unsettling.

Walking from the parking lot to the hotel in the scorching sun further diminished the experience. For a luxury hotel, this lack of accommodation for bikers is surprising and disheartening.

Ambience and Atmosphere

Once inside, the ambience of Pondicherry Café was pleasant but lacked any accompanying music, which made it feel somewhat lifeless. The décor was appealing, but the overall atmosphere could use some warmth and vibrance to match the expectations of a premium dining experience.

Buffet Experience

We opted for the buffet based on its promising menu, but the food did not deliver in terms of taste. While there was a variety of options available, very few stood out. Here’s a breakdown of the meal:
•	Soup: 2/5 – Bland and unremarkable.
•	Starters: 3/5 – Only two items were decent; the rest were forgettable.
•	Main Course: 2/5 – A disappointing selection with subpar flavors.
•	Desserts: 2/5 – Average at best. The pista kulfi had an odd paan flavor, which didn’t appeal to me.
•	Pizza & Pasta: Possibly the worst I’ve ever had.

Overall, the food lacked flavor and quality, especially considering the premium pricing.

Service

The service was another letdown. Staff were hard to find when needed, whether it was for cutlery or water. This lack of attentiveness added to the frustration and further detracted from the overall dining experience.

Final Thoughts

For a restaurant within a luxury hotel, Pondicherry Café failed to meet expectations on multiple fronts. The motorbike parking issue, coupled with an underwhelming dining experience, made this visit quite disappointing. Considering the high ratings this restaurant holds on platforms like Zomato and Google, I feel it is overrated.

Recommendation:
•	For Bikers: Avoid this place if you value convenience and proper parking facilities.
•	For Food Lovers: There are far better dining options in the BKC area offering superior taste, service, and overall experience at similar or lower price points.

Overall Rating:
•	Ambience: 3/5
•	Food Taste: 2/5
•	Service: 2/5
•	Value for Money: 1/5

The restaurant has a colorful and desi-style décor that immediately gives you a vibrant, festive vibe. The seating is comfortable and well spaced, making it a good place for family dinners or outings with friends. The overall atmosphere feels warm and welcoming, which adds to the dining experience.

Coming to the food, it’s quite impressive. The flavors are rich and authentic, and the portions are generous. Their curries, kebabs, and tandoori dishes stand out for their taste and presentation. The food definitely lives up to Urban Tadka’s reputation for good quality and traditional Indian flavors.

However, one thing that needs improvement is the service. The staff seemed a bit slow, and it took longer than expected for the food to arrive. Even after placing the order, getting follow-ups or additional items required some waiting. The service could be more attentive and prompt to match the great food quality.

reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=2 months ago, review=We tried almost everything at Road House Bluez, and honestly, it lived up to the hype! One of our friends from Mumbai recommended this place, and we couldn’t be more thankful. The menu is quite extensive — from juicy starters to perfectly done mains, there’s something for every mood. We sat on the second floor, which had a nice chill vibe, but we also hopped down later to check out the karaoke night on the first floor — super fun energy!

The food was absolutely delicious — we loved the keema variants, pizza and the tandoori platter in particular. The cocktails were equally impressive; the classic mojito and signature Bluez special are must-tries. The staff were warm and welcoming, and the service, though a bit relaxed, came with genuine smiles that made the experience even better.

Overall, Road House Bluez is the kind of place where you go for the food but stay for the vibe — definitely coming back!, name_person=Sumit Raj}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Best best best place for Karaoke! The experience was fabulous, and we were thrilled to learn that it's renowned for its karaoke nights. While the food was great, we felt that the quantity was less than expected, considering the prices. However, the vibe was extraordinarily awesome, and the starters were exceptionally tasty. They give popcorn complimentary with drinks., name_person=Janhavi Raut}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=11 months ago, review=If you’re in Andheri West and looking for a place to chill with friends or a loved one, Road House Bluez is the spot to hit. The ambience is on point—super aesthetic, perfect for a laid-back hangout, or even to wind down after a hectic workday. Whether you're enjoying a chilled beer, catching up with friends, or just vibing with the music, this place has it all.

They’ve recently introduced Drifters Brewing Company’s beers, which are a must-try. With unique flavors like Basmati Blonde, German Lager, and Belgian White, paired perfectly with their amazing starters and snacks (aka chakna), you’ll be hooked from the first sip. The taste is on another level!

The real highlight, though, is the karaoke experience. It’s not just singing—it’s about creating those unforgettable moments with your crew. There’s something magical about holding a mic in one hand and a cold drink in the other, belting out your favorite tunes. The staff are friendly, and the service is top-notch, making it feel even more like home.

If you’re in the area, make sure this place is on your list. 10/10 for the overall vibe, drinks, food, and karaoke fun!, name_person=amin shaikh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=a month ago, review=Great KJ! Shane was the reason I didn't bounce off after meeting whoever that big guy was at the entrance. Rude chap at the entrance who I guess is a co owner or something! And why the hell is there a bouncer at the gate? It's a karaoke bar, not a night club! I've been to a lot of great karaoke places and this was the first time seeing a bouncer at the front door with an owner or something saying stags not allowed. Let people come have fun and sing! Regulars are regulars but new ones come too! 5 stars for Shane and 0 star for the team! Crowd is okay okay, mostly wannabes!, name_person=Paonam Tolstoy}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Loud, but you can still talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_SPECIAL_EVENTS=[Others, E:DINING_SPECIAL_EVENTS_OTHERS], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=6 months ago, review=The ambience was very good. The food was super excellent and the service was on the top. Good place to go for Karaoke. There were already warmup singer who was totally firing up. The only down side was too pricey for everything, name_person=eclipse paonam}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=2}, time_line=a month ago, review=The weekend experience at this place is a mess. The KJ has no grip on order, timing or mood. Songs jump all over the place with zero logic. Slow, fast, random, confused. People who show up early wait for hours while big spenders walk in and get multiple songs like the whole night was arranged for them. It’s not karaoke. It’s chaos dressed up as a playlist.

The bar is another headache. The bartender acts like handing over a glass of water is a personal insult. One minute he insists you must buy a bottle, the next someone else gets water for free. A bottle was ordered and never delivered. Complimentary popcorn is apparently “a thing” but not for you if you actually ask for it. It’s inconsistent service mixed with attitude for absolutely no reason.

The servers are the only ones doing their jobs properly. Everything above them feels disorganised, uninterested and weirdly hostile for a place that’s supposed to be fun. Weekdays prove the place can function because the KJs then actually listen and understand the customers and patrons. To summarise : weekend ; objectively terrible.
Weekday: excellent., name_person=Akshata Narayan / Glitter Vandalism}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a year ago, review=Just happened to drop down at this place today and I was pleasantly surprised with what I saw and experienced!
The food was extremely good and tasty! Loved the ‘Egg on a Roll’ as it was dripping in cheese! The ‘Kasundi Fish Tikka’ was fresh and completely marinated in mustard! The Lasooni Chicken Tikka was a bit on the spicy side!
The service was impeccable and the servers were knowledgeable and helpful!
The ambiance was great even on a Wednesday evening!
The karaoke was the icing on the cake!
Will definitely drop by here again!, name_person=Sunny Ali}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Good small decent place with nice peppy food and music backed by good cocktails}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=A perfect place for Karaoke and drinks 🍸 Great vibe and good service}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=They have a fab Karaoke set up and friendly staff and patrons.}"]

Interiors are really good. Feels like an expensive restaurant but to my surprise the prices were very reasonable. Lot less than I imagined. Restaurants with such interiors charge a lot for no reason.
Total bill for Manchow soup and Chole bhature was 588 including taxes.

Definitely try it once if you want a good ambience, good food and great service at a much lower cost compared to competitors., name_person=Karan Soni}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Roti], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Would not recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_STREET_PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN]}, time_line=a year ago, review=I recently visited Green Door Restaurant with high hopes, but unfortunately, the experience was disappointing. The "biryani" was a real letdown. It looked and tasted more like plain fried rice, with none of the aromatic flavors or rich spices you expect from a proper biryani. There was no depth, no seasoning, and it lacked any authentic touch.
Then came the "bean tortilla soup." Calling it a soup feels generous, as there was hardly any liquid – just an overwhelming amount of tortilla. It was more like a bowl of soggy tortillas with a hint of beans somewhere.
Overall, the meal left much to be desired. name: Steps Café
reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=Definitely was on my bucket list for quite some time, decided to check it out one fine evening when I found myself in Bandra anyway.

Ambience: MINDBLOWN. First thing I noticed is the unique appearance and just nice photogenic location, amidst the trees and calm of Bandra, the amazing smell as soon as you enter the ground floor. You then climb up the steep steps of the treehouse. We chose the AC section as it was quieter.

Food: We weren’t planning on having too much. But what we had was incredible. Pro tip, you can’t go wrong with their signature hot chocolate. This is chocolate imported straight from Europe, I believe and it showed. I have never had anything like it. The onion rings and the avocado toasts were perfect companions to it!

Service: So so good! We were served by Sarah and she was the sweetest! Gave us amazing recommendations, checked in to see if everything was to our liking and was super friendly and joyful throughout the process! We also met Ravi, who gave us such a nice background on why this place was started and we had very similar views to him when it came to chocolates and upcoming food items!

PS they are planning to expand and include more Italian food on the menu. So excited to try that!, name_person=Ayush Sinha}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=2 months ago, review=What a beautiful space with the kindest staff! I loved my time at Steps Cafe on a very rainy day. But I think it’s the perfect place to visit no matter the weather. If you’re looking for a cafe that you can spend time relaxing in with friendly workers, this is it. One memorable touch was one staff member recommending I move to a more scenic spot when it became available and telling me more about the imli tree. The best balance of attentiveness and space for me to just enjoy 🙂, name_person=Nicole Morissette}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Such a cute experience. Loved the service and all the dishes were super tasty! The staff was very sweet and cooperative which made the experience even better. Would recommend to visit!, name_person=Drishti Sinha}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Other, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Not_sure, E:NOT_SURE], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=a month ago, review=The food was amazing, enjoyed every bite. The staff was absolutely lovely, made sure we're comfortable. Honestly the place made us feel like we belong there. Do try their Sea salt foam coffee as well if you're a coffee enthusiastic, such flavour notes to live by. Honestly I couldn't rant about how much we enjoyed yet it wouldn't be enough to show how much actually we did. Couldn't get the names of the staff who took care of us but a big shout out to each one of them., name_person=sakshi shigwan}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION]}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Highlights of this cafe:
1. Steps view from 2nd floor which is calm & peaceful and good for discussion or other writing work. Whereas slow music and chill kind of ambience at 1st floor. One can choose what they prefer.
2. Mango Matcha is hands down one of best combination drink i have had.
3. Tamarind tree surrounding which whole cafe is built which is quite fascinating.

We tried Bruschetta and nutella croissant which was also good. Service was quite fast which i prefer. Cafe is inside the gullies of Bandra and crossing the steps, one can easily reach hill road market approx 1.5 km from here.
Only suggestion is that number of fans can be increased at top 2nd floor especially on humid days when its not naturally windy., name_person=Aarefa Lokhandwala}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Just like any other old school cafe in Bandra, Steps has its own charm and glory with its vintage vibe and location.
Located near St.Stephen's Steps, it has quiet, calm vibes with narrow stairways leading to cafe
Mocha Latte - 4/5. The flavor was rich, Dark with perfect ratio of cocoa powder to coffee. I would recommend this 100%

Chocolate croissant- 1/5 the lady behind counter actually suggested us to try their croissant and i have to say it was THE BIGGEST disappointment of the evening. I always travel to bandra to try croissant from diff bakeries and by far, theirs was the worst one. Chewy, stale and hard to cut into.
Lacking in size and failed to deliver in taste. Try subko or vanilla miel for this one

Classic cold coffee - 1/5. It felt less coffee and more thick foam. After 10 minutes of serving, you will have a 2 inches thick bitter foam in your glass with little to no milk and worst part is the foam is too thick to dissolve so it just floats around in glass. Another utter disappointment

These 3 things rang up our bill to 1000rs and the croissant and cold coffee truly didn't deliver

We refrained ourselves from ordering anything savory after this experience. Would totally suggest this place if you want to experience instagram aesthetic and calm vibes but that's that., name_person=Heena Mistry}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹200–400, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Tucked in a quiet little corner of Bandra, this cafe is a must visit. They have an open sitting area as well as a closed one. Since it was raining, so I chose the closed space and sat for almost 2 hrs reading a book. Perfect to cozy up with a cup of hot chocolate and almond croissant on a rainy day which is exactly what I did. I went on a weekday, so could easily read my book on a corner of the cafe with no rush to leave. Coming to the food, both the items were delicious. The hot chocolate had the perfect amount of sweetness with its smooth silky form. The almond croissant could have been a little more flaky but it was a good one nonetheless., name_person=Bhaswati Saikia}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO, 3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=Up to 10 min}, time_line=4 months ago, review=such a pretty cafe and love the way it was built around an entire tree! had ordered a chilly chicken garlic bread and chocolate cheesecake. while the garlic bread took a lot of time it was definitely worth it and the cheesecake as told by the owner had jaggery as the sweetener and was gluten free too! the owner was really sweet :) would definitely recommended dropping by this place if you’re around bandra, name_person=Anushka Kulkarni}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Really nice vibe, lovely staffs, loved the food and staff behaviour.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Disappointed with the service they took over 20 mins for a French press coffee.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=I absolutely loved the cozy ambience and decor of the place!!}"]

A Hidden Gem for Tea Lovers!
This tea shop is the perfect escape from the city buzz. It’s incredibly peaceful with minimal noise — just soft background music and the gentle clink of cups. Eddie’s Bistro has long been on my radar, and I finally decided to give their Iftaar menu a whirl, expecting nothing less than a feast for the senses. Right from the get-go, the presentation scored high marks; the food arrived in pristine packaging that promised good things within.

Carnivorous Delights Unleashed:
The evening kicked off with Lamb Sliders, a real treat for the palate. These little delights were packed with tender, juicy lamb that melted in the mouth—clearly the star of the evening. Each bite was a perfect symphony of flavors, making it hard not to crave more.

Vegetarian Surprise:
Next up, the Paneer Chilly. Soft, succulent cubes of paneer tossed in a spicy sauce that had a kick but was incredibly flavorful. It was a bit on the spicy side for my taste, but it seemed to hit the right note with everyone else at the table, proving that spice is indeed the variety of life.

Kebab Corner:
The Chicken Seekh Kebab lived up to its reputation. Perfectly cooked with spices that sang through each bite, it was a testament to the careful preparation and love that went into its creation. It’s always a pleasure when a dish meets your high expectations, and these kebabs did just that.

A Chinese Twist:
Rounding off the meal was a Chicken dish with a Chinese twist that was intriguingly different. It was a refreshing change, adding a unique flare to the meal and showcasing the versatility of Eddie’s kitchen.

Overall Experience:
Eddie’s Bistro delivered an Iftaar that was both delightful and memorable, scoring a solid 5/5 on the food front. It’s clear that their culinary prowess isn’t just about good food, but about creating experiences that linger long after the meal is over.

Whether you’re in it for the love of meat or the joy of well-crafted vegetarian options, Eddie’s is a bistro that caters with heart and substance. ["{guided_block={HOTELS_PILOT_TRAVEL_GROUP_TYPE=Solo, HOTELS_PILOT_TRIP_TYPE=Business, HOTELS_ASPECT_SERVICES=5, HOTELS_VIBE=[Luxury, E:HOTEL_VIBES_LUXURY, Great_view, E:HOTEL_VIBES_GREAT_VIEW, Great_value, E:HOTEL_VIBES_GREAT_VALUE, High-tech, E:HOTEL_VIBES_HIGH_TECH], HOTELS_ASPECT_LOCATION=5, HOTELS_ASPECT_ROOMS=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=I stayed at The Leela Mumbai for a day and honestly, it was a great experience. The moment you walk in, the lobby feels warm and elegant. Even though it’s right next to the airport, the place is surprisingly peaceful. Check-in was quick and the staff were polite without being overly formal. The room was spotless and nicely done you can tell they pay attention to small details.

Amazing breakfast spread with hospitable staff! Swimming pool is quite unique amidst green tranquil space. Didn’t feel much chlorine in the water, fountains and well placed sunbeds add to the charm of the place.
Rooms are bit small if one is travelling with family but other amenities make up for it., name_person=Abhinav Rajawat}", "{guided_block={HOTELS_PILOT_TRAVEL_GROUP_TYPE=Solo, HOTELS_PILOT_TRIP_TYPE=Vacation, HOTELS_ASPECT_SERVICES=5, HOTELS_VIBE=[Luxury, E:HOTEL_VIBES_LUXURY, Quiet, E:HOTEL_VIBES_QUIET], HOTELS_ASPECT_LOCATION=5, HOTELS_ASPECT_ROOMS=4}, time_line=a month ago, review=I stayed here one night from 17th-18th October, 2025. It’s just a kilometre walk from the airport making it a perfect choice for business travellers looking for a comfortable one night stay in case they have flight layovers or just a quick business to do in the main city and leave the next day. I MUST CLARIFY ONE THING, THIS ISNT THEIR PALACE VARIANT. It’s a business hotel that’s designed really well from inside to give it a luxury feel.

Here’s my experience:-

1. The staff hospitality is the highlight of the hotel. Right from doorman to the receptionists to the room service guys, they were just excellent. The receptionist even went one step forward and helped me with some cash so I didn’t have to stop at an ATM (Of course just to be clear he included that amount in my bill ).

2. Interior decors in the lobby area were fabulous be it the chandelier area or the fountain .

3. Breakfast was pretty amazing with their pastry taste being the best .

4. Very nice car service to the airport

5. Swimming pool area is quite big and nice place to chill .

NEGATIVES:-

1. Fix your “THE LEELA” board on top of the hotel it’s so hilariously embarrassing when at night , only the T, H , E and L glow up to show “THE L” from far off.

2. I wasn’t particularly impressed with my room (232). I took a smoking room but atleast when a new guest comes in, the room shouldn’t smell of smoke like someone just smoked a few minutes back . The room seemed to have been renovated but there were still signs of age here and there especially if I pointed out the switches for room cleaning or DND.

3. Although the breakfast was pretty good, I just don’t like the fact that such expensive hotels serve machine tea/coffee.

4. This might be a controversial point but I hate walking through that one area of the hotel where all the back end stuff is done just to collect my online food order . I feel that side of the hotel can be used as an easy access to the metro station but I only didn’t like walking through that area because it’s that one part of the hotel you want to keep hidden from guests .

Overall, a pretty good one night stay and i believe most of you can ignore certain points I made in the negative section and safely choose this hotel if you are looking for options close the airport, name_person=Anik}", "{guided_block={HOTELS_ASPECT_SERVICES=5, HOTELS_ASPECT_LOCATION=5, HOTELS_ASPECT_ROOMS=5}, time_line=2 weeks ago, review=The Leela truly embodies five-star hospitality. The breakfast spread offers an unbelievable variety, better than any other five-star hotel I have experienced. The dining staff are exceptionally courteous and attentive, while the duty managers at reception ensure everything runs seamlessly. A special mention goes to Ms. Suhana, whose assistance was immensely helpful and made our stay even more memorable., name_person=Anantharaj Bandagar}", "{guided_block={HOTELS_PILOT_TRAVEL_GROUP_TYPE=Family, HOTELS_ASPECT_SERVICES=5, HOTELS_VIBE=[Luxury, E:HOTEL_VIBES_LUXURY, Great_value, E:HOTEL_VIBES_GREAT_VALUE], HOTELS_ASPECT_LOCATION=5, HOTELS_ASPECT_ROOMS=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=The Leela Mumbai took wonderful care of my family. The rooms are cozy, the property is lush and green, and the location is unbeatable  just five minutes from the airport. The swimming pool is massive and feels like a tropical rainforest escape!

More over we loved our stay becauss of the amazing staff at the buffet restaurant. My kids looked forward to every meal because of how warm and caring the team was. Even when they ran around the buffet, the staff handled everything so gracefully  ensuring safety and comfort for everyone.

A special shout out to Namsi, who my kids absolutely adored. She went above and beyond to engage with them while managing her duties so professionally. Also a big thank you to Pranav, Roshan, and Astler  your warmth and smiles made our stay extra special.

Also I would like to mention house keeping staff. We requested for a baby cot,and when they got to know its a girl , they changed its bedding to pink . (How thoughtful)

The Leela doesn’t just have a great location  it has great people. Highly recommend for families!, name_person=Zainul Khatani}", "{guided_block={HOTELS_PILOT_TRAVEL_GROUP_TYPE=Family, HOTELS_PILOT_TRIP_TYPE=Vacation, HOTELS_ASPECT_SERVICES=5, HOTELS_ASPECT_LOCATION=5, HOTELS_ASPECT_ROOMS=5}, time_line=2 months ago, review=We stayed at the Leela a couple of times during our recent trip to India. Initially, in a standard (city facing) room for four nights, and then again in a club room, prior to flying home.

The hotel is definitely a solid five star, with very good facilities. The pool is an oasis of calm, with plenty of sunbeds, and we were well looked after by the staff there. The gym is also very well equipped, with modern equipment, and spotlessly clean.

The rooms themselves are incredibly well equipped, with everything you could possibly need and more. The bed was amazingly comfortable and housekeeping did a fabulous job. The only thing that wasn’t in the room was an iron/ironing board, but you could request one be bought up.

I thought the corridor was looking a little tired in places. There was an odd smell as you exit the lift on floor four and the carpets looked a bit past their best, but this is an older hotel.

We ate in one of their restaurants called Jasmine one night which was a little underwhelming. The food was very tasty, but the wine was very expensive, even for a hotel. We paid 5k INR an Indian white. It was just missing a little wow or ambience. Having dinned at an exceptional hotel restaurant (Avartana @ ITC Maratha) the evening prior, it was a little disappointing in comparison. Maybe we just picked the wrong one.

The staff are amazing. Nothing is too much trouble. Very professional at all time.

Their airport pick is really good. We used it both times. Super efficient. Yes, you can get an Uber for less, but the airport team made it SO easy after a long flight.

My club room was identical size/layout to my standard room – however, you get various club benefits, including access to the club lounge. This is a great space, with very attentive staff. If you have a club room, you also get your airport transfers included. They did an afternoon tea, which was okay, but the free drinks and canapés in the evening (from 6 pm to 8 pm) were very good.

Overall, a good hotel. Perfect for a few nights in the city., name_person=Phil Gough}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Good ambience, food quality, room service}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Need to focus on staff behaviour at night shift...had very bad experience}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Variety of scrumptious , lip smacking starters and main course dishes served.}"]

Ordered Butter Chicken alongwith Tandoori Roti and Butter Naan, Soft Drinks and Papad. Couldn't even eat the Roti, tasted like Dough was Mixed with HAIR ! Management was Very good at pretending not to understand, so had ordered Buttered Naan, since then.

Good sports themed restobar with multiple options of liquor n food and ideally located close to Kandivali station.

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Would not recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_RESERVATION=Not sure, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=1+ hour, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Not_sure, E:ANSWER_NOT_SURE]}, time_line=a month ago, review=It was my Anniversary and My first experience to the cava lounge and bar. Bartender was like yes sir we do have all the liquor ingredients required for making negroni. I request him once again and asked him to double check that he is sure about it. Just to take an order like a fool he said yes we do have all the ingredients and later when I ordered it instead of using martini rosso (sweet vermouth) he used white wine saying martini rosso is not in stock at so moment. He didn't even knew to make or stir the drink and didn't even knew how to serve the drink. Being a bartender I feel ashamed on such people who do not respect our profession and love towards the creativity and hospitality....

Secondly I ordered chicken lollipop which was again taste burn..

Finally they had a offer of 25% of discount on liquor bill which the waiter clear denied at the time of billing.

So...
Overall the place was good. ["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 months ago, review=4-Star Review for Glass House
Glass House is a fantastic spot with a vibrant atmosphere!

The decor is stylish and modern, with creative lighting that sets the perfect mood for a night out.

The staff are friendly and attentive, making the experience enjoyable. The seating is comfortable, and the place gets lively with a great crowd.

The food and drinks are good, though there’s room for a bit more variety in the menu.

Overall, it’s a great place to hang out with friends, and I’d definitely recommend it for a fun evening!
However the valet service here definitely needs improvement and hence a 4 star instead of 5 star, name_person=Gurvinder Pal Singh Kalra}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Must add more veg menus with spice in it. This place is huge and has a vibe for the party lovers and bollywood music.  It has sofa seating and tables for seating with a beautiful bar section and dj music with club experience.
Smoking is allowed inside but the sheesha which was earlier provided is not served now.
The music here is so much beautiful that one will start dancing on theri seats itself.

Food is also pretty awesome both thr veg and non veg options are best. Ask the staff for best serving items . Service though was good. But it can be better. Pricing is also good not much expensive

Located right beside chincholi fire station and near to inorbit mall ,malad.

Overall superb experience and will recommend everyone., name_person=AKASH KAVAIYA}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_RESERVATION=Reservations recommended, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Very loud, hard to hear, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION]}, time_line=Edited a month ago, review=Visited Glass House Lounge in Malad recently, and overall it was a mixed experience.

Food:
The veg dishes were genuinely impressive. The flavors were rich, well-balanced, and tasted fresh. If you’re a vegetarian or simply enjoy good veg food, you’ll definitely appreciate their menu. The food is the highlight of this place.

Service:
The service, however, was quite disappointing. The staff seemed slow and inattentive, and it took a lot of time for even simple requests to be fulfilled. This is one area where the restaurant really needs to improve.

Ambiance:
The atmosphere is very nice. The lounge has a pleasant vibe, comfortable seating, and a good overall feel that makes it a great spot to relax and spend time.

Overall:
Great veg food and a lovely ambiance, but the poor service brings down the overall experience. With better staff management, this place has the potential to be amazing., name_person=Durgashankar Patidar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Glass_House, Hookah, Fries, Broccoli_Tandoori_Mixed_Grill, Chicken_Chilly], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_of_charge_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_PARKING_LOT, Free_of_charge_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_STREET_PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 years ago, review=This place has a comfortable seating area. The staff is good but we did have some trouble as the menu was limited for mocktails as the lemon was over so they suggested some other drinks . Recently visited for lunch after quite some time and ordered 2 Deluxe Thalis for 3 people—a great value deal. Each thali came loaded with tomato soup, 10 puris, 5 sabzis, pulao, papad, shrikhand, dahi vada, fruit salad, and chaas. It’s more than enough for two people and offers a satisfying variety of flavors in one meal. If you're looking for comfort food in a generous portion, this checks the box.

The taste was good, on par with popular spots like Bharat Cafe, and the pricing is very reasonable. Seating is decent, offering a no-frills, functional dining space—nothing fancy but good enough for a casual lunch or dinner.

The overall experience was okay, but felt priced on the higher side for what was offered.

We ordered 1 non-vegetarian and 2 vegetarian lunch sets. The food presentation was very fancy and visually appealing—typical of a fine-dining concept. The flavours were decent, but nothing exceptionally memorable considering the price point. It feels more like an experience-driven meal rather than comfort food.

The lunch set is priced at ₹1375 + taxes per person, and on top of that:
•	7% service charge is added
•	Water is charged separately (even still water)
•	No offers or discounts can be clubbed, which makes the final bill feel heavier

Our total bill came to around ₹5224 for 3 people, which feels steep for a lunch outing.

Service was fine and polite, but again, nothing extraordinary. The menu is curated and experimental, which some may enjoy, but it may not appeal to everyone looking for value-for-money dining.

Overall:
✔ Fancy-looking food
✔ Good ambience
✖ Expensive pricing
✖ Extra charges add up quickly

Good for a one-time experience, but unlikely to revisit frequently due to the pricing. The carnival bites were the most innovative, and among those, the pani pur semifreddo stood out - it bursts in the mouth where the cold temperature and the flavours work wonders. Bao bhaji is more mundane, with a bhaji stuff bao. So it is a spectrum.

Kombdi rasa was fabulous with perfectly flavoured rasa. Same is true of the crab krapow, served in a dish shaped as crab. I was looking forward to the much hyped recardo negro, but not sure it lived up to the hype. The flavour of the mutton wasn't as intense as I expected it to be - I am not talking about the chilli heat here. A heartfelt thank you goes to Ruchi Thapa for her kindness. That will always stay in our hearts. A big big thank you to Viraj, Akshay, Puja, and Om too (the amazing Aloo Paratha guy). Their generosity, kindness, and professionalism stood out every single day. They went above and beyond to make our experience special — whether through thoughtful gestures, warm conversations, or simply anticipating what we needed before we even asked. Their smiles and genuine care made us feel truly pampered.

Everything about our stay was perfect — the delicious breakfast, the comfort of the room, and the impeccable service throughout the hotel. The team at Marriott Sahar continues to impress with their ability to make guests feel at home.

I wholeheartedly recommend Marriott Sahar to anyone visiting Mumbai. I’m already looking forward to my next stay.

Ambience & Service
The warm, rustic décor—with reclaimed-wood tables and soft Edison-bulb lighting—creates a cozy, neighborhood-bistro vibe. Our server was friendly and attentive, ensuring our water glasses were always topped up and offering helpful menu suggestions.
