After-Hours Perk

Desserts
The chocolate brownie and vanilla bean crème brûlée both delivered for the price: the brownie was rich and fudgy, and the crème brûlée struck the perfect balance between creamy custard and crackly caramel topping.

Overall
Between the inviting atmosphere, attentive service, and that lovely roast chicken (plus a sweet post-8:30 pm discount!), The Family Table NY Joseph’s is a must-visit in Bandra—whether for an early dinner or a laid-back late-evening meal., name_person=Sampath Iyengarr}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Brunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Chicken_Pepper_Roast_Sandwich_Triangle_2_Pieces, Chocolate_Croissant], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=11 months ago, review=A very cozy place yet very simple to chill with your friends, family and great for dates. While butter is a dairy product made from milk,Delicious Fat Spread is made from vegetable oils, and the two have very different properties.

Although Delicious Fat Spread is also manufactured by Amul and marketed as a versatile alternative to butter, it is not the same as real Amul Butter. When I asked the hotel staff about it, they claimed they use Amul Butter — but in reality, they use Delicious Fat Spread.

This product may not be as healthy as real butter, especially for those who prefer natural dairy products. My only intention in sharing this review is to make people aware: if you order dishes here that contain butter, you may actually be served fat spread instead.

The birdseye chili wine and Santra were delicious. As was the Pork and Smoke, Duck Puff and watermelon rind achaar. Can't wait for my next visit! Highly recommend, name_person=Noora Dmello}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=6 months ago, review=The space transitions beautifully and is definitely a highlight of the experience at Bombay Daak. The sun roof, the all glass facade, adds a wonderful charm to the cosy space. The open kitchen also made

10/10 would recommend if you’re feeling a bit bougie and want to impress your date. It’s tucked away enough for it to be a discovery, but also buzzing to not feel like you’re the only people to discover it- a balance that’s so rare.

We ordered quite a few things from the menu, but the highlight of it all were two things: the Pork & Smoke, which was the best thing I’ve tried in a while. Really smoky, succulent, meal-in-your-mouth bits of pork belly, over a mash, and layered with spices, herbs, a little bits of funk. So, so satisfying. If you eat pork, don’t miss it!

The other highlight was the Rasam inspired cocktail- blew our collective socks off. Such a refined cocktail, and so seasonable. Despite the impressive technique, it didn’t feel over intellectual and genuinely had a rasam after taste.

The rest was fine, nothing to write home about. But definitely worth frequent visits (if you can get a spot!), name_person=Sumit Sen}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO, 3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 months ago, review=Where do I even begin? The vibe, obviously. Imagine a dive bar, but it decided to clean up its act and look classy for once. That’s Bombay Daak. I’m a sucker for dive bars, and this one just gets it. Dark, moody, but still modern enough to make you go “okay, this is cool.” And the music, oh the music. In true Bangalore fashion, they dropped “Santhoshake,” that was it. I was emotionally invested.

Now the food, let me tell you, they had me at Shikaar Ka Achaar. Rabbit preserve in some mango-pickle-style masala, served with pav. I’m not exaggerating when I say I could eat that every day and still not get bored. The rest of the food was great too, but that rabbit? Unreal.

And then came Whistle Podu, a gin-based rasam cocktail. I know, sounds like chaos in a glass, but it worked. Refreshing, a little spicy, and very “what the hell, why is this so good?” kind of moment.

Service? Quick, friendly, and totally on point.

In short, go to Bombay Daak. Eat, drink, vibe. Thank me later (preferably with a Whistle Podu in hand)., name_person=Maanush Dev}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=The food, the staff, the drinks everything is just an experience.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=If you love cocktails that celebrate Indian flavours, this is the place to be.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Very small space Seating a bit too close to each other.}"]

reviews:
["{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Food taste: almost consistent. Which is very important. Except for couple of times for Misal it disappointed me, but leaving that aside, it's awesome!
Ambience: they have general non-AC section which is always crowded yet nice and pleasantly full. You get that morning/evening all fresh minds getting together for chattering as well as for delicious food.
Apart from this non-AC, they have one AC family section down and one small AC section upstairs. There is a clean toilet too..
Talking about food,
Interestingly, they serve combos of breakfast for just 100₹ as follows,
1. Sheera, Poha, Batata Vada, & Elaichi Banana
2. Upma, Medu Vada, Mini Uttapam & Elaichi Banana
Have tried 2nd one more than once and it's nice on so many levels. It's a perfect combo to start your day with.
Apart from that snacks like are as follows:
1. Kothimbir Vadi (कोथिंबीर वडी) is niiice,
2. Misal (मिसळ) with पाव (bread) or पुरी (poori) is again a fulfilling combination,
3. Alu Wadi (अळु वडी) is crispy and tasty (they serve just 2 pieces and these vadis are deliciously awesome!!),
4. Batata Vada Sambar is awesome and fulfilling (can be someone's meal too 😋),
5. Corn Patties is also nice,
6. Pineapple raita is basically chopped pineapples in sweet curd and I am not fan of.sweet but it was yummy
7. Sabudana Kahichdi is so like the one we make at our homes (They don't serve dahi with Khichdi)
8. Sabudana Vada is lovely and served with Dahi
9. Dahi Vada is yummy
10. Gulkand ice cream is gonna make you forget everything  and is genuinely a must have
11. Very decent and yummy lemon coriander Soup
.
Lunch has Gravy Sabji+Dry Sabji+Rice+Chapaati+Koshimbir(Cucumbar-curd salad)+Daal+Paapad+Gulab Jamun and it's superbly healthy as well as tasty and worth the money.
Apart from this they have rice combo too.
I am done. This is one of the very best consistent at food and cleanliness restaurants i had been to.

Location & ambience
•	Gallops is located inside the Mahalaxmi Race Course in Mumbai, which gives it a uniquely lush, open-green backdrop uncommon in the city’s dining scene.  ￼
•	The décor and setting combine colonial charm with upscale comfort: for example, walnut-floors, candle-light chandeliers, and equestrian-themed décor post-revamp.  ￼
•	Outdoor and al-fresco dining is one of its strong suits — especially nice in cooler months.  ￼

2. Food quality & menu variety
•	The menu successfully blends Indian and Continental dishes. From traditional kebabs and curries to refined European-style mains, there’s something for varied tastes.  ￼
•	Signature dishes that get strong mentions:
•	“Dori Kebab” (mutton or chicken) – minced, skewered and charcoal-cooked.  ￼
•	“Chicken Ala Kiev” with cheese/butter-filled centre, as a refined European choice.  ￼
•	Desserts are also strong: Baked Alaska and newer additions like Baileys Caramel Cloud.  ￼
•	Many reviewers emphasize the generous portions, good presentation and a sense of value for a fine-dining venue.  ￼

3. Service & experience
•	The service is frequently praised: attentive staff, good recommendations (e.g., for wine or pairings), smooth reservation experience when booked in advance.  ￼
•	The overall dining experience is described as memorable— especially when everything aligns (good table, nice view, well-timed service). For example:
“What a wonderful restaurant from the minute we arrived the staff were so efficient and helpful, the food was absolutely incredible.”  ￼

4. Ideal for special occasions / date nights
•	The ambience, décor and location make it ideal for anniversaries, special dinners or when you want to treat yourself. Many mentions of formative visits, nostalgic moments, photo-friendly setting.  ￼

If I were picking one restaurant for a refined Mumbai meal — especially if you’re after something more than just dinner but an experience — Gallops checks a lot of boxes:
•	A setting that feels premium yet relaxed.
•	A menu that offers both familiar Indian comfort and elevated Continental touches.
•	Good enough service to let you focus on the evening rather than logistics.
•	A chance to dine in one of Mumbai’s less-hustle zones (given the race-course setting) while still being accessible.

If you ask me: go for the outdoor or window-view table (book ahead), order one of the signature starters + a main you haven’t tried, and finish with one of the classic desserts. ["{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=36 Downtown Restobar has recently opened in Kemp’s Corner & offers a casual dine/ bar experience serving North Indian, Chinese & Thai cuisine.

USP :- Decent Decor, Lively Ambience, Live DJ, Delicious Food, Signature Cocktails @ reasonable prices

DECOR, AMBIENCE & SEATING

They have a full fledged bar which offers a wide variety of mocktails & signature cocktails to spoil you for choices.
The place offers indoor seating only which is compact in size, seating is well spaced out & comfortable.
The Bar is located in one corner, seating is spread in the middle while the DJ plays some peppy tracks on his console from the other end.
They have two large tv screens on both sides to enjoy live sports while you munch on tasty food & sip classic cocktails 🍸

OUR FOOD & DRINK ORDER

Veg Starters
* Stuffed Tandoori Aloo Nazakat
* Paneer kalimirch
* Crispy chilli lime potato
* Salted baby corn mushrooms broccoli
* Veg spring roll

Main Course
A) Indian main course
* Punjabi chana masala

B) Chinese main course
* Thai bamboo rice

DRINKS
Mocktail
Water Melon cooler

Cocktails
Guava Mary hai
Kafir orange blast
Downtown sangria
Downtown sour
Bull frog

FOOD & DRINKS REVIEW

Their Food delivers on all fronts in terms of quality, quantity, taste & presentation.

Their Signature cocktails are made using unique combinations, decent alcohol level & less ice which balances the drink perfectly (not too light or strong).

STAFF & PRICING
The Staff is well groomed, polite, attentive & well rehearsed with the menu to make you comfortable & your food experience delightful.

In terms of pricing this place scores really well as their prices are reasonable when you account for the food & drink portions served.

A great place to catch up with family and friends where you can munch on tasty food, sip on drinks while dancing on foot tapping numbers and having a blast without burning a hole in your pocket., name_person=Akshay Davda}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=36 Downtown is a new outlet located within walking distance from the Grant Road Station. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Would not recommend, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Very quiet, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Not_sure, E:ANSWER_NOT_SURE]}, time_line=Edited 3 months ago, review=To be honest, I’m not the kind of person who usually writes reviews 😅✍️… but this is the first time I felt like sharing one — and that itself should tell you how special this place truly was for us 💗.

Yesterday, my friend and I checked out the new outlet. It’s nice, with comfy seating and a decent vibe 😊✨ But honestly, nothing compares to their Oshiwara outlet. That place was truly special — cozy, warm, and such a rare escape in the middle of Mumbai’s chaos 🏙️💛. For me, it wasn’t just a food spot, it was our little comfort corner where good food met peace 🍜🤍.

When the staff told us it’s shutting down soon, it honestly felt heartbreaking a Lil 💔 And it shouldn't close. That's the only spot I've visited multiple time these days, We’ve had such good times there, and the food was always a perfect 10/10 🍜✨, the staff 10/10 👩🏻👨🏻. It’s the kind of place you don’t just visit, but actually connect with ❤️‍🩹. The new outlet is still good, feels like just another Korean/Japanese spot — a bit pricey than before  💸 and food that’s good enough, but missing the soul.

Oshiwara's outlet hits different 🤌🏻✨, had character, comfort, and warmth 🪄 — and that’s what we’ll always miss the most. Some places just stay with you forever 🌸✨.

That was until I discovered Chef James — a true culinary virtuoso.

At his restaurant, every dish reflects authenticity, artistry, and passion. Using genuine ingredients and presenting a thoughtfully curated “James Special” menu, he has redefined the Japanese–Korean dining experience in Mumbai.

I’m still savoring memories of the exquisite Sushi, Makgeolli rice beer, Kimbap, Galbisal, Ramen, Prawn Tempura, and the irresistibly delicate Mochi sticky rice ice cream. Each bite was a perfect balance of flavor and finesse.

I can’t wait to return to explore more — the Hot Pots, live barbecue, sizzlers, Donburi, a wide selection of appetizers, Sashimi (fresh raw fish), and Aburi Nigiri, gently seared with a blowtorch for that smoky finish.

Mumbai finally has a place that captures the true spirit of Japanese and Korean gastronomy — thanks to Chef James., name_person=Lamka Matters}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=6 days ago, review=Chef James Kitchen in Andheri is truly a hidden gem. Recently shifted from Adarsh Nagar, the restaurant offers a calm, intimate, and very chef-driven dining experience.

What makes this place special is the variety and thought behind the menu — Japanese and Korean favourites paired with Peruvian flavours, which is something you rarely find in Mumbai. Every dish felt well-balanced and carefully executed.

From the freshness of the crab salad to the melt-in-the-mouth Buta No Kakuni pork, the smoky sumi biyaki prawns, and the beautifully done Salmon Crello, each plate had its own personality. The chef’s special sushi roll and ramen were comforting yet refined, and the mushroom rice tied everything together perfectly.

The Mount Fuji cocktail was refreshing and well-crafted, and ending the meal with mochi ice cream was a lovely touch.

Overall, Chef James Kitchen isn’t just about food — it’s about the experience. Definitely worth a visit if you enjoy exploring global cuisines done right., name_person=Rohit Mavle}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=a month ago, review=The food at Chef James was truly exceptional, with the creamy Snow Mountain, fresh Rainbow Roll, rich Curry Udon Ramen, and authentic Takoyaki all being absolute highlights. Every dish tasted high-quality and was perfectly prepared. However, be aware that the service was super slow during our visit, which definitely impacted the overall experience. While the kitchen team delivers five-star food, the service pace needs significant improvement, name_person=Rohan Sachin}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Clearly_labeled_vegetarian_dishes, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS]}, time_line=2 months ago, review=If you enjoy wandering aimlessly in search of a door that may or may not exist, this is your spot. No signs, no directions, no hint of welcome—just confusion in a remote location. What was meant to be an adventure felt more like a poorly planned scavenger hunt. By the time we found the entrance, the charm had worn off. A little signage goes a long way. Sadly, this place missed the mark.

Unfortunately, the service fell short of expectations. We waited quite a while without being checked on, and no one asked if we needed help serving ourselves. The food quality was mixed. The hotpot recommended by the waiter fell below expectations—it tasted like watered-down broth with no spice or depth, and no banchan were served alongside it. The fried tofu/paneer in it felt very off... My friend received only kimchi with her cold noodles, which felt sparse and incomplete.

The takoyaki was flavourful and rich in umami, and the vegetable gimmari was well cooked and enjoyable. However, there was a noticeable absence of a dessert menu—just one option offered, with no details or presentation. A single option without context misses the chance to end the meal on a memorable note., name_person=Melissa “Flavia” Pereira}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Even though this restaurant is hidden away, everything was just awesome. As you enter, the ambience is top-level. Cozy, good music, quiet, chill atmosphere. Staff is extremely polite and kind! I recommend reserving a booth before visiting. 🤎
Service was quick. The food was really good. It was my 1st time trying this cuisine and the experience was wonderful. There's a huge variety in Ramen, Kimbap, Sushi flavors and at an affordable price. 🍜
Ask them for in-house beverages! ;)🍶
I tried two desserts matcha ice cream, and the vanilla mochi was recommended by our server- it tasted pretty good!!
I'm a huge fan of Anime and Kdramas, so I felt literally at-home here! The booth area is especially my favorite. 🎀
Hats off to the owner of the restaurant! Great idea, great execution.
Will definitely visit again!
The dishes I tried :

Pork Kimbap 3/5
Chefs Special Ramen 5/5
Squid BBQ 4/5
Chicken Mandu 5/5
Matcha Iced Tea 5/5
Green Apple Mojito 5/5
Match ice cream 5/5
Vanilla Mochi Ice cream 5/5, name_person=Melanie}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Loud, but you can still talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=Up to 10 min}, time_line=5 months ago, review=I’ve visited both the Malad and Oshiwara branches of Chef James' Kitchen, and I have to say, the Oshiwara branch stands out—especially when it comes to portion size and slightly better quality overall.

Here’s what we tried:
- Spicy Chicken Korean Carbonara
- Chicken Spicy Chef James’ Special Ramen
- Chicken and Pork Katsu Rice Bowl
- Prawn Tempura Sushi Roll
- Strawberry Mochi Ice Cream

The Spicy Carbonara and the Chef James’ Ramen were absolute winners—flavorful, comforting, and totally worth the price.

If you’re craving a hearty rice bowl, don’t think twice—go for the Chicken Katsu. It’s packed with flavor and super satisfying. The pork version didn’t quite hit the mark for me, especially the katsu fry, which lacked the crispiness and taste I was expecting.

I’m not usually a sushi fan, but the prawn tempura roll but it is worth a try.

And finally, the strawberry mochi ice cream was the perfect sweet ending—light, chewy, and refreshing., name_person=Ancia Dias}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=2 months ago, review=I've never had a worse tonkatsu ramen in my life. The staff were super sweet to at least give me a side small serving of pork that would add some flavour to the flavorless broth water, but it was too late by then. Even objectively speaking, nobody would like this, it was just plain water with noodles, i just left most of it. The pork pieces were the only redeemable thing in ramen. They dropped the ball on this one. We waited a long time for all 3 of our orders.

The chefs special ramen on the other hand was top class, incredibly tasty and enriching. I couldn't believe how good it was compared to the tonkatsu.

Even the snow moutain maki roll was really good. It's served with a mountain of crab. Damn tasty.
Any star they get is for the wonderful staff and the other 2 items we tried., name_person=Anish Karkera}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=It is a quaint little japanese and korean restaurant serving lovely food}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=For starters we ordered spicy crab gimbap and pork katsu.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Huge juicy chunks of chicken batter fried perfectly as not oily tasted good.}"]

We have eaten at Leopold cafe, Mirchi and Mime, Ranjit da Dhaba and so on. Mentioning this so that you know we have already considered the level of the restaurant and speaking only after analysing that.

So here is my story. After finishing our meal, we were given a feedback form in which I gave mixed reviews according to the food and services provided.

I don't have a problem whether this is normal or not or whether you choose to give that much quantity in this price.

But the main problem was they are just arrogant and ignorant to guests satisfaction. They think that they deserve 5star irrespective of their service or food and only a fool would give them a lower rating.

["{guided_block={HOTELS_ASPECT_SERVICES=5, HOTELS_ASPECT_LOCATION=5, HOTELS_ASPECT_ROOMS=4}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=We celebrated family gathering here for overnight stay with waterpark experience and it was an amazing. Recently, I visited Nandanvan Resort for an overnight stay with my family, and we were absolutely overwhelmed by their warm hospitality.

✅ The ambiance of both the hotel and water park was fantastic – clean, vibrant, and very welcoming.
✅ The staff was extremely courteous and well-behaved, always ready to help with a smile.
✅ The arrangements were fabulous, and the food was absolutely delicious and mouth-watering! 🍴

A special highlight of our trip was celebrating my son’s birthday there. 🎂 Although they don’t usually keep bakery items, the team went the extra mile to arrange a cake from outside and even helped us celebrate by the poolside – something they generally don’t allow. This thoughtful gesture truly made our experience unforgettable. ❤️

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a fun, relaxing, and family-friendly getaway! 🌊🏖️

I rarely leave bad reviews, but this resort deserves it.
Location 📍 – Extremely remote and hard to reach. No proper signage, and GPS takes you on the wrong route.
Rooms 🛏️ – Dirty, smelly, and poorly maintained. Broken fixtures, stained bedsheets, and zero hygiene.
Staff 👎 – Unprofessional, rude, and completely unhelpful. No hospitality at all – seemed like they were doing us a favor by answering basic questions.
Service 🕑 – Pathetic! Delayed responses, no room cleaning, and they never attend calls from the room.
Food 🍽️ – Absolutely tasteless and overpriced. Cold, stale, and served after long waits. We ended up eating outside most of the time.

reviews:
["{guided_block={HOTELS_PILOT_TRAVEL_GROUP_TYPE=Couple, HOTELS_PILOT_TRIP_TYPE=Vacation, HOTELS_TIPS_TOPICS=[Rooms, E:HOTEL_TIPS_ROOMS], HOTELS_ASPECT_SERVICES=3, HOTELS_ASPECT_LOCATION=4, HOTELS_ASPECT_ROOMS=1}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=Once a Great Stay — Now Deeply Disappointing

I recently stayed at Farm House in Tamtalao, Vasai, and unfortunately, the experience was far from what it used to be. This property was once a wonderful place to stay with great food and a warm atmosphere, but the quality has dropped significantly over time.

The restaurant, once famous for favourites like their chicken nachos with authentic dips served in traditional chi glasses, no longer lives up to its name. The food was average, lacking the taste and charm it once had. But the biggest issue isn’t just the food — it’s the stay itself.

The room we were allotted had a stale, unpleasant smell, almost like it hadn’t been cleaned for a while. We had to call housekeeping just to get room freshener sprayed. The bathroom door was difficult to open, and the flush area was stained with yellow marks, along with visible mould — clear signs of poor hygiene and maintenance. Even the room didn’t feel properly cleaned or prepared for guests.

We were so uncomfortable that we checked out the same night.

This place once had so much potential, history, and popularity — I truly hope management takes maintenance and cleanliness more seriously, because right now, Farm House is nowhere near the standard it once proudly held., name_person=Jude Costa}", "{guided_block={HOTELS_PILOT_TRAVEL_GROUP_TYPE=Family, HOTELS_PILOT_TRIP_TYPE=Vacation, HOTELS_ASPECT_SERVICES=1, HOTELS_ASPECT_LOCATION=1, HOTELS_ASPECT_ROOMS=3}, time_line=2 weeks ago, review=Even after clearly informing the property twice — once before booking and once after booking — that the number of guests might increase, and also confirming that I was ready to pay for extra mattresses, the experience was extremely disappointing.

At 3 AM, the property manager came to our room and refused to provide the mattresses, then demanded extra money for four mattresses. Even after my guest took only three mattresses, the manager kept yelling at them, which is completely unacceptable. He continued to ask for money even though the checkout hadn’t happened yet.

This unprofessional behavior caused unnecessary stress in the middle of the night. The attitude and handling of the situation by the manager were highly disappointing., name_person=Pratik choudhari}", "{guided_block={HOTELS_PILOT_TRAVEL_GROUP_TYPE=Family, HOTELS_PILOT_TRIP_TYPE=Vacation, HOTELS_ASPECT_SERVICES=5, HOTELS_VIBE=[Kid-friendly, E:HOTEL_VIBES_KID_FRIENDLY, Great_value, E:HOTEL_VIBES_GREAT_VALUE], HOTELS_ASPECT_LOCATION=5, HOTELS_ASPECT_ROOMS=3}, time_line=a month ago, review=Had a great time at the hotel! The overall vibe was amazing — perfect place to chill and enjoy with family. The food and drinks were absolutely awesome! The room was okay, but the lively atmosphere and great service made up for it. Best spot in Vasai for good vibes and drinks!, name_person=Nitin Devle}", "{guided_block={HOTELS_PILOT_TRAVEL_GROUP_TYPE=Couple, HOTELS_TIPS_TOPICS=[Food_&_drinks, E:HOTEL_TIPS_FOOD_AND_DRINKS], HOTELS_ASPECT_SERVICES=1, HOTELS_ASPECT_LOCATION=1}, time_line=a month ago, review=I had booked Farmhouse Mulgoan for a special birthday date and specifically requested a romantic decoration. The team asked for advance payment and promised a good decoration. To my shock, when we reached, there were just four balloons (two on each chair), no bouquet, nothing close to what was promised. I felt completely cheated.
That’s not all — the service was painfully slow. Every order took around 30 minutes to arrive, and even after requesting beer, no one came for 15 minutes until we had to call someone again. On top of this, the prices were unreasonably high for such poor quality of service.They ruined what was supposed to be a beautiful evening. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Nestled in Khar, Megumi is a haven of luxury dining that perfectly blends opulence with warmth. The experience exceeded expectations, surpassing even the impression it creates on social media. Each dish showcased finesse and flavor, leaving no room for disappointment.
The service stood out as exceptional. The staff were attentive, courteous, and impressively knowledgeable about the ingredients and preparation of each dish. Their thoughtful recommendations tailored to our preferences elevated the overall dining experience. Senior managers personally checked in to ensure everything was to our satisfaction, adding a touch of genuine hospitality.
The ambience is truly remarkable—elegant, spacious, and accentuated by a stunning duplex-style layout that enhances the grandeur of dining at Megumi. With several aesthetically designed, Instagram-worthy corners, the space feels both contemporary and inviting.
Overall, Megumi offers a memorable and refined dining experience marked by excellent food, exquisite interiors, and impeccable service., name_person=Rishabh Mishra}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Loud, but you can still talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a week ago, review=Megumi – Santacruz West

Just one suggestion that the quality and quantity of the food can be improved☺️., name_person=Rohini Sharma}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Bitter_Chocolate_Mousse], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=3 months ago, review=RATING-7/10

Recently visited Megumi, Bandra after hearing a lot about their sushi and Asian food. The restaurant is located on the 9th floor, with a typical brown-toned aesthetic that’s nice but feels a bit monotonous since many places now follow the same style.

We received a very warm welcome from the staff. Seating options include both high and low tables – initially, we were given high seating which wasn’t very comfortable, but the staff kindly shifted us to low seating after a while.

The menu is beautifully designed in a Japanese style, though I found the drinks on the pricier side.

I tried the Tempura Shrimp – it was good, but I’ve had better versions elsewhere.

The Mousse was absolutely delicious and definitely the highlight of the meal

Must visit!, name_person=ShaguftaJahan}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Edamame_Truffle_Dimsum, Cottage_Cheese_Kungpao, Crystal_Dimsum, Kimchi_Rice], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Loud, but you can still talk, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_PARKING_LOT], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION]}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Megumi is an amazing spot I came across on Khar Linking Road, easy to locate as it’s right on the main road, with parking available. The entire experience was fantastic, from food to ambience to service. We went with the waiter’s recommendations, and every dish was absolutely spot on. From appetisers to mains and desserts, everything was delicious, no complaints at all. Honestly, it’s hard to recommend just one or two dishes because everything we tried was genuinely amazing. The place does lean towards the expensive side, but it’s totally worth it for the experience, food, and vibe. A heads-up: on Fridays, the bar night starts at 11:15 PM, so they politely inform diners to wind up dinner if you’re seated downstairs, which is fair. They also have an upstairs seating area, once you exit the lift on the 9th floor, there’s a staircase leading up. You can ask the staff to assist with seating upstairs if you prefer.

The ambience is beautiful, the interiors are tastefully done, and the music post 11:30 PM (especially on weekends) is really great, perfect for a lively night out. The crowd was pleasant, and hygiene standards were well maintained, including the washrooms. Special mention to the staff polite, attentive, and gave us some of the best food recommendations. Prior reservation is definitely advised, especially on weekends, to avoid waiting and get preferred seating.

Highly recommended for a weekend outing or any special occasion!, name_person=Annkita Guptaa}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Megumi_Sushi_Tempura_Roll, Crispy_Avocado_Roll], GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION]}, time_line=3 months ago, review=Megumi is luxury Japanese-Pan Asian restobar offering a unique dining experience, known for its blend of Japanese culinary techniques with fine-dining, a tropical-inspired interior design based on Brazilian bamboo-weaving, and a high-energy atmosphere perfect for special occasions and social get-togethers. The restaurant features creative dishes and cocktails in a visually stunning and calming ambiance.

Started with the Beetroot & Avocado Noritakosu , basically a nori taco stuffed with sushi rice and yuzu black bean aioli. Fresh, flavorful, and absolutely loved it , full marks!

The Megumi Guacamole was a nice touch, simple yet satisfying.

Then came the Megumi Special Tempura Roll, crispy asparagus tempura (I opted out of the enoki mushrooms), tofu, spicy mayo, and a sweet sauce all rolled together. Great balance of crunch and flavor, definitely a win.

Apart from the food, the interiors are stunning, 😍 soaring ceilings, elaborate aesthetics, and a clear view of Bandra street below. The vibe really adds to the dining experience, making it memorable., name_person=Padmini Dixit}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Great place, good staff , highly recommend sushi’s and desserts are okish}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Amazing atmosphere, very cool decor and the service was apt and on point!}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=The food is amazing and I feel they could work a bit on the quantity.}"]

Atmosphere:
We were seated in the semi-lounge area, which was part of the bar. It had really good vibes, especially with the music and low lighting — a great space for dancing, but not ideal if you're there just to catch up, as the loud music makes it nearly impossible to hear anything.

Food:
Honestly it was so disappointing, we had ordered of total four dishes;
"Peri peri fries", some dumplings whose name I can't seem to recall (this was the only decent item), "Paneer keema bao" and "Cheese mushrooms" and both were so bad, I would definitely not recommend. I'm not sure maybe it was a series of bad orders from our end but atleast the options we tried were definitely not worth the money I paid.

Service:
It was a reservation for two, and I arrived at the venue first. However, my friend was stopped at the entrance and denied entry because Level 2 was restricted to guests aged 25 and above. Interestingly, I wasn’t asked about my age before being seated on Level 2. As a result, my friend had to wait for almost 15 minutes before finally being allowed upstairs. If there was an age restriction for Level 2, we should have been seated elsewhere from the beginning. Due to the staff's lack of coordination, we ended up facing unnecessary inconvenience. The place was extremely crowded, so the staff wasn’t very attentive either — which, to some extent, is understandable.

Final Verdict:
Since I was directed to the semi-lounge area, I can’t comment on the regular restaurant zone. But if you're looking for good vibes, a drink, and a place to chill, this spot is worth checking out. Otherwise, it definitely wouldn’t be my first choice., name_person=SoulCranell}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=8 months ago, review=I recently visited Oriv Resto Cafe Bar for a friend’s birthday party, and while the ambiance was quite nice, the overall experience was disappointing.

The biggest issue was the service—slow, sluggish, and completely uninterested. The waiters seemed least bothered about serving us and even made faces, which made us feel unwelcome. It took way too long to get our orders, and even basic requests were met with disinterest.

As for the food, it was just okay—nothing special, but not terrible either. However, the poor service overshadowed whatever positives the place had.

Overall, it was not a pleasant experience. A good ambiance alone isn’t enough to make up for bad service. Definitely not planning to return., name_person=Mithun M}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Chicken_Burnt_Garlic_Kabab], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=9 months ago, review=Orive Resto Café Bar offers a delightful dining experience with a mix of great food and a beautiful setting. We opted for the rooftop seating, which provided a fantastic view. The proximity to the metro added a unique charm, as we could occasionally see the trains passing by, making the atmosphere lively and engaging.

Food & Drinks
We tried a variety of dishes, and overall, the food quality was impressive.

Tom Yum Chicken – While it had a good balance of spice and warmth, the lemongrass flavor could have been more prominent. It leaned a bit too much toward tangy and lemony, which slightly overpowered the dish.

Chicken Burnt garlic Kebab – This was a standout dish! The fresh burnt garlic flavor complemented the tender, well-cooked chicken beautifully, making it one of our favorites.

Green Thai Curry – A comforting and flavorful dish with a smooth coconut-based sauce. Traditionally served with jasmine rice, but here it came with buttered rice, which was a nice twist and added richness to the dish.

Prawns Kurkure & Cheesy French Fries – Both were well-made, with the prawns being crispy and well-seasoned, and the fries having a great cheesy indulgence.

We also tried a few of their mocktails, and they were refreshing and well-presented:

Lemongrass Cooler – A fresh and soothing drink with a citrusy punch. The lemongrass flavor was subtle yet noticeable.

Guava Beach – This was a delightful tropical drink with a sweet and slightly tangy guava base. It had a well-balanced taste, neither too sugary nor too sour, making it an easy and enjoyable sip. (The best amongst three)

Mango Boots – A rich and creamy mango-based drink that was both refreshing and indulgent.

Ambiance & Service
The ambiance was undoubtedly one of the highlights, with a relaxing rooftop setup. However, the biggest downside was the repetitive music playlist. We stayed for about two and a half hours, and the same songs played multiple times, which became a bit annoying. When we asked if it could be changed, we were told it wasn’t possible for the staff to do so. Also we wanted to try their Bao but we were told that it wasn't available. That was a minor drawback in an otherwise pleasant experience.

The service was good, with staff being attentive and ensuring we had everything we needed.
Price was Reasonable for the quality of food and setting
Would definitely visit again! reviews:

We stopped by right before the Women’s World Cup Final at DY Patil since it was raining and we were waiting for it to stop, and it turned out to be such a great find.

We ordered the plain garlic bread (and trust me, it was so delicious!), the Alfredo pasta which had a perfect creamy sauce, and cheese corn balls that were quite decent. For drinks, we tried the hot chocolate, Nutella milkshake, and watermelon mojito — all of them were absolutely fab!

The ambiance is beautiful and cozy, and we even played a few games while we waited. The owner was really sweet and welcoming too. A must-visit place if you’re in Ulwe — perfect for good food, great vibes, and warm hospitality. ☕🍝✨, name_person=Shivani Kadam}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 weeks ago, review=I’ve ordered Chicken Caesar Salad, Caramel Latte, Veggie Lovers’ French Bread pizza,
Mushroom omelette, Korean Ramen -Chicken, Garlic bread online from them.

1. Chicken Caesar Salad - Chicken perfectly cooked, white sauce - perfect balance of flavour(mild✅). Fresh crunchy lettuce! Croutons-soggy with white sauce on the outside and crunchy in the middle. A perfect dish.
2. Iced Caramel Latte- the adding of double shot espresso later in the caramel milk was tasted in the smooth blend as desired.
3. Veggie Lovers’ French Bread pizza: had to heat it in the oven for some time but it was worth it when there was a significant cheese pull! I really appreciate your using of fresh vegetables cut perfectly.
4. Mushroom omelette: I have no clue what mushroom it was, (and I was sceptical as I’ve seldom had a good experience with mushroom). But it was beautifully cooked and seasoned. The egg itself! Perfectly cooked.
5. Korean Ramen -Chicken- I’m no expect at this and I’ve not explored this cuisine or do I wish to. In my inferior knowing of the dish, I would say chicken was perfectly cooked, noodles nice and noodley😂. Veggies- fresh and cooked perfectly. Loved the mushrooms and the miso sauce. It was a package.
6. Garlic bread - loved them.
I give a part of what I eat to birds(if I remember) and 2 loafs of bread in the morning. (I do not feed pigeons as it’s against the law now, but there are other birds that live on a tree infront of my house, maina, bulbul, squirrels, bats). Long story short, Garlic Bread and Veggie Lovers’  French bread pizza was deeply enjoyed by my avian friends.

reviews:

It’s rare to find a café with that kind of soul, and they pull off the mix effortlessly.

Tarun has a passion for coffee that’s truly inspiring. For him, it’s not just about brewing; it’s about understanding the story behind the bean itself, where it’s grown🗺️, at what altitude🏔️, how it’s processed, and how each step transforms its character and flavor. Talking to him actually changed how I look at coffee, it’s no longer just that magical “keep me awake” juice 😅 but something to slow down and appreciate.

Ruchika, a talented tattoo artist , also makes and sells beautiful crochet pieces at the café. There’s something grounding about seeing someone express creativity across such different forms — from ink to yarn 🧶 adding another layer of soul to the space.

Nitanya, who’s just starting her journey as a tattoo artist, barista, and culinary artist 🎨☕🍴, brings these three amazing skill sets in my opinion. She hosts hand-poked tattoo workshops and curates the menu, blending creativity with curiosity in everything she does 🌸

Aaryaman, whose passion for music runs deep 🎶, is the mind behind the listening lounge upstairs. The vinyl collection he’s curated is incredible, built with love and a true ear for sound. It’s a different vibe to walk into a café and feel that level of thought poured into the music that surrounds you.

I ended up marking a perfect memory on my wrist! Getting a very specific tattoo that I’d been meaning to get for the longest time, somehow, the vibe, the people, and the presence of music in its most preserved format all came together perfectly and I finally got it inked on my wrist.

Definitely visiting every time I’m in Mumbai. :), name_person=Devakant Sanasam}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Very quiet, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_STREET_PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=a month ago, review=I had gone to ink and brew for a latte art workshop with my best friend, my sister and my cousin sister and I ended up having the best time. They were so kind and down to earth in terms of hosting us, guiding us through the cafe latte art workshop. We made some new friends as well and this truly was a beautiful experience. It was my birthday on the 23rd of October and on 25th of October I went for this session and it turned out to be such a blessing. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=Up to 10 min}, time_line=6 months ago, review=It’s an awesome , cozy place. The ambience is elegant and perfect for a relaxed evening. The food was delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented.

Special thanks to Sachin and Tushar for their excellent service — they were attentive, polite, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our visit.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a great dining experience with good food and top-notch hospitality., name_person=Raj Baldota}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=2 years ago, review=The prettiest rooftop place in Sobo😍
Allamanda terrace looks very serene and has gorgeous views. It is very dreamy and has a beautiful view of Marine drive. It is located at hotel marine plaza. I really loved their huge ambience, which also has pool near dining

In terms of the food we had ,
- Bhatti ka paneer
- Murgh chandni tikka
- Lamb and jalapeño seekh gilafi
- Chooza khas makhni
- Gosht Lahori

Everything we had was very tasty , hearty and indulgent . I liked the flavours and aroma . It’s very evident that everything is freshly made with great quality of ingredients . We also had their unique desserts malpua bites with rabdi and dates pudding kataifi . Drinks were also great in taste !
This place is really good for dinner dates with friends or family .
With new year around the corner Allamanda terrace is perfect for all your dinner needs !!!, name_person=Anisha M}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=Edited 3 years ago, review=We wanted to visit Allamand Terrace since a very long time & finally we made it. Located on 6th floor of Hotel  Marine Plaza, this place is perfect for your romantic date with your loved ones. You will get to see the complete top view of Marine drive & queen's necklace.
Talking about the service, it was the best. Ms. Mamta displayed an example of great hospitality & made sure we have a memorable experience. She was bang on with her recommendations of Jain dishes as per our taste buds. She is truly amazing. Chef Rajendra also cooked delicious food according to our preference.

They also have a big projector right above the pool so you can enjoy live screening of matches along with your loved ones with soft music playing in the background.

Coming to the food, they serve only North Indian food with cocktails & mocktails. Price wise it expensive but its worth it.

We started with mocktails & opted for our favourite Virgin Pina Colada & Exotic punch. Both were refreshing, thick & creamy. Totally loved it.

In appetizers we had

Bhatti ka paneer (Jain)-
Soft cottage cheese marinated with thick delicious marination made from different spices, hung curd & grilled to perfection. The portion size was quite enough for two people & totally worth the money. It was perfectly cooked & paneer was also tender & full of flavours. Add little lemon on top & have it with mint chutney.

Za'atar dahi ke kebab-
These tangy kabas made from Hung curd, minced chillies, grated ginger and spices were soft from inside and super crispy from outside. Have it with mint chutney and onions. These were made in Jain by chef on request. 4 kababs are served but these are really big and worth the money with a view. Loved it..!!

In Main course we ordered two sabji one jain & one veg.

Bocconcini Khurchan (Jain)-
This was made in Jain.
One of the best sabji we had. It was made with bell pepper & small round
pieces of mozzarella tossed in rich thick tomato gravy. It was a bit sweet and not spicy spicy at all. It goes well with Cheese Naan. Highly Recommended..!!

Punjabi Chole Wadiyan- Delicious chole along with wadi cooked in Punjabi style. It was spicy and the taste of Kasuri Methi in it was a cherry on the cake. Loved it with Chur Chur laccha paratha and also goes best with Jeera Rice.

Desserts

Dates Pudding Katafi-
Dry Dates were soaked & cooked with ghee with lots of dry fruits & mawa. Later it was rolled in vermicelli and baked till perfection. 3pcs were served along with Shrikhand. The presentation of the dish was very captivating to the eyes. It was not much on sweeter side.

We also tried Baked Gulab Jamun Shrikhand Tart & Rasmalai Tiramisu.
Loved the tart more. The tart was perfectly baked & mini gulab jamun totally elevated the taste of this. Dessert. A must try.

Please note the restaurant is open everyday from 7.30pm to 11pm. Though on social handle it says it is closed. Prior reservation is recommended., name_person=HisandHerCravings}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review=South Mumbai has a new fine dine rooftop restaurant, to chill and unwind. Cool Breeze, Dine under the Stars, Nice Music, Beautiful Ambience, Pool-side and  Breathtaking Views of the Mumbai Skyline and Queen's Necklace, believe you me it can't get better than this. The Allamanda Terrace opens doors to all, pre booking is recommended. And since it is on the terrace, currently it's open only for dinner. Located on the 6th floor of Marine Plaza Hotel, the Allamanda Terrace serves a 3 course unlimited set menu of Indian food with decent options for vegetarians as well as non-vegetarians. You have a live counter as well so one can catch the chefs live in action. The price for the set menu is set at INR 1500 + taxes.

Talking about what we tried here - we started with a couple of mocktails, special for the day was Melon Cooler which is a watermelon based drink blended with coconut milk. The other one was Papaya Cooler - fresh fruit with sweet - sour mix. The drinks were quite refreshing. Moving to starters, we tried Pesto Paneer Tikka, Sarson Broccoli, Bharwan Kumbh and Soya Subz Nawabi Seekh. All appetizers grilled to perfection. My personal favorite amongst these was Soya Subz Nawabi Seekh and Bharwan Kumbh. Seekh Kebab was not very dry and the smokey taste of mushrooms was the key here.

Moving to the mains, we called for Dal Makhani, Khade Masale Ka Paneer and Kasuri Methi Miloni Tarkari. Creamy Dal Makhani and Paneer Subzi were top notch and the dark house was veggies flavoured with dried fenugreek in Spinach base and some cream. We had this with Ajwaini Laccha Paratha and Garlic Naan. Scrumptious meal! We ended our meal with a bit of hot Gulab Jamun and cool Rasmalai.

Must say, the staff was courteous and helpful and they ensured we had a good evening. All in all, a must visit purely from an experience point of view.  The Allamanda Terrace is a perfect recommendation for all those looking for options to celebrate special occasions with either family or friends., name_person=Jatin Shah}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=10-30 min}, time_line=Edited a week ago, review=Overall nice dining experience over the rooftop!, name_person=Pravat Biswas}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review=The Allamanda Terrace is one the most beautiful rooftop place in Mumbai. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=2 months ago, review=We spent the afternoon at a café that screams Pinterest — and no, it’s not in Bandra!
Every corner is so aesthetic, the clips don’t even do the dreamy interiors justice.
Just when we thought it couldn’t get any better, the food took us by surprise.
It’s pure veg, Jain-friendly, and genuinely worth the hype.
We started with the Tiramisu Latte — eggless, light, and creamy. The perfect start. 8.5/10.
Then came the Lebanese Bowl — with falafel, hummus, and warm pita. Super fresh, crunchy, and shockingly filling. 9.5/10.
Next up, the Dal Bukhara — rich, creamy, comforting, and Jain-friendly. 8.5/10.
The Chilli Cheese Naan? Soft, spicy, indulgent — honestly, addictive. 7.5/10.
Their Bomdia Special Roti was soft, flaky, and a total must-have with any curry.
The Asian Sizzler arrived sizzling — slightly on the sweeter side, but flavour-packed. 7/10.

Bomdia in Matunga is literally a Pinterest board come to life…
And the best part? It’s not just cute for the ’gram — the food was just as good as the place looked., name_person=Gourmetgram}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN, Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=a week ago, review=Visited Bomdia and tried the Christmas special menu. While we waited for our group to arrive we ordered the kale and strawberry salad along with one iced and one muddled drink. Loved the salad, the kale was fresh and crunchy, nuts toasted just right and the sweet and tangy tartness of strawberry to balance it off.  The muddled drink too was warm and spicy and filled with Christmas cheer, once again the flavours were melded beautifully.

A few of the items we tried and worth a shout out were Kaffir lime mushrooms with bold fresh flavour of lime and Crispy Corn tempura, delicately flavoured and crisply fried and served in a sauce. So it’s not dry but still crispy. 👍 The burnt garlic dim sum and satay too were excellent. The chilli oil dip is something I would like to take home, by the bottle.

In mains, or Large plate, we selected Butter Garlic spaghetti in coconut cream. In this east meets west dish, the coconut cream was the star ingredient and will warm the hearts of all Pan Asian food lovers.

We ended with Basque cheese cake and skillet cookie. You must visit here to find out why the skillet cookie is a big favourite. 😋

As we were travelling the next morning we did a takeaway of Bomdia twisty and Ragi sandwich cookie.  The Ragi Cookie is rich, indulgent and sinfully delicious. The twisty makes a perfect travel mate, no mess, no fuss, no crumbs, no cutlery. Full on taste, beats the pizza to the finish line on convenience. Well done twisty👏🏽

To sum up, Bomdia is great for balance of flavours. Great service, thanks to Williams and Mohan who guided us and served us great food. If you go in a larger group you can try a couple more dishes., name_person=Madhumati Deshmukh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=Edited a month ago, review=Matunga’s newest pure-veg spot - Bom Dia. Two floors, double the deliciousness
because when it’s pure veg and pure fun, it’s always a good day at Bom Dia Cafe.

The staff behaviour was equally impressive. They were polite, attentive, and made sure we had a comfortable time throughout our visit.

The place has a warm, fun vibe — lively music, pretty interiors, and an overall cheerful atmosphere that instantly puts you in a good mood.

We ordered sushi, nachos, paneer tikka pizza, and for drinks, went with a classic mojito and a watermelon mojito. Every dish was full of flavour and beautifully presented. The sushi was fresh and well-balanced, the nachos were perfectly crispy with generous toppings, and the paneer tikka pizza turned out to be the star of the evening — smoky, cheesy, and loaded with flavour.

The space is small but they have done their maximum in getting the most out of the place.
We visited on a Sunday and had to wait even though we had prior reservation due to limited no.of tables. So keep that in mind and reach the cafe accordingly.
Since we were many of us, we tried a lot many food items from the menu. Here is what we ate and what we liked.

- Tomato Basil Bell Pepper soup - tomato was overpowering the basil taste & couldn’t taste the bell pepper.
- Avocado Toast - It was really nice. The touch of pomelo (grapefruit) was really refreshing. Highly recommended & a must order.
- Falafel Pocket - They were very dry, they need to add more hummus inside the pockets. The falafel was crispy and nice.
- Thecha Cheese Grill - It wasn’t spicy enough. With the cheese and double bread layer, they must increase the spicy thecha flavour to give its authenticity.
- Peri Peri Fingers (Tofu) - Deep fried and crispy. It was nice.
- Loaded Nachos - Decent in terms of the flavours.
- Spinach Mushroom Cheese Crepes - It was nice.
- Mumbai Delight - The vadas were lacking the Mumbai punch.  The masala tea was nice.
- Jackfruit Makhani - Tried such a dish for the first time and it was nice. Can give it a go if you want to try something different.
- Shakshuka - This was another different take of a popular dish with chargrilled Tofu pieces served in a red gravy pan along with some pita bread. It was a good dish.
- Breakfast Quesadilla - It was nice. Loved the taste.
- Tofu Schnitzel Wrap - The wrap was nice. Liked the taste and the flavours.
- Korean Cheese Buns - The buns were a disappointment. There was very less salt in it and also it lacked the garlicky flavour.
- Hazelnut Gianduja Pancakes - Pancakes were a little dry but the taste was nice. It was served with caramelised bananas and chocolate coated grapes.

- Espresso - Had the double espresso and the coffee was rich in flavour. Must try if you like espresso.
- Berry Black Iced Tea - It lived up to its name. Loved it.
- Kahwa Iced Tea - It was really nice. The flavours were bang on.
- Raspberry Mocha (Hot) - Loved it. The raspberry taste was complimenting the mocha flavour very well.
- Classic Lemonade - It was nice. Could go wrong with this.
- Lemon Ginger Soda - It was nice.
- Pink Guava Chamomile Iced Tea - Absolutely loved this! It was an instant hit with everyone and we ended up calling for multiple orders of this iced tea. We even added some chilli powder & salt to it on top and it was the most delicious Guava drink I’ve had in a long time.

All in all, it was a wonderful experience to eat at the cafe. The staff were polite and helpful and the service was really top notch considering it was a full house.
Will definitely come back here for another meal., name_person=Nirav Gangar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Other, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=a month ago, review=First things first, the cafe's got nice decor and seems like a cozy spot. ["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Rolls On Coals is a excellent vegetarian fast‑casual café in the Bhayandar west near Maxus mall. The place is cozy, decent décor, a pleasant place to hang out with friends and loved ones. The place focus on cheesy indulgent bread‑based fast foods like rolls, sandwiches, pizzas, pasta, other “snacky / cheesy” eats and Chinese too. It is 100% vegetarian including Jain options which is a strong plus point for vegetarian and jain dinners. Signature Items / Must-tries are varities of Melting Sandwiches, ROC Rolls and Volcano sandwich as a signature, go-to item. Other popular items include Stuffed garlic bread, Pink sauce pasta, Papa Pasta with 3 different sauce, Chilli garlic fries, Paneer pizza, etc. The place offers a varities of sandwiches, pasta, pizza, rolls, snacks, cold beverages, shakes and waffles. It also supports customization (e.g. spice, cheese etc.). Also tried its Bombay Chilli from chinese section, a lovely combination of rice and gravy. Loved its Blue Lagoon mocktail - totally refreshing and Chocolate mud shake. Service is quick and good. The staff are polite and helpful. The price of food dishes and beverages are economical. Rolls On Coals is a good café chain in its niche: vegetarian, snacky, indulgent, casual dining. It offers enjoyable items, especially sandwiches and cheesy snacks, and has a warm, cozy vibe definetely worth trying., name_person=Bhavin Parekh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_SEATING_TYPE=[Indoor_dining_area, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_INDOOR_DINING_AREA, Outdoor_patio_/_terrace, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_OUTDOOR_PATIO], GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 months ago, review=Visited Rolls On Coals recently and had a really good experience. The Brownie Shake and Kit Kat Waffle were a perfect sweet ending to the meal. The portion sizes were quite satisfying, and the presentation was neat. Would definitely visit again!, name_person=Yash Patel}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,400–1,600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN]}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Finding a dedicated, pure vegetarian spot that caters specifically to Jain requirements is always a win, and Rolls on Coals in Bhayandar delivers just that. Conveniently located close to the popular Maxus Mall, this restaurant is immediately appealing, boasting a well-lit, vibrant ambiance and a genuinely courteous staff, setting a great tone for the meal ahead.

Starting off with shakes, the Strawberry Shake was truly 'berry berry delicious' and complemented the upcoming courses perfectly. The Kitkat Shake was a solid, enjoyable chocolate option as well.

Moving into the savories, we tried the Pesto ROC special roll. This roll, served uniquely in whole wheat roti, was a delightful combination of fresh pesto, basil, veggies, and cheese—a pretty decent and healthy-leaning choice. The Pesto Spaghetti Pasta followed, which was very presentable and had a satisfying taste, served alongside two slices of garlic bread. The star of the evening, however, was definitely the Exotic Pizza. As their chef’s special, this pizza was fantastic, with a harmonious mix of various sauces, fresh vegetables, and cheese. It was easily the highlight of our visit.

We wrapped up the meal with the Hazelnut Waffle. While the flavor was good, we noted that the texture was slightly chewier than the desired crispiness, but still a satisfactory end to the dinner.

Beyond the menu, Rolls on Coals offers great value. They have special deals for those looking to book the space, such as for birthday or kitty parties, with rates starting incredibly low at ₹499 onward. This, coupled with their focus on pure veg and Jain food, ensures they cater to a wide range of needs. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Would not recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_STREET_PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Somewhat difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Clearly_labeled_vegetarian_dishes, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS]}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Came across this restaurant on Zomato and the estimated time of delivery was quite fast, so I ordered a hyderabadi mutton dum biryani.
Honestly it did not disappoint me even though it was not the authentic Hyderabadi dum biryani because I've on many occasions had the real stuff in Hyderabad.
The biryani was still good, mutton quality was good and the packaging was nice.
Overall a pleasant experience., name_person=Ap Consultants}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=°°°ZYTUN°°°
Yesterday hit this place for dinner.  It's in marol.
Ambience is amazing. Above the restaurant there is Hotel.
It was raining outside and the dinner gave perfect moment to us.
So, we started with mocktails,

° Zytun special mocktail - it was mixed fruits based mocktail.

° Sunlight - it was orange - pineapple based mocktail. It was so refreshing.

° Tangri Kebab - It was chicken leg piece baked in tandoori, was looking tempting. It tasted good.

° Pahadi Kebab - I literally loved this. The color, texture,  taste.  Everything was just perfect. One should definitely try this.

° Murgh Maharaja -  it was in main course we order this with tandoori roti.
The gravy was thick and chicken pieces was more than enough. Taste was awesome.

° Fresh Fruit Salad - it was like normal fruit salad with ice cream on top of it. However presentation took my heart.

° Malai kulfi - its my favorite one.  I can't say NO to malai kulfi ever. There was chocolate syrup on it which was also impressive.

**Recommended**
° Sunlight.
° Pahadi Kebab.
° Murgh Maharaja.
° Malai Kulfi., name_person=hina ansari}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹200–400, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 years ago, review=Zytun - The Restaurant

You may find the road to reach the restaurant bit crowded and the parking space seemed a bit congested.
The restaurant is part of Hotel Metropolis Mumbai on Marol-Maroshi Road (Andheri).

Ambience: The ambience of the restaurant was good, the lighting was decent and the restaurant is medium sized.

Staff: The staff was polite.

Food: We had ordered the Chicken Manchow Soup. The soup was bit salty but it tasted nice with good amount of chicken in it. We had also ordered Chicken Clear Soup which was very well prepared. Following that we were served - Chicken Badami Malai Kebab. It was something new for us and we were trying it for the first time. It was cooked in cream and roasted almonds and it tasted very nice. Highly Recommended. And at the end, we had Chicken Tikka Biryani which also bit salty.

Crowd: Since we had reached the restaurant late (around 10 PM), the restaurant was less crowded. You would find mostly families dinning in here. There are very few good restaurants in this locality, I would recommend to contact the restaurant in advance for reserving table(s) during peak hours (for lunch & especially dinner).

Rating: 4 / 5, name_person=Mehul Karkar}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=We ordered couple of things, crispy chicken, badami murgh malai, butter roti was good.However Murgh mussalam and schezwaan triple rice needs improvement. Cost is on the higher side, Packaged drinking water which costs Rs 20 had  been billed for Rs 40. We also had Zytun special ice cream and Icecream sundae which was scoop of ice cream together. The ambience is very good. Staff is responsive & available for quick assistance., name_person=SandeepN}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=5 years ago, review=Zytun - Gold restaurant. Total Bill - RS 280 (divided amongst 3 people)

We ordered -
1) Chicken tandoori - 3/5
Taste was great but I've had better tandoori in other places. Small chicken pieces, not huge like a tandoori should be. The green chutney served along side was yum though and really enhanced the flavor of the dish.

2) Chicken Biriyani (RS 280) - 3/5
Tasty biriyani rice but a full bowl of biriyani will get you only 2 chicken pieces, which was not adequate at all. They serve you tons of rice but no chicken to balance it out to presumably save on their costs. It's tasty but if you're a chicken fan more than a rice fan, it's a mediocre dish.

Ambience - wonderful ambience. Very clean and neat, comfortable seating area, well lit, great pristine washrooms. Prompt service and we got our bowl of extra chutney whenever we asked for it.

Overall food - 6/10
Overall ambience - 10/10

Continental had choice of boiled eggs and omelette. Toast bread, butter, jam. Cornflakes with milk.
Fresh fruits had a choice of cut lovely sweet papaya, watermelon and banana.
Choice of pineapple and watermelon juice which was very sweet. So i avoided.
Choice of hot tea and coffee in flask., name_person=HILDACRAFTY}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Being a banquets part of a Stay in Hotel Metropolis, my colleagues decided to have a team dinner over.

But the food was a real disgrace to spend for,being the prices so exorbitant, I was expecting a good quality cum quantity food but both didn't do in our dinners case.
