reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Korean_Pull_Apart_Garlic_Bread, Blabber_Fried_Chicken_Bao, Mocktails], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a week ago, review=The ambience at Blabber Juhu is elegant and calming, making it a great place to unwind. Its convenient location and generous portion sizes offer good value for the price. The food quality is impressive, with standout dishes like their Korean pull-apart garlic bread, pink sauce pasta, and the Juhu dabeli bao — all absolutely outstanding. The comfortable, soothing setting also makes you want to sit back and enjoy your time for longer.

They offer a wide variety of dishes, so whatever you’re in the mood for, you’re likely to find something that hits the spot. The service could be slightly more attentive, but it doesn’t take away much from the overall experience.

Overall, Blabber Juhu is definitely worth a visit. Valet parking is available as well., name_person=Rahil Kotadia}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=4 months ago, review=An Unforgettable Birthday Lunch with a Unique Dining Experience

We celebrated a birthday lunch here and were blown away by the overall ambience, decor, and food quality. The restaurant is spacious, offering multiple seating options for couples, families, and larger groups. We chose the swing seating area, which was a fun and unique dining experience — something you don’t often find!

The interior design is inspired by Italian architecture, featuring elegant arches, vibrant colors, and plush upholstery that create a warm and inviting ambience. The space is also highly Instagram-worthy, with several beautiful photo spots, including a grand piano on the ground floor that adds a touch of sophistication.

The food was fresh, flavorful, and well-portioned, clearly made with quality ingredients. From appetizers to desserts, each dish was presented beautifully. The service stood out — the staff were polite, attentive, and knowledgeable about the menu, carefully explaining the ingredients, preparation, and signature elements of each dish.

Whether you’re looking for a place to host a birthday celebration, enjoy a romantic meal, or just have a relaxing lunch with friends, this restaurant delivers on all fronts — great food, exceptional service, stunning decor, and a memorable atmosphere. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for a picture-perfect, high-quality dining experience in town., name_person=Rishabh Mishra}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Can get a bit packed after 1:30 on weekends.

We went on a Saturday for lunch. Booked a reservation so getting to our table was smooth.

The ambience is simply sublime. The music selection is groovy remixes, the lights are just right and the colours go well together.

Service is quite fast and accommodating.

As for the food, y’all will be fighting to finish the plate. Everything is of high quality ingredients with the most amazing flavour profile. A touch overpriced, but certainly worth it.

Highly recommend korean pull apart garlic bread, salt and pepper lotus stem, fetuccine alla mascarpone, san sebastian cheesecake, waterfall (drink)

Will gladly recommend this place, and will visit again!, name_person=AmKam Omega}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Loud, but you can still talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Went for birthday dinner table for 6 and we were accommodated in a little separate area with 2 huge tables for 8, the whole vibes were very pretty and elegant but the music was completely contrasting the ambience of the restaurant, especially when you have a piano for decor I think a little classical music would help, rather than edm, the service was okay, the servers were attentive and also wrote birthday msg on our cake with candles which was very kind of them, loved the food, especially the paneer starters, the cream cheese dumplings and the 4 cheese pizza, the mocktails were okay. Photos of cake, food and sm ambience attached, name_person=Ayaan Shah}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=Edited 5 months ago, review=Visited Blabber All Day recently and had a great experience overall! One of the major plus points is their valet parking facility, which makes things so much easier in a busy area like this.

We had a reservation via Zomato, and thankfully we did—because the place was fully packed! Booking in advance really helped us avoid the wait.

Once seated, the service was very attentive. A modern touch I appreciated was that there’s no physical menu—each table has a QR code you can scan to order directly, including for cocktails, appetizers, and mains. Another thoughtful feature is the “ring for service” button on each table, which alerts the staff directly instead of having to call them over repeatedly—very convenient!

The ambience is chic and aesthetic, with dim lighting and a peaceful vibe, perfect for a relaxed evening.

Here’s what we ordered:
•	Cheesy Stuffed Mushrooms – Juicy with mild, flavorful stuffing. A good start.
•	Crackling Rolls (Sushi) – Absolutely mind-blowing! So good that we reordered.
•	Edamame Truffle Dim Sum – Wasn’t a fan of this one. It looked good but lacked the punch.
•	Berry Smoke Cocktail – Great presentation and a refreshing mix of berries and herbs.
•	Spaghetti Aglio Olio with Pepperoni – Taste was decent, but it was on the drier side.

The staff was friendly and efficient, making the entire experience smooth and enjoyable. I’d definitely recommend this place for a date night, an evening out with friends, family get-togethers, or even colleague dinners.

Tip: Make a reservation in advance to avoid waiting, and if you’re booking via Zomato, you can also avail 20% off when you pay through the app., name_person=Siddhesh Kotian}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_RESERVATION=Reservation required, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Had an amazing time at Blabber Juhu! The ambience is vibrant, the food is delicious, and the staff is super courteous. Perfect place to chill with friends or spend a relaxed evening. Loved the presentation and music vibe too. Will definitely coming back soon!, name_person=Guru Bhai}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=Up to 10 min}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Overall really good this one. We went on a Sunday night using the Dineout reservation.

Aesthetic - The place has a bohemian vibe to it, a very modern setup. Loved it

Food - really good, felt the taste was bang on and layered, we had the chicken karivepla and noodles, amazing stuff

Service - This was something that was slightly under par but I'm gonna give them a pass on this because it was packed so understandle

Location - Located right on the highway, very accessible.

Will definitely plan another visit soon., name_person=Jinesh Nair}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Very bad experience.
Salt and pepper lotus stem was way too salty and I am someone who likes salt in my food.. even I cant eat it and had to return. They got the replacement after almost 30 mins
The pasta was okay only nothing out of ordinary.
I ordered iced americano and it felt like normal water added to espresso, it was literally at room temperature and had to ask them to add ice.

The common sense was missing from their staff.

It's not easy to get the attention of the waiting staff.. they are all busy on their own and the call button they have on the table doesn't make any difference, nobody probably even look at that system.

Only good thing was the interior, but even that was degraded by the ambience, music was too loud to have a decent conversation with someone across the table and when that happens people tend to talk loudly, almost every restaurateur knows this basic thing.

Went there on someone's recommendation, would suggest to avoid if food is what you are looking for.

Or they should stop selling it as a fine dining place but a budget one., name_person=subhanshu pradhan}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Food, music, drinks, staff, and ambiance is fantastic!}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Overall, we loved the ambience, restaurant food, service and atmosphere.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=We ordered one thai Veg Thai Basil sauce gravy and rice.}"]

reviews:
["{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=When Frooters contacted me to review their sparkling mocktails, I wasn't sure what to expect. Turns out that these drinks pretty much exceeded whatever I was hoping for. Absolutely in love with these drinks!

They are available in 8 flavours:
1) Sparkling Peach Passionfruit
2) Sparkling Mint Melon
3) Green Apple Fizz
4) Sparkling Citrus Blue
5) Bubbly Strawberry Lemonade
6) Bubblegum Mojito
7) Imli Masala Soda
8) Kala Khatta Masala Soda

My personal favourites are the Sparkling Peach Passionfruit, Green Apple Fizz, the Bugglegum Mojito and the Kala Khatta Masala Soda.

So get ready to #UnboreYourself with #DrinkFrooters, ready to serve premium sparkling mocktails that are #NowInABottle ! They have such a fruity base, no artificial flavours and no preservatives. Best served chilled or in an iced glass. Highly recommended., name_person=Minu Mariya Pauly}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Enjoyed Frooters during a college event .l like the green apple flavor, the others were also good. Nice to have something new in the market. Could include some more fruit flavors., name_person=Nishith Khandelwal}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Gone are those days when you have to visit any restaurant for your favourite flavour of mocktail
@drinkfrooters  gave me my punch of happiness in a form of bottled drink
They have a. variety of flavors to choose from a wide range according to youe taste and mood.

Sparkling Mint Melon : The Aroma of juicy melon followed by the refreshing note of mints . Best had when poured along with Ice , Mint leaves and Slice of lemon .
Green Apple Fiz : Its an sweet tart apple juice based Frizzer . That has earned the status  of classic in the drink circles .
Sparkling Passion Fruit : You have either had it , or you havent . There is no Maybe .

Sparkling Citrus Blue : Goes by the name of blue Lagoon or Blue Curaco . Its an orangey lemoney bubbly drink that might just leave your tounge blue
Imli masala soda: This is the one i loved the most . Tangy flavour with the masala mix is all you need sometimes . Taste better when served with ice .
Kala Khatta Masala Soda : A kind of twist to the jeera soda and masala soda with some tangy flavours of kala khatta that makes us remind of the Gola .
Bubblegum Mojito : Its an bubble gum in a bottle . A flavour which you will always love to have on the  go
All this drinks are enough to make you tipsy for a day
Must try 🙌🙌
.

From the moment we arrived, the ambiance, hospitality, and attention to detail made us feel like we were part of something truly special.
The resort itself is stunning — lush greenery, elegant architecture, and serene surroundings that created the perfect backdrop for a joyful celebration. Every corner of the property felt thoughtfully designed to enhance the experience, whether it was the beautifully decorated banquet hall or the cozy, luxurious rooms.
A special shoutout to Altamaz Bhai, the manager, whose warmth and professionalism elevated the entire event. He was always present, ensuring everything ran smoothly and that every guest felt cared for. His dedication and calm demeanor made all the difference, especially during the more hectic moments of wedding prep!
The staff were equally courteous and efficient, the food was delicious and varied, and the overall vibe was festive yet relaxed — exactly what you’d want for a family celebration.
If you're planning a wedding or any special event, I wholeheartedly recommend Nirva Resort. It’s a place where memories are made, and ours will be cherished forever 💖, name_person=ASHISH}", "{guided_block={HOTELS_PILOT_TRAVEL_GROUP_TYPE=Family, HOTELS_PILOT_TRIP_TYPE=Vacation, HOTELS_TIPS_TOPICS=[Walkability, E:HOTEL_TIPS_WALKABILITY, Noteworthy_details, E:HOTEL_TIPS_NOTEWORTHY_DETAILS], HOTELS_ASPECT_SERVICES=1, HOTELS_ASPECT_LOCATION=1, HOTELS_ASPECT_ROOMS=1}, time_line=2 weeks ago, review=I had one of the worst experiences at Nirva Cottage Resort, and I strongly advise others to think twice before booking this place, especially for family functions or marriages. The overall attitude of the staff and management reflects a complete lack of respect toward people. Instead of making guests feel welcome, they make you feel like you are a burden. This is not what anyone expects when booking a resort for a special occasion.

High priced due to location and ambience, name_person=TJ Sean}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=It was a Friday night and we really wanted to start our weekend with something interesting and happening. We came across this recently opened place called Baroke at Grant Road.

Location is bit confusing with maps, however the manager helped us in finding it very quickly. Place is situated on the first floor of Krishna palace Hotel.

Ambience and decor actually cheered up our mood. It is a perfect party and chill out place for you and your gang. Place is spacious with limited yet comfortable sitting area with a dance floor.

Coming to the food, food menu is not so lengthy with some veg and non veg quick bite items. We loved all the dishes that we tried. The Bar menu offers some really good options in cocktails.

We totally loved phuljhadi chicken tikka, fish tikka and baby corn tempura. Also the white sauce pasta for main course was creamy and delicious.

From Bar menu we tried Cucumber rosemary gin tonic, Gauva Daiquiri and Coffee caipirinha. We totally enjoyed our drinks. All of them were refreshing.

Baroke sets up a perfect weekend mood with good food, great music and classy ambience.

Totally recommended.

Happy eating.😊., name_person=snehal dalvi}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Baroke was something where I didn’t go with great hopes but trust me visiting here changed my outlook for a good reason. Lot of pubs have come up these days in Mumbai but this place reminded me only 90s where the interior is rustic and gives a classic look. The music was dapper and the crowd is happening.

The manager was very much helpful is suggesting us the best food as per our liking. The food was impeccable. I am sharing few recommendations and I bet you will go there again to have them - chilli cheese toast, chicken tikka pizza, stuffed masaledar Kulcha served with Dal makhani. Although the menu is not that extensive but it does fulfil the need.

Highly recommended place for great taste of music and yummy food., name_person=Pushpak Vanjari}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=5 years ago, review=If you're looking for a place to party in SoBo, Baroke is the place to go. Quite close to the Grant Road station, this place has a dance floor with good music and lights.
We tried quite a few dishes and mocktails. In starters, we loved corn fritters and cheese chilli toast. Bruschetta was decent too. Chicken tikka was a showstealer. Really tender and juicy chicken cooked well.
We had mint melon cooler and coffee chocolate martini to wash down the food with. Loved the drinks and their presentation.
In mains, we loved the stuffed kulcha with dal makhni. Also had noodles with green chicken. Didn't quite like this one. The green gravy wasn't working with the noodles.

Overall, it was a nice experience and a good place to party., name_person=Shreya Bharti}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Baroke was on my list as I have been hearing a lot about them offlate, this indeed a great night life bar which is operational on Wednesday, Friday and Saturday only till 3:00am which is so nice.

📍This place is located at a jump distance from grant road west station.
Cited inside Krishna palace hotel on the first floor.

>Ambience - Dark theme bar having trippy lights , huge bar , super comfy couches to dine , pretty interiors is what baroke all about.
>Food - It basically serves different cuisines and bar/finger food. It absolutely delivers a gastronomical experience!
>Hygiene- The place is maintained well , right from lounge arena and even smoking zone everything was hygienic.
>Value for money- Being cited in south bombay , this place definitely delivers a great night life to the patrons. The prices are charged perfectly.
>Our order -
R: denotes Recommendations.

•DRINKS:
1)Black currant(R)- Black currant crush topped with soda and dash of lime juice and bit of salt mix in it was refreshing and delicious.
2)Blue lagoon- Blue curracao , lime juice and soda mixed together resulting into a great refreshment.

•APPETIZERS:
1)Cheese corn balls(R)- corn and cheese mixture in ball shape served in 8 pieces , this was really delicious , the cheesy texture and crisp coating from out was done well , served with ketchup and mint dip.
2)Chicken in hot garlic sauce(R)- Chicken pieces sautéed in hot garlic sauce having perfection of spice and flavor balance ! It is a  best one if you want to fave something with your drinks.

•MAIN COURSE:
1)White sauce pasta(R)- Super cheesy macaroni made to perfection. It had generous portions of chicken in it and the best part was the creamy texture which was superb.
2)Kulcha with dal makhani- 4 pieces of freshly made aloo kulchas served along flavorful dal makhani , it was indeed splendid one.

•DESSERTS:
1)Pastry- Though it wasn’t available, it was sourced from out by them , loved the sweet gesture of the staff.
It was something we demanded and we got. Loved this too:)

-•- Overall experience was superb and we really loved the vibe of this place. It’s absolutely a perfect place to party on weekends.

•Food - 9/10
•Ambience - 10/10
•Staff- 10/10
•Value for money - 8/10
•HYGIENE- 10/10

*REVIEW IS BASED ON PERSONAL EXPERIENCE!, name_person=Vedant lad}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Baroke:

Recently visited the newly revamped Baroke!
Divided into 2 lounge and Dance floor area are totally different. Lounge is dark with flash light placed with Comfort Velvet royal sittings.. loud music & well stocked bar also ample place for people to dance & soak themselves in peppy music.. To my surprise the compact menu is droolicious.
The Cocktail and Mocktail presentation is vibrant and settle in taste.
Must Try Cocktail: Pineapple Caribbean!

What I ate:
CHICKEN FULJADI KABAB:
I think they had marinated the chicken for 24 hours.. the chicken that was succulent and juicy that beautifully marinated in indian spices. That texture of kabab that will make you gulp all in no time.
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

LEMON BABY CORN TEMPURA:
this particular this was super delicious and met with all the elements when it comes flavors, the crackle texture from crunchy fried baby Corn.. tossed in sweet and sour sauce.
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

CHEESE CHILLI TOAST & TOMATO & OLIVE BRUSCHETTA:
These two baked to perfection with the right crisp from toast..
Perfect for siders.
RECOMMENDED, name_person=Freeda Bhati}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Baroke (The Flute) is one of the oldest party places in town. Since it is located in Krishna Palace (hotel) it stays open till pretty late in the night. So one doesn't need to worry about deadlines, let the hair loose and party all night.

Located at level 1, Baroke hasn't changed much over these years. Wooden doors at the entrance and couple of doors to actually enter this club. One of the rare few places in town which has a such a big dance floors. And decently big bar to cater to the drinks of people. Baroke has about 6-7 tables to accommodate large groups, always recommended to reserve before heading out.

Talking about what all I tried at Baroke -

Since it's a club, where people primarily come to dance and drink, the food menu is concise, however includes most of the things. We concentrated mainly on the starters and one odd main course. In starters we had a platter of Bruschetta and Chilli Cheese Toast. Later followed by Lemon Chilli Babycorn Tempura. All starters were decent but order of preference would be exactly the same as written - Bruschetta followed by Chilli Cheese Toast followed by Tempura.

Along with food, ordered couple of mocktails, mixed quite well - Cranberry and Orange Coolers. Mocktails were good, hence I am sure cocktails would be too. For main course, we had the highlight of the evening. Masaledar Kulcha with Dal Makhani. Easily the best dish at Baroke. One cannot miss this, highly recommended.

If one doesn't want Indian, they can go for Pizza and Pasta as well. Had visited Baroke a long time back, brought back few pleasant memories. As far as place is concerned, if you want a place to party at reasonable rates without deadline pressure, head to Baroke. Music is more of EDM. Wait around till late to have a good time, both from dancing / drinking as well as food perspective., name_person=Jatin Shah}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Cheese Chaska Cheese balls with an amazing Indian twist served with chutney.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Highly recommended place for great taste of music and yummy food.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=The Bar menu offers some really good options in cocktails.}"]

reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=7 months ago, review=Cafe Blue J is a small cafe located in Mahim just few minutes away from the railway station. The ambience is cozy and inviting, making it a perfect spot for a relaxed brunch or a coffee date. And If you are lucky enough, you might be able to even meet Orry the cat.

-Starting with the burger and the fries; the soft bun, the tangy pickled onion and the fresh pattice really enhanced the overall taste of the burger. Plus the cheese/mayonnaise dip that came with it was to die for.
- We also had Green Apple Latte, it was top notch and the creamy alfredo was ok to my taste however my sister liked it.
- We were planning to try Matcha for the first time, so we ordered Honey matcha iced latte which was recommended by the staff and we just loved it so much.. Its a must try if you are a Matcha lover.

The staff is friendly and attentive, enhancing the overall dining experience. If you wish to pass the time reading a book, the cafe even offers a small collection of books from different genre.

Unfortunately, we couldn't try their deserts but surely we will have them during our next visit to the cafe!

Whether you're a coffee enthusiast or a foodie, Cafe Blue J is definitely worth a visit!, name_person=Jenisha Justin}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION]}, time_line=Edited 6 months ago, review=I have discovered this cafe few months back and this is has become my go to spot now.

And what do I say about the food it taste very Delicious.
They make everything fresh. I didn't expect a freshly made patty in my burger. It was just mouth watering

And the cheese chilly toast was a sourdough and was fully loaded.

Not sure if one would travel to Mahim just to visit this cafe, but if you are there on a hot Summer day, then you could definitely drop by.

The cafe has both indoor (Air-conditioned) and outdoor seating. The indoor section can accommodate 6-7 ppl max.

We came the 3 of us for brunch several times.

* scrambled egg burger, eggs perfect and huge
* open egg toast , delicious and beautifully arranged
* peri peri fries, crispy and good

While the music playing in the background had good selection of western songs and not something the ones popularly played on Instagram reels these days, which is the case with certain restaurants.

The staff experience is good. Viraj was the one who assisted for the night, he was good at explaining the menu as well as mocktails. The dishes were handed out in a timely manner and nothing felt rushed.

Coming to the food, we ordered:
- Santa Fe Chicken Quesadilla: There was a good quantity of chicken filling, whereas the tortilla was grilled perfectly. It's a bit on the sweeter side but overall I liked it. Fries on the side were a big bonus.

- Chicken and Mushroom Buritto: This was Buritto wrap with chicken and mushroom in creamy sauce with rice served on the side. The cream sauce tasted really good while the Buritto wrap had a good quantity of chicken and mushroom. The quantity of ingredients was perfect which made it enjoyable. Rice was more Indianized and could have kept it less moist to make it more close to the original.

- Empanada: It was the chicken and cheese empanda but this one was the weakest of all. The fried dough was crisp but hardly any filling inside it, while being provided with mayo on the side, it didn't go well!

We also ordered a couple of mocktails, Miami vice which was a mixture of pineapple juice and some thing else which I don't remember, the coconut flavour in it elavated the drink. I went for fresh watermelon with basil leaves something.. and it was refreshing!

When I finally stopped by, I was genuinely impressed with the interior and rooftop section. It has a cozy, laid-back vibe that’s rare to find in a highway-side bar. The ambiance feels just right for a casual drink or quick hangout, especially in the evenings.

But unfortunately, that’s where the positives ended for me.

The food and service were a big letdown. I ordered chicken lollipop, but the head waiter kept insisting I try the tandoor version instead. When I clearly told him I wasn’t interested and that I’d rather skip it if the regular lollipop wasn’t available, he suddenly said, “We do have the lollipop.” It felt very manipulative and pushy.

A similar thing happened with the veg starters. We ordered mushroom, but they brought paneer instead—and again, the waiter tried hard to convince us to just go with it. When we refused, he said mushroom would take 20 minutes. We agreed to wait, but then suddenly he claimed they were out of mushrooms altogether. This kind of flip-flop and forceful attitude really ruined the experience.

My favourite part of the meal was the indulgent deserts - dark matter cosmos and chocolate Divine. Both are amazing for chocolate lovers.

- Loved the butterfly pea pilaf with Amuk curry — gorgeous to look at, delicious to eat.

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=I recently visited Ciel in Andheri East and this pure-veg restaurant genuinely surprised me with its ambiance, flavours, and warmth. The moment you enter, you feel the calm, classy vibe — subtle lighting, elegant interiors, and a beautifully designed Instagram-friendly corner that instantly sets the tone for a great dining experience. They have launched new menu menu which includes Sushi and more.

Their mocktails are fabulous — refreshing, well-balanced, and visually stunning. For starters, I tried the Paneer Bao and the Vegetarian Kebab Platter. Soft bao, juicy paneer, and perfectly seasoned kebabs… both dishes stood out with clean flavours and great presentation.

The mains were the highlight: two different sizzlers that came in piping hot, full of aroma, and packed with flavour. I also tried their spaghetti, which added a comforting Italian twist to the meal.

A special mention — Chayya Ma’am, the owner, personally came to our table to check if we were enjoying our food. That warm gesture truly elevated the experience.

And of course, the perfect finale: their Sizzling Brownie with Ice Cream — hot, gooey, chocolatey, and a must-have!

Overall, Ciel offers great food, great hospitality, and great vibes. If you’re looking for a memorable pure veg dining experience in Andheri, this one is definitely a must-visit., name_person=Nishit Kheradia}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Ciel is a great place. Simple yet elegant ambience.
Service is great.
The food is tasty and excellent choice for vegetarians and Jains.
Almost every dish can be made Jain.
This is a haven for pure vegetarian and Jain folks.
I was blown away by the horizontal mocktail glass and the starters.
Mains were filling and left me wanting more.
Gulab jamun is the perfect ending to every meal.
So if you’re in Andheri East anytime do visit this lovely little vegetarian outl, name_person=urmi chhapia}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=recently visited Ciel in Andheri East, and it turned out to be one of the most delightful pure-veg dining experiences I’ve had in a long time. The ambience is warm, cosy, and beautifully aesthetic — perfect for anyone who loves photogenic corners and a calm atmosphere. We tried a variety of dishes, starting with their Farmhouse Pizza, which was fresh, well-loaded, and bursting with flavour. The sizzlers were served hot and smoky, adding a wonderful twist to the meal. Their paneer gravy was rich, creamy, and absolutely delicious. We paired everything with refreshing mocktails, and ended our meal with some indulgent desserts, each one well-presented and satisfying.

The service was smooth, the staff was polite, and the overall experience was truly worth it. If you’re looking for a pure-veg restaurant with great taste, lovely ambience, and good value for money, Ciel is definitely a must-visit!, name_person=sayama khan}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=Loved our experience at Ciel! The ambience is calm, aesthetic and perfect for a relaxed meal. The hummus and veggie crispy bao were amazing starters, especially the bao which was super flavourful. Their in-house sizzler was the highlight—aromatic, sizzling and full of taste. The paneer biryani was rich and comforting too. Pure veg and Jain-friendly options make it even better!, name_person=Gaurav Tank}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=4 weeks ago, review=First time I could find a great family place which offers Indian and continental food.
A great place for a small family gathering.

Food is equally very flavourful and satiable. Ambience very cosy. they even have a private area for birthday celebrations, corporate day out with projector and screen.

Loved and savored every dish be it Sabzi miloni or authentic style triple schezwan which after many years could relish this mouth-watering dish. Triple shezwan was perfect in spice also rice n noodles perfectly cooked. I enjoyed their drink, peachy mama what was d attaraction in this was it's sleeping glass that was so great in presentation and refreshing at the same time even enjoyed having their new menu barbecue saute Lotus stem crispy n crunchy. cheesy cigar was just yum and at last no meal is complete without a sweet ending to it  which was lotus biscoff cheese cake again a perfect balance of sweet. I savored it all thank you ciel
Do check into this place m sure you won't be disappointed and will go with happy heart. walking with your family relatives n have a funtime.
*drinks*
peachy mama
*munchow soup*
*starter*
lotus stem
nurtures cheese cigar
*main*
triples schezwan
subzi maloni
*dessert*
lotus biscoff cheese cake, name_person=Zoya Anjum}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=I recently visited at ciel and had a lovely experience. The calm ambience set a great tone for the meal.

Started with a  Kiwi Mojito which was refreshing and it was very well accompanied with the Paneer Dum Kebab and Spring Rolls which were delicious and carried a perfect flavour of it,in mains we tried their Paneer Shashlik Sizzler which was recommended  by the chef and it turned out to be made a great dish

Ended with a warm Sizzling Brownie, which was the perfect finish.
The food quality, flavours, and service were all impressive., name_person=niket kaskar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=At Ciel we tried the following:
Started off with a Roasted Hazelnut Coffee — sounded fancy, looked nice, but taste-wise... meh, not bad, just not hitting the mark, you know?
Then came the Mix Berry Smoothie — bro, that thing was so refreshing, perfect balance, not too sweet, super yum.
Now here’s the shocker — I’m a hardcore non-veg guy, but this starter... KurKuri Cheese Cigar with Chilli Sauce — brooo, crispy outside, cheesy inside, that sauce combo? Dangerous.
Then the Mushroom Korean Bao — soft bao, perfect umami flavours, like legit comfort food level good.
We also tried the Silk Route Oriental Sizzler — rice and gravy were full of flavour, but the potato wedges were like... giant bro, actual boulders. Overall, okay-ish.
But the Paneer Tikka Masala with Roomali Roti Butter — finally, my long-time craving satisfied, that combo just hits different.
Overall — loved both the starters and that Mix Berry Smoothie. Super chill family restaurant vibes, pure veg but still full of flavour.
If you’re around Andheri East, definitely check this one out — proper sit-down spot, good food, good energy., name_person=Aradhya}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Visited Ciel Pure Veg with my mom and absolutely loved the experience! The restaurant is very close to Andheri Station, which makes it super convenient to reach. The starters were delicious, and the main course was just as good — everything tasted fresh and well-prepared. The staff was polite, and the service was quick. Had a really fun and comfortable time overall — definitely recommend this place for anyone looking for great pure veg food near Andheri! 🌿✨, name_person=Shreya Pandey}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Best Jain food near Andheri station 👍 rooftop ambience 👍funky live music}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Ciel Bistro offers a cozy and elegant ambiance with excellent service.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=A great place for a small family gathering.}"]

The location is excellent, and the hotel is well maintained. The rooms are small and compact but very clean. The gate and security staff were friendly and welcoming, and the restaurant team was polite and attentive. The morning buffet was decent.

However, the billing experience was frustrating. I was charged an extra INR 5,000 for a few hours of early check-in. During checkout, I was told that an additional INR 10,000 had not been added at check-in and needed to be paid. Thankfully, I had my Booking.com receipt, after which the staff acknowledged the mistake and said they would resolve it internally. If I had not checked my booking details carefully, I could have been overcharged.

What stood out most was the focus on money rather than guest comfort. At no point did anyone ask about my stay or whether I was comfortable. For a hotel claiming five-star standards, this level of service is disappointing.

Overall, the stay did not match the expectations of a five-star hotel, mainly due to the poor check-in experience and billing issue.

name: Club Illusions
reviews:
["{guided_block={}, time_line=Edited a month ago, review=Extremely Disappointing Experience at Club Illusion

Our experience here was far below expectations. The manager’s behavior was shockingly rude and unprofessional. Right from the entrance, his attitude and way of speaking felt disrespectful. And at the end, things got even worse.

They added an unreasonably high service charge on both liquor and food (almost 40% extra). When we asked for clarification, instead of helping, the manager literally started shouting and arguing. His tone changed instantly and it felt like he was trying to provoke a fight rather than resolve the issue.

Service was painfully slow and the staff seemed careless and completely untrained — no attention, no hospitality nothing, even basic requests were ignored multiple times.

Considering the prices they charge, the service and attitude are absolutely not worth it. There are many better clubs in the city where guests are treated with respect.

Overall, a terrible and stressful experience. Definitely not recommended.
Don't go Don't go.

Reply to club illusion's revert :-
The major issue was the manager’s behavior. The way he spoke to us was very rude and unprofessional. Even when we raised concerns about the bill, he did not cooperate and his attitude made the experience very unpleasant. I hope you address this seriously so future customers don’t face the same behavior.
Please take this feedback seriously and ensure better customer service. my concern is very clear.
A club that charges a premium price must provide premium hospitality, not arrogance. Please address this seriously because such behaviour completely ruins the experience for paying customers.
And most importantly train your staff and specially your unprofessional manager how to behave Profesional.
They are literally untrained for sure.

Thank you., name_person=Bharti Kanojiya}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 months ago, review=“Club Illusions is the perfect place for a high-energy night out! The music is amazing, the vibe is electric, and the lighting and ambience set the mood just right. The cocktails are fantastic, and the food options pair perfectly with the party atmosphere.

The staff is super professional and friendly, making sure everything runs smoothly even when the club is packed. If you’re looking for great music, good drinks, and a lively crowd, Club Illusions is definitely the place to be!”, name_person=Jay Purohit}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=5 years ago, review=Visited the newly opened Club Illusions on a Thursday night. It is located in Andheri West and is definitely a must visit place for all the party goers in town. As soon as you enter this party house you know the night is going to be lit. The dance floor was crowded and everyone was having a good time. The cocktails acted as a fuel which charged everyone. Beautiful ambience and music with amazing food and cocktails. Food Menu consists bar bites as well as comfort food along with a comprehensive drinks menu with a range of regular liquor options to a plethora of elegant cocktails.

Our cocktails were superb, we ordered oriental sunset and kumquat mojito. Both were amazing and were beautifully presented.

Speaking about the food we had -
▪️Cheese Garlic Bread
▪️Peri Peri Fries
▪️Pink Sauce Pasta
▪️Veg Hakka Noodles with Manchurian Gravy

In dessert we tried the Mango Delight which was absolutely delicious.

The customer service is top notch. Staff is very courteous and helpful. Comfortable seating arrangement with both sofa and high chairs options. Overall food, drinks, music and ambience is excellent. Highly recommended., name_person=Meghana Jain}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=5 months ago, review=The ambience is awesome, the manager and staff is so helpful and forthcoming... However, there is limited seating, so I would recommend if you plan to party hard and dance some night, just book a table for yourself else, you will find yourself standing on the bar counter without a bar stool. Also, I would like to highlight that the manager was so courteous that he offered us one of the reserved sofa seating area to be comfortable during our entire stay at the club!
The DJ and live band were fantabulous!!!, name_person=R Pandey}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=5 years ago, review=Club illusions!
Recently visited this newly opened club in Andheri West. If you’re a night animal you should really hit up at this place with your gang. The club is pretty good and has its own different vibe. It has a decent accommodation and the staff is pretty cooperative. Talking about the food I really loved the appetizers.
The music is really good and the club has a really good bar. The drinks are just too good! The cocktails were really the one that made our nights, proper proportion of everything and was just excellent!
Overall it was an amazing night, we had the time of our lives. Would totally recommend it others!
Note : Bringing small kids is not advisable!
Would love to visit again!❤️, name_person=Shallom Lobo}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1}, time_line=a month ago, review=Overall, the experience was a bit disappointing.
My girlfriend paid ₹10k for a package that was supposed to include unlimited alcohol, but later they charged us extra, claiming it wasn’t part of the package.
Guys, please be careful and double-check your bill
they might add hidden charges and try to take more money from you., name_person=Geetesh Wadekar}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=3 years ago, review=Club Illusion is the best club in Andheri. It has got the great vibes. The ambience was superb and lighting was super attractive. The bar section was too big.

The staff gives us their best recommendations about cocktails, starters and mains. The service was quite fast and staff are friendly.

Coming to the food,
In Cocktails we tried Long Iceland Iced Tea - Bartender Special And Oriental Sunset. Both this drinks are just awesome. I specially love this bartender special LIIT.

In Mocktails we ordered Asian Fever and Granday. Granday is the cream based mocktail and i like this most.

In starter we tried their Chicken Madeira Kebab. And the taste was superb.
After that we ordered chicken tikka pizza and it was super cheesy and yummy. They serve only 10" pizza and it was really great.

Overall if you are looking for superb club for party then this is the place. It has amazing vibes. Will definitely visit here again., name_person=Sumit Chilvante}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review=Pubs are happening & that's why I love to visit them. My personal favourite cocktail was white Russian. If you want to eat something then do go for oriental chicken pot rice. Their bombil fry was okay, but the chicken lollipop is awesome., name_person=Anish Karkera}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=3 years ago, review=We've been to this lovely compact yet a two story restaurant in Vile Parle, Spice 57. This place had good happy hour deals and nice staff though some of them are a bit underknowledged but since being new ones these things happen.

We've started off with LIIT & Caipiroska which both the drinks were made with a good amount of spirits and gave a slight kick which felt nice. Alongside we had Chicken Nachos & Chickrn Tikka. Boss both these starters are so delicious.

I mean I loved Chicken Tikka since the marination was too good and tender chicken piece felt delicious to my taste buds. Similarly Nachos were nothing different just perfectly crispy with salsa and shredded chicken on the top.

Then we've had Butter Chicken & Cheese Garlic Naan. Butter chicken was not too sweet but creamy and the accompaniment Cheese Garlic Naan went perfect with the gravy.

Lastly we had a Chocolate Delight in the dessert but was a bit too sweet so I'll recommend everyone to goa Sizzling Brownie rather. I did not went for it because I've had it a couple of times now.

The decor is chic, and the atmosphere is complemented by musical or sporty vibes, often catering to Cricket fans. Customers have highlighted the value for money, with a typical cost for two people averaging ₹1200.., name_person=Gajanan Deshmukh}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=3 years ago, review=Spice 57!

Recently visited this place with some friends of mine!
It is located in Vile Parle East!
It is good hangout spot for Sathaye & Dahanukar College students as it’s very near by!
The ambience is very pretty with amazing lights & they have indoor and outdoor seating as well.
I visited this place for lunch.

So we had ordered-
Cocktails:
Caprioska, it was very nice. It had mint leaves and lemon in it

Mocktails:
Cinderella, it was a pomegranate based juice, it was sweet and very refreshing.

Appetizers:
Afro chicken, stir fried chicken with fried veggies which were onion, bell peppers & garlic! It was saucy

Afghani chicken tandoor, it was so nice, was served with green chutney and salad.

In the main course we tried,
Chicken steak sizzler, I always wanted to try chicken steak so I chose it. The chicken was very juicy and it was served with stir fried veggies, potato fries and rice/noodles.

In desserts:
We had Sizzling brownie with Vanilla ice cream! The classic. The brownie was so good!

My experience at this place was amazing and would definitely recommend this place., name_person=Sanika Angwalkar}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=3 years ago, review=If you are looking for the perfect place for get together, family function or wonderful food experience then  Spice 57 is the one of the best Restaurant in Vile parle  which is Situated at Ground Floor of Sangita Nest Building. This place near from Vile parle railway station which is around 1.2 km. This is One of the best place which known for  their sizzlers, BBQ food and Seafood.  Yesterday I've visited this beautiful place for lunch with my friend. Ambiance of this place is beautiful and colorful which perfectly decorated with lots of lights and colorful ambiance. They Maintain Perfect Ambiance. The seating arrangement of this is perfectly managed and organised. They have perfect combination of attractive wooden table and comfortable colorful chairs which gives a great look to this place. Liked this place a lot.
Talking about staff and food..
Staff are professional and Attentive. Management has maintained good hygiene and  take all safety precautions and sanitation.
Food was so delicious. Quality , Quantity and presentation of food was awesome. We've tried many dishes here. Liked each and every Dish.
We've Tried and Blue Lit and Whisky Sar in cocktail.  In Staters Fish Chilly  tastes superb. Liked it very much. In Main Course Prawns Chilly Sizzlers was awesome one of the best sizzler i ever had. Highly recommended sizzler.
In Dessert Choco Delight was fantastic. Love the dessert. Overall my experience at Spice 57 was Great. Liked each and everything.
Highly recommended 👍👍👍, name_person=yogesh gaikwad}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=3 years ago, review=NEW PLACE ALERT*

Located in Vile Parle East, this restaurant and bar serves some amazingly fresh and quality dishes. The primary cuisine served is North Indian and Chinese. They also have Mangalorean dishes on the menu which are a must try. They have a nice bar with a wide variety of drinks to choose from.
The ambience is nice with dim lights and a wall full of quotes. The seating is comfortable. The overall look and feel is like a family restaurant and bar. The service was prompt to start with Mahesh taking down the orders. However they took a reasonable amount of time to get all the dishes.

The mocktails we had were Cinderella and Berry Blast. Both these were juice based drinks. Berry blast has Cranberry and Apple juice with a touch of honey.
Cindrella has orange juice and fresh lime which makes it very refreshing.

The food we had was all very good in terms of quality and quantity. I would rate it a value for money place.

We had Murg Toorki which was Chicken Tikka marinated with Cheese and this was delicious. The chicken was cooked to perfection, juicy and charred perfectly. This tasted even better with the mint coriander chutney.

Coriander Chicken Dry was a Chinese appetizer, this was again very good. Herbaceous flavour with garlic and spring onions. Again well cooked Chicken. Very satisfying.

For the main course we had Chicken Ghee Roast with Neer Dosa. My favourite and everything was perfect. Must have when here. Highly recommended.

The Cheese Garlic Naan here is not the usual Naan with the Garlic and Cheese outside. Here it's stuffed inside and is very wholesome.
We had Chicken Betabi which is a red gravy similar to Butter Chicken in many ways with shredded chicken in a luscious velvety gravy.

For dessert we had a sizzling walnut brownie with ice cream. This was fresh and well made.

This place even has outdoor seating which is accessible only post rains. I am totally in awe of the simplicity and the no nonsense kind of approach to serving good quality food.

I am totally coming back here again with my gang for a great meal.

Till next time Bon Appetit!, name_person=Varun Poduval}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Good Ambience, Good Service, quality and tasty Food ,}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=They serve Chinese, BBQ,North Indian, seafood, biriyani, deserts and beverages.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Tasted really well with the mild flavours of the butter garlic chicken.}"]

Now it has dropped down to 4.1... the owner must wake up.

The place is supposed to open at 8 am. At 9.30 the kitchen staff wasn't in yet. There was an untrained service staff to take the order. Cleaning was still happening upstairs. The cleaner's uniform was stained and disheveled.

The food was cold even when it reached me. Salt dispensers were jammed. The omlet, which was quite good, is only served with 1 slice of toast. When I asked for another slice, the server said he would have to charge me. When I pay 800 bucks for breakfast the least they could do is serve me one extra slice of toast. This server was clearly untrained. The way he was dressed and spoke, he seemed to fit more in a Udupi Hotel than a place which calls itself Brunch Bar Cafe.

All of this is down to poor management and lack of training for staff.

I had a similar experience at Brunch Bar last year, and hesitated to walk in today. I was hoping it had improved but I leave disappointed and disheartened more than upset. If these things happened at a grade III restaurant serving dishes for 50 rupees, I wouldn't bat an eyelid. But this is Brunch Bar Cafe. They are expected to have standards.

Here's the kicker - I WANT this place to work out because there aren't many good continental breakfast spots around. The burgers at UGO are amazing – freshly handmade patties in a unique UFO shape, spill-free, and packed with fresh, tasty ingredients. The staff is friendly and welcoming, the washroom is neat with a basin and mirror, and the owner has an interesting story. Highly recommended! A must-support for homegrown, organic brands using authentic ingredients. Every bit of the concept is thoughtfully executed., name_person=Siddharth Vashisth}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=5 months ago, review=I recently visited a place that serves a new and interesting concept—UFO Burgers—and I was genuinely impressed. The burger was not only visually unique but also tasted great. It had a nice blend of flavors, and the patty was juicy and well-cooked. It’s definitely something different from the usual burger joints, and I appreciate the creativity behind it.

Along with the burger, I also tried their chicken popcorn, which turned out to be surprisingly good. It was crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, and had just the right amount of seasoning. It made for a perfect side and really complemented the burger well.

However, I also decided to try their coffee, and that was a bit of a letdown. The taste was flat and didn’t match the quality of their food. I wouldn’t recommend going there for coffee, but for the burger and chicken popcorn, it’s absolutely worth a visit.

Overall, it was a refreshing experience. The food is creative and flavorful, and it offers a good change from the usual fast food options. I’ll definitely be going back to try more items from their menu—just skipping the coffee next time!, name_person=Sajid Maldar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹200–400, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_PARKING_LOT], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=Up to 10 min}, time_line=6 months ago, review=If you want to have a burger with a healthy twist, Paolo's is the place to go! I tried the butter chicken burger which was delicious.
The chicken popcorn is crunchy and flavorful.
This place offers a small space for private birthday parties which can host upto 15 people. The walls are beautifully painted in caricature doodle artworks, which can act as lovely backdrops for pictures.
This place also serves good coffee and desserts.

Not only is it the first place in India to serve UFO burgers! a unique twist on the classic burger but the menu is full of delicious options. Korean Veggies Burger was packed with bold flavors.

Galaxy Chicken Burger was crispy and juicy—definitely worth trying. (Must try)

Smash Fish Burger made with fresh ravas was a standout for me. It’s hard to find such fresh seafood in a burger, and this one was perfectly cooked and seasoned.

The management should aeriously think about renovating the place, name_person=Ajay Bhat}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 years ago, review=I've heard about Chulha a lot and been recommended about the same a lot in the last couple of years so I finally decided to give it a visit on my Dad's birthday this year.

The place is quite fancy given the view you get from the 14th Floor. We chose a place near the window and found it extravagant to sit there and enjoy our food.
(Sadly the seats are really uncomfortable. Maybe its a psychological hack that they just don't want the people to enjoy the view endlessly.)

We ordered Chicken Manchow Soup. The soup was quite tasty and not overloaded with garlic which some restaurants do. But sadly the fried noodles were sour. Which I understand was due to the noodles which had turned stale and then they were fried to avoid wastage.

We asked for recommendations from our server and he recommended Banjara Kebab and Dilkhush kebab. But we had already tried those umpteen times in other restaurants so we rather went for Murgh Maharaja Kebab. It was Chicken Tikka Kebab which was in turn wrapped with Chicken Seekh Kebab. We found the description quite fancy and ordered that. Were served 6 pieces of it. Honestly taste was great but wasn't really value for money. And was on the drier side so had to compensate with the green Chutney and lemon.

Then we ordered Java Style Chicken Lollipop which was really tasty. Though there was no hint of Thai flavor in it. It simply felt it was tossed in Schezwan Sauce.

We then saw Sizzlers on the menu and were really tempted to order the same. So we ordered a Chilli Basil Chicken Sizzler. The quantity was humongous. We were three people and initially I thought only 2 would be able to share but the portion size was more than enough for 3 people. Noodles were sadly soggy and overboiled and sauce was a bit bland for my palette. But it didn't matter much it was tasty.

I ordered a Chicken Tikka Biryani and again the portion size was more than enough for 2 people.

Our total bill was around 2200. And I feel it was all in all a good experience.

Only downside being the server being a bit too smart. Located atop Centrum IT Park, the core appeal of this venue is undoubtedly the stunning rooftop ambience . The open-air seating provides panoramic views of the city skyline, making it the perfect backdrop for a romantic dinner or a relaxed night out with friends. The soft lighting, vibrant music (often featuring a live DJ or band), and overall chic decor successfully create a lively and energetic atmosphere.

The menu is multicuisine, featuring a fusion of Indian, Continental, and Chinese dishes. While the overall food quality is rated highly by most patrons—with the pizzas and Chicken Tikka often cited as must-try dishes—the cocktail and drinks menu is equally impressive. Service is generally attentive, though some reviews note occasional delays during peak hours, suggesting popularity can sometimes strain the staff.
Costing around ₹1,400 to ₹1,900 for two, it sits in the mid-to-high range, but the immersive rooftop experience, including live music and the excellent view, offers strong value for money. While some of the food is truly amazing and I’ve recommended this place to many friends—whether colleagues or my husband, who’s also a foodie—unfortunately, the overall experience has been going downhill, especially when it comes to customer service.

I used to love bringing people here because earlier, there was a staff member (a young man) who truly understood hospitality. He was warm, friendly, and knew how to make customers feel welcome. You walked in, and he’d instantly lift your mood. But lately, the service has been taken over by someone who clearly isn’t trained or simply lacks the attitude for customer-facing roles.

During our last visit, we ordered a hazelnut croissant, and when I asked for it, the new girl looked completely clueless. She couldn’t guide us properly—same issue I had brought up earlier. At the time, the owner had explained she was new and still learning, which I understood. But this time, it went from inexperience to flat-out disrespect.

I had gone with a friend and we were speaking in English, and perhaps she assumed we didn’t understand Marathi. I asked her again just to confirm if the pizza available was thin crust, and she went to the kitchen and started mocking us in Marathi—saying things like " Ekda sangitla kalat nahi ka...kiti vela vicharte.....ekda bolaichna....(and what not)” It was incredibly unprofessional, and honestly, humiliating to hear as a customer.

What’s worse is that the owner was present that day, and while she is a genuinely sweet person and has always been respectful, I couldn’t bring myself to raise the issue then because the experience had already left a bad taste. We quietly left, but it was truly disappointing.

The food still has potential—but customer experience matters just as much, if not more. The ambience is perfect with beautiful open garden seating as well as comfortable indoor AC seating, it’s a great place for families, couples, or even big groups of friends.

The food was absolutely delicious we started with hot Chicken Manchow Soup, juicy Chicken Tikka, and sizzling prawns, all cooked to perfection. The main course with chicken gravies, naan, and the highlight Bamboo Mutton Biryani was full of authentic flavors and a must-try! Ended the meal on a sweet note with classic Vanilla Ice Cream.

From the moment you step inside, you know you’ve found your new favorite spot.
Atmosphere and Vibe
The cafe masters the art of cozy minimalism. The space is flooded with natural light, featuring rustic wooden tables, comfortable upholstered chairs, and a few strategically placed plants that add a burst of life. The background music—a curated mix of jazz and low-key indie—is loud enough to be enjoyable but soft enough to allow for conversation or focused work. It's the ideal spot for a quick morning espresso, a casual lunch meeting, or an afternoon spent diving into a good book. They’ve managed to create a peaceful, yet lively, sanctuary.
Coffee and Cuisine
The coffee here is the star. I ordered a flat white, and it was perhaps the best I’ve had recently. The espresso was rich, nuanced, and perfectly extracted, beautifully complemented by expertly steamed milk with that signature velvety microfoam.
On the food front, their signature Avocado Toast (with chili flakes and a lemon zest sprinkle) is a game-changer. It’s fresh, generously portioned, and surprisingly sophisticated. The pastry case is also tempting, and their almond croissants are buttery, flaky perfection—the ideal accompaniment to a morning brew. Everything tasted incredibly fresh, signaling a strong commitment to high-quality, local ingredients.
Service
The staff at Bean Town cafe are genuinely friendly and efficient. Despite a steady stream of customers, my order arrived quickly, and the barista took the time to chat about the source of their beans. They operate with a level of attentiveness and genuine enthusiasm that makes every visit feel personalized and welcoming.
Final Verdict
The Bean Town cafe  is a must-visit. Whether you are a dedicated coffee purist or just looking for a beautiful, comfortable place to relax, this cafe exceeds expectations on all fronts. It’s proof that sometimes, the simple things—great coffee, a cozy seat, and a friendly face—are the very best. Overall, Phulkari by Copper Chimney feels like a cultural celebration on a plate through flavor, color, and creativity., name_person=Aditi Prabhu}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Visited July 16, 2025 – day 13 in India

This is another excellent recommendation by my friend Shakun. We are staying at Novotel in Juhu, so we enjoyed a leisurely walk on the beach to reach the restaurant. We were welcomed very graciously and seated by the hostess. Since we had walked on the beach and were all very sandy, my husband, my daughters (aged 5 and 7), and I went to the restroom to wash up. When we returned to our table, I was pleasantly surprised to find it set up with a kids’ menu featuring lots of activities, along with sets of crayons and a chef hat crown that both my girls promptly put on. This was such a refreshing change on our 13th day in India, as until now we hadn’t seen a kids menu specifically geared for children in any of the restaurants we’ve visited. It was definitely a highlight for me.

We were kindly greeted by our servers Mukul and Manojit Roy, and their service throughout our meal was outstanding. They offered thoughtful recommendations, anticipated our needs, checked in at just the right moments without being intrusive, and treated our whole family with genuine warmth and respect.

For dinner, both my daughters wanted popcorn chicken—actually their favorite back home—and they were thrilled to see it on the menu. One chose a vanilla milkshake and the other a chocolate milkshake. The popcorn chicken was a bit spicy for their mild palates—but they loved the milkshakes.

My husband and I chose the Fish and Mixed Meats kebab platter. Mukul honestly informed us that the fish was unavailable, and substituted another chicken kebab, which we were completely fine with. We ordered the kebabs as served, thinking our girls might want to try them—and it turned out to be an excellent decision. The girls devoured the chicken reshmi kebab. It was so satisfying to see them enjoying something from the Indian menu, knowing we’ve found another safe and delicious option for them here in India.

We also ordered Rawalpindi Gosht, extra spicy, along with roomali roti and rice to accompany our meal. My husband was delighted with the kebabs—every bite was melt‑in‑your‑mouth tender. The Rawalpindi Gosht was succulent and richly flavored; we absolutely loved it. Despite being full, Mukul suggested the baked motichoor rabri for dessert. It was absolutely delicious—the warm, layered sweetness with the motichoor bits and creamy rabri was the perfect end to our meal.

We loved everything about this place. From the walk-in welcome to the thoughtful touches for our kids, the exceptional service by Mukul and Manojit, and the outstanding food, Copper Chimney Juhu made our evening truly memorable. We will definitely return., name_person=Foodieextreme Foodieextreme}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Very quiet, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Nice place to have authentic Indian Food.

After what went down yesterday, I honestly can't tell.

I usually ask bartenders to measure my wine before pouring, but this time I forgot. So I politely asked them to check it after. Turns out, it was 5–10 ml more than the standard serving - no big deal, right?

Apparently, it was. Instead of simply pouring the measured wine back, the bartender (Bhavesh) decided to keep the extra wine for himself and snapped, “You wanted the standard serving - this is it.”

When I said, “If that’s your attitude, I don’t want this glass,” but he refused to cancel the order.

Now the other 2 Jokers - The Two managers.
They were right there. Watched everything. Said nothing :)

It’s funny - you might actually have a decent time here as long as nothing goes wrong. But the moment you raise a concern, the service attitude changes completely.

If you’re looking for a chill bar on that street, there are plenty of others (some even cheaper) that understand basic courtesy better than this place, name_person=Nigel Dsouza}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=3 months ago, review=Three Wise Monkeys 🐒 was the perfect spot for our karaoke night. The karaoke host was incredibly friendly and brought so much positive energy to the room. People were cheering each other on, singing their hearts out, and even joining in to jam with us. It was more than just a night out. It felt like a celebration of community and connection.

This place knows how to bring people together. I cannot wait to go back on Wednesday nights for more karaoke fun. It has quickly become one of my favorite bars in Mumbai. Ambience: 4/5

Food: 5/5
Creativity: 5/5

Food we ordered:

4. Kolambi Bhaat: For the Mains we ordered this prawns rice based dish. Its extremely spicy but equally delicious, a very nice balance. The rice was tossed well in prawns coconut preparation for that perfect balance of spice and flavor. Totally nailed it.

reviews:

The restaurant serves unique Nikkei cuisine, a beautiful fusion of Japanese and Peruvian flavors that felt fresh, creative, and perfectly balanced. Every dish was presented with care and tasted amazing.

The team at Koishi went above and beyond - they were warm, attentive, and even surprised my husband with a special dessert to celebrate his birthday. It was such a thoughtful gesture that made the evening truly memorable.

The atmosphere was super elegant yet comfortable, making it a perfect spot for a celebration or a nice night out.

Highly recommend Koishi for anyone looking for excellent food, great service, and a special dining experience!

We had wanted a quiet place and they were able to accomodate our request in their private dining space.

reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Would not recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1–200, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1}, time_line=a month ago, review=Ordered Veg Biryani — extremely disappointing experience. The dish lacked the authentic biryani flavor entirely; it tasted more like plain pulav with unevenly mixed rice. There was no aroma, no proper spices, and barely any vegetables. The quality was far below expectations — even a simple roadside pulav would have been better.
Definitely not recommended., name_person=Prashant Pingale}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Breakfast, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1–200, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=2 years ago, review=So this restaurant is located in Airoli just at the main road itself near the Airoli-Mulund Bridge. Very conveniently located and easy to navigate. 📍 🗺️
We visited this restaurant on the weekend, Sunday to be precise, somewhere around 9-9:30 in the morning. None other shops or snack places were open at that time near the vicinity of the restaurant. Being new to the area we could not figure out a breakfast point. However I saw people having tea ☕ outside this restaurant so I decided to go and check ✅
So the owner of the restaurant said they did open now only so most of the items on the menu were not available. They only had a South Indian menu available and nothing else. We managed to order masala dosa (obviously the preparation of South Indian dishes like chutney, aloo stuffing and sambar were prepared the night before). The taste of dosa was average but the only flaw was that the dosa was not hot enough.
We also ordered 🍵 tea, coffee  ☕ and along with it I wanted to try Kanda bhajji. I will only recommend chai here if you are planning to visit the place early in the 🌅 morning only if no new place for chai be found nearby.
We also ordered Kanda Bhajji, however, the owner said preparation of Kanda Bhajji will take time as a fresh batch of the day to be made. However we insisted to him that we are fine with the delay in preparation of food. The taste of Kanda 🧅 bhajji was below average and not at all good, salt 🧂 was missing in it and it was served with sauce so that made it more uninteresting for me.

I feel that the hospitality was really 👍 good, the owner was taking care of everything in his control so that we like this place, this shows the kind of service he was willing to provide and he is providing at that place.

The service experience was good but we were too early to visit this place thus could not explore much of it., name_person=Saurabh Singh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=2}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Review/Complaint for The Great Saiba Hotel, Airoli.

I visited The Great Saiba Hotel at Airoli last night with my wife, and I must say it was one of the worst dining experiences I've ever had. We arrived at around 10:50 PM, and despite ordering promptly, we were not served any food even by 11:30 PM.

When I politely asked for vinegar to go with the Chinese food, the staff's attitude was completely unprofessional and negative. To make matters worse, the manager at the billing counter was equally rude and dismissive.

For a place that charges a premium, the lack of basic customer service and respect is unacceptable. I strongly do not recommend visiting this restaurant. It was a horrible experience, and I will never return., name_person=Neeraj K}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Not sure, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN]}, time_line=2 months ago, review=I am highly disappointed and concerned by the lack of food safety at this location. reviews: ["{\"name_person\":\"Varun Ranawat\",\"time_line\":\"Edited a month ago\",\"review\":\"The Bigg Small Caf\u00e9\\nA newly opened spot at One International, Dadar, The Bigg Small Caf\u00e9 truly lives up to its name \u2014 big on taste and variety! The caf\u00e9 offers an impressive range of dishes catering to both Jain and regular preferences.\\n\\nWe started with the Guac and Crisp \u2013 a creative combination of guacamole served with fried khichiya, offering a unique desi twist and a nice crunch. Finally, the Chopper Rice rounded off the meal beautifully.\\n\\nOverall, The Bigg Small Caf\u00e9 scores high on both taste and ambience, making it a great new place to try in Dadar for anyone who enjoys good food with a creative twist.\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE\":\"Dinner\",\"GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE\":\"\u20b9600\u2013800\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":4,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":4,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":4,\"GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE\":[\"Suitable_for_all_group_sizes\",\"E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL\"],\"GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME\":\"No wait\"}}", "{\"name_person\":\"SGT Reviews\",\"time_line\":\"a month ago\",\"review\":\"Visited The Big Small Caf\u00e9 for an office Friday lunch, and the place instantly impressed with its aesthetics and vibe.
