Primarily due to all the dishes are made fresh and served on the table. From Indian, Chinese to global dishes everything we tried was really good. So definitely worth the money.\\n\\nBelow is the menu which was served for Sunday brunch.\\n\\nWhat We Had -\\nAPPETISERS~\\nBurmese Style Cottage Cheese\\nCheese Chilli Naan Bomb\\nMakhmali Paneer Tikka\\nSalt & Pepper Lotus Root\\nPlum Chilli Water Chestnut\\nChamba Seekh\\nNadan Chicken Wings\\nClassic Chicken Tikka\\nMulgapodi Fish Fingers\\nXiang Chicken\\nBangkok Chicken\\nPrawns Butter Garlic Sauce\\n\\nDIMSUM & BAO~\\nChilli Cheese & Corn Dim Sum\\nFirecracker Bao\\nKerala Pepper Chicken Momo\\nSriracha Prawns Charcoal Dim Sum\\nTeriyaki Chicken Bao\\n\\nMAINS~\\nGreen Thai Curry with Steam Rice\\nVegetable Biryani with Raita\\nChilli Garlic Noodles\\nMiya Bhai Khurchan\\nChicken Thai Curry with Steam Rice\\nClassic Chicken Dum Biryani\\nChicken Hakka Noodles\\nTBS Special Pulled Butter Chicken\\n\\nLIVE STATIONS~\\nDIY Crepes\\nKathi Roll / Shawarma\\n\\nDESSERTS~\\nChocolate Mousse\\nClassic Tiramisu\\nLemon Cheesecake\\nFruits Tarts\\n\\nMOCKTAILS~\\nThe Japanese Smash\\nBlue Hawaain\\n\\nSo Sunday should be celebrated at The Bigg Small Bar and Cafe Lower Parel and this place should not be missed.\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE\":\"Brunch\",\"GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE\":\"\u20b91,400\u20131,600\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Aditi Prabhu\",\"time_line\":\"3 months ago\",\"review\":\"Visited The Bigg Small Cafe this weekend for a lunch with a large group of foodies.\\n\\nIts located in India Bulls and is easily accessible from Dadar, Prabhadevi and Lower Parel.\\n\\nIt is spacious and has a calming yet fun vibe. The staff was friendly, warm and super helpful.\\n\\nThey serve some lip smacking food for their sunday brunch.\\n\\nTheir cheesy naan bomb, nadaan wings, butter garlic prawns, peppery lotus stem, fish fingers, thai curry and steamed rice are an absolute must try.\\n\\nTheir grazing table with cheese, hummus, fresh fruits cannot be missed.\\n\\nTheir live counters serve some berrilicious crepes and meaty shawarmas.\\n\\nAnd the live music is a icing in the cake.\\n\\nOverall, Definitely a must visit place\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_MODE\":\"Dine in\",\"GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE\":\"Lunch\",\"GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE\":\"\u20b92,000+\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME\":\"No wait\",\"GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS\":\"Highly recommend\",\"GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO\":[\"Large_vegetarian_selection\",\"E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION\",\"Clearly_labeled_vegetarian_dishes\",\"E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS\"],\"GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS\":[\"Vegetarian_options\",\"E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS\"]}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Taronish Mullan\",\"time_line\":\"5 months ago\",\"review\":\"A lovely restaurant. We ordered a variety of dishes and each one was very tasty. Not disappointed with a single dish we ordered. The lotus stem chips , the chilly garlic bomb naans , the Mexican corn and mutton seekh all were superb: the staff was polite and helpful. We had been on Sunday for lunch and dinner were disappointed with 2 things. If you keep a Sunday brunch everything should be unlimited : the restaurant has a funny configuration of starters limited and 1-2 choices which really doesn\u2019t make sense. Why would anyone have a limited brunch for Sunday. It\u2019s not like a working day office lunch. Desserts were yummy specially the cacao mousse is superb and the basque cheesecake . Tiramisu was a bit disappointing. Didn\u2019t taste like a Tiramisu . Secondly the live music was very nice and a great singer but the music was way too loud and we couldn\u2019t even talk amongst ourselves: But I would still love to go back again\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE\":\"Lunch\",\"GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE\":\"\u20b91,200\u20131,400\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":4,\"GUIDED_DINING_RESERVATION\":\"Reservation required\",\"GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL\":\"Very loud, hard to hear\",\"GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS\":\"Highly recommend\",\"GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO\":[\"Large_vegetarian_selection\",\"E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION\"],\"GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY\":\"Plenty of parking\",\"GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS\":[\"Valet\",\"E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET\"],\"GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS\":[\"Vegetarian_options\",\"E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS\",\"Parking\",\"E:PARKING\",\"Wheelchair_accessibility\",\"E:ACCESSIBILITY\"]}}", "{\"name_person\":\"fane 12\",\"time_line\":\"8 months ago\",\"review\":\"A Hidden Gem in Lower Parel! \\uD83D\\uDC8E\u2728\\n\\nFrom the creators of Shiv Sagar, Kymaa, and Butterfly High, this new Caf\u00e9 & Bar is an absolute delight! With a perfect mix of delicious food, elegant ambiance, and heartwarming service, it\u2019s a must-visit spot.\\n\\nHere\u2019s what we tried and loved:\\n\\n\\uD83C\\uDF79 The Japanese Smash (4/5)\\nA refreshing 3-layered drink with yuzu syrup, passion fruit, and cranberry juice. Mild yet thirst-quenching!\\n\\n\\uD83C\\uDF36 Thaicha Kokan Kokam (5/5)\\nA spicy guava mocktail with a fiery twist! Made with kokum syrup, Tabasco, and Worcestershire sauce and served with a red chili powder rim \u2014 it\u2019s a bold burst of flavors.\\n\\n\\uD83C\\uDF54 Bunny Bhaji (5/5)\\nA unique spin on the classic pav bhaji! Mini burger buns stuffed with the chef\u2019s special bhaji. Pro Tip: Don\u2019t miss the lacha onion on the side!\\n\\n\\uD83E\\uDD51 Guac & Chips (5/5)\\nFreshly prepared guacamole with tomato salsa and sour cream, served with roasted khichiya papad. A healthy yet flavorful treat!\\n\\n\\uD83C\\uDF5C Khao SSI (5/5)\\nA creative twist on Khow Suey! Unlike the traditional version, this one packs a punch of Indian spices, making it spicy and irresistibly delicious. Highly recommended for adventurous palates!\\n\\n\\uD83C\\uDF55 Speziato Pizza by Slice\\nNot in the mood for a whole pizza? Try their pizza by the slice! Topped with burrata cheese, pesto aioli, jalape\u00f1os, and red peppers, it was a perfect bite to end our meal.\\n\\n\\uD83C\\uDF70 Basque Cheesecake (5/5)\\n100/5 if we could! reviews:
["{guided_block={}, time_line=5 years ago, review=Hearing this awakens ones soul as the very 2 warm yoga instructors turned wellness experts promote their slice of life to create awareness about vegan food but also which is raw , no refined and extra processed ingredients used, low oil usage that too of cold pressed coconut oil.

They work on a Pre order basis with deliveries done via Swiggy and scootsy this one can try not only their mains but also bakery stuff, crackers and desserts that don’t get you down a guilt trip.

A neat small kitchen with a seating outside surrounded with plants we were welcomed at The Prana kitchen with some healthy good for you food with their own spins to the techniques used in cooking.

We were served an array of dishes in an eco friendly thali which comprised of watermelon feta salad (almonds were used to make their feta version), nachos on home baked multigrain chips with cashew cheese, beetroot patties with a tangy sweet chutney and paired with a refreshing ice tea.

Out of these my favourite was the nachos whose cheese sauce one would not believe of it being made with cashews and it beat the dairy ones, the salad was just soo good and perfect summer replenish. The tikkis had a very nice flavour with a kick of garlic.

Next we were served some herbed hummus with their dehydrated flax seed crackers which were soo delicate and yummy. My favourite dish turned out to be the pesto zoodles with the pesto being super creamy made with cashews again and didn't make me feel like I was have ing veggies instead of staple pasta.

What’s a meal without dessert. The raw cacao smoothie bowl was good but could have been better if there was some granola on it and fresh fruits would have made it a 5/5.

Summers are not summers without popsicles and we had strawberry almond milk popsicles which had raw cane sugar this again healthy and soo good with real berries.

All in all for all my vegan friends who want to go a mile extra to have stuff which is preservative free, raw and vegan with homegrown and quality ingredients with love and so much thought put into it,  prana is your place.

reviews:
["{guided_block={}, time_line=7 years ago, review=Located in the next lane of rythm house, this place is the first I have seen to mention the serving timings till 3.30 am. The place is a combination of quality food which is light on pockets. I have reduced one star because there are only 2 sitting tables outside the cafe. The cafe is run by the same management of Carter's blue and one can sit inside Carter's and place the order., name_person=Imran mirza}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Pandora's Box in Fort, Mumbai is a fast-food eatery which is located right next to Carter's Blue.
Along with a range of Pizzas and Fries, you also have an option to customize it with given sauce and toppings on the menu.
It is a pure veg restaurant with good food and light on pocket making it a complete delight.

We ordered
1.Falafel Pita Pocket Sandwich which is served with potato wedges and mayonnaise sauce.
2. Home Run Fries is a combo of onion rings and french fries served with melted cheese and Jalapeno topped with thousand island sauce.
3. Pink Pasta - Loved the cheesy consistency and flavor of this classic Pasta.
4. Cold coffee from the wide range of beverages they have to offer, name_person=Meghna Talreja}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Situated near Carter's blue at Kala Ghoda. They serve only Vegetarian food. The quality and the quantity of the food is good.
Ordered Tandoori Paneer Pizza, Cheese Chilli Parotha and Triple Decker Club Sandwich. Raees served us very well and also suggested the dishes.
Best place to visit if you want quality food. Will definitely go again., name_person=Suresh Jaisingh}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=I have been a regular since the very beginning, specially because of the home run fries.
This place has an outdoor seating with 2 tables but you can sit in Carters blue and order from here with an additional 10% on the bill.
I really appreciate that they replaced the foil containers with plates.
Coming to the food, the Mac and cheese was amazing and I loved the aglio olio too. The sandwich was quite cheesy and very filling.
It’s a pocket friendly restaurant tucked in the lanes of Kala ghoda., name_person=Annie Chen}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=5 years ago, review=Decided To visit Pandora Box Located in The Galis of Fort , This Outlet Has some Amazing vibes and Music .

Located just beside Carter's , The Seating is For Almost 30-40 People at a time.

Ambience - The Ambience is Vintage and has been kept Simple, with Simple Lightings.

Food - The Aroma here is Amazing .

We Ordered
Italian Garden pizza - the base was crisp Tortilla and Had a topping of Tomato's and capsicum with basil , the Cheese was processed and It was just tasting delicious

3 Amigo Slider - The Slider was of 3 flavours 1 paneer Makhani , 1 Chinese , 1 Bombay veggie

The Stuffing was really Creamy and Tasty.

All together a good Experience, name_person=Aniket Hele}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review="Pandora's Box" is a small place with no seating arrangements. It's currently not available for dining. Talking about the food we ordered
1. The Bombay Grilled Sandwich
2. The Basil Pesto Pasta
The food was great. I really enjoyed the Pasta. The Basil leaf added a fancy taste to the pasta. For me it was the best dish. .
.The Bombay Grilled Sandwich was good but it was litter over priced.Half of the items on the menu were unavailable.Please visit this place for good food, name_person=Abhishek Wadke}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Pandora's Box is one of the best places I have been to . This place just doesn't serve ordinary vegetarian food instead they serve some of the most exquisite , lip-smacking and scrumptious dishes to feast on . The ambience of this place is fantastic . It's dimly lit and that is paired with music that soothes the soul . The staff over here is also very kind and welcoming.I tried four dishes over here they were:
Paneer makhni pizza : loads of paneer topped with loads of cheese . Loved the base of the pizza and the sauces used in it .

Home run fries : this is fries + Onion rings + potato wedges + thousand islands sauce. Yes it certainty was heaven on Earth to eat this . Every component of this dish was perfectly fried. This was my favourite dish of the night to be very honest .

Kiwi garden slush : The flavour of the kiwi just won my heart . Do try this if you love slushes .

Mt. Olympus Shake : this is hands down the best shake I have had till date . This is a combination of snickers, kitkat, home cookies , Nutella and caramel . Loved every bit of this . Dont call yourself a dessert lover if you haven't tried this., name_person=Craig Saliyan}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=This place located next to Carters Blue Restaurent and is highly recommended because everyhthing we tried was perfect.

Following are the items I Tried:
Quattro Fiamma Pizza
Spice Cottage Cheese Mint Mayo Pizza
Paneer Chilli Dry Sizzler
Mushroom Cheese Rissoto
But food was so good.

Lovely place to spend time with your loved ones.

The have outside and inside sitting arrangements.

The staff was slow. Rest all was good
Overall - 4/5., name_person=ABHISHEK PAL}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Good place for friends gathering, Pizza was awesome, falafel not so nice.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=All the food were freshly made and served hot service was fast and quick.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=So we had ordered burgers , french fries and some more dishes.}"]

I asked the manager if the two restaurants shared the same ownership, and he clarified that while they were separate entities, the management was the same.

On a positive note, the waitstaff at Jungle Family Restaurant were exceptional—definitely deserving of a 5/5 for their service.

Now, about the restaurant itself: the ambiance was ok, but unfortunately, the food did not meet expectations.

Here’s a breakdown of what I ordered:

- Virgin Mojito Orange: 2/5. It had too much lemon, and the orange flavor was barely noticeable.
- Blue Sky: 1/5. It tasted more like overly sweet kids' syrup than a cocktail.
- Paneer Chatpata Masala: 1/5. The paneer was rubbery and seemed stale, possibly even fake. Not fresh at all.
- Butter Naan: 5/5. This was the highlight of the meal—perfectly cooked and delicious.
- Lachcha Paratha: 2/5. It was unevenly cooked, leading to a less than satisfying experience.
- Malai Kulfi: 4/5. The taste was good, but the portion size was disappointingly small.
- Thandi Kesar Rabdi: 2/5. It didn’t taste like authentic rabdi, and the portion was too small.

The food was completely tasteless, and the service was highly unprofessional.
When we ordered two same dishes, they brought one first and the second after 30 minutes, simply saying “Sorry” each time.

Even the side table family was served bassi (stale) chicken and paneer, and the ladies had to shout repeatedly at the management to get any response.

We paid the full bill (photo attached) but it was a total waste of money and time.

Prior to settling for this, I had asked the server if I should also order a starter. He advised me against as what I was ordering was enough. Mighty honest of him!

reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_RESERVATION=Reservations recommended, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=a month ago, review=It was not worth the hype, for a restaurant this famous with the kind of price they charge per person there was nothing unique, I'd ordered for a pizza but that did not end up coming to my table (the chef probably forgot it), the pasta was very basic, soups okok, the chatt counter was nice but that's something i can have anywhere, the inky love highlight for me was the cheese section nd Salads including the salami, main course as well was very okok (the goan prawns curry nd mutton was good) and lastly the dessert there were too many cake options and indian sweets which again I think I'd get at any other decent buffet (I grabbed the chocolate mouse, blueberry pie, cheesecake nd dark chocolate dessert), name_person=Michelle D'Souza}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=Edited 11 months ago, review=The ambience here is truly great and has always been a highlight 🌟. I’ve been visiting this restaurant 2-3 times a year for the last 5-7 years, and earlier, the taste they delivered was gold. Back then, they really tried to include everything in their buffet, and the dessert section used to be huge and impressive 🍰🍮.

Now, let’s talk about the breakfast buffet—it’s pretty standard, similar to what you’d find at any 5-star continental breakfast 🍳🥐. They do include a few Indian dishes, but honestly, breakfast here has never excited me since the beginning.

As for dinner, it used to be something I truly looked forward to because of how flavourful and varied the food was 🍽️. However, over the last 2-3 visits, it feels like something is always off—sometimes it’s the salt, sometimes it’s the flavours. The food feels same-same now, and perhaps I’ve become fed up of eating the same dishes repeatedly. There’s nothing new or exciting anymore, and the taste is not extraordinary enough to crave anything specific. I used to love the pizza here; it was one of my favorites. But lately, the taste has literally deteriorated 😞. It’s just not the same anymore, and it’s disappointing to see the quality drop. Hope they bring back the original flavors they were known for.

That said, this place still shines for its ambience ✨, and for newcomers, it might still feel impressive and worth the visit. But for me, my interest in visiting Lotus Cafe is slowly fading away 😕. I guess it’s a matter of having it too many times.

Still, for the overall experience, I’d rate it 4 stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐., name_person=Ameen Shaikh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_SEATING_TYPE=[Indoor_dining_area, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_INDOOR_DINING_AREA], GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Loud, but you can still talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Dietary_restrictions, E:OTHER_DIETARY_RESTRICTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=6 months ago, review=I visited this cafe a few weeks ago, for their famous Sunday brunch. I was spoilt for choice. They have a wide array of dishes to choose from.

I started off with their Asian dumplings and they were good. I absolutely loved chicken Sumai.

Next up, I tried a cheese platter with Gouda, Brie, burrata, cheddar, caramelised figs and crackers. Everything paired so well.

They had a wide range of cured meats, smoked tuna, smoked salmon and lots and lots of grilled veggies.

The lobster and oysters and tiger prawns were outstanding. Their mutton chops were delicious too.

But their pizza and drinks stole the show for me. The pizza base was perfectly chewy and charred while the cheese was melty and gooey. Their pineapple Pina colada was sweet and creamy.

The pasta was okayish. And some dish were just average.

They also had a wide range of dessert to choose from. But their Gulab Jamun and chocolate caramel dessert was overly sweet. But I loved their blueberry cupcake and chia seed pudding.

Overall it’s worth visiting. Fusion Grill has a good bustling vibe in the evenings. The ambience is pretty good for a having a good time over food and drinks.

The food quality is excellent, and the quantity is also very good. Starters have bigger than average sized portions. I went for the chicken pot fried rice as suggested by them and it more than lived up to the expectations. Food is priced at an average rate for a joint like this. I found the alcohol rates are very reasonable though.

The service is also extremely good. Despite being there during peak hours, we were well attended to, and the dishes arrived in surprisingly quick time. The staff were pleasant and cordial.

There is separate open-air seating outside as well and they have made good use of the space available. A smoking area is also available. They don’t have a separate parking space of their own, but you will find plenty of space to park on the roadside, though it may not necessarily be adjacent to the restaurant.

They also have a small dancefloor. The music they play can get loud at times.

Fusion Grill is a great option for friends and families alike. I recently had the pleasure of dining at Vasundhara Restaurant, a hidden gem that takes you on an enchanting South Indian culinary journey. From the moment I stepped inside, I was greeted by the aromatic scents of spices and the vibrant atmosphere that transported me to the streets of Chennai. Vasundhara Restaurant offers a wide variety of South Indian delicacies, and two standout options were the Super Tasty Sambar and Dosa.

The Super Tasty Sambar at Vasundhara Restaurant was a true delight for the taste buds. It was rich, flavorful, and perfectly balanced in terms of spices. The sambar had a comforting homemade taste, with a medley of vegetables and lentils simmered to perfection. The flavors were harmonious, with a hint of tanginess that complemented the natural sweetness of the vegetables. It was evident that the chefs at Vasundhara Restaurant put great care into crafting this traditional dish, as every spoonful was bursting with authentic South Indian flavors.

The Dosa at Vasundhara Restaurant was nothing short of exceptional. The dosa was thin, crispy, and golden brown, just as it should be. The texture was perfect, with a delicate balance between softness and crunchiness. The accompanying coconut chutney and sambar were the perfect accompaniments, adding layers of flavors to the already delicious dosa. Whether you prefer the classic masala dosa or the mouthwatering cheese dosa, Vasundhara Restaurant offers a range of options to satisfy every dosa lover.

Vasundhara Restaurant's dedication to serving authentic South Indian cuisine is truly commendable. The menu offers a variety of other traditional dishes as well, such as idli, vada, and uttapam, ensuring a diverse culinary experience. The staff members were friendly and attentive, providing excellent service throughout my visit. The ambiance of the restaurant was pleasant, with clean and well-maintained surroundings.

The only reason I am not giving Vasundhara Restaurant a full five-star rating is that the wait times during peak hours can be quite long. However, the quality of the food and the overall dining experience make up for any minor inconveniences. I recommend visiting during off-peak hours or making a reservation to avoid potential delays.

In conclusion, Vasundhara Restaurant is a delightful destination for South Indian cuisine enthusiasts. With its Super Tasty Sambar, delectable dosas, and a range of other mouthwatering dishes, Vasundhara Restaurant offers an enchanting culinary journey. Their lunch service goes on till 4:00 pm, with the last order taken at 3:15 pm. Luckily, we managed to reach just in time at 3:10 pm.

We ordered the KOKO Signature Roll (avocado, tempura asparagus, crisps, and KOKO sauce) along with Hong Kong Soy Noodles with chicken.

The sushi was the absolute highlight for me – crisp, fresh, and packed with layers of flavour. Every bite was a delight, and it’s definitely something I would love to come back for. The noodles, on the other hand, had a very balanced and subtle taste, making it a nice complement to the meal.

I really loved their Sushi Go, I think it’s the best sushi I’ve ever had. However, other dishes were missing some wow factor. The food is good, no doubt. But, the price you’re paying vis-a-vis the food quantity and quality you’re getting doesn’t seem to match. I think they can do so much better if they expand their menu to include better chicken and veg options.
Overall, it was a decent experience., name_person=Snigdha Srivastava}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 months ago, review=THE PLACE TO BE!

You can ask the team for some extras like you want dishes without onions or garlic...
All the dishes were flavoured perfectly and with love.

The dessert was a creamy fluffy dream. And the espresso too.
Absolutely all on point.

Price wise it's not cheap. We paid 60 EUR ala cards. They have special brunches like the father's day brunch for 25 EUR plus taxes. These  prices are absolutely fair but eating ala cards is expensive as the portions are not that big.

Nevertheless a fantastic restaurant and we definitely will visit again as the food is incredibly good., name_person=WK}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=6 months ago, review=KOKO, Lower Parel – A Luxe Asian Dining Experience

KOKO in Lower Parel offers a refined and memorable dining experience. The ambiance is top-notch — modern, elegant, and perfect for an evening out. The menu features an impressive variety of sushi and dim sum, with ample vegetarian choices that are just as flavorful and thoughtfully prepared as the non-vegetarian options.

Highly recommend trying this popular Maharashtrian street food - it's a game-changer! Can't wait to go back for another serving!" 😋👌, name_person=Dhruv Sangwa}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review=Their menu consists of types of Misals and usals and the variations are based as would be the highlight if it would be served in that specific city and also the fusion dishes variety.
In frame – Tandoori missal, tacos missal, aam panha and kharwas.

1) Tandoori missal:  The missal is served with farsan in a small matka in which there is a bowl of charcoal kept for that smokey effect. The missal is on the spicy side, but it is a perfect combination of blended spices, which add in to the delicious taste. The primary ingredient is matki, which is properly cooked and being a sprout also adds up to the whole nutritious value of the Dish.  Also served  2 Pavs, chopped onions, lemon all these additions complement the original taste even better.

2) tacos missal(5/5):  This is surprisingly amazing fusion with the tacos stuffed with onions, tomatoes, cabbages and matki all in schezwan sauce. The tari is given separately which can be poured on these tacos and enjoyed. An amazing concept to try on.

3) aam panha - this is traditional raw mango drink having that sweet and tangy taste of kairi in it.

4) kharwas - this is again a traditional sweet dish which is quite similar to the malai and is creamy. Perfectly apt after having the spicy missal. Definitely try this

Overall rating - 5/5

Final verdict, this great and delicious effort to provide variations to the humble and simple Misal, keeping its basic essence and authenticity intact. The proportion of food portion is excellent and so is the quality.  The misal tastes delicious and overall it is a thumbs up experience and would definitely like to try the other variants as well., name_person=karuna bangera}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Heaven for all Missal Lovers out there😍😍

Visited this place on a perfect evening to grab a quick snack.. Ended up having my tummy full with yummy missal pav.

This place offers a basic seating space.. Approx 30 people can be accomadated inside.. Larger groups would probably not get a single table but will have to split & sit.

The menu is superb with varieties of missals at super affordable rates.. Mostly below 100rs

What we tried?
Pani Puri Missal
Cheese Missal Pav
Tandoori Missal Pav
Kharwas

The pani puri missal is unique in its own & the tandoori missal is sure to give u that smoky flavour.

Decent amount of cheese was given with the cheese missal.

Kharwas is something they recently started & it's yumm.. Jst 30rs for a small size dabba..

Overall.. We loved this place & happen to visit it again & again & again.

Ratings-
Food - 4/5
Ambience - 4/5
Service - 4/5

Go go go.. I started with the Nutella Hot Chocolate, which was absolutely delightful! It was rich, creamy, and had the perfect mix of Nutella and chocolate. If you’re a chocolate lover, you’ll definitely enjoy this.

Next, I ordered the Belgium Dark Chocolate. Unfortunately, this drink was a letdown. The consistency was very watery, and it was overly sweet. I expected a thicker, more intense flavor, but it didn’t meet those expectations.

The Potato Wedges with Garlic Mayonnaise were a clear winner! The wedges were crunchy, flavorful, and served in a generous portion. The garlic mayonnaise complemented the wedges perfectly and added an extra burst of flavor.

I also tried the Mexican Salad, which could have been better. The nachos in it were very limited, and the salad was overloaded with capsicum. There was hardly any cheese, and baby corn was almost missing. Instead of cherry tomatoes, large chunks of regular tomatoes were used, which didn’t work well. Black beans and avocado, which are key ingredients in a Mexican salad, were missing entirely.

The ambiance of the cafe was quite impressive. The quirky decor, colorful walls, and beautiful lighting created a welcoming vibe. The seating arrangements were comfortable, making it a great place to relax. They also had good music playing in the background, which added to the lively atmosphere. The cafe features a screen, so you can enjoy watching music videos or entertainment while you dine, enhancing the experience.

Parking is convenient for two-wheelers, but finding a spot for cars might take some effort. You may not always get parking right outside the cafe.

Tucked right outside Thane station, Regency isn’t just a bar — it’s nostalgia bottled up with Old Monk and chakna. I’ve been coming here since my college days back in 2010, and even after all these years (and all these fancy new places popping up), Regency still holds its own.

The vibe is unapologetically unpretentious. No Instagrammable neon signs or overpriced fusion tapas here. Just solid, top-notch bar food that hits the spot every single time. The chicken lollypop,crispy, the chicken fried rice, the kebab starters— everything’s consistently great.

The staff? Absolute sweethearts. They know their regulars, they’ll sort your table out, and you’ll never have to ask twice for your smokes or chakhna. Also, smoking in the AC section is a rare luxury in today’s world and Regency still lets you be.

This place has seen it all — bad days at work, good days at work, solo drink evenings, hangout with friends, college reunions, and impromptu sessions with strangers who became friends. It might not make it to a glossy magazine’s “Top 10 Bars in Mumbai” list, but for those who know Bombay’s soul, this is the real deal.

Regency isn’t a bar. It’s a tradition. Let's start with the positive. The atmosphere is undoubtedly appealing; it's a stylish, modern space with a nice vibe that makes a good first impression. This was complemented by genuinely good service. Our server was attentive, friendly, and efficient, ensuring our glasses were never empty and checking in on us at just the right times.

However, these positives were significantly overshadowed by the venue's major drawback: its size. The place is simply too small for the crowd it attracts. Tables are crammed uncomfortably close together, making private conversation nearly impossible and creating a constant, cramped feeling. The noise level was high, and navigating to the restroom felt like an obstacle course.

Unfortunately, the most disappointing aspect was the food, which I found to be below average. While presented nicely, my main course was underseasoned and lacked the freshness and flavour I expected for the price. It felt like a dish going through the motions without any passion or precision.

In conclusion, Spin City has a great foundation with its pleasant atmosphere and excellent staff. But until the significant issues of cramped seating and, most critically, the subpar kitchen offerings are addressed, it's difficult to recommend for anything more than a quick, crowded drink., name_person=Vimall P Shah}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=6 months ago, review=Visited Spin City Kitchen & Bar recently and here’s how the overall experience went. Firstly, the vibe of the place was really welcoming — warm lighting, upbeat crowd, and the highlight definitely being the live music session, which they host on weekends. The singer truly added a great energy to the evening!

However, the service left much to be desired. We had to wait for around 45 minutes just to get our starters, and even during that long wait, the mocktails we had ordered didn't arrive. When they did come, the mocktails (Hawai Punch, Virgin Blue Lagoon, and Pink Panther) were quite average — drinkable, but nothing memorable.

Moving on to the food: In starters, we tried the Hara Bhara Kebab, Punjabi Lasooni Chicken, and Murgh Lucknowi Seekh Kebab — all of which were flavorful and enjoyable. But again, the delay in service really dampened the mood.

For mains, I had specifically ordered Veg Pesto Pasta, but they mistakenly got Pink Sauce Pasta instead. Though they did correct it, it took a couple more minutes and by then, it slightly interrupted the dining flow. The Thai Wok Chicken Fried Rice was good and had a decent wok-tossed flavor to it.

Dessert was a mix of highs and lows. The Honey Noodles with Ice Cream was quite disappointing — lacked crunch, and the balance of sweetness was off. But on the other hand, the Sizzling Brownie was absolutely worth it — gooey, rich, and served perfectly hot.

I visited Ladurée at Jio World Plaza, Mumbai, and it was a delightful experience.

Famous for their macarons, they didn’t disappoint—crisp, flavorful, and perfectly delicate.

I tried the mango tart, which was refreshing with a buttery crust. The avocado burrata was creamy and fresh, paired beautifully with crisp bread. When you enter the place you witness fancy lightning column, sleek orange interiors which creates the fun, joy and playfulness atmosphere. Orange is a great colour choice because it stimulates the appetite and also encourages social interaction. Being foodaholic, I like everything from street food, fast food joints to cafe's and regular restaurants. This place is serving varity of cuisines with finest quality taste which makes this place interesting. If you wanna have thalis, proper north Indian and south indian food or any quick bites head here if you find yourself around. Each section on the menu has the timings written for when the dishes are available. Starting off with mocktails tried blue lagoon and Virgin mojito which were okay. Also, tried sweet Lassi and Oreo Milkshake according to me milkshake needs little improvisation.
Moving on to the appetizers section tried Crunchy manchurian dry which was spicy, crisp faultlessly tossed tasted great. Crispy Corn makes a ideal starter for veg's and it was palatable.
Chinese Bhel: This is my all time favourite chat which is made with fried noodles perked up with crunchy vegetables which was so appetizing.
Italian Paniyaram: This balls were made with green's and others veggies coated with breadcrumbs and deep fried topped with cheese.
Rumali Masala Papad topped with Indian chopped masala, lime, coriander and finely chopped fresh veggies. Nachos were served with cheese and bean's were flawless.
Vol-au-vents: It's a puff pastry stuffed with corn delivered maximum flavour when paired with cheese.
Vada Pav Dabeli Combo name itself says it's a combination snack the pav has both dabeli and vada pav flavour
Mumbai Masala Pizza: The pizza was quite good with a desi twist and loaded with lots of veggies, paneer and cheese.
Masala Garlic bread: Desi garlic bread tasted good and was having the perfect amount of the cheese and veggies added to it.
Pav Bhaji: It was served piping hot with flavourful bhaji
Moving to the much anticipated main course Mumbai Masala didn't disappoint one little bit. Veg Chatpat and Paneer Toofani were the curries of the day which were very well enjoyed with the hot, fluffy and soft breads. Paneer Toofani was having to kinds of curries half of the curry tasted like butter paneer masala and the other half tasted like palak paneer which was served in cabbage leaf. Coming to breads tried Lachha paratha, Kashmiri paratha, Lal mirch ka Paratha, kothmir butter naan, Chilli garlic naan, Masala kulcha, Kothmir butter roti and butter naan. Tried combination fried rice which was served with wet manchurian with an awesome presentation. Lastly, from the main course tried veg dum biryani which was soulful.
As, for desserts they don't have elaborate menu. Tried moong dal ka halwa set to perfection with drizzle of dry fruits. Sundae icecream was also good.
The service staff was pleasingly hospitable making sure there was never ever a moment where the diner's are waiting with empty plates.
Overall Taste:4/5
Service:5/5

It was as good as it looks., name_person=Ramsha Tausalkar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,600–1,800, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Chicago_Deep_Dish_Pizza], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a year ago, review=Light House Cafe is located in Worli and it is on the main road hence easy to find. I must say they are one of the oldest restaurant in Worli and of course the specialist for Chicago Deep Dish Pizza in Mumbai.

The restaurant is decent in size with indoor and outdoor Non AC section available for seating. Options are great for all size of groups. Loved the lightings done and the nice sized bar looks beautiful. They were playing nice music and hence the vine of the place during dinner time was just perfect.

Loved the menu here as it contains global dishes with great options for both vegetarians and non vegetarians. Prices are not too high and the quantity served is amazing. The kitchen service was perfect and the table several by Floor Supervisor Sushil was excellent as he was very professional and he knew the menu well.

What We Had -
APPETISERS~
Jerk Chicken -
Grilled chicken with Jamaican dry chilli rub with flavourful sauce in base and served along with salad tasted delicious. Lived the grilling as it was done perfectly keeping the juices intact. Loved the spice rub as it tasted really good.

Thai Basil Chicken -
Chicken tossed in garlic basil sauce along with bell peppers and onions tasted outstanding. Again the chicken was tender and the taste of garlic and basil was spot on as it had subtle flavours and there were no strong flavours of any ingredient.

MAINS~
Creamy Cheddar Deep Dish Pizza -
What should I say about this. This pizza is a meal in itself. We went for classic version skipping the makhani variant and trust me my decision was good. Thin base and generously filled with veggies, chicken and cheese looked brilliant and tasted heavenly. Loved the use of everything in this as you don’t get bored by eating so much cheese. This had garlic and whole black pepper in it hence you get kick in between. A must try here.

DESSERT~
Tres Leches -
Perfectly executed this was amazing.

So our meal at Light House Cafe Worli was perfect in every way as I loved the ambiance, service and food was definitely good. The Veg Junkie 🌟
Majja Ni Life 🌟, name_person=Krina Parekh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION]}, time_line=a year ago, review=Light House Cafe has been renowned for their Chicago styled Deep Dish Pizzas and we were just waiting to pounce upon them for a long time. Finally, got the opportunity to visit this place and we were not surprised at all because it lived up to the hype completely.

Taking you through all the dishes that we had here 👇🏻

Hummus Platter

The Hummus Platter consisted of Grilled Pita Bread, Garlic Tahini, Lavash, Falafel, Tabbouleh Salad and two different types of hummus, both of which were absolutely delicious.

Cheese Gherkin Balls - Highly Recommended

The combination of cheese and gherkin enlivens a combination of cheddar, tasty and creamy cheeses in this yummy starter. You just can't have enough of it.

Veg Lasagna

This is savory and satisfying, filled with roasted and tender veggies, creamy cottage cheese, ruffly noodles, and plenty of marinara sauce.

Butter Chicken Deep Dish Pizza (Available in 6 and 12 inches) - Highly Recommended

A special deep dish pizza stuffed with smokey grilled butter chicken, loads of mozzarella cheese, makhni gravy and sauce. Worth to mention that it's quite filling and we were absolutely full after having the six inch version.

Veg Makhani Deep Dish Pizza

The vegetarian version was also quite yummy with paneer replacing chicken but at the same time we couldn't finish the entire thing because even one slice is very filling.

Mocktails

We ordered a few mocktails such as Peach Iced Tea, Virgin Mojito and Berry Surprise. All of them were quite refreshing.

We also wanted to try their Chicken Crispy Donut but they were unavailable, so hopefully next time.

Overall, we had a wonderful experience and if you're visiting Light House Cafe, you should definitely try the deep dish pizzas. With its legacy as one of Mumbai’s oldest multicuisine veg restaurants, Relish consistently delivers both on taste and variety. Located just steps from the newly constructed Churchgate metro station, it’s incredibly easy to find—making it a go-to spot.The menu is a vegetarian’s dream, spanning everything from sizzlers and burgers to pasta, cheesy fondue, and world cuisines like Italian, Mexican, and Continental. Whether you eat Jain or simply want a hearty veg meal, you’re spoiled for choice here. We visited on a bustling Sunday afternoon and, to our delight, there was no wait for a family table—quite a feat given how popular this place can get. Every dish we ordered in Jain style was delicious, and the staff were prompt, polite, and knowledgeable.A thoughtful touch: they even offer bento cakes, which made our family birthday celebration extra special. Valet parking is available, with BMC parking charges of Rs. 100. The only area for improvement? The menu lacks a few options for toddlers—something the restaurant could enhance. Nevertheless, the lively, well-utilized space and inviting ambiance make it perfect for big get-togethers. It was about half an hour to closing time but I was still surprised by how dead the place was. The decor looks and feels pretty much as it did when the place opened: woody and kitschy. There was a private party on in a small section and they were blasting 80s Bollywood songs. Not that I minded but I did wonder why the whole pub was subjected to the music taste of a small group. Anyway, we ordered a couple of Negronis and settled down. This is where the disappointment really kicked in. All the “bartender” did was fill a glass with ice cubes and pour in the gin, campari and vermouth. No lemon or orange peels, but for some strange reason there were mint leaves in the drink. When we asked the bartender why the cocktail wasn’t made on ice, stirred, drained… as cocktails are usually made. We were simply told that we don’t do that. This is how a Negroni is made. At a ₹1000 plus a drink - cocktails aren’t blended? Bizarre. As expected, the result was the gin, vermouth and campari floating limply under the mountain of ice cubes. Horrible experience. Sadly, nostalgia just ain’t worth it anymore. Not going back., name_person=Vinay Choudary}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=8 months ago, review=Geoffrey's,  is a must visit place in Marine drive,  Mumbai ( Bombay ) for all the tourists, whether you are an Indian or a froreigner. The ambiance is stunning, with warm lighting, rich wood furnishings, captivating wall art and floral carpets. The display of wines and desserts is breathtaking.
Key Features
1. Extensive cocktail menu. Innovative gin-based creations crafted to delight the palate.
2. Flawless hospitality: Friendly staff ensure every need is met with a smile.
3. Culinary offerings: Classic pizzas to exquisite desserts, each dish crafted with precision.
4.Rooftop pool: Tranquil atmosphere with mesmerizing views of the Arabian Sea.
Experience
Geoffrey's combines elegance with comfort, making it a quintessential destination for refined dining in Mumbai. Its vintage charm and exceptional service create a cherished experience, drawing guests back repeatedly.
Geoffrey's culinary offerings are a masterful blend of flavors and textures, with dishes crafted to delight the palate. The service is impeccable, with attentive staff ensuring a seamless dining experience. Every guest is treated to a warm, personalized welcome, making each visit truly unforgettable.
Nextvtime when you visit Mumbai make sure rhat you visit this place and enjoy., name_person=Dr Vinay Kumar T}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Great Wines and classy interiors! The Prawns with avocado and basil were the best of all. They serve  great bites with the beer and a separate menu for wines! One must consult their waiter for the best wine to have depending on your preferred taste., name_person=Abhijit Ekbote}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=3 years ago, review=As it was an anniversary night, we chose Geoffrey's as the decor and ambience was perfect for our evening. It has a vibrant yet a rustic feeling to it's charm. The interiors, the stunning wall filled with pictures, old film & art memorabilia, and many others...

When it comes to the drinks and the mocktails on offer, the bartender simply hit it off with amazing creations one after the other!

A few cons:

However, when it comes to the food, as a Indian who loves eating spicy food, the 'Jerk Spiced Chicken' was really bland, to my surprise, so much that I had to had the Tabasco Hot Sauce to it to get a spicy flavor!

The chicken Burger too was barely seasoned with salt & pepper, and lacked a flavorful taste, which you'd usually expect with a crispy fried chicken patty!

Overall:

Despite that, I’ve been served regular food containing onion, garlic, etc., on three different occasions. What’s even worse is that when I double-checked with the waiter, he confidently assured me that the food was Jain — only for me to later realize that it wasn’t.

The first time I complained, the manager offered to cancel the item from the bill. By the third time, I made it clear that this solution was not acceptable anymore. The manager told me they were busy due to a crowd and would call back with a resolution — but they never did.

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in}, time_line=3 years ago, review=TOSSIN'S PIZZA located at Versova is at a walking distance from Versova Social's and serves some Authentic Gourmet Pizza you might definitely love to try!

Next we Tried 2 Milkshakes - Chocolate Hazelnut Milkshake and Strawberry Milkshake which were beautifully presented and had a fulfilling quantity worth the prize. Extremely creamy, perfectly thick and yummmmmy! I loved the Chocolate Hazelnut Milkshake. Do Try.
Also ordered the Exotic Veg Lasagne having a saucy texture with lovely layers of pasta and veggies. Has a cheesy flavour and taste tooo scrumptious.
They recommended us the chicken Lasagne which is house special.
The vibe is quiet cool and chill.

I tried the avocado chicken, which came in a generous portion for the price and delivered beautifully on flavor. I ordered the hazelnut affogato and it was heavenly. The blend of rich espresso poured over the creamy hazelnut gelato created the perfect balance of bitterness and sweetness. It was my first time trying an affogato and I\u2019m so glad this was the place I chose to experience it.\\n\\nThe caf\u00e9 itself has a very chic and calming vibe. It\u2019s minimal in its design yet incredibly warm and welcoming. The use of earthy tones and the cozy setting give it a very homely feel. It\u2019s the kind of place that instantly puts you at ease and makes you want to stay a little longer.\\n\\nA big shoutout to Amit from the staff. He was genuinely sweet and courteous. With its serene atmosphere, kind staff, and absolutely delicious offerings, I can definitely see myself visiting again and again.\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_MODE\":\"Dine in\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Vishal Gaglani\",\"time_line\":\"2 months ago\",\"review\":\"This place has sugar free chocolate ice which is like totally paisa vasool. Please try this place worth every penny\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Rajesh Padmanabhan\",\"time_line\":\"4 months ago\",\"review\":\"Affogato My Style \u2013 A Shot of Cool in the Heart of Bandra.\\n\\nTucked away in one of Bandra\u2019s quieter lanes \u2014 where leafy bougainvillaea meets curated minimalism \u2014 Affogato My Style is less of a caf\u00e9 and more of a mood. A soft blend of indulgence, intimacy, and invention, this charming little spot reimagines affogato not just as dessert, but as the final word in coffee couture.\\n\\nWalk in, and you\u2019re greeted by a space that whispers Scandi-meets-Mumbai: warm wood tones, muted lighting, vinyl records playing Norah Jones or AR Rahman unplugged, and baristas who take their pours as seriously as sommeliers swirl their reds.\\n\\nThe star, of course, is the affogato \u2014 and this is where the magic unfolds. Forget the traditional espresso-vanilla formula. Here, the gelato is handcrafted in small batches: think Madagascar vanilla bean, French lavender-honey, or even a sinful dark chocolate with sea salt from the Konkan coast. The espresso? Pulled slow, bold and moody, roasted in-house with beans sourced directly from Chikmagalur estates.\\n\\nThe pour happens tableside. There\u2019s something quietly dramatic about watching molten espresso cascade over frozen silk, creating that perfect swirl \u2014 like Mumbai monsoon meeting Mediterranean soul.\\n\\nThere\u2019s even a Bandra Signature on the menu: a limited edition affogato with filter kaapi, jaggery gelato, and a dusting of pink peppercorn. It\u2019s cheeky, warm, and wildly addictive \u2014 much like the neighbourhood itself.\\n\\nGreat Place \\uD83D\\uDE4C\\uD83C\\uDFFD\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE\":\"Brunch\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Rahul Thorat\",\"time_line\":\"Edited a year ago\",\"review\":\"We had the:\\nStrawberry cheesecake gelato - which was really good - 8/10\\nMushroom quiche - which was cheesy and delicious - 9/10\\nJalapeno cheese croissant - pretty good but nothing special - 7/10\\nGreen apple bubble tea - average - 5/10\\n\\nAs you can tell from the pictures, the cafe looks beautiful and has a unique look to it. It's a good place to kill some time over coffee and some baked goods\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_MODE\":\"Dine in\",\"GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE\":\"Dinner\",\"GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE\":\"\u20b9200\u2013400\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":4,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION\":[\"Strawberry_Cheese_Cake_Nas\",\"Asian_Chicken_Quiche\"],\"GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS\":\"Highly recommend\",\"GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO\":[\"Large_vegetarian_selection\",\"E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION\"],\"GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY\":\"Difficult to find parking\",\"GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS\":[\"Parking_is_unavailable\",\"E:PARKING_OPTION_NO_PARKING\"],\"GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS\":[\"Vegetarian_options\",\"E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS\",\"Parking\",\"E:PARKING\"]}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Rushabh Gundal\",\"time_line\":\"9 months ago\",\"review\":\"As a coffee and dessert enthusiast, discovering Affogato x Coffee by Javaphile was a delightful experience. This caf\u00e9 offers a unique blend of Italian-inspired gelato and artisanal coffee, making it a must-visit for anyone who enjoys high-quality coffee and desserts.\\n\\nAmbience & Design\\n\\nThe moment I walked in, I was captivated by the caf\u00e9's minimalist and modern design. The interiors have a soft, monochromatic palette inspired by swirling gelato, creating a serene and inviting atmosphere. The large, curved glass windows let in plenty of natural light, making it a perfect spot to unwind with a coffee. The outdoor seating area, surrounded by lush greenery and a calming white gravel setting, adds to the charm, making it a great place to relax and enjoy a peaceful break.\\n\\nMenu Highlights\\n\\nAs the name suggests, Affogato x Coffee specializes in affogatos, and I couldn\u2019t resist trying their signature affogato with Belgian Chocolate gelato. The combination of hot espresso and cold, velvety gelato was nothing short of amazing! They also have a great selection of gelato flavors, from Salted Butter Caramel to Tiramisu, all crafted using traditional Italian methods.\\n\\nFor those looking for something beyond affogatos, the caf\u00e9 also offers freshly baked goods like Almond Croissants, Pain au Chocolat, and Cinnamon Rolls, which pair beautifully with their coffee. If you\u2019re into unique coffee flavors, I highly recommend their Sea Salt Mocha or Spiced Latte\u2014both have a perfect balance of richness and depth.\\n\\nService & Atmosphere\\n\\nThe staff here is friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about coffee and gelato. This place was heavily recommended over the channel by Indian cricket legend Sachin Tendulkar, hence making it easier in terms of choosing the place.

It's a restaurant that serves a vast array of seafood items and some standout dishes that are worthy of being called Legendary.

The dishes I ordered during my visit were Bomblivi fish fry, Prawn Rechada and a bowl of Mixed Sea food pulao.
Add to that, 2 mugs of kingfisher beer to help in aiding the food down the stomach correctly.

The outcome, i was absolutely in wonderland after gorging on their food like there was no tomorrow.

The Prawn Rechada was simply outstanding to another level. The flavours, reminding me of the coastal beaches of India really gave an everlasting taste to hook onto.

The mixed seafood pulao was again another real dish that was crafted amazingly by their chefs. The homemade spice aromas were so imminent that it wasn't a surprise about finishing up the dish by myself.

Overall service and management deserves a 5/5. Food deserves a 5/5 as well .

Keep up the good work., name_person=Siddharth Bose}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a week ago, review=⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Fantastic Seafood Experience!

I visited fresh catch seafood restaurant on 11.12.24 @ 2.00 pm. This restaurant delivers an outstanding seafood feast from start to finish. The prawns were exceptionally fresh and perfectly seasoned, and every fish dish—fried, grilled, or in curry—was full of authentic coastal flavor. I especially loved the refreshing solkadhi, which balanced the spices beautifully. To end the meal, the traditional Goan dessert bebinca was absolutely divine—soft, layered, and rich without being overly sweet.
The service was impeccable throughout; the staff was warm, attentive, and quick to offer recommendations. Overall, an excellent dining experience that captures the true essence of coastal cuisine. Highly recommended!, name_person=SWATANTRA PRAGATI}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Bombil_Fry, Surmai_Masala_Fry], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_STREET_PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Parking, E:PARKING, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Somewhat difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=6 months ago, review=Fresh Catch is a seafood restaurant that has a mix of goan and mangalorean style fare. For starters we ordered the bombil rava fry which was crispy and tasty. Next we got the prawns butter garlic which was again done very well but the quantity could have been more. We got the surmai masala fry which was delicious and the masala was spot on. For the mains we got the ravas rechado gravy with some neer dosa and it was an absolutely delightful combo. We also got the prawns pulao which was less flavourful and dry. We ordered some squids sukkem to go along with the pulao. The squids were well cooked. In the drinks we got the mango mule and the spiced guava which tasted like any other tetra pack juice and was too expensive. Overally the food is good but the ambiance and certain aspects of the food should be looked into., name_person=Patricia}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1}, time_line=7 months ago, review=One of the biggest hype bubbles, Fresh Catch finally burst! Never expected it to be so so so bad! Lol! 🤣 All those pictures of Sachin notwithstanding, this place is a DUD!

Our meal happened on a weekday, and early in the evening when only two other tables were occupied. It was hot and all of us were sweating, profusely. The staff just said, multiple times, that all the air conditioners were on full blast. We even politely asked for a table/pedestal fan and it was promptly denied, though one pedestal fan was sitting idle in the corner with the TV. Allowing paying customers to keep sweating is unpardonable IMO. Staff should ideally do everything in their power to make customers comfortable. I guess  with so many pictures of Sachin on the wall, why bother with idiot sweaty customers. 🤷

The best part is the food - most of the things we ordered (many recommended by the staff) tasted the same - bland, characterless, papery. Only the Surmai was exceptional - really fresh with the most heavenly rachead masala. I think I tasted/munched on sand in the Crab Butter Garlic, which is ridiculous!

We didn't want to order mains because it was unbearably hot and all the food we had already ordered didn't inspire much confidence. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Amazing place for vegans and those who are following a gluten-free diet.
The outside is very unspectacular but inside it welcomes you warmly. The stuff is very friendly and caring.
I liked the menue. All marked clearly so you could easily choose the right treat in line with your diet. And yes for me it was a big joy to have such a variety of vegan gluten-free treats.
The tea is brewed freshly, very delicious. The coffee (Americano) was not very intense so better to go for Espresso for more intensity but the rest was amazing. The mushroom dish was very nicly roasted and flavoured as well as the caramelized tomatoes in balsamic vineger. The croissant cross toasted. Different to what I know but nice.
And there are so much more treats worth to test but we expected to for a coffee only. So we need to come back to test the rest.
Car parking situation is super difficult.
And it is not accessible for disabled people.
The prices are super fair. Go and test some super scrumptious vegan treats., name_person=WK}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Other, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Such a cool place! Food is good, staff is polite, prices are reasonable.

Rotis are now much chewy unlike many other restaurants.
Manchow soup is very good.
Tomato soup 🍲 was too sweet for my liking, but many people in my group liked it.
Paneer smoky and Veg Hungama both are yummy sabzis although they could have been little more spicy. Veg Handi was very spicy, and not that tasty.
Paneer Majestic starter is also a crunchy variant of the typical Veg crispy., name_person=Rushabh G}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN]}, time_line=2 months ago, review=​"Balaji Fine Dine is a pure vegetarian gem! From the moment we walked in, the staff was incredibly welcoming and attentive. The ambiance is elegant and perfect for a family dinner or a special occasion. We started with the Paneer Tikka, which was perfectly marinated and smoky. For the main course, we tried the Malai Kofta and Dal Makhani, both of which were rich, creamy, and absolutely delicious. name: My Regular Place, Dadar
reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[1_person, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_ONE], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=a month ago, review=Visited My Regular Place— MRP, Dadar (Mumbai) — and once again, it proved why it’s one of my favorite places in the city!

The food, drinks, and overall vibe were absolutely spot-on. I tried a few dishes this time:

🍤 Prawns Koliwada – Crispy, perfectly seasoned, and fried to perfection. The coating was light and flavorful, and the prawns were juicy and fresh. Easily one of the best versions of this classic Mumbai seafood dish I’ve had!

🍕 Pizza from Punjab – A creative fusion that truly stands out. Tandoor-cooked chicken paired with a rich butter tomato sauce, a hint of kasturi methi, and gooey mozzarella cheese — this pizza is as Indian as it gets and absolutely bursting with flavor. It’s the perfect mix of comfort and innovation.

🍸 Cosmopolitan – A refreshing blend of vodka, cranberry, lime, and Cointreau. Perfectly balanced — not too sweet, not too tart — and a great complement to the meal.

The service was prompt, the staff was friendly, and the ambiance had that perfect mix of lively and relaxed — ideal for an evening out with friends or even a solo unwind session.

Every visit to MRP feels consistently good, and this time was no exception. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for great food, well-crafted drinks, and a chill vibe in the heart of Dadar., name_person=ASWANTH T S}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=a month ago, review=They gave me an old menu with cheaper drink prices, then charged me more when the bill came. When I argued, they showed me a bunch of other menus and said "sorry, it might be a mistake." Plus, they charge 10% service for drinks and another 10% for food. The food and service were good otherwise, but this kind of scam really ruins the experience. If you want more money, just ask for it upfront instead of trying to trick people. And definitely take pictures of the menu before you order! I've attached the menu card they'll give you when you order, so please be careful., name_person=saurabh shinde}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RESERVATION=Reservations recommended, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Dietary_restrictions, E:OTHER_DIETARY_RESTRICTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_SPECIAL_EVENTS=[Themed_nights, E:DINING_SPECIAL_EVENTS_THEMED_NIGHTS, Seasonal_/_holiday_event, E:DINING_SPECIAL_EVENTS_SEASONAL_EVENT, No_special_event, E:DINING_SPECIAL_EVENTS_NO_SPECIAL_EVENT, Others, E:DINING_SPECIAL_EVENTS_OTHERS], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_PARKING_LOT], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO, 3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR, 5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT, 9+_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_NINE_OR_MORE], GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=6 months ago, review=We went for Friday night at MRP,  vibes were great and very energetic, we explored various food dishes here, in which we tried Chicken Asian Rice Bowl which was, flavorful, and perfectly balanced! But BAD EXPERIENCE EVERR!! We had gone there for my Birthday, but…. The DJ at MRP, made it the WORST evening for us. After insisting 5,6 times, he was NOT PLAYING APPROPRIATE DANCE NUMBERS at all!! He was a RUDE UNCLE!! Will never ever visit this place again !!

The bouncers and other staff were helpful! But that DJ WAS THE WORST DJ EVERRRR!!!, name_person=Gauri Kelkar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Fiesta_Nachos], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_STREET_PARKING, Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Somewhat difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a year ago, review=I recently visited MRP - My Regular Palace, and I have to say it was an amazing experience from start to finish. I decided to try a mix of their offerings and ordered Chicken Biryani, Peri Peri Fries, Thai Curry Rice, along with plenty of beers to wash it all down. The food was incredibly tasty, exceeding my expectations in both flavor and presentation. The Chicken Biryani was cooked to perfection, with tender chicken and a perfect blend of spices that really hit the spot. The Peri Peri Fries were crispy and had just the right level of heat, making them an addictive snack to pair with the beers. The Thai Curry Rice was rich, creamy, and packed with flavors, adding an exotic twist to the meal.

The drinks were great too, with a wide selection of beers served ice-cold, which made the dining experience even more enjoyable. To top it off, the DJ was playing some really good music, creating a lively and upbeat atmosphere. The place had a cool and casual vibe, with just the right balance between being a fun hangout spot and a great place to enjoy good food. Prices were very reasonable, especially considering the generous portions and quality of the food. The combination of delicious food, great music, and chilled beers made it a memorable evening, and I would highly recommend MRP to anyone looking for a laid-back, enjoyable dining and drinking experience., name_person=Sagar Jondhale}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 years ago, review=Yesterday, visited this party place "My regular place". I highly recommend this place for non-vegetarian as well as vegetarian. Love this place they have huge Seating Area indoor and outdoor both are available, With amazing ambience.

Here I had,
Paneer Chilli Kolkata
Korean spicy garlic chicken
TCN Japanese Onsen
The unexpected
Nasi Goreng(paneer)
Sizzling brownie

All Dishes and drinks were so good and tempting.
Staff is good and polite, Everything is perfect. I had an amazing evening.

Must visit this place ❤️, name_person=Siddhi Sathe}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Fiesta_Nachos], GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Paid_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_PAID_STREET_PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Somewhat difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=11 months ago, review=The ambience of the place is very good,  quiet and dark themed place. There could be stag entries in the weekend and also they don't allow people with sandals of flip-flops. But they allowed us on the weekday. The food quantity is very low and prices are very high. So I didn't like that thing. There are many other better options in Dadar consider this option as last one., name_person=Saurabh Nimbade}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=2 years ago, review=We visited mrp which is located in dadar, very close to the station. First of all the ambience, seating and the vibes of the place is quite lit. You can visit here with your friends or office colleagues for an amazing dj night.

They have both indoor and outdoor seating with live match screening and play area as well.

Coming to the food & drinks:
We tried their molecular Dslr - vodka based cocktail and jackie Chan's legacy - whisky based cocktail which were quite flavorful.

For food, we tried their salt n pepper chilli prawns, chilli oil chicken, which tasted delicious and the presentation was great. Then we also had their grandmamas rub chicken wings which was deep fried with special masala coating on top served with Mayo and chop chop rice (highly recommended) this had fried rice, chop chop chicken gravy on top and a half fried egg. Lastly, we ended with sizzling brownie.

They also have happy hours everyday on their drinks menu (40-50% off on drinks) from 6 to 9 pm. And they have a weekly calendar where everyday you get various offers on drinks.

We enjoyed here a lot and would highly recommend this place. The service is quick and the staff here will guide you to order their best dishes., name_person=priyanka shikhare}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Good music,Good food,Good ambience,Staff & service is great.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=We ordered chicken wings, nachos, spring roll, chicken and paneer pizza.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Not serving the drinks we want and charging 10, % service charge.}"]

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=a month ago, review=Very nice restaurant and amazing service! Every dish has its complexity and is unique! Everything was nice, however, it seems the chef there just has a passion for ginger! The tapas were exceptional and amazing! The Sourdough and Mochi was just amazing! Went for the full degustation to try every dish. Entree, main and Ayurvedic type cocktails were pretty good. Desserts were quite average and not that yummy or impactful. How western desserts are approached in western countries are amazing - don’t know but my view is stick to Indian desserts done differently., name_person=R M}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 months ago, review=Every bite was packed with flavor. The place itself has a chill vibe, super friendly staff, and great music. Whether you’re going on a date, hanging with friends, or just treating yourself (because you deserve it!), this is the place., name_person=Mamta Karkera}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Had an amazing experience at Ekaa! The staff took time to explain each course, and you can tell how much thought goes into everything here. Definitely one of the most memorable meals I’ve had in Mumbai., name_person=Ishan Patole}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 months ago, review=The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was outstanding – friendly, attentive, and very professional. Overall, it was a real feast for the senses and an excellent culinary journey. Highly recommended!, name_person=Monika Ochal}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Visited Ekaa and was pleasantly surprised! The menu is refreshingly unique—far from the usual clichés. The food was excellent, the ambiance beautifully planned, and the open, hygienic kitchen adds to the charm. The staff was polite, helpful, and even offered a tour of the thoughtfully designed space. A truly different and memorable dining experience!, name_person=Smita Bhat}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Really enjoyed the 'awakening' tasting menu at Ekaa! Different members of the kitchen team explained each dish in detail. The team was very passionate and sweet. They also invited us to tour the kitchen and offered my parents a small token for their anniversary. :)

The tasting menu experience easily takes two hours and we are very grateful for the innovative dishes and the hard work behind it.

I am sharing in the pictures a few of the dishes and the menu we ate (the pictures are mostly in order).

In terms of favorities: we really loved the main dishes with the mushroom risotto and sheet pasta with chickpea cutlet. Not to mention the bite size starters were extremely exiting! At no point did we feel the food was too much or not enough. Despite being a 20 course tasting menu it was just right!

We weren't completely in love with the sweets, but maybe that's more on us not having much of a sweet tooth.

Small note: we usually don't have leafs that are already eaten by worms. Despite being heavily processed there is always a chance that their is egg residue left behind. One of the leaf dishes did have such leafs. On us pointing it out the chef mentioned that its processed very well after coming from the farm. I would have personally prefered having dishes without them. But understand if that's a choice restaurant makes to keep them in., name_person=Tanvi Goyal}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=4 weeks ago, review=An appreciation message for one of the girls during lunch service- I don’t remember who it was but - my friend who works with leaves and textile design took the skeleton leaf garnish from my cocktail. She’d put it on the table waiting for it to dry. This girl noticed and came along with a box of tissues so that my friend could carefully put the leaf between paper and keep it safe and dry.

All of us at the table noticed it but somehow while leaving we forgot to mention it and show our appreciation for her.

But I this is what sets apart the best restaurants from the good ones. It’s not just food, which Ekaa is obviously excellent at, but it is this attention to detail that keeps us coming back. This is what makes Ekaa Ekaa., name_person=Anshul Shah}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=The place itself has a chill vibe, super friendly staff, and great music.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Good ambience , good service, good food , fine classy taste..}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=We got 5 tapas, 5 mains and 2 desserts + cocktails between 5 people.}"]

reviews: ["{\"name_person\":\"Shweta Singh\",\"time_line\":\"4 months ago\",\"review\":\"We visited this restaurant 18 July 2025 for a quick bite as our kids were quite hungry. Upon arrival I was asked if I wanted still or sparkling water.

I opted for sparkling water.

It is perrier, a French mineral water which is fairly priced at 300 inr + + (comes to around 3.90 EUR which is the same as what a small mineral water in a 5 star hotel in France typically costs).

However, perrier spent a quarter of a billion EUR recalling and destroying millions of mineral water bottles this year because it admitted one of its seven water wells in Southern France had fecal contamination due to heavy flooding.

It would be better had I been told what exactly I was getting rather than "sparkling water".

I started with pani puri and dahi puri which were the only tasty items.

After being seated I was not asked if I want any bread to accompany the meal.

It is only after I got my food that I realised it must be ordered so the bread arrived after my food was already sitting for a while.

The waiter said they have "all Indian breads".
I asked for a kulcha and a roti.
