reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=3 months ago, review=Sunday The Comfort Kitchen - A Cozy Haven for Comfort Food
Sunday The Comfort Kitchen is a delightful spot for anyone craving hearty, comforting meals. The menu offers a great mix of classic comfort dishes, Service is friendly and attentive, enhancing the overall experience. Whether for brunch or dinner, this place is perfect for a relaxed meal with loved ones., name_person=Dakshta Desai}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Loud, but you can still talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=Up to 10 min}, time_line=4 months ago, review=There are very few places in Borivali that consistently serve genuinely good food and Sunday Comfort Kitchen is definitely one of them. I’ve visited this place around 4 to 5 times now and it has never disappointed.

My absolute favorite here is the chilli fries with their secret dips. Hands down, a must try. I’ve also tried the Kung Pao potatoes, veg chopper rice, and Moroccan cottage cheese in the past. All of them have always been on point.

This time, we went for the potato wedges and ratatouille. Since it was my first time trying a veg ratatouille, I’m not entirely sure if it was the most authentic representation but it did taste good.

Overall, the food here has consistently been good and that’s exactly what keeps bringing me back., name_person=priyal soni}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SEATING_TYPE=[Indoor_dining_area, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_INDOOR_DINING_AREA], GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Visited Sunday – The Comfort Kitchen recently, and it’s definitely a cozy little spot for a quiet meal. The menu has a great variety of cuisines, which is perfect if you’re in the mood to try something different. The portion sizes were decent and most dishes tasted good.

That said, a couple of items were served cold, which took away from the overall experience a bit. Hopefully, that’s something they can improve on.

If you’re looking for a peaceful place with a wide range of food options, it’s still worth a visit!, name_person=Shivani Kadam}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a week ago, review=The food was excellent for both veg and non-veg options, and the mocktails were equally impressive. I was genuinely amazed by how quickly they delivered each order without any compromise on the quality of food and drinks.

They even customized the sizzler for us, which made the experience feel truly special. A restaurant that can elevate a special occasions definitely deserves 5 stars.

P.S. :- The mocktail portion was slightly small, but they were refreshing and enjoyable., name_person=Rahul Udvadia}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Somewhat difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Clearly_labeled_vegetarian_dishes, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS]}, time_line=10 months ago, review=Visited Sunday - The Comfort Kitchen, Borivali for a dinner date with my husband.
And..oh my God - the two of us experienced the 'Ratatouille-effect' as soon as we took our first bite!! Our taste buds tingled and danced with absolute joy. The food was hands-down, undoubtedly savoury and scrumptious.
So we ordered - Prawns Papped & Chicken Cigars for starters, followed by Non-Veg Dragon's Delight Sizzler as our main. A big big 👍🏻 for the way the chef handled each of the proteins in all our dishes. Both chicken and prawns were cooked to perfection! The dishes were not only a feast for the eyes but they were very well-seasoned, lip-smacking & as the name of this restaurant goes -- 'TOTALLY COMFORTING'.
I would highly recommend this place to all.
Will soon be returning - hungry to gobble more 🫶🏻
PS: staff - courteous
ambience - cozy, name_person=Vinita Kudtarkar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Nuttella_Oreo_Mousse, Cigar_Spring_Rolls], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_STREET_PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=a year ago, review=A place among the heavenly empire.
The food is crazy amazing in all senses, by far the most ever comforting food to be eaten. I had been here for couple of times now and did the variety run between both the veg and non-veg dishes.
Star of both times are their starters which are completely fantastic, finger food are top notch and the mains are too flavoursome, rice dishes are look out too and the best part are their desserts which are a must.
Summing up in a line for Sunday The Comfort Kitchen, is nonetheless that it sure is the comfort that one could require on a soothing Sunday., name_person=Vru}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 years ago, review=I recently had the pleasure of dining at Sunday The Comfort Kitchen in Borivali, and I must say it was a delightful experience from start to finish.

The ambiance was warm and inviting, creating the perfect atmosphere for a relaxed meal. The restaurant's decor exuded a cozy charm that instantly put me at ease.

Now, let's talk about the food. The menu offered a variety of options, and I was truly impressed by the diverse range of dishes they had to offer. The flavors were rich and authentic, and every bite felt like a burst of happiness in my mouth.

The service was top-notch. The staff was attentive, friendly, and always ready to assist with any questions or recommendations. It's evident that the team at Sunday takes great pride in ensuring their guests have a memorable dining experience.

In terms of value, the prices were reasonable for the quality and quantity of food served. Dining here felt like a great value for money., name_person=Dhruv Singh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a year ago, review=Recently, I had the pleasure of dining at Sunday - The Comfort Kitchen for lunch and its experience is worth sharing

Ambience
The ambience truly lived up to the name, offering a comforting and inviting atmosphere. The warm lighting paired with mild, soothing music created the perfect setting for a relaxing meal.

Service
The staff was incredibly welcoming and well-versed with the menu, which made deciding on dishes a breeze. Their suggestions and attentiveness added significantly to the overall experience.

Food
Starters: We opted for the Veg Cigar, a delightful take on spring rolls, served with a superb dip that stole the show. A dish must try for its Dips
Mains:The Dragon Delight in Sizzlers (vegetarian) was a fusion masterpiece, blending the charm of a classic sizzler with vibrant Chinese flavors. It was an absolute winner.
For the non-vegetarian option, we tried the Moroccan Chicken, which resembled a chicken steak with a unique sweet and tangy sauce. Surprisingly, the veg sizzler sauce outshone the chicken dish for me—a first
Drinks:The Kokum Breeze mocktail was refreshing and well-balanced.
The Siesta, advertised as a spicy mocktail, lived up to its reputation, offering a kick of spice that complemented the meal beautifully.

Overall, Sunday - The Comfort Kitchen excels in offering a mix of comforting dishes with creative twists. The blend of great food, impeccable service, and a cozy ambience makes it a must-visit for anyone looking to unwind with a hearty meal.

Would definitely recommend and revisit!, name_person=SAHIL RATNAPARKHI}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Very good place to njoy your weekend, nice vibe... good service and staff 😊}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Awesome food, we ordered fish n chips, prawns n chicken starters..}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Excellent food quality and variety of options on the menu offered here.}"]

reviews:

I tried their pasta, and it was absolutely delicious! The flavors were rich, and the presentation was top-notch. The service was also excellent, with friendly and attentive staff who were more than happy to accommodate my requests.

The restaurant serves a variety of cuisines, and I'm sure they have something for everyone. The prices are reasonable, making it a great value for money.

Overall, I had a fantastic time at Monopoly, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great dining experience. The food, service, and ambiance all came together to create a truly enjoyable experience.

*Rating:* 5/5 stars

*Price Range:* Moderate (₹200-₹500 per person)

*Recommended For:* Couples, friends, and anyone seeking a relaxing evening out.

*Will I Return?:* Absolutely! I'm already planning my next visit.

This is the perfect place for unique pastries like Rasmalai, Gajar Halwa, Paan, etc.
Location:- Thakur Village, Kandivali East.

Staff over here is very friendly and service is  quick!

We had,
1) Truffle Cake Shake:- The shake was really good and was very thick with perfect blend of truffle pastry. It was not very sweet and was perfect for people who loves chocolate on a dark side.
PS:- It was for Rs. 200/- which we felt was a bit expensive.

2)  Rasmalai Pastry:- Tried this unique flavour in pastry for the first time.
The pastry was good in taste and the flavour of rasmalai blended well with the pastry and was not too overpowering.

3) Chocolate Truffle Pastry:- One of the best Truffle pastry ever had, it was neither too sweet nor too dark and perfect in taste. A must have when you visit Little Cherry.

Now you can also ask them for your favourite cake flavour and it will be made infront of you in around 15 minutes. You can also choose from a variety of customised cakes and it takes around half an hour approx for the same, depending on the design you choose.

Note: They do not have dine-in area now so plan your visit accordingly.

They are serving authentic asian cuisine and I am loving the options they have.

They are taking all the necessary measures in the current situation and there packaging is spill proof.

I will recommend following options

1. Life's a Peach Bubble Tea - it's a combination of Peach , Cranberry and Yuzu and the flavours blends so well. It's really refreshing.

2. Cottage Cheese Baos - The Baos are perfectly cooked and I am loving the sauce you. The paneer is crispy but they can add more taste to the paneer. But overall it's good

3. Mushroom and Truffle Dimsums - The flavours are perfectly blends together. The chilli oil is adding extra spice which is required. It's simply amazing.

4. Veg Tempura Maki Rolls - This is one of the best sushis I tried. Loving the flavours added in this and tempura flakes adding the extra crunch. A must try options here.

I am loving the experience and food. You can definitely satisfy the your food cravings with amazing bubbles teas.

Overall ratings

Packaging - 5/5

Food ordered was delivered on time with perfect packaging of Sushi and Boba Tea.
We had the following:
Green house avocado cucumber and cream cheese
Very aesthetically served in a proper container which had compartments for chopsticks, wasabi and soy sauce. Sushi was amazing, loaded with cream cheese and avocado.

Edamame and Truffle Dim Sums
These just melt in your mouth, filled with mashed smooth paste of edamame and truffle, served with chilly garlic oil, pesto sauce and soy sauce.

Mushroom Bao
Soft and steamed bao filled with mushroom and topped with veggies and and mayo.

Tropical Bew.
It was basically unsweetened cocounut milk and coffee along with sweet chewy boba. I would recommend to add extra sugar if you are not health cautious, otherwise a refreshing drink to beat the summer heat., name_person=brijesh jani}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review=I remember being extremely excited last year when I heard about a bubble tea bar opening up in Mumbai. I’m obsessed with Bubble tea and the idea made me so happy. In fact I even visited the outlet when it started but due to COVID restrictions the tapioca pearls weren’t available. Cut to 1 year later, it’s 2021, they’ve managed to source their ingredients AND they’ve expanded the menu to include some of my favourite things, dimsum and sushi.

Here’s what I ordered in recently:

* Taro Bubble Tea
A milk based tea with tapioca pearls, a mild flavour of the purple root vegetable Taro and a perfectly sweetened beverage. There’s nothing not to love about this classic drink. A special mention for the amazing packaging Mongoose offers, their glass is so sturdy and attractive, it won’t leak during delivery and you definitely won’t want to throw it after.

* Chicken and Truffle Oil Dumplings
A glutinous wrapper that resembles that of a hargao, stuffed generously with minced chicken, veggies and the aroma of truffle oil. Wrapped beautifully and shaped to resemble a little animal with 2 ears and sesame seeds for eyes. This ones a treat for the eyes and the palate.

* Green House Avocado, Cucumber and Cream Cheese Maki
Definitely my favourite dish from the order and make with fine quality ingredients, this sushi was excellent. The condiments on the side were also of stellar quality and the roll had finesse. I enjoyed the ingredient combination and the balance of flavours. Excited to try a non veg variant next time.

* Crystal Veg Dumplings
Thin, translucent glutinous wrappers stuffed with flavourful, exotic vegetables and shaped into a beautiful ball, if you’re a vegetarian, this must be on your order.

I absolutely loved my experience with Mongoose. Everything is made from fine quality ingredients, the packaging is great and it feels like care and attention have gone in to every detail., name_person=Sanskaara Lalwani}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review=Looking for some real good Dimsums and bubble tea? This is the place to order from!

I ordered Mushroom Bao, Edamame & Truffle Dimsum, Avocado Cucumber Cream Cheese Sushi Roll and the classic Bubble tea! Food was delivered in time and packaging was perfect.

Mushroom Bao - Fresh properly steamed soft baos, loaded with very well sautéed exotic veggies and Mushroom, also those tangy & Spicy sauces adds extra flavour. Fresh lettuce and cucumber added little bit of crunch. Overall, flawless I would say and a must try.

Edamame Truffle Dimsum - one of the finest Dimsum I would say! Chef here is definitely a pro at Dimsums. Stuffing, shell, toppings everything was upto the mark. Melt in mouth shell with very well cooked Edamame stuffing, it was really satisfying.

Bubble Tea - loaded with those chewable bubbles, absolutely refreshing iced tea with appropriate sweetness.

Overall, good place to order from for your asian food cravings. Bit expensive but the quality that they provide justify the cost. We enjoyed our meal from this place!, name_person=Pankaj Kaklotar}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Positive: Price for what you pay, container is great, and the service was kind.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Food ordered was delivered on time with perfect packaging of Sushi and Boba Tea.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=The exotic flavours like Taro and Thai bubble tea are the best.}"]

reviews:
["{guided_block={}, time_line=2 years ago, review=A first for us, visiting a premium whisky lounge. Although I’m not a fan of whisky this place was so appealing I had to visit! Situated inside The Orchid Hotel near Mumbai Airport this place is a delight for whisky lovers with more than 99 premium whisky brands in their bar.

This place gives of a little bit futuristic neon vibes with pink and light blue colours dominating the decor. With the bar on one end and tables across the floor this place is as good as it gets.

They even host live music every now and then, please check with the lounge before visiting. Their drinks section is quite huge with a menu as extensive as it can be. There’s a liquor or cocktail for everyone!

The service is also super fast, staff is very courteous and helpful in guiding through the menu. The dish presentation is also quite neat. Our food was on the table within a few minutes of ordering.

Coming to the food we had a few cocktails and a few veg and non veg starters. The cocktails were really good, they were strong punchy and had a good flavour. Same for the food the starters were really good. Overall we had a really great time!, name_person=Pratik Patil}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=2 years ago, review=I visited Merlin's Karaoke Bar this weekend with my better half and here I am sharing my experience.

The lounge is located in the 5 star premium property of The Orchid Hotels near Mumbai Airport.

Starting with the ambience. The interiors are eye catching with a comfy couch and lounge chair seating.

The bar is mesmerizing and they serve 99 kinds of Whiskeys. They have a wide spread of options in the Cocktail Menu.

We were attended by Jay and Allen. They were kind and served us with warm hospitality. The service was prompt and they helped us well to decide drinks and starters as per our taste buds.

We started our night with Rob Roy which was a whiskey based cocktail. Just how I like it.

My partner tried their bartender special LIIT which was made with a mix of different white spirits with a twist of cranberry juice and beer.

We started our meal with Cheesy Mutton Seekh Kebab and Malai Chicken Tikka. Both the starters were marinated and grilled to perfection and complimented well with the green chutney.

In mains we loved Extravaganza Pizza. It was a thin crust pizza topped with exotic veggies and mozzarella cheese.

You can enjoy IPL or any sports matches with your partner along with drinks and appetizers here.

They have Live Gigs and Karaoke throughout

Warm hospitality, crafty cocktails and mouth watering appetizers.. couldn't ask for me.

It was a lovely experience for me and my partner. Will surely visit again very soon., name_person=Gurmeet Singh Rait}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=2 years ago, review=Visited Merlins karaoke bar and it was an amazing experience. Also we had chicken Bhuna roll which was too yum 😋😋. The stuffing was soo delicious. Still can't get over its taste!! 😍🥰

Overall the place is fun and a must visit atleast once for the experience it provides!, name_person=Indica Roy}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=2 years ago, review=The first thing that stands out about this lounge is its impressive collection of 99 different types of whiskeys. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=a month ago, review=Been here last weekend for dinner and this is hands down one of the best place to unwind if you are in Versova as they are opened till late night and have drinks menu starting from just 99/-

After major success in Andheri Lokhandwala HOPS have opened their doors now in Versova. They have 3 levels of seating here. The one on the ground floor looks quite sophisticated and composed. The level 2 dining area is a proper bar set up as it is  dim and looks amazing. My personal favourite one would be the rooftop which looks absolutely stunning and a perfect one for the date nights.

The F&B spread over here is exceptionally amazing. On bar they have brewed beers so all the beer fanatics you guys are covered too. In drinks we had Gin Botanic which was basically cucumber G&T which was super refreshing and had lovely taste. Next we had double trouble which was mix of cranberry juice topped with 2 shot glasses having whiskey and Jäegermeister each. This was my personal favourite and a must try if you are here. Also if you are boozing over here do not forget to try their famous chakhna platter which is a solid 10 and goes really well with the drinks and brings extreme nostalgia. For the starters we tried Thecha Chicken Kebab which was perfectly tandoor-ed inside out and the kick from green chillies was quite dominant. Next we had Prawns in black pepper sauce. Wok tossed prawns in black pepper sauce which was perfectly spiced and that crushed black pepper really elevated the flavour profile. Loved both the appetisers a lot! Upon our server’s recommendation we also tried chicken pepper dimsums which was really good too. Paper thin outer layer and generously filled with juicy chicken filling this was lovely. Our meal ended with their Ghee roast chicken pizza which was made using thin crust and loaded with toppings. The traditional flavours of ghee roast on to a pizza was super delicious and one of the best fusion pizzas we have tried off late.

However, my experience today was extremely disappointing and quite upsetting.
A lady (whom the staff referred to as "madam" ) approached me and said I couldn’t sit there unless I kept ordering something every hour. She even accused me of sitting for eight hours, which is completely untrue, CCTV footage would clearly show otherwise.
To make things worse, she claimed I “only order tea,” which is false, I don’t even drink tea. It’s concerning that she speaks without knowing the truth and makes baseless assumptions about customers.
She also mentioned that she “can’t afford” me using the cafe' s electricity, which was completely unnecessary and unprofessional to say.
I would still understand if this happened during peak hours or when the cafe was crowded, but that wasn’t the case , it was afternoon and early evening, and there were plenty of empty seats.
Also, there’s no visible notice or written policy anywhere about mandatory hourly orders either.
If she is the owner, then it’s unfortunate that such a good team is under poor leadership. And if she isn’t, I sincerely hope the owner looks into this matter, because her behavior and tone were far from customer-friendly. The point isn’t about ordering,  it’s about how she could have communicated the message respectfully and perhaps waited until I was about to leave (which was in just 15 minutes).
She did say “sorry” later, but it left me wondering, sorry for what? For disturbing my work or for creating a wrong image about the cafe? Either way, it ruined an otherwise peaceful afternoon.
If you’re someone who likes to sit for a while to work, read, or relax, this might not be the right cafe for you. It’s disappointing that one person’s rudeness and poor judgment can overshadow an otherwise pleasant experience.

During my recent visit to Adda heist I was thoroughly impressed by both the ambiance and the culinary experience. Located in the heart of the city, this restaurant offers a perfect blend of traditional flavors and modern presentation.

The décor is warm and inviting, with soft lighting and rustic wooden furniture that create a cozy atmosphere. The service was exceptional—our server was attentive, knowledgeable, and offered great recommendations.

Now, onto the food! We started with the Tandoori Paneer Skewers, which were perfectly grilled and had a smoky, flavorful marinade. For the main course, I opted for the Butter Chicken with Garlic Naan, while my companion tried the Paneer Tikka Masala. The butter chicken was rich and creamy, with a perfect balance of spices, and the naan was soft yet crisp. The portion sizes were generous, making it great value for money.

For dessert, we couldn’t resist the Gulab Jamun Cheesecake, a delightful fusion that combined the richness of Indian sweets with the smooth texture of cheesecake—an absolute must-try!

The only minor drawback was the slightly long wait time, but considering the quality of the food, it was well worth it. Prices are reasonable for the experience offered, making The Spice Haven a great spot for both casual dining and special occasions.

Overall, I’d highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for authentic Indian flavors with a modern twist. I’ll definitely be coming back!

We chose the buffet and were happy with the wide range of dishes available. Here's a simple breakdown of our experience:

Starters & Salads
The buffet had four fresh salad options that were light and tasty. We enjoyed both starters—one vegetarian and one non-vegetarian. They were well-cooked and paired nicely with the dips. The soups, one veg and one non-veg, were warm and comforting.

Main Course
The main course had a good selection with three vegetarian and three non-vegetarian curries. The vegetarian options included Paneer Mirch Masala, which had a nice spice to it, Kofta, which was creamy and flavorful, and Jeera Hing Aloo, which gave a homely feel. There were also pasta and noodles as sides, both decent additions. The non-vegetarian curries were also well-cooked and satisfying.

Desserts
There were four to five desserts to choose from, including chocolate burfi, gajar halwa, and pudding. The gajar halwa was especially delicious, with just the right amount of sweetness.

Drinks
We ordered LIIT and Mojito, although these were not part of the buffet. Both drinks were refreshing and well-made.

Service
A special thanks to Biswajit and Abir, who greeted us warmly and provided great service throughout our dinner. Their friendly attitude made our experience even better.

Overall, Connexions by The Fern offers a nice buffet with a good variety of dishes and excellent service. This is Sindhi-style Falooda, very buttery with a kawa-type flavour, which makes it unique.
Not overly sweet—perfectly balanced taste and very satisfying.
One of the better faloodas you’ll find in Ulhasnagar, especially if you like rich, traditional flavours.

About the place:
Asha Falooda, Ulhasnagar is quite popular and usually crowded, known mainly for its falooda.

Areas of concern:
Hygiene needs serious improvement—there are only 4 tables, and most tables and chairs are not cleaned properly.
When charging ₹90–₹100, basic hygiene practices like wearing gloves while serving should be maintained., name_person=Suraj}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Other, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹200–400, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a year ago, review=I recommend eating their regular falooda as it contains everything. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=I was wanting to come here since a long time and I am glad I came here.

The food was kickass.

We started with Cheesy Affairs which were very flavourful. Next we had the falafel with hummus which were crispy and tasted good.

Next on the table was Cantonese Pot rice which was the best of all. We also had the Pull Me Up pasta which was decent.

We did not want to have the pizza that they had in the menu and so we requested Ajay there to customise the margarita for us with usual toppings and he was so kind to that for us.

We ended up with the deconstructed hazelnut brownie which was very creamy and rich in chocolate.

Our experience was amazing and top notch.

Highly recommend!! 💕, name_person=Sakshi Ladia}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,400–1,600, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Valet parking is available.  The decor is warm and comforting. The music was just apt allowing to have a conversation , that’s a rarity these days.

The food presentation was impeccable and it also tasted quite well. I really loved it. The service was a bit patchy as it was difficult to get someone at the table inspite of not having many guests at the time of our visit.

However, I will definitely visit for the food once again, name_person=Indradeep Roy}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Very quiet, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a week ago, review=The food was excellent and full of great flavor. The service was also wonderful—every staff member was very kind and attentive. A special mention to Appam, who provided exceptionally friendly and professional service. Highly recommended!, name_person=Patinya Kruacharoen}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO, Not_sure, E:NOT_SURE], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Two Gud Sisters in Santacruz West, Mumbai, is a cozy, welcoming café and bar with a big heart and aesthetic vibes.

Founded by Rinka Jha and Rashmi Mishra, two friends who share a love for food and creating warm spaces, this spot feels like home.

The decor, designed by architects Rohit Sharma and Siddhartha Srivastava, blends earthy tones and chic European style, with cozy seating and artisanal touches.

The cocktails, like the punchy Pinacte with basil and honey notes and the beautifully presented Miliministic, are highlights.

Starters like the crunchy, umami-packed Kung Pao water chestnuts shine, while the caramelized French onion soup could improve.

The margarita pizza with onions and jalapeños is tasty, and Chef Avinash Nayak’s koshary is a standout.

The tiramisu dessert is delightful, and the service feels warm and homely. With outdoor seating and a vibrant atmosphere

Two Gud Sisters is worth revisiting.

Owners passion makes it a perfect spot to connect over great food and drinks. Cheers, name_person=Prithvish Ashar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 months ago, review=MUST VISIT!!!!!

Located in an industrial lane, this restaurant has amazing vibrant vibes. They curate unique and innovative cocktails by their excellent skilled bartenders. The food is no doubt, Delicious !!! You get to choose on Indian, Regional, Italian, Mexican, Middle Eastern & more such cuisines. My personal favourite was the mango menu and from that was the mango cheese cake. Loved this place and the vibe., name_person=Jayesh Tiwari}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,400–1,600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=7 months ago, review=What’s Your Plan is located in Sakinaka and it is behind the famous McDonalds and you have ample parking space available.

It might sound cliché, but this is the first time I’m genuinely using the term hidden gem — this place truly surprised me with how good it was in every aspect.

The restaurant is spacious with two different sections being available. One is AC with high chair seatings and a bar plus DJ space too and the other is Non AC causal seatings with pool table in the center and a nice bar. Loved the use of the space and the wall designs as it looked really happening. Currently as IPL is going on they have decorated the Non AC section with team flags and have kept a big screen too.

The menu here is vast and they have options available in Indian, Asian, Italian and some more cuisines. Right now they have added a limited edition mango menu too. Apart from this they have various offers in food and drinks specially for big groups for IPL season. Prices are at par with similar type of brands and the quantity served is good.

Went here on a Monday dinner and the kitchen service was on time and table service by staff Mantu was great as he was polite and knew the menu well.

What We Had -
APPETISERS~
Jamaican Jerk Spice Chicken Tikka -
Served in a unique way as hanging skewers in the Dubai frame. Served with buttery naan, onion and green chutney this was juicy chicken tikkas done in green Jamaican spices. Loved the taste of this as it was not the regular tikka and the spices had nice hint of hotness to it.

Genkai Prawns Maki Roll -
Surprisingly a very nice and tasty sushi served. Fresh prawns rolled nicely with rice and the crunchy tempura coating with spicy sauce tasted excellent. Loved everything about this sushi as it was bang on tasty.

MAINS~
Mushroom & Truffle Cream Cheese Flatbread -
Thin base topped with generous amount of cheese, mushrooms, red chillies, cream cheese and sprayed with aromatic and earthy truffle oil looked perfect and tasted delicious. Loved the juicy mushrooms and the cream cheese and they were honest in using the truffle oil hence a perfect dish again.

Nasi Goreng -
This was a complete miss for me as it was way different from the Nasi Goreng that I have been eating for years. Maybe it is their way as I felt it was a plain normal fried rice however being fried rice it tasted nice but for Nasi Goreng they need to check the recipe.

DESSERT~
Mango Cheesecake -
Again a very different version of cheesecake as this was more closer to a baked layered malai cake with mango flavour and topped with Alphonse mango. Taste wise it was really good as the mango was sweet and it was not extra sweet.

MOCKTAILS~
Tropical Bliss.
Sunset Bloom.
Both the mocktails tasted refreshing as the ingredients tasted nice with each other.

So our meal at What’s Your Plan was really good as the food tasted perfect, the ambiance plus vibe of the restaurant is great and the service was excellent. Therefore a must visit., name_person=Shaikh Khalid Sarfaraz}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=6 months ago, review=*New Place Alert*

Ambience was classy and you get a feel of nawabi tradition. Very friendly and respectful. Great Evening. The food was outstanding and the kulfi was to die for. Thank you for a great experience. This is especially good for someone who has limited knowledge as to how to order food in India - this is my first meal after arriving the hotel at night. Nice!, name_person=Raymond Li}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in}, time_line=3 years ago, review=‘Eat like a Nawab’. Nawab Saheb - The Westin Powai brings you a royal experience.
This place has a comfortable aura and interiors of this casual dining restaurant are appealing.
The cuisine is focused on traditional Indian featuring the regions of Awadh, Rajasthan and North West Frontier India. These flavours are influenced by local culture bringing out the authenticity to provide a world class gastronomic experience. The food is absolutely amazing – everything we tasted melted in other mouths especially GALAWAT KE KEBAB and LUCKNAWI GOSHT DUM BIRYANI. Absolutely the best meal we had
At Nawab Saheb you can enjoy culturally rich traditional dining experience which stays in your memory., name_person=Gargi Bagul}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Renaissance Hotel Powai is nothing short of royal and beautiful. Simply amazing hospitality and such pretty restaurants. This Infact, was my reason to visit Nawab Saheb for their ongoing Tawa & Tandoor Festival (20th- 28th September) as there are very few restaurants who actually go out of their way to curate special menus like these. Brainchild of Chef Yunus Khan, I think everything on the menu was fantastic. Service was slow as the restaurant was quite packed, being a Friday night. I opted for the vegetarian fare priced at 2800. Frankly, I thought it was value for money only because of the main course. Just their dal makhani and paneer will leave you licking your fingers till the end. Here's what the spread consisted of and how I felt about it :
Vegetarian :
1. Til Malai ka Phool (5/5)- Melt in the mouth brocolli with cream cheese. Found the cauliflower okayish.
2. Chef Yunus Khan ka Paneer Tikka (10/5)- Star dish! Has to be the best I've had in a long time. Highly recommended.
3. Subz ki Ashraphiya (3/5)- Found it average.
4. Bhune Bhutte ke Seekh (5/5)- AMAZING combination of seekh Kebab and babycorn. YUM.
5. Kabuki Kebab (3/5)- Found it too dry. Taste wise as well, bland due to Chickpeas.
6. Chukunder ke Kebab (4/5)- Beetroot galauti, it was nice.
7. Kumbh ke Galawat (5/5)- Wow. Has to be the one thing I'd come back for! Surprisingly it was served on a thepla kind of bread.
8. Aloo Atishi (4/5)- Bharwan aloo, classic.

Mains :
1. Paneer Kaliyan (10/5)- Now that's what I'm talking about. It's dishes like these that make you remember these hotels. No one does mains like them. I ALWAYS skip mains but yesterday I was too tempted after a bite and ended up having 3 pieces of bread after such heavy array of starters. MY FAVOURITE FROM YESTERDAY because it was cashew gravy, so creamy, soft paneer chunks and rightly spiced. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.
2. Daal Nawab (10/5)- Probably as good as the one I've had in Delhi at ITC. Properly slow cooked for 48 hours, perfectly creamy and texture was just right. Not overdone. Yum.
3. Subz Biryani - couldn't dare to try it. Was too full.

Desserts : Assorted variety
Motichoor Laddoo, Kaju Katli, Kalakand, Gulab Jamun, Akhroti Halwa, Phirni - all were great but my favourites were the Phirni and Gulab Jamun.

Great staff and great hospitality by team. Special thanks to Manager Avanish, steward Shrikant and Chef Rahul Karve., name_person=Mahek Khanna}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Nawab Saheb as the name suggests it’s a luxurious fine dine restaurant located in the basement of Renaissance Powai. This place was in my wish list since a very long time. I was amazed by the interiors and ambience of the place. The place can accommodate around 100 people at a time.

This place has maintained not just the standards but also taste of the food. The staff was very welcoming and warm with hospitality. Nawab Saheb is a gastronomical journey for those exploring the ageless Royal Mughlai and North Indian Cuisine.

The menu boasts of different menus such as Mix & Match, Seafood, Non-Vegetarian, Vegetarian and Jain options. Also, they have A-La-Carte menu. All these are eloquently curated by their Chef.

We started with Mix & Match Platter. The following dishes were adorned in the Platter.

Appetizers:

Nawabi Aloo Ki Nazakat

Chef Yunus Khan Ka Paneer

Dhuan Achari Lobster

Jheenga-e- Nisha

Akbari Murg Tikka

Shahi Gilawat Kebab

Mains:

Awadhi Paneer Korma

Makhamali Jheenga

Mahi Dum Qaliyan

Lagan Hara Murg

Potli Nihari

Dal Nawab Saheb

Gosht Awadhi Biryani

Desserts:

They have a dessert buffet in which you will get many Indian desserts. So, if you’re fan of Indian desserts it’s a perfect end to your meal.

Overall, a brilliant experience with the expertise in culinary world.

Food: 5/5

Ambience: 5/5

Décor: 5/5

Value for Money: 5/5

P.S: The review is strictly depending on my personal experience., name_person=shripad marathe}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=3 years ago, review=Nawab Sahab - Westin Powai
Amazing place , richness all over , menu curated by master Chef Yunus Khan a fusion of awadh , frontier India and Rajasthan
This place is known for it's Kebabs and mouth watering aromatic curries

Here is what we had :
==================

Veg and non veg platter - makai motiya seekh minced corn charred with Indian spices normally served on skewers. Since it was a platter it was a single piece
YONUS KHAN KA PANEER TIKKA - signature dish. Middle had a filling of dry fruits and nuts. Indian spices tandoor well with spices balanced
Subz gauloti - melt in mouth minced veggies with herbs and spices served over a bread. So Lucknow ( must try )
MALAI KA PHOOL - richness all over . Cheese and cream marinated broccoli charred.
Perfect

Non veg platter - Mahira babuli kebab famous dish of amritsar on bones. Melt in mouth tangy spicy marinating. Must try
GALAWAT KE KEBAB - do try this , served on a small paratha. Minced lamb with spices .balanced was prefect. Normally served on a griddle. Since it was a platter just had one piece which was enough to know the culinary talent of the master chef.

Samunder ki apsara - wow this was something new . Small lobster tandoor to perfection. Special spices used by the chef. I will remember this . Never had it as a starter

Coming to mains :
VEG - do try the Aminamadi  Saag , a spinach preparation with garlic and cumin. Freshly made full of flavours. Chef has kept it simple . Let the dish do the talking

Paneer Lazeez e khaas again a signature by chef. Chunks of cottage cheese with rich tomato gravy . Subtle in spices and aromatic at the same time.
However the 48 hour Long process Dal e yunus is worth a wait , rich urad lentil. Goes well with biryani or breads.

Non veg - ghost nihari tho banta hai boss . Bone marrow stock , lamb slowly cooked gives that aromatic taste and flavour.
Do try the murg handi lazeez - braised chicken with base of onion gravy along with methi ( fenugreek ) and cream. Chicken was cooked well tender and juicy

Must say that food , kebab or the gravy are not heavy or oily. Just perfect.
Missed out the prawns kasundi , lovely hit of kasundi cooked well. Velvety tomato and anar gravy. Do try.

Small portion of Subz Chilman biryani , long grain basmati rice with saffron a bit of Ittar ghee and veggies

Breads - Taftaan / Khameeri / Naan
However the dessert had a pleasant surprise
Had a capsicum halwa FOR the first time.
Something different which one needs to try out

Overall experience = awesome
Felt like a Nawab Dining at this place paired with a sparkling wine

Big thanks to Saurabh Dixit and team Westin for hosting

name: KOA - Cafe & Bar (Thane)
reviews:
["{guided_block={}, time_line=a week ago, review=Had a wonderful dining experience at KOA – Thane! 🌟 The moment you step in, the ambience feels chic, vibrant and perfect for both group plans and relaxed evenings. The staff is welcoming and the service is smooth throughout. 😊✨

Food & Drinks Tried:
🍹 Refreshing Cocktails – bright flavours, refreshing and well-balanced
🥟 New York Cream Cheese Dumplings – rich, creamy filling with a great texture
🍝 Mac n Cheese Pasta – super comforting, cheesy and satisfying
🍛 Subz Dum Biryani – fragrant, flavourful and cooked beautifully
🍰 Pistachio Tres Leches – mildly sweet, nutty and the highlight of the meal

Everything tasted fresh, well-presented, and worth the price.
If you’re in Thane and looking for a place with great food + great vibe, KOA should definitely be on your list! 💚✨, name_person=Anshita Saxena}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Very quiet, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=KOA Café & Bar, located at Korum Mall, Eastern Express Highway, Samata Nagar, Thane West, is truly one of the most aesthetic and vibrant spots in Thane.

The ambience is beautifully designed around a bohemian / boho-chic theme, featuring warm wooden elements, greenery, soft tawny lighting, and creative décor. The vibe is relaxed and cozy — more like a “room to share” than a formal fine-dine space.

They have a circular bar, cabana-style seating, window-side spots, and even an al-fresco section that gives outdoor-style dining feels. It’s a perfect hangout place for friends, casual dates, or relaxed get-togethers. The early evening vibe with low ambient music adds to the charm.

🍽️ Cuisine & Drinks

KOA serves a broad and global mix of Italian, Asian, Continental, Indian, and fusion cuisines, making it great for groups with different tastes. Veg or non-veg — there’s something for everyone.

🥤 What We Tried – Drinks
•	Lemon Basil Oasis Mocktail – refreshing and perfectly balanced
•	Hazelnut Blended KitKat Milk Frappe – rich, creamy, and indulgent

🍽️ What We Tried – Food
•	Sriracha Chicken Dumplings – spicy, juicy, flavour-packed
•	Rock Shrimp Tempura Sushi – crunchy, fresh, and delicious
•	Jamaican Jerk Chicken Pizza – smoky, spicy, and full of flavour
•	Kasundi Mustard Fish – tender fish with a strong mustard punch

🍰 Desserts
•	Pull Me Up Tiramisu – creamy, dramatic, and super satisfying
•	Smash It Dessert – fun, interactive, and tasty

⭐ Overall Experience

10/10 — The food, drinks, and ambiance were all outstanding.
The staff, service, and the manager were extremely polite and attentive.
A perfect spot in Thane for amazing food, great vibes, and beautiful aesthetics.

Highly recommended! A must-visit place at Thane., name_person=amin shaikh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Not sure, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Stunning interiors and beautiful aesthetics make this place stand out. The staff are genuinely welcoming and attentive. One of the attendants went out of her way to arrange a pepperoni pizza that was no longer on the menu  while it wasn’t quite the same as before, it was still very tasty.
Peri Peri fries came in a large portion with a fantastic garlic dip. Rechado Murg Tikka and Murg Khatta Pyaz were both delicious, thanks to the excellent staff recommendations. The Jammin Islander mocktail from the bar menu was perfectly balanced and refreshing.
Overall, a great experience with top notch hospitality and quality food highly recommended.
Only one draw back water service to table was not up to the mark asked a quiet a few times still didn’t got it served., name_person=sanmay khade}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Paid_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_PAID_PARKING_LOT], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=a month ago, review=The ambiance is dim and cozy, ideal for a relaxed evening, but the menu setup pulls the experience down a bit. Since it stands upright for “easy sharing,” it ends up cluttering the table and feels inconvenient to use.

I tried the Island Calling watermelon mocktail, which began mildly sweet but quickly turned flat, leaving a dull, watered-down aftertaste. *Wouldn’t recommend it.*

The food, however, was impressive.
The Loaded Fries were spot-on, perfectly salted, well-balanced, and indulgent without being messy.
The KOA Special Korean Fried Chicken was a highlight, with a great crisp and a lively salsa.
The Cottage Cheese Balls in Spicy Sauce had a delicious sauce, though the inner texture of the cheese balls felt a bit off. Without that inconsistency, it would have been an excellent dish.

Overall, great food with a few fixable flaws in the menu design and drinks., name_person=Patricia Cardoza}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Other, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=a month ago, review=Had coffee and some snacks at this place with my sister. Missed taking the picture of their bread and dip platter. The food overall was nice tasting. The coffee was good too. I did feel the pricing was on the higher side though given we spent almost 1000 rupees per person on one coffee and two starters.
We also went at 6pm at which time most of their menu items were not available. So we pretty much had to eat whatever they did have. But overall nice ambience., name_person=Pragya Agarwal}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,400–1,600, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Koa has a lovely bohemian Mediterranean vibe, blending Greek, Oriental and Indian cuisines under one roof. We tried veg ramen which had nice broth but came in a surprisingly small bowl more like soup with a few noodles and at ₹650, it didn't feel worth it (Foo and Chimichuri do it better.

Next we ordered Charcoal Mushroom pizza witj buttered truffled oil base with extra saucy mushrooms as side. Then we did the gnocchi dumplings in cheesy basil sauce. These both dishes were spot on!

Overall Koa offered a great ambience and vibe, their Indian menu is good but the continental dishes could use reworking especially in portions size and value. Even some iconic restros in Mumbai offer more satisfying plates for similar prices., name_person=Prathamesh Bandekar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Loud, but you can still talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Lovely decor with tasty food.
We had ordered chicken dimsum, butter chicken, mushroom starters. Food wuality is good though the quantity seems little on lesser side but we 3 girls had no issue with that.
The ambiance is to the  top.
One can spend good amount of leisure time and enjoy live music DJ.
Wish it had a dance floor !!, name_person=Shilpa S}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 months ago, review=One of the best restaurants to go. Loved this experience!!, name_person=Tejal Patil}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=<<Old Review>> Great place, great ambience, great food, good service.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=I have tried the sushi, pasta, pizza, bao and ginger cocktails.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Atmosphere is good, rates 4 star only because of too loud music 🎶}"]

reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a week ago, review=Spiceklub is definitely a place if you wanna try food with innovation.

Located in lower parel its a fine dine restaurant serving modern indian cuisine .

Menu is truly outstanding ,they bring molecular gastronomy to indian cuisine .

Food we had ,
Vada Pav Mousse :
Deconstructed vada pav served with potato mousse with boondi ,chutneys and mini pav which was truly the same as mumbaiya vada pav .

tandoori paneer shots :
This dish is highly recommended.Tandoori paneer with chutney foam served with coriander and green chilli shots .

For mains we opted for bhuna paneer masala with garlic naan .

Ended our beautiful meal with never imagined dessert ,
Bubbling kulfi :Deconstructed kulfi stored under -196 degree served with four different flavours rose caviar ,bluebbery ,chocolate, salted catamel and rabdi .

They have also introduced kids friendly menu like makhni pasta ,quesadilla and many more .
So a must visit for family dining ., name_person=Mirchi Mumbaikar}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 days ago, review=Tucked right opposite Palladium Mall in Lower Parel, Spice Klub is one of those rare places that truly redefines vegetarian North Indian dining. From the moment you walk in, the vibe feels modern, artistic, and full of curiosity - and a sense that you’re about to experience something different. This place is creativity plated beautifully.

We began with their mocktails, the Pineapple Burn Fizz and Coconut Water Margarita, both refreshing and thoughtfully crafted - ideal palate cleansers before diving into the food.

The starters were where Spice Klub really showed its innovation. The Green Goodness Kebab, a sesame-crusted vegetable kebab, was crisp on the outside and soft within, paired perfectly with tzatziki and chimichurri for a refreshing herby punch. The Vadapav Mousse was a complete surprise—in the best way possible. Vadapav reimagined as a creamy mousse, served with soft pav and bursts of chutney pearls, it was shockingly delicious. The Manchurian 2.0 was glazed in Indo-Asian flavours.

For mains, we tried the Paneer Lazeez, a smoky, spiced makhani-style gravy that felt rich yet well-balanced. The paneer was soft and flavorful, pairing beautifully with the garlic butter naan and butter rumali roti—classic comfort done with finesse.

Dessert was equally indulgent. The Sizzling Gajar Delight arrived on a hot plate with warm gajar halwa, creamy rabdi, and a kulfi, making it a perfect mix of temperatures, textures, and nostalgia.

Overall, Spice Klub is a must-visit for anyone who loves innovative, vegetarian North Indian cuisine. It’s creative without being gimmicky, rooted in tradition yet unapologetically modern. • Cottage cheese kebab

reviews:
["{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review=Apna’s rolls is a small outlet in fort which is always flocked by people. They serve some great rolls and tikkas.

I highly recommend the Chicken Cream Roll and Chicken Malai Breast. The pieces of chicken are very tender and will simply melt in your mouth.

You may also try malai seekh biryani, chicken tikka, Baidabaty roti and offcourse chocolate mousse.

They make their own cream and other sauces. We ordered seekh kebab and Malai kebab and tawa Pulao., name_person=Kaustubh Pal}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=A friend had suggested this place saying it offers good kebab and rolls. Yester evening my wife ordered rolls and chicken tandoori (in her office and then brought home) so not sure about the ambiance.

The packaging was good. Both rolls and tandoori was wrapped in aluminium foils.

Coming to the food part...

1. Chicken cheese tikka roll: A nicely made roll with egg coating (something like a frankie) filled with chicken tikka. Really liked the taste and it was filling too. Worth a try!!

2. Chicken Cream roll: The roll was very very dry and average to taste. The outer covering was thick and hence just after the first bite, decided to open the roll up and only had the malai tikka pieces within.

3. Lastly we had ordered Full chicken Tandoori and it might have been one of the worst tandooris ever. (I do understand that tandoori is a dish to be had then and there when its just out of tandoor but this was beyond that). The Chicken was neither marinated properly nor was it cooked nicely. We could only finish half of it (even the green chatni given alongside was too liquidy and tasteless) and threw the rest of it in the trash.

This is next morning and I am having stomach upset making me regret having the half cooked tandoori., name_person=Deven Dabholkar}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Food on ur mind.. visit this place.. variety dishes from barbeque to rolls mughlai nd biryani.. one of my fav is the mutton seekh, chicken cream Tikka roll, chi cream tikka, baida roti, bheja fry😋😋😋😋

It also has a bar.\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_MODE\":\"Dine in\",\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":4,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":5,\"GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL\":\"Moderate noise\",\"GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE\":[\"Suitable_for_all_group_sizes\",\"E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL\"],\"GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME\":\"No wait\"}}", "{\"name_person\":\"Moumita S\",\"time_line\":\"4 months ago\",\"review\":\"Miller House Bar & Kitchen at Khar West has brought back old Bombay charm in our lives.\\nMiller House Bar & Kitchen is founded for creating a happy space for the foodies who want to chill out with friends and family after a long hectic day. Situated in the Delphi building at Hiranandani Gardens, the place has a large, stylish interior with well-thought-out décor: disco balls, retro touches, wooden furniture, greenery, and seating zones that allow both vibrant activity and more relaxed conversations.
Food choices are broad and mostly satisfying. Starters like sliders (Truffle Lamb, Cheetos Crusted Chicken), dim sums, lotus stem, and ravioli garners praise. Some mains — e.g., tofu chili bean blue rice, margarita pizza, Pan-Thai noodles, etc. — are generally considered good. Desserts too have highlights: caramel tart and Sandesh puff are often recommended.

Drinks also catch attention: creative cocktails, mocktails, some on-tap cocktails, refreshing lemonade-based drinks, and clever presentations. This adds to the mood in a big way.

Ambience and vibes are among the strongest points. On weekend nights, the place fills up, the music and energy pick up, which many find enjoyable. There is also seating away from the main crowd for those wanting quieter time. Service is generally good, though during busy hours guests report delays, slower attention, or small hiccups. Portions, especially for starters, are sometimes viewed as smaller relative to pricing, particular with high expectations.

Pricing is on the premium side. For two people without heavy drinking, costs are somewhat high—but many feel you’re paying for ambience, décor, the all-round experience, not just food. It seems worth it if you want a fun, visually pleasing, social evening out.

---

reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=Edited 3 months ago, review=Great place and fantastic service. Tried their veg and non-veg dishes. Both were good. Stir fry chicken and chicken spicy dumplings were the best. Try their 5 rice chilli combo, superb! That too veg. Place is great for a small group. Do book in advance., name_person=Navin Nathani}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Loud, but you can still talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=We dined at Hakkasan Mumbai tonight and, while the space is beautiful and the service was polite, the overall experience did not live up to the premium pricing or the reputation of the brand.

The biggest disappointment was the cocktail pricing. We ordered very standard drinks — a Negroni and a Paloma — and were charged approximately $40 per cocktail. At that price point, you expect truly exceptional creativity, presentation, or ingredients, but these were simply average. If a restaurant chooses to price cocktails at this level, they really need to deliver something ultra high-end to justify it. Otherwise, it feels excessive and out of proportion to what you’re actually getting.

We had dined the night before at Bastian at the Top, and the contrast was striking. Bastian was on another level entirely — the views from the 47th floor, the energy, the food, the drinks, and even the value for money were all significantly better. Their cocktails were roughly 50% less expensive, yet far more impressive in both taste and presentation. That experience absolutely set a high benchmark, and unfortunately Hakkasan did not meet it.

Overall, Hakkasan is not bad by any means, but it feels overpriced for what it offers. With so many outstanding dining options in Mumbai, I expected more in terms of both value and wow factor. For us, it ended up being a 3 out of 5 — decent, but not memorable, and not somewhere I would rush back to given the pricing., name_person=Aman B}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=4 months ago, review=It was my first time to visit this restaurant.Over all everything was nice and place is very beautiful. We had great interaction with Hardik who is working as restaurant manager and Mathotmi was our server. Hardik introduced us about restaurant and Mathotmi explained us about drinks and food. Also they suggested us food and drinks too. Food was authentic and well presented and explained by the server.We had great time and I hope to visit again soon. Thanks., name_person=pooja gaonkar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Dark_Chocolate_Mousse_with_Mandarin_Sorbet, Classic_Hakka_Steam_Dimsum_Platter, Braised_Pork_Belly_with_Truffle_Sauce_and_Mantou, Dumpling, Dark_Chocolate_Mousse, Mocktail, Half_Peking_Duck], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=Edited 5 months ago, review=This is my second visit to Hakkasan. As always, brilliant food and even better service. The staff were pleasant in particular, Apam, which lifted the overall experience. Had the pleasure of meeting the man behind the scene Chef Raymond. Special thanks to Dhananjay Gowda for making the experience even more memorable with his recommendations to suit all our fussy palettes., name_person=Demetrius Errol Cordeiro D'Souza}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1}, time_line=a year ago, review=I recently revisited this upscale Chinese restaurant for brunch, despite previous underwhelming experiences. Unfortunately, the lack of natural light and overuse of tacky blue lights remained a major turnoff. The ambiance, while appealing to some, doesn’t  resonate with me.
The food, while reasonably priced during brunch, didn't change my opinion about Chinese cuisine in Bombay. It still feels like a generic Chinese restaurant in a five-star hotel.

On a positive note, the staff was attentive and well-trained, with noticeably more staff members on deck. The addition of a smoking cabin upstairs was convenient, and the toned-down music was a welcome change. The unlimited flow of good brand cocktails was a great value.

While this restaurant still isn't my favorite, I appreciate the positive changes in price, smoking area, and music volume., name_person=Chirag Patel}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Soup, Dumpling], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Dietary_restrictions, E:OTHER_DIETARY_RESTRICTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Not sure, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION]}, time_line=a year ago, review="Hakkasan, Bandra West, is a stylish and sophisticated spot, but the food doesn't quite live up to the hype. Ambiance: 5/5 - Elegant decor, perfect for special occasions. Service: 5/5 - Attentive and knowledgeable staff. Food: 3/5 - While the Cantonese cuisine is good, it's not exceptional. Some dishes feel overpriced and lacking in flavor. Must-try dishes include the Peking Duck, but other options are hit-or-miss. Cocktails: 5/5 - Innovative and expertly crafted. Overall, Hakkasan is a great spot for a night out, but foodies might find it just average. Rating: 3.5/5 stars", name_person=Lakshita Agarwal}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Breakfast, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Classic_Hakka_Steam_Dimsum_Platter, Dark_Chocolate_Mousse_with_Mandarin_Sorbet, Soup, Half_Peking_Duck], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=11 months ago, review=Had the pleasure of dining at Hakkasan in Mumbai, and I have to say, the atmosphere is fantastic. The setting is modern and sleek, with comfortable seating and a stylish bar that creates a welcoming vibe. It’s definitely one of the top Chinese restaurants in Mumbai, but while the ambiance is spot on, it doesn’t quite deliver in terms of traditional Chinese authenticity.

The staff were friendly and attentive, always ready to assist. We ordered the Peking duck, which was, unfortunately, underwhelming. The preparation was just okay—the skin wasn’t crispy, and the duck itself was on the smaller side but came from Thailand. Traditionally, the creases would be used for a soup or stir-fry, but they were left unused here. A bit disappointing considering the cost and overall taste.

On a positive note, the dim sum was quite good, and I was impressed by how they cater to a wide range of dietary preferences, with no lard used in their offerings. We also tried the stir-fried buffalo, which was surprisingly delicious—tender, not too gamey, and packed with flavor.

The drinks were excellent, and it would’ve been nice to see the tea served personally as needed, perhaps with a selection of puer on the menu for added depth?

As for dessert, I think they could elevate the experience by adding some authentic Chinese options instead of just only the Western-style desserts.

The desserts, while good, leaned more towards Western-style offerings. I would love to see some traditional Chinese desserts added to the menu for an authentic touch.

All in all, it was a very enjoyable experience. The service was excellent, and the atmosphere was top-notch, though there’s room for improvement in the authenticity and food preparation. Still, I would recommend it for a refined and relaxed dining experience in Mumbai., name_person=Chrisy Macau}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Classic_Hakka_Steam_Dimsum_Platter], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a year ago, review=Staff is really good with recommendations and well trained. Food is definitely on expensive side. So don't expect huge portions like some critics. But, all dishes had very unique and great flavours. Atmosphere feels cozy and comfortable. Sometimes so comfortable that you might feel sleepy.
Hakka Dimsun platter is a must. For drinks got sour and spicy cocktail also a Hakka special which had coconut in it. For dessert we got an off the menu item which was Sweet Caviar with chocolate and ice cream, really unique taste., name_person=Ishan K}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Nice location staff as well service also......food and drinks superbly served}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Soup : Veg - Hot and Sour/ Non Veg Sweet corn Chicken Soup Review good 2.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Best continental food ,the Chinese dishes are so tasty can’t stop eating}"]

reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=a week ago, review=I absolutely love Earthbun Café! It’s the perfect spot for anyone looking for vegan, protein-rich, and wholesome food that actually tastes amazing. The menu is thoughtfully curated — from protein-packed bowls to burgers and wraps, everything feels fresh, balanced, and full of flavor.
The ambience is calm, welcoming, and perfect for enjoying a meal without feeling rushed. I especially loved their Beet Buzz Bowl, Wah Rajma Wrap, and Cold Coffee 2.0 — every bite shows the care and quality they put into their ingredients.
Whether you’re health-conscious, vegan, or just looking for clean, satisfying meals, Earthbun Café is a must-visit in Khar West. I’ll definitely be coming back!, name_person=Radhika Supal}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=a month ago, review=Absolutely loved my experience at EarthBuns! This place is truly redefining what “healthy indulgence” means. We tried their burgers, wraps, warm salad bowls, and cold coffee, and every single item surprised us in the best way possible.

What stood out instantly is how clean yet flavor-packed everything tasted. Their gluten-free, zero-guilt burgers are honestly a game changer — no atta, no maida, no refined sugar, and yet the buns and patties were super satisfying. The air-fried plant-based patty and vegetable fries felt so light but still indulgent, something you hardly ever find in “healthy” food.

The wraps were high-protein, gluten-free, and filled with fresh, crunchy veggies — genuinely delicious without feeling heavy. The warm salad bowl was another highlight; wholesome, hearty, and full of bold flavors that don’t make you miss regular fast food at all.

And the cold coffee? Smooth, beautifully balanced, and made without any artificial syrups — sweetened naturally and done right. Love that they also offer millet milk and almond milk options for people who prefer vegan or gut-friendly alternatives.

EarthBuns isn’t just a café — it’s a whole new way of eating without compromise. Super impressed by their concept and the honesty behind their ingredients.

If you're health-conscious, gluten-intolerant, or simply want guilt-free comfort food that still tastes amazing, this place is a must-visit.
“Healthy and Tasty” isn’t just their tagline — it’s exactly what they deliver.

Can't wait to go back and try more!, name_person=Abhijeet Devadiga}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,400–1,600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN]}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Looking for the best gluten-free café in Bandra-Khar? EarthBuns is India’s first zero-guilt fast food brand, serving air-fried burgers, wraps, bowls, shakes, and desserts that make healthy eating exciting again. We tried their Crunchy Corns Burger, Not Chicken Tikka Burger, and Crunchy Garden Wrap, and each one was bursting with unique flavours. There was no atta, no maida, no refined sugar, and definitely no compromise on taste.

The Dilli in a Bowl is a must-try warm salad bowl, comforting, filling and beautifully seasoned with Indian-inspired flavors. Pair it with their Banana Caramel Sea Salt Shake, made using real bananas, jaggery caramel and regular milk, it’s honestly one of the best healthy shakes in Mumbai. Even the Peri Peri French Fries are air-fried, making snacking guilt-free but still super satisfying.

Whether you are looking for gluten-free burgers in Mumbai, vegan-friendly wraps, or refined sugar-free desserts, EarthBuns has set a new benchmark. Every dish reflects their commitment to clean eating, sustainability, and big flavors. It’s not just a meal, it’s a movement for mindful indulgence., name_person=Farhan Shaikh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[OH_so_Chocolaty, All_Veggie_Burger], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_STREET_PARKING, Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN]}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Earthbuns, Khar—where cozy vibes meet bold flavors that hit you right in the taste buds.

Their Beet Buzz Bowl salad: crunchy, chunky and vibrant.

The sweet potato peri peri fries: Crispy, savory, and addictive and their Pure chocolate shake is worth a million dollars.

The All vegies burger - exploding with flavors in every bite.
The Wah rajma burger - Juicy and loaded.

The red Beet wrap: Fresh, zesty, perfectly spiced.

Earthbuns isn’t just a cafe—it’s a full-on flavor adventure that Khar just got lucky to host., name_person=S N}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 months ago, review=The moment you walk in, there’s this calm, earthy energy — warm lights, the smell of fresh bakes, and that peaceful café buzz. Their menu feels so comforting — simple, wholesome, but packed with flavor. I tried the truffle mushroom burger and, wow… that umami hit was perfection. 🍔 The sourdough buns are soft, fresh, and you can actually taste the quality. And those sweet potato fries? Total must-have. Everything just feels… clean, nourishing, and made with care. It’s one of those places that makes you slow down and just enjoy your meal. If you love mindful food with cozy café vibes — Earthbuns, Khar should definitely be on your list., name_person=Anjana Narula}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=4 months ago, review=We had a wonderful experience at EarthBuns ,a vegan and completely plant-forward cafe that truly stands out for its clean, creative, and wholesome offerings.

I recently visited with friends, and the experience reminded me exactly why this place is considered a classic. The moment you enter, the quirky garage-themed decor pulls you in—number plates, car parts, the iconic Beetle overhead, dim lights, and a vibe that instantly makes you feel like you’ve stepped into an old-school rock pub.

The music is easily the best part of Toto’s. Their playlist is always on point, with rock classics, indie hits, and the kind of tracks that make conversations flow and the mood lift automatically. It’s loud enough to create energy but not overwhelming, and the crowd is always a great mix of regulars, college kids, and working professionals just looking to unwind.

The food and drinks are fairly priced for Bandra, and everything we ordered tasted fresh. The chicken wings, nachos, and their signature cocktails are must-tries. Service is quick, friendly, and no-nonsense—exactly what you expect from a legendary neighbourhood pub.

What I appreciate most is the consistency. Even after all these years, Toto’s still feels authentic, cozy, and full of character. It’s one of those places where you can go with friends, have a good laugh, enjoy great music, and genuinely feel at ease.

If you’re in Bandra and want a laid-back night with good vibes, Toto’s Garage is a no-brainer. Another good thing is the service, staff atitude, they are informed and very sweet. Btw they didn't add service charge to the bill so I left a 100 Rs. tip for their amazing service..

Worth it.. and the restaurant is just outside of ghatkopar east exit of rlw station. You exit and cross the road you'll find the building and go to 7th floor and you'll reach. A big thank you to team Trio Spice for making lunch so special.

Ordered the Paneer Rice and Mushroom Rice—both were extremely oily and lacked proper flavor. The amount of oil made the food feel heavy and unpleasant.
